src: Tincumo teKhabhinethi mayelana netindzaba letigcamile kulesimo sanyalo.
tgt: Seemo sa Kabinete mo mererong e e kwa setlhoeng mo maemong a ga jaanong.

src: IKhabhinethi ivete kukhatsateka kwayo ngelutfutfuva lwakamuva nje lwetisebenti tasemayini iLonmin eMarikana loluholele ekudvubeni umsebenti kanye nasekuphatanyisweni kwemkhicito.
tgt: Kabinete e tlhagisitse matshwenyego a yona tebang le dikhuduego tsa fa gautshwane tse di bakileng go ngala tiro le go kgoreletsa tlhagiso kwa Moepong wa Lonmin kwa Marikana.

src: Kubikwe kutsi lokungevani kahle kubangwa ludzaba lwekumelwa kwelinyenti letisebenti lokusemkhatsini kwetinhlangano tetisebenti letimbili lokuyi-National Union of Mineworkers (NUM) kanye ne-Association for Mining and Construction Union (AMCU).
tgt: Go begwa fa mooko wa kgotlhang e le ntlha ya kemedi e kgolo go gaisa e e akaretsang Mokgatlho wa Bosetšhaba wa Badiramoepong (NUM) le Mokgatlho wa Meepo le Boagi (AMCU).Kabinete e ikuela kwa boeteledipeleng jwa mekgatlho ka bobedi (NUM le AMCU) go rarabolola dikgotlhang tsa bona ka kagiso le go baya dikgatlhegelo tsa naga le badiri godimo ga tsotlhe.

src: IKhabhinethi icela buholi baletinhlangano letimbili i-NUM ne-AMCU kutsi busombulule kungevani kwabo ngekuthula nekutsi bubeke embili timfuno telive netetisebenti.
tgt: Badiri ba tshwanetse go lemoga gore mogwanto yo o sa sireletsegang o ka nna le ditlamorago tse di bosula mo badiring le mo isagong ya meepo le ditiro tsa bone.

src: IKhabhinethi yenta sicelo nakubaphatsi beLonmin kutsi bente konkhe lokusemandleni abo kucinisekisa kutsi tinkinga letikhona tisonjululwa ngekushesha ngembi kwekutsi umonakalo uchubekele embili.
tgt: Gape Kabinete e ikuela kwa botsamaising jwa Lonmin go dira tsotlhe tse di kgonegang go netefatsa gore mathata a rarabololwa ka bonako jo bo ka kgonegang kwa ntle ga ditshenyegelo tse dingwe.

src: Kuyinshisekelo yelive kutsi letinhlangano letimbili kanye nebaphatsi beLonmin bakhombise buholi lobudzingekako kanye nekusingatfwa kwebudlelwane emsebentini.
tgt: Go mo dikgatlhegong tsa naga le mekgatlho ka bobedi mmogo le botsamaisi jwa Lonmin go supa boeteledipele jo bo tlhokegang le tsamaiso ya dikamano tsa badiri.

src: IKhabhinethi iyesekela ngalokugcwele imiphumela leyandvulelako yeluphenyo lolumayelana nekuhlaliswa kwendiza yangasese lokungamange kugunyatwe eSikhumulweni Setindiza Tembutfo i-Waterkloof.
tgt: Kabinete e tshegetsa ka botlalo diphitlhelelo tsa pulamadibogo tsa patlisiso ya go tsuruma go go sa letlelelwang ga sefofane sa banamedi kwa Boemelafofaneng jwa Sesole jwa Waterkloof.

src: IKhabhinethi igcizelele kutsi kuphepha nemandla ekulawula eNingizimu Afrika kuyintfo lebaluleke kakhulu.
tgt: Kabinete e gateletse gore pabalesego le go ikemela ga Aforika Borwa go botlhokwa thata.

src: Kwephulwa kwemitsetfo lemayelana nemachweba ekungena eliveni kanye netikhungo tavelonkhe letibalulekile kumele kubukanwe nako ngesandla lesicinile nangaphandle kwekuvuna kumbe kwesekela luhlangotsi lolutsite.
tgt: Go tshwanetse ga samaganwa le kgatako ya melao le melawana e e malebana le matseno le ditlamelo tsa botlhokwa tsa setšhaba ka tsepamo, kwa ntle ga letshogo gongwe go direla yo mongwe molemo.

src: Laba lokutfolakala kutsi bephule nobe bacegise imitsetfo kumele babukane nesandla semtsetfo.
tgt: Ba go fitlhelwang ba tlola gongwe ba nyatsa melawana ba tshwanetse go lebagana le bogale jotlhe jwa molao.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukela umsebenti lowentiwe ngeMatiko aHulumende lokubikwe Tindvuna tematiko lahlukene ngesikhatsi Sekwetfulwa Kwemcombelelo wematiko.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela tiro ya Mafapha a Puso e e begilweng ke Ditona tse di farologaneng ka nako ya Ditekanyetsokabo tsa mafapha.

src: IKhabhinethi itfole kutsi kusakatwa kwaletiwombe Tekwetfulwa Kwemcombelelo wematiko kuyasita ekuhlomiseni ummango ngelwati kuphindze kwente kutsi hulumende abe nekutiphendvulela esiveni.
tgt: Kabinete e lemoga gore go begwa ga Ditekanyetsokabo go thusa go maatlafatsa baagi ka tshedimosetso le go rwesa puso maikarabelo.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukela tinkhulumiswano emkhatsini weLitiko Letemfundvo Lesisekelo kanye nenhlangano yabothishela i-South African Democratic Teachers' Union (SADTU) lokutinkhulumiswano letiholele ekumisweni kwemshuco.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela dipuisano tse di lebisitseng kwa go sekegiweng ga dikgato tsa ngongorego magareng ga Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le Mokgatlho wa Temokerasi wa Barutabana wa Aforika BorwaKabinete e ikuela mo batsayakarolong botlhe mo lephateng la thuto go rarabolola dikgotlhang tsa bone gore thuto ya bana e se ke ya amega.

src: IKhabhinethi ibita bonkhe badlalindzima emkhakheni wetemfundvo kutsi basombulule kungevani kwabo kute imfundvo yelusha lwakitsi ingetuphazamiseka.
tgt: Kabinete e itemogetse Tshekatsheko ya Kotara ya Palo ya Badiri e e bontshang koketsego ya seelo sa botlhokatiro go tloga go diphesente di le 24,9 go ya go diphesente di le 25,2.Puso e akofisa dikgato di tshwana le letsholo le le eteletsweng pele ke mmuso la mafaratlhatlha, go oketsa ditiro ka ditsereganyo tsa Lephata la Setšhaba.

src: Hulumende ngekubambisana nemkhakha wetisebenti kanye newemabhizinisi wetfule Sivumelwano Setenhlalakahle lesimayelana Nekucashwa Kwelusha ngaMabasa 2013.
tgt: Puso mmogo le lephata la badiri le kgwebo, ba tlhomile Tumelano ya Loago ya Go Thapiwa ga Bašwa ka Moranang 2013.

src: Loku kuphindze kukhombise kutibophetela ngekubambisana ekusombululeni ludzaba lwekungasebenti.
tgt: Seno se bontsha gape maitlamo a a tlhakanetsweng malebana le go samagana le ntlha ya botlhokatiro.

src: Kuhlahla indlela yekutsi umkhakha ngamunye utibophetele ekufakeni sandla ekulweni nekungasebenti kwelusha ngekubeka imigomo netikhatsi lokutakwenteka ngato, kulandzelelwa kanye nekuhlolwa ngekubambisana kwaloko kungenela lokuphawuliwe.
tgt: E tlhalosa maikano a maphata a a farologaneng tebang le go tsayakarolo mo go lwantsheng botlhokatiro jwa bašwa ka dipeelo tse di tsepameng le nako e e beilweng go lebeletswe tiragatso, tlhokomelo mmogo le tshekatsheko e e tlhakanetsweng ya ditsereganyo tse di supilweng.

src: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba lekutsi lemikhankhaso lesevele ichubeka itawusita lelive kutsi lisungule ematfuba emisebenti lemisha liphindze lifeze imigomo letibekele yona yekwakha imisebenti lemisha letigidzi letisihlanu ungekafiki mnyaka weti-2020.
tgt: Kabinete e na le bonnete jwa gore dikgato tse di setseng di tsentswe tirisong di tla thusa naga go tlhama ditiro tse dintšhwa le go fitlhelela diphitlhelelo tse di totilweng tsa ditiro tse dintšhwa di le dimilione di le tlhano ka 2020.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukela kusayindwa kweluhlelo lwekwenta lokutawuholela ekusebenteni Kwesivumelwano Sekuvana mayelana Nekulondvolotwa kanye neKuvikelwa Kwemvelo emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika kanye ne Vietnam.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go saeniwa ga leano la tiragatso go tsenya tirisong Memorantamo wa Ditumelano o o ka ga Tshomarelo le Tshireletso ya Ditshedi tse di Farologaneng magareng ga Aforika Borwa le Vietnam.

src: Kusebenta Kwaloluhlelo kutawuchubeka kudzimate kube ngu-2017 kantsi kutawusita emitamweni yekulwa nebugebengu lokufaka ekhatsi tilwane tasendle, ikakhulukati kutingelwa kwabobhejane.
tgt: Leano la Tiragatso le tla dira go fitlha ka 2017 mme le tla thusa maiteko a go lwantsha bosenyi jo bo amang diphologolo tsa naga, bogolo segolo bogodu jwa go tumola dinaka tsa ditshukudu.

src: IKhabhinethi yengeta ngekutsi Hulumende utibophetele ekulweni nalesihlava sekutingelwa kwabobhejane iphindze icinisekise nekutsi tigilamkhuba tiyashushiswa.
tgt: Kabinete e boeletsa gore Puso e itlamile go samagana le leroborobo la bogodu jwa go tumola dinaka tsa ditshukudu mme e boa e itlama gore ba ba molato ba tla sekisiwa.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukela simemetelo seLitiko Letasekhaya sekuhlola kusebenta kweluhlelo Lwabomatisi Bemakhadi, lokuyintfo letawucinisa iphindze itfutfukise kuvikeleka kwebuve betfu.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela kitsiso ya Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae go lekeletsa Thulaganyo ya karata ya Boitshupo, e e gokaganyang boitshupo jwa rona jwa bosetšhaba mme e tokafatse tshireletsego ya bosetšhaba.

src: Lomgamu lobaluleke nakangaka utawukhona kunonophisa kwetfulwa kwetinsita lokwentiwa nguhulumende, ngakulolunye luhlangotsi ube unciphisa bugebengu nenkhohlakalo letsintsa bomatisi.
tgt: Go na le kgonagalo ya gore phitlhelelo eno ya botlhokwa e ka akofisa ditirelo tsa puso, fa e tla bo e fokotsa bosenyi le bobodu jo bo amanang le makwaloitshupo.

src: IKhabhinethi ibita takhamiti taseNingizimu Afrika kutsi tesekele loluhlelo kute kutsi nga-2020 sibe sonkhe sesinabomatisi bemakhadi njengendlela lekhombisa buve betfu.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng go tshegetsa tsamaiso eno gore ka 2020 rotlhe re bo re amogetse Karata ya Boitshupo jaaka karolo ya boitshupo jwa bosetšhaba.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakugceka kuhlaselwa kwetincola tetitfunywa Tamhlabuhlangene e-Abyei, eSudan, lokuholele ekufeni kwendvuna yesive kanye nemgcini wekuthula wase-Ethiopia.
tgt: Kabinete e nyatsa tlhaselo e e bakileng dintsho tsa kgosi ya morafe le modiri wa kagiso wa Itopia mo mokolokong wa Ditšhabakopano kwa Abyei, Sudan.

src: Lesento lesilishwa sicekela phasi lutinto lwase-Abyei kanye nenchubekelembili lebonakele kamuva nje eSudan naseNingizimu Sudan.
tgt: Tiragalo eno e e swabisang e tshosetsa go tsepama ga Abyei gammogo le tswelelopele e e sa tswang go fitlhelelwa ke Sudan le Sudan o o kwa Borwa.

src: IKhabhinethi igceka kuhlaselwa kweSiriya lokwentiwa ngumbutfo wetekuvikela waka-Israeli.
tgt: Kabinete e nyatsa tlhaselo ya Seria e e dirilweng ke masole a tshireletso a Iseraele.

src: IKhabhinethi ibita Mhlabuhlangene kutsi atibonakalise kumbutfo wetekuvikela wangaphandle kute kuvikelwe emandla ekutimela kweSiriya kuphindze kuvunyelwe bantfu baseSiriya kutsi basebentisane ekusonjululweni kwekungevani kwabo.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go Ditšhabakopano go netefatsa gore maphata a kwa ntle a tlotla go ikemela ga Seria le go letla maSeria go dira mmogo go rarabolola dikgotlhang tsa ona.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukele kubekwa kweMmeli Lawrence Mushwana njengaSihlalo lomusha weLikomiti Lekusebenta Kwemave Emhlaba (ICC) Letikhungo Tavelonkhe Tekutfutfukiswa Nekuvikelwa Kwemalungelo Eluntfu.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go tlhomiwa ga Moatefokate Lawrence Mushwana jaaka Modulasetilo o montšhwa wa Komiti ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya Kgokaganyo (ICC) ya Ditheo tsa Bosetšhaba tsa Tsweletso le Tshireletso ya Ditshwanelo tsa Botho.

src: Loku kukwekucala kutsi i-Afrika iphatse lihhovisi laSihlalo we-ICSikhundla saSihlalo we-ICC senta kutsi kwandze kugcila kwalelive emlandvweni wemalungelo eluntfu kanye nekuhambisana kwalo nemibandzela yemave emhlaba lemayelana nemalungelo eluntfu.
tgt: Ke la ntlha Aforika e etelela pele kantoro ya Modulasetilo wa ICMaemo a Modulasetilo wa ICC a netefatsa tebo e e oketsegileng mo rekotong ya ditshwanelo tsa botho ya naga gammogo le kobamelo ya yona ya maitlamo a boditšhabatšhaba a ditshwanelo tsa botho.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukele kugujwa kweminyaka lengema-50 kwasungulwa Inhlangano Yelubumbano Lwe-Afrika (OAU) lesitakube sikubungata Ngelusuku Lwe-Afrika, mhlaka 25 Inkhwenkhweti 2013.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse segopotso sa bo 50 sa Mokgatlho wa Tshwaragano ya Aforika (OAU) se se tla ketikiwang ka Letsatsi la Aforika, la bo 25 Motsheganong 2013.

src: IKhabhinethi ivete kutsi kubumbana kwe-OAU ekukhipheni inyumbatane hulumende welubandlululo etinhlakeni tawo kwanika emandla umzabalazo wetfu wenkhululeko kanye nekutfolakala kwentsandvo yelinyenti.
tgt: Kabinete e sedifaditse gore kemonokeng ya OAU ya go se akaretse puso ya tlhaolele mo ditokololong tsa yona e maatlafaditse kgaratlho ya rona ya kgololesego le phitlhelelo ya temokerasi.

src: INingizimu Afrika itawuhlanganyela nelivekati ekugujweni kweminyaka lengema-50 kwasungulwa Bunye be-Afrika.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e tla golagana le kontinete go keteka Segopotso sa bo 50 sa Tshwaragano ya Aforika.

src: Lokutakwentiwa kufaka ekhatsi umbukiso wenyanga yonkhe webuciko lobubonwako besikhatsi salamuhla esigodzini se-SADC kusukela mhlaka 24 Inkhwenkhweti kuya kumhlaka 28 Inhlaba 2013.
tgt: Ditiragalo di akaretsa dipontsho tsa kgwedi yotlhe tsa botsweretshipono mo kgaolong ya SADC go tloga ka la bo 24 Motsheganong go fitlha ka la bo 28 Seetebosigo 2013.

src: Sikhungo i-Africa Institute of South Africa naso sitawuhlanganisa ummango wetifundziswa nalabahlakatekile njengencenye yemigubho ngamhlaka 19-21 Inkhwenkhweti 2013.
tgt: Setheo sa tsa Aforika sa Aforika Borwa se tla kokoanya barutegi le ba ditšhaba jaaka karolo ya segopotso ka la bo 19-21 Motsheganong 2013.

src: Ngetulu kwaloko, kutakuba nembukiso eMnyuziyamu iDitsong (KuMkandludolobha WaseTshwane) ngenhloso yekugubha Lusuku Lwe-Afrika mhlaka-21 Inkhwenkhweti 2013 ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi “Ngemuva Kweminyaka lengema-50 kwasungulwa Inhlangano Yelubumbano lwe-Afrika – i-Afrika kumele ibumbane nobe iChitseke”.
tgt: Godimo ga moo, go tla nna le dipontsho kwa Musiamong wa Ditsong (Motsemogolo wa Tshwane) go keteka Letsatsi la Aforika ka la bo 21 Motsheganong 2013 ka moono wa "Dingwaga tse 50 morago ga go tlhamiwa ga OAU - Aforika e tshwanetse go tshwaragana kgotsa e nyelele."

src: Loku kutawulandzelwa yikhonsathi yemculo weLusuku Lwe-Afrika eTakhiweni Temdibaniso mhlaka-25 Inkhwenkhweti 2013.
tgt: Seno se tla latelwa ke konsarata ya mmino ya Letsatsi la Aforika kwa Union Buildings ka la bo 25 Motsheganong 2013.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukele kuphendvula ngekushesha kwaMengameli Jacob Zuma kusimemo selilunga lemmango sekutsi avakashele bantfu base-Eldorado Park kanye nabomakhelwane bayo iKliptown, ngeLesibili, mhlaka 14 Inkhwenkhweti 2013.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse tsibogelo ya ka bonako ya Moporesitente Jacob Zuma mo taletsong ya moagi gore a etele batho ba kwa Eldorado Park le ba kwa Kliptown e e gaufi, ka Labobedi, la bo 14 Motsheganong 2013.

src: Ummango bewucele kutewukhulumisana naMengameli ngenkinga leyandzako yekungasetjentiswa kahle kanye nekushushumbiswa ngalokungekho emtsetfweni kwetidzakamiva kulendzawo.
tgt: Kopo ya baagi e ne e le malebana le go buisanela go gola ga kgwebo e e seng mo molaong ya diritibatsi le bothata jwa tiriso ya tsone e e botlhaswa mo tikologong eo.

src: Hulumende ngekubambisana nemmango utibophetele ekunonophiseni luhlelo lwekungenelela ekucedzeni lesihlava lesicedza bantfu labasha.
tgt: Puso, mmogo le baagi, ba itlamile go akofisa lenaneo la tsereganyo go emisa leroborobo le le bolayang bašwa.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukele kuvakasha lokulandzela kwangaphambilini kweLisekelamengameli Motlanthe, lapho belihambisana khona nebaholi betinhlaka tahulumende letintsatfu, kuya eDe Doorns eNshonalanga Kapa ngeMgcibelo mhlaka 11 Inkhwenkhweti 2013.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse ketelo ya tatediso ya Motlatsamoporesitente Motlanthe, a patilwe ke baeteledipele ba magato a le mararo a puso, go ya kwa De Doorns kwa Kapa Bophirima ka Lamatlhatso, la bo 11 Motsheganong 2013.

src: Loluhambo netinkhulumiswano nalabatsintsekako kufaka ekhatsi tisebenti tasemapulazini kusukela ekuvakasheni kwangaphambilini kweLisekelamengameli ngamhlaka-12 Indlovana 2013.
tgt: Ketelo le dipuisano le baamegi ba ba akaretsang badiri ba dipolase e latela ketelo ya ntlha ya Motlatsamoporesitente ka la bo 12 Tlhakole 2013.

src: Kube khona inchubekelembili lecinile ematikweni ahulumende lamanyenti ekwetfulweni kwetinsita kulendzawo.
tgt: Go lemogilwe tswelelopele e e tsepameng ya go tokafatsa ditirelo mo tikolong eo go tswa mo mafapheng a le mmalwa.

src: Lokutibophetela lokukhonjiswe ngito tonkhe tinhlangotsi kubeka sisekelo lesicinile kulokukhulumisana lokuchubekako lokubange ekutseni kube nelutinto kulomkhakha wetekulima.
tgt: Maitlamo a a bontshitsweng ke maphata otlhe ke motheo wa dipuisano tse di tswelelang go lebeletswe gore go nne le lephata la leruri la temothuo.

src: Tinkhulumiswano netincumo teKhabhinethi letihamba embili.
tgt: Dipuisano le ditshweetso tsa botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.

src: IKhabhinethi yatiswe ngemalungiselelo eLiviki Lekuvikelwa Kwebantfwana (CPW) emkhatsini wamhlaka-27 Inkhwenkhweti namhlaka-2 Inhlaba 2013, ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kubambisana ekuvikeleni bantfwana.”Tinkhulumomphikiswano letimayelana nebantfwana kanye nelusha tibanjwe kuto tonkhe tifundza njengesendlalelo sekwetfulwa kweLiviki Lekuvikelwa kwebantfwana kanye neNgcungcutsela.
tgt: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka dithulaganyo tsa Beke ya Tshireletso ya Bana (CPW) magareng ga 27 Motsheganong le 2 Seetebosigo 2013 ka moono wa "Re dira mmogo go sireletsa bana.

src: Njengencenye yekwatisa, Liviki Lekuvikelwa Kwebantfwana litakwetfulwa ngesikhatsi sinye neNgcungcutsela Yetintsandzane, Bantfwana Labasengotini kanye neLusha (OVCY) ngamhlaka-27 Inkhwenkhweti e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: "Go tsweletswe ka dipuisano tsa bana le bašwa mo diporofenseng tsotlhe go baakanyetsa go tlhomiwa ga CPW le Khonferense.

src: IKhabhinethi icela tonkhe takhamiti taseNingizimu Afrika kutsi tifake sandla ekuvikeleni bantfwana betfu kanye nasekwakheni simo lesiphephile nalesivikelekile.
tgt: Jaaka karolo ya go oketsa temogo, CPW e tla tlhomiwa mmogo le Khonferense ya Dikhutsana, Bana le Bašwa ba ba mo Matshosetsing (OVYC), ka la bo 27 Motsheganong kwa Tikwatikweng ya Bosetšhaba ya Dikopano ya Inkosi Albert Luthuli kwa KwaZulu Natal.

src: Takhamiti taseNingizimu Afrika tingakhombisa kwesekela kwato ngalokubonakalako ngekutsi tigcoke iribhoni leluhlata kwetjani njengeluphawu lwemphilo, kukhula, litsemba, kunakekela kanye nekwesekela baholi betfu bakusasa.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe go tshayakarolo mo tshireletsong ya bana ba rona le go tlhama tikologo e e babalesegileng e bile e sireletsegile.

src: Liviki Lekuvikelwa Kwebantfwana kanye neNgcungcutsela Yetintsandzane, Bantfwana Labasengotini kanye neLusha kugcile ekubambiseni lichaza kwemntfwana esiveni nasemimangweni yetfu kute kutowulalelwa tintfo letitsintsa bantfwana.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a ka bontsha tshegetso ya ona ka go apara lente le le tala jaaka letshwao la go supa botshelo, kgolo, tsholofelo, tlhokomelo le tshegetso ya baeteledipele ba rona ba isago.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukele Luhlaka Lwenchubomgomo Yekudla Lokutfolakala Emantini (NAPF).
tgt: CPW le OVYC di lebeletse seabe sa baagi gore bana ba reediwe malebana le merero e e ba amang.

src: Lenchubomgomo iniketa luhlaka lolubumbene lwekusungulwa nekutfutfukiswa kwemboni letawufaka sandla ekwakhiweni kwemisebenti nasekwenyusweni kwekusisa lokusimeme.
tgt: Pholisi eno e tlamela ka letlhomeso le le kopaneng la go tlhamiwa le go tlhabololwa ga intaseteri e e tsayang karolo mo go tlhamiweng ga ditiro tsa leruri mmogo le dipeeletso tse di oketsegileng.

src: I-NAPF yasungulwa ngekubuka umkhakha wekudla lokutfolakala emantini wemave emhlaba lokubonakele kunesidzingo lesikhulako semkhicito wetinhlanti.
tgt: NAPF e tlhamilwe go lebeletswe lephata la boruatlhapi le le itemogetseng koketsego ya go batlega ga dikuno tsa ditlhapi.

src: ENingizimu Afrika, kudla lokutfolakala emantini kuniketa litfuba lelihle lekwehlukanisa umkhicito wekukhicitwa kwetinhlanti kute kwenetiswe sidzingo salapha ekhaya, kufake sandla ekutfolakaleni kwekudla, ekusungulweni kwemisebenti, ekutfutfukisweni kwetemnotfo nasekutfutfukisweni kwetindzawo tasemakhaya kanye nematfuba ekutfumela umkhicito emaveni angaphandle.
tgt: Mo Aforika Borwa, boruatlhapi jwa mo lewatleng le mo metsing a a foreše bo tlamela ka tšhono e e siameng ya go atolosa tlhagiso ya ditlhapi go kgotsofatsa tlhokego ya selegae, go tsayakarolo mo tlhagisong e e sa tlhaeleng ya dijo, go tlhama ditiro, go tlhabolola ikonomi mmogo le go tlhabolola metseselegae, gammogo le ditšhono tsa thomelontle.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ibambe iNgcungcutsela Yesitsatfu Yemave Emhlaba Kutekulima, Kutfolakala Kwekudla kanye Nekugucugucuka Kwesimo Selitulu ekoteni yesine yemnyaka wa-2013, letawuholwa Litiko Letekulima, Temahlatsi Netinhlanti.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse gore Aforika Borwa, e eteletswe pele ke Lefapha la Temothuo, Jalo ya Dikgwa le Bodirelatlhapi, e amogele Khonferense ya Boraro ya Lefatshe ya Temothuo, Tlhagiso e e sa Tlhaeleng ya Dijo le Phetogo ya Tlelaemete mo kotareng ya bone ya 2013.Tlhagiso e e sa tlhaeleng ya dijo e sa ntse e le ntlha e e tshwenyang go gaisa mme Khonferense e tla nna le ditlamorago tse di siameng tebang le ka moo re tlhagisang, re tsamaisang le go dirisa dijo ka gona.

src: Kutfolakala kwekudla kuhlala kuyintfo lekhatsatako kantsi leNgcungcutsela itakuba nemitselela lemihle mayelana nekutsi sikukhicita njani, sikuphatsa njani nekutsi sikusebentisa njani kudla.
tgt: Fa e sa le ka COP17/MP7, Aforika Borwa e ntse e le nngwe ya dinaga tse di eteletseng pele mo go tsweletseng temothuo e e botlhale e e tsibogelang dikgwetlho tsa go nna teng ga dijo mmogo le phetogo ya tlelaemete.

src: Kusukela ngesikhatsi seNgcungcutsela Yekugucugucuka Kwesimo selitulu i- COP17/CMP7, iNingizimu Afrika ibe live lelihamba embili ekutfutfukiseni simo lesikhutsata tekulima, lokuyimphendvulo yetinselele tekutfolakala kwekudla kanye nekugucugucuka kwesimo selitulu.
tgt: Maikaelelo a Khonferense ya Lefatshe ke go tlhama mekgwa ya kgolo e e ka dirisegang go ya go ile mo loagong le mo tikologong.

src: INgcungcutsela Yemave Emhlaba ihlose kutfutfukisa tinhlelo tekukhula letisimeme kutenhlalo nakutemvelo.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse tlhomamiso ya Aforika Borwa ya Mametlelelo ya Tlhokomelo ya Ditshedi le Tlhokomelo ya Dijalo (SPS) mo Mametlelelong ya Molao wa Kgwebisano ya Dinaga tsa Mokgatlho wa Tlhabololo ya Borwa jwa Aforika (SADC) le gore e isiwe kwa Palamenteng.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume kugunyatwa kweNingizimu Afrika kutinhlelo te-Sanitary and Phytosanitary (SPS) Letiluliwe Emgudvwini Wetekuhwebelana Wemave Latfutfukako ase-Afrika leseNingizimu (SADC) kutsi loku kungeniswe ePhalamende.
tgt: Molao wa Kgwebisano ya SADC e Aforika Borwa e dumelaneng nayo e tsweletsa tirisanommogo ya kgaolo le kgolagano magareng ga dinaga tse e leng ditokololo malebana le kgwebisano ya dithoto le ditirelo mo kgaolong, go akarediwa dikumo tsa temothuo.

src: Lomgudvu Wetekuhwebelana kwe-SADC iNingizimu Afrika lewuvumele uhlose kutfutfukisa kusebentisana kulesigodzi kanye nekuhlanganyela emkhatsini wabohulumende labangemalunga kute kube nekuhwebelana etimphahleni nasetinhlelweni ngekhatsi kulesigodzi, kufaka ekhatsi imikhicito yetekulima.
tgt: Mametlelelo ya SADC SPC ya Molao wa Kgwebisano ya SADC e tlamela ka letlhomeso le le kgontshang tirisanommogo ya SPGape e tsweletsa kgokaganyo ya dikgato tsa SPS tse di ikaegileng ka seemo le kaedi ya boditšhabatšhaba go gokaganya kgwebisano e e babalesegileng le e e sa gobeleleng ya dikuno tsa temothuo mo kgaolong.

src: Kwelulwa kwe-SADC SPS Emgudvwini Wetekuhwebelana ku-SADC uniketa luhlaka lwekubambisana ku-SPKuphindze kutfutfukise kusebentisana kwetindlela te-SPS lokwesekelwe etukwemazinga nemihlahlandlela yemave emhlaba kute kuchutjwe kuhwebelana ngemkhicito wetekulima lokuphephile nalokungavuni luhlangotsi kulesigodzi.
tgt: Kabinete e sedimoseditswe ka tswelelopele e e amanang le go amogela Dikopano tsa Aforika Borwa ka ga Sekema sa Ditifikeiti tsa Tiragatso sa Kimberley (KPCS), go simolola ka la bo 4 go fitlha ka la bo 7 Seetebosigo le Kopano ya KPCS kwa Gauteng go tloga ka la bo 26 go fitlha ka la bo 29 Ngwanaitseele 2013.

src: Kubanjwa kwemihlangano ye-KPCS kutawufaka sandla ekutfutfukisweni kwemkhakha wemadayimane newetekuvakasha.
tgt: Go amogelwa ga dikopano tsa KPCS go tla tsayakarolo mo tsweletsong ya intaseteri ya ditaemane le bojanala.

src: Simo seNingizimu Afrika njengasihlalo we-KPCS senta kutsi kubonwe indzima lebalulekile iNingizimu Afrika leyidlalako emkhakheni wemadayimane emhlabeni wonkhe.
tgt: Maemo a Aforika Borwa jaaka modulasetilo wa KPCS a lemoga seabe se segolo se Aforika Borwa e nang naso mo lephateng la boditšhabatšhaba la ditaemane.

src: Njengasihlalo iNingizimu Afrika ihlose kucinisa budlelwane betekuhwebelana nemave emhlaba, ngenhloso yekuhlanganisa nekwenyusa ligalelo le-Afrika ngekhatsi ku-KPCS kanye nekufaka sandla esimeni semhlaba lesiphephile.
tgt: Jaaka modulasetilo, Aforika Borwa o ikaelela go maatlafatsa dikamano tsa kgwebo tsa boditšhabatšhaba ka maikaelelo a go golaganya le go oketsa seabe sa Aforika mo KPC le go tsayakarolo mo tikologong e e babalesegileng ya lefatshe.

src: Imitsetfosivivinywa.
tgt: Melaotlhomo.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume kushicilelwa kweMtsetfosivivinywa Lochitjiyelwe Wekubuyiselwa Kwemalungelo Emhlaba wanga-2013 kanye Nesivumelwano seTindzaba Letitsintfwa Ngumtsetfosivivinywa, kute ummango uphawule ngawo.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse go phasaladiwa ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Pusetso ya Ditshwanelo tsa Lefatshe wa 2013, le Memorantamo o o ka ga Maitlhomo a Molaotlhomo, gore baagi ba tshwaele.

src: Loku kwenta kutsi sikwati kusebenta simemetelo saMengameli Senkhulumo Layetfulela Sive yanga-2013 mayelana netichibiyelo letiphakanyiselwe uMtsetfo Wekubuyiselwa Kwemhlaba.
tgt: Seno se diragatsa kitsiso ya Moporesitente ya Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba ya 2013 malebana le dipaakanyo tse di tshitshintsweng mo go Molao wa Pusetso ya Lefatshe.

src: Loku kuhambisana nekwelulwa kwelusuku lwekufakwa kweticelo kwalabo labangamange batifake ngelusuku lwekugcina lwamhlaka-13 Ingongoni 1998 nobe labakhishelwa ngaphandle kuloluhlelo.
tgt: Seno se amana le go atolosiwa ga letlha la go tsenya dkopo tsa pusetso ya lefatshe, go kgontsha ba ba sa kgonang go tsenya dkopoi ka letlha la go tswala la bo 31 Sedimonthole 1998 gongwe ba ba neng ba sa akarediwa mo tsamaisong, go dira jalo.

src: Lokuvulwa kabusha kwekufakwa kweticelo kuholwa ngumbononchanti weLuhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwekutfutfukisa kanye Neluhlelo Loluphelele Lwekutfutfukiswa Kwetindzawo Tasemakhaya kanye nalamanye emasu ekukhula lokuhloswe ngawo kutfutfukiswa kwekubuyisana kuvelonkhe kanye nekubambisana kutenhlalakahle.
tgt: Go bulwa gape ga go tsenngwa ga dkopo go kaelwa ke ponelopele ya Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) mmogo le Lenaneo le le Akaretsang la Tlhabololo ya Metseselegae le maano a mangwe a kgolo a a ikaeletseng go tsweletsa poelano ya bosetšhaba le tomagano ya loago.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume kungeniswa ePhalamende Kwemtsetfosivivinywa Lochitjiyelwe Wetekuchumana nge-Elekthroniki.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse go tlhagisiwa ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Tlhaeletsano ya Eleketeroniki kwa Palamenteng.

src: Lesichibiyelo sibangwe kwandza kwemkhakha wetekuchumana nge-elekthroniki kanye nekutfutfuka ngesivinini kwetheknoloji lokwente kutsi kuhlale kuba khona tihlintekelo teMtsetfo letingasenamsebenti.
tgt: Paakanyo e tlhodilwe ke kgololesego ya lephata la tlhaeletsano ya eleketeroniki mmogo le kgolo e e bonako ya thekenoloji e e dirang gore go nna teng ga ditlamelo dingwe tsa Molao ono go se ke ga nna mosola.

src: Letichibiyelo tihlose kubukana nesakhiwonchanti setekuchumana nge-elekthroniki, tindleko tetekuchumana kanye nekwenta ncono sikhatsi setinhlelo tekubonisana.
tgt: Paakanyo e ikaelela go samagana le tekanyetso ya tsweletso ya kgaisano, phitlhelelo ya mafaratlhatlha a tlhaeletsano ya eleketeroniki, ditshenyegelo tsa eleketeroniki mmogo le go tokafatsa nako ya tsamaiso ya patloditirelo.

src: Umtsetfosivivinywa Wekuchibiyela wenta kube nekuhambisana emkhatsini weMtsetfo kanye nemtsetfo loshayiwe wekuhlonyiswa ngalokubanti kwalabamnyama kutemnotfo kwentiwa ncono kwetindzaba tetimvume kwentiwa ncono kwetihlintekelo tetekuncintisana kutekuhwebelana kucedvwa kwekucinana kwetilawulo kanye nekuhlintekwa kwetincenye letitsintsa loludzaba.
tgt: Molaotlhomo wa Paakanyo o lepalepanya Molao le molao wa maatlafatso e e atolositsweng ya ikonomi ya bantsho o tokafatsa dintlha tsa dilaesense o tokafatsa ditlamelo tsa dikgaisano o tlosa dikgoreletsi tsa taolo mme o na le tlamelo ya merero e e amanang le tseno.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume kungeniswa ePhalamende Kwemtsetfosivivinywa Lochitjiyelwe Wetekusakata eNingizimu Afrika (ICASA).
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse go tlhagisiwa ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Bothati jo bo Ikemetseng jwa Tlhaeletsano jwa Aforika Borwa (ICASA) kwa Palamenteng.

src: Lokuchitjiyelwa Kwemtsetfosivivinywa kuphendvula kuletinye tetindzaba letiphakanyiswe eLuhlelweni Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (NDP).Letichibiyelo teMtsetfo Wetekusakata Nombolo 13 wanga-2002 (Mtsetfo we-ICASA) tesekelwe ngaphasi kwesidzingo sekutfutfukiswa kwetikhungo kute kuciniswe kutimela kwalomkhakha.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng o tsibogela dingwe tsa dintlha tse di mo NDP.

src: Loku kutakwentiwa ngekucaciswa kwetincenye temandla awo kwenta uMtsetfo uhambisane neMtsetfo Wekulawulwa Kwetimali Tesive (PFMA) kanye nekwenta ncono kusebenta kahle kwawo.
tgt: Dipaakanyo tsa Molao wa Bothati jo bo Ikemetseng jwa Tlhaeletsano wa bo 13 wa 2002 (Molao wa ICASA) di tshegeditswe ke tlhokego ya ditokafatso tsa setheo go maatlafatsa Bothati jo bo Ikemetseng.

src: Loku kulandzela umbono wekwenta ncono kutiphendvulela nekungagodli lokutawufaka sandla kutindlelanchubo tekuphatsa letivakalako ngekhatsi ku-ICASA.
tgt: Seno e tla nna ka go sedifadiwa ga dintlha tsa maatla a jona go lepalepanya Molao thata le ditlhokego tsa Molao wa Tsamaiso ya Ditšhelete tsa Setšhaba le go tokafatsa bokgoni jwa bona.

src: Hulumende kudzingeka adlale indzima lenkhulu ekucinisekiseni kutsi umkhakha wetekuchumana nge-elekthroniki ulawulwa ngendlela leyesekela tinhloso tavelonkhe.
tgt: Seo se dirwa go totilwe go tokafatsa maikarabelo le go direla dilo mo pepeneneng e leng se se tla tsayang karolo mo taolong e e lolameng mo teng ga ICASA.

src: Loku akukameli kutsatfwe ngekutsi kuletsa imikhawulo letsite ekutimeleni kwe-ICASA.
tgt: Puso e tshwanetse go nna le seabe se se golwane go netefatsa gore lephata la tlhaeletsano ya eleketoroniki le laolwa ka tsela e e tshegetsang maitlhomo a bosetšhaba ka kakaretso.

src: Kubaluleka kwekuba nemlawuli lotimele nalongatsatsi luhlangotsi wemkhakha wetekuchumana kuyintfo lengete yagcizelelwa ngalokwecile.
tgt: Seno ga se a tshwanela go tsewa e le tshitshinyo ya go lekanyetsa go ikemela ga ICASA.

src: Tincumo teKhabhinethi mayelana netindzaba letigcamile kulesimo sanyalo.
tgt: Seemo sa Kabinete mo mererong e e kwa setlhoeng mo maemong a ga jaanong.

src: IKhabhinethi icela imimango kutsi ihlale icaphe bugebengu lobuneludlame lobubhekiswe kubekuchamuka lobungaphindze bucubuke.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging go nna kelotlhoko kgatlhanong le kgonagalo ya go tsoga gape ga bosenyi jwa tirisodikgoka jo bo totileng baditšhaba.

src: IKhabhinethi icaphele kutsi loludlame ingalubiti ngeludlame lolubhekiswe kubachamuki ngobe bufakazi lobukhona kwanyalo buveta kutsi letento tiholwa bugebengu.
tgt: Kabinete e tila go ka re tirisodikgoka eno ke ya letlhoo la baditšhaba gonne bosupi jwa ga jaana bo supa gore ditiragalo tseno di susumediwa ke bosenyi.

src: IKhabhinethi iphakamise kutsi tikhungo letibukene nemtsetfo titsatse tinyatselo netincumo letiphutfumako.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse maphata a tiragatso ya molao ka ntlha ya dikgato tse di bonako le tse di maikaelelo.

src: IKhabhinethi indlulisa emavi endvudvuto kumindeni nebangani bemajaha lalahlekelwe timphilo tawo ngenca yekusoka lokungamange kuhanjiswe ngendlela lefanele.
tgt: Kabinete e romela matshidiso kwa malapeng le kwa ditsaleng tsa makawana a a latlhegetsweng ke matshelo ka ntlha ya ditiro tse di seng maleba tsa go rupisa.

src: IKhabhinethi yeleka elubitweni lwaMengameli Jacob Zuma lwekutsi kwentiwe bulungiswa ngekuphutfuma iphindze ibite baholi bendzabuko kanye nemalunga emmango kutsi bacaphe kungasentjentiswa kahle kwaloluhlelo kanye nebudedengu lobentiwako.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela boikuelo jwa Moporesitente Jacob Zuma jwa gore go diragadiwe bosiamisi ka bonako mme e ikuela mo magosing le ditokololo tsa baagi go ema kgatlhanong le tshotlakako le botlhaswa.

src: Hulumende wesekela ngalokugcwele tinkhambiso nemasiko emmango wetfu lowehlukehlukene uphindze asho kutsi kumele kutsi loku kuhambisane nemalungelo lakumtsetfosisekelo.
tgt: Puso e tshegetsa ditso tsa baagi ba rona ba ba farologaneng ka botlalo mme e gatelela gore di tshwanetse go lepalepana le ditshwanelo tsa molaotheo.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukele kubamba lichaza kweNingizimu Afrika Emhlanganweni wakamuva weBunye base-Afrika (AU), lapho iNingizimu Afrika yabeka khona tintfo letinyenti embili eluhlelweni lweMhlangano.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse seabe sa Aforika Borwa mo Samiting ya Tshwaragano ya Aforika (AU) fa gautshwane, moo Aforika Borwa e beetseng kwa pele dintlha di le mmalwa mo lenaneong la Samiti.

src: Letintfo tifaka ekhatsi Luhlelo Lwemasu eKhomishini ye-AU lwesikhatsi kusukela nga-2014-2017 kanye neLuphakelotimali lwe-AU lwanga-2014 simo sekuthula nekuvikeleka e-Afrika leminye imitfombolusito yemali yekusita i-AU Luhlelo Lwentfutfuko lwangemuva kwa-2015 umhlangano weLikomiti Letinhloko Temibuso netaboHulumende beLuhlelo Lwelidlelandzawonye Lelisha Lekutfutfukisa i-Afrika (NEPAD) kanye neNkhundla yeMhlangano weKubuyeketa Kusebenta Kwemave ase-Afrika (APRM).
tgt: Tsona di akareditse Leano la Togamaano la Khomišene ya AU mo pakeng ya 2014-2017 le Tekanyetsokabo ya AU ya 2015 seemo sa kagiso le pabalesego mo Aforika metswedi e mengwe ya tlamelo ka matlole ya AU Lenaneo la Tlhabololo la morago ga 2015 kopano ya Ditlhogo tsa Mebuso tsa Bodirisanimmogo jo Bontšhwa jwa Tlhabololo ya Aforika le Komiti ya Kitsiso ya Puso, mmogo le Samiti ya Foramo ya Thulaganyo ya Tshekatsheko ya Balekane ba Aforika.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume buholi Benhlangano Yemave Latfutfukako Wase-Afrika LeseNingizimu (SADC) kutsi buchube luhlelo lolwaholela ekutsaneni iZimbabwe yemukele uMtsetfosisekelo lomusha.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse boeteledipele jwa Mokgatlho wa Tlhabololo ya Dinaga tsa Borwa jwa Aforika ka go gokaganya thulaganyo e e lebisitseng kwa goreng Zimbabwe e amogele Molaotheo o montšhwa.

src: UMtsetfosisekelo waseZimbabwe unemgamu lobalulekile ekwetfuleni ngemphumelelo Sivumelwano Sekuthula Semave Emhlaba.
tgt: Molaotheo wa Zimbabwe ke sesupo sa tswelelopele mo tiragatsong e e atlegang ya Tumelano ya Kagiso ya Lefatshe.

src: Ngembi nje kwekucala Kwenyanga Yelusha iKhabhinethi ibita tonkhe tincenye temmango kutsi tenyuse tinhlelo tekulwa nekusetjentiswa kabi kwetidzakamiva.
tgt: Pele fela ga Kgwedi ya Bašwa, Kabinete e ikuela mo dikarolong tsotlhe tsa baagi go godisa manaane a a lwantshang tiriso e e botlhaswa ya diritibatsi.

src: Ingcikitsi yeNyanga Yelusha itsi: “Kubambisana eKutfutfukiseni Lusha kanye neNingizimu Afrika Lengasebentisi Tidzakamiva.”Sincumo saHulumende lesicinile sekubukana nekusetjentiswa kabi kwetidzakamiva e-Eldorado Park, eGauteng, sisondzeta bantfu bakulendzawo ekufezekisweni kwemmango longasebentisi tidzakamiva.
tgt: Moono wa Kgwedi ya Bašwa ke: "Re Dira Mmogo go Tlhabolola Bašwa le go bona Aforika Borwa yo o se nang Diritibatsi.

src: IKhabhinethi icaphela iphindze yemukele inchubekelembili leyentiwe ngemaphoyisa, baholi bemmango kanye naletinye tinhlaka e-Eldorado Park ngephasi kwebuholi baHulumende Wesifundza saseGauteng.
tgt: "Kgato ya puso ya go samagana le tiriso e e botlhaswa ya diritibatsi kwa Eldorado Park kwa Gauteng, e atametsa batho ba lefelo le gaufi le go fitlhelela go nna lefelo le le se nang diritibatsi.

src: IKhabhinethi iyati kutsi lesimo sase-Eldorado Park siluphawu lwetintfo letibukene nemimango leminyenti eliveni lonkhe kantsi sibita imimango eliveni lonkhe kutsi ihole imphi yekulwela iNingizimu Afrika “lengasebentisi tidzakamiva” kuto tonkhe tindzawo tayo.
tgt: Kabinete e lemoga le go amogela tswelelopele e e dirwang ke mapodisi, baeteledipele ba baagi le ditheo tse dingwe kwa Eldorado Park ka fa tlase ga boeteledipele jwa Puso ya Porofense ya Gauteng.

src: NgeNyanga Yelusha, asitibophetele futsi ekulweni nemphi yekusetjentiswa kabi kwetidzakamiva kanye netjwala kuto tonkhe tindzawo talelive.
tgt: Mmogo ba nnile le tswelelopele e e bonalang mo ntweng kgatlhanong le bosula jwa tiriso e e botlhaswa ya diritibatsi.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukela kwetfulwa kwetiLwimi Temdzabu lokwengetako eBangeni R naseBangeni 1 lapho letilwimi tisengakafundziswa khona.
tgt: Kabinete e lemoga gore seemo sa kwa Eldorado Park ke sesupo sa mathata a a lebaneng bontsi jwa baagi mo nageng ka bophara mme e ikuela mo baaging go ralalala naga go etelela pele ntwa ya go fedisa diritibatsi mo Aforika Borwa mo mafelong a WEBTOKEN Kgweding ya Bašwa, tlaya re itlameng gape go lwa ntwa kgatlhanong le tiriso e e botlhaswa ya diritibatsi le botagwa mo dikarolong tsotlhe tsa naga.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze idvumise simemetelo lesentiwe yinyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal sekwenta lulwimi lwesiZulu lube lulwimi loluphocelelwako kubafundzi labenta ticu tekucala, labangasheleli elulwimini lwesiZulu, kutsi babhalisele lolulwimi kute batfutfukise emakhono abo ekuchumana ngalo.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela kitsiso e e tla okediwang ya puo ya seAforika kwa Mophatong wa R le Mophato wa 1 koo dipuo tseno di neng di sa rutiwe teng.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhutsata tonkhe takhamiti taseNingizimu Afrika kutsi tifundze lulwimi lwemdzabu njengobe loku kukhutsata buliminyenti kuphindze kusite ekwakheni sive.
tgt: Gape Kabinete e akgola kitsiso ya Yunibesithi ya KwaZulu-Natal ya go dira gore baithuti ba ngwaga wa ntlha, ba ba sa itseng puo ya SeZulu ba patelesege go ikwadisetsa serutwa seno gore ba oketse bokgoni jwa go tlotla.

src: IKhabhinethi idzabukile ngekushona kwelucwecwe lwentsatseli Vuyo Mbuli iphindze indlulise emavi endvudvuto emndenini wakaMbuli, kubangani nakulabo labekadze asebenta nabo kulemboni yebetindzaba.
tgt: Kabinete e rotloetsa maAforika Borwa otlhe go ithuta dipuo tsa tlholego ka ntlha ya fa seno se rotloetsa go nna dipuodintsi mme se maatlafatsa kago ya setšhaba.

src: UMnuMbuli ufake sandla kakhulu ekucondziseni tinkhulumiswano tavelonkhe etindzabeni letihamba embili kantsi inshisakalo yemsebenti wakhe itsintse tinhlitiyo tetakhamiti taseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Kabinete e nopotse gore go tloga ka la bo 1 go fitlha ka la bo 3 Seetebosigo 2013, Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tla tsaya leeto la semmuso go ya Japane koo a tla tsenelang Khonferense ya Botlhano ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya Tokyo e e ka ga Tlhabololo ya Aforika (TICAD V).

src: IKhabhinethi indlulisele emavi ayo endvudvuto kutakhamiti tase-Bangladesh kanye nemindeni nebangani betisebenti tasembonini yemphahla labangetulu kwe-1 000 labashone ngalesikhatsi kudzilika sakhiwo.
tgt: Moono wa TICAD V kwa Yokohama, Japan, ke: “Re tshwaragane ka diatla le Aforika e e Mafolofolo go Gaisa.”.

src: Sivelana futsi sithandazisa bantfu base-Bangladesh.
tgt: Kabinete e utlwisitswe botlhoko ke loso la mankge wa mmegadikgang Vuyo Mbuli mme e romela matshidiso kwa lelapeng la ga Mbuli, kwa ditsaleng le kwa badiringmmogo ka ene mo lephateng la bobegakgang.

src: IKhabhinethi idzabukile ngekulahleka kanye nekulimala lokubangwe tikhukhula letinkhulu eningizimu nelive lase-China.
tgt: Rre Mbuli o tsere karolo go bonala mo go rulaganyeng dikganetsano tsa bosetšhaba mo mererong ya botlhokwa mme lerato la gagwe mo tirong ya gagwe le amile dipelo tsa maAforika Borwa.

src: Hulumende undlulisa emavi endvudvuto kumindeni, bangani, bafundzi kanye nebafundzisi balabo labatsintsekile.
tgt: Kabinete e romela matshidiso kwa baaging ba kwa Bangladesh le ba malapa le ditsala tsa badiri ba le 1 000 ba feme ya diaparo ba ba tlhokafetseng fa kago e ne e gosomana.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume kutsi Umculu lomayelana Netemaphoyisa ushicilelwe kuGazethi yaHulumende kute ummango utewuphawula ngawo.
tgt: Gape Kabinete e tlhagisitse kutlobotlhoko ka ntlha ya dintsho tsa barutwana ba le batlhano go tswa kwa motseng wa Lwandile kwa Ngqeleni, kwa Eastern Cape, ba ba tlhokafetseng mo kotsing ya bese.

src: Ngekuhlanganyela kwadzingeka kutsi bete neluhlaka lwekubukana netindzaba letibanti letimayelana netekuphepha nekuvikeleka kudzimate kube nga-2004.Lomculu udzingidza “Kubukana Nebugebengu eNingizimu Afrika Lebuswa Ngentsandvo Yelinyenti, Kucondzisa Umsebenti Wemaphoyisa kanye Nekuhlelwa Kwesikhungo.” Loku kuhlose kubeka i-SAPS esimeni lapho itawukwati khona kuphendvula ngekushesha kugucule simo sebugebengu ngalokunjalo ihlangabetane netidzingo tembuso lotfutfukako.
tgt: Fa e sa le go tlhamiwa Tirelo ya Sepodisi ya Aforika Borwa (SAPS) ka 1994, go nnile le diphetogo di le dintsi mo tikologong ya ka fa gare le kwa ntle, tse di amileng ka moo Tirelo e tlhaloganyang le go tsibogela merero ya bosenyi le pabalesego ka gona.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume Luhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwekwenta Lwebantfwana lwanga-2012-2017 njengeluhlelo loluphelele lwekuhola nekucondzisa ematiko ahulumende, ummango kanye nalabanye badlalindzima emkhakheni wetebantfwana kute kufezekiswe emalungelo ebantfwana.
tgt: Morago ga 1994, puso e ne e lebanwe ke go samagana le maitlhomo a le mabedi a go tlhama mmuso o o tlhabologang mme gape e ntse e fetola sepodisi go nna setheo sa taolo.

src: Loluhlelo luhlanganisa Umtsetfosisekelo, tivumelwano temave emhlaba netetigodzi, umtsetfo loshayiwe losacalisa lomayelana nebantfwana eNingizimu Afrika, Tinhloso Tentfutfuko kanye Nembononchanti Weluhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwentfutfuko wanga-2030.Loluhlelo lunetingcikitsi letisihlanu letibalulekile: kuphila kwebantfwana (sib.
tgt: Lokwalotshwaelo lwa Puso leno le tsibogela dikgwetlho tse di supilweng go latela tshekatsheko ya bomaleba jwa Togamaano ya Thibelo ya Bosenyi ya Bosetšhaba ya 1996 le Lokwalotemoso lwa puso lwa 1998 le le ka ga Pabalesego le Tshireletsego.

src: kuncishiswa kwelizinga lekufa kwebantfwana) kutfutfukiswa kwebantfwana (tinhlelo letibukene nekukhuliswa kwebantfwana labasebancane) kuvikelwa kwebantfwana (sib.
tgt: Mo teng ga dipholisi tseno go ne go na le ntlha ya go samagana le pabalesego le tshireletsego ka tsela e e akaretsang tlhabololo le go tsenngwa tirisong ga manaane a a kopaneng a a kgabaganyang maphata.
