src: Kudzingeka masinyane kutfutfukiswa kwendlela yekwenta umsebenti lokuhlangene kucinisekisa kutsi lusha, bafundzi, tisebenti letingenawo umsebenti lokahle kanye netakhamiti letingasebenti tifinyelele elwatini lwemsebenti losezingeni kanye nasetindleleni tekwenta umsebenti.
tgt: Go tlhokega tirelo e e gokaganeng ya tlhabololo ya tsela ya tiro ka bonako go netefatsa gore bašwa, baithuti, badiri ba ba sa direng sentle, le baagi ba ba sa direng ba fitlhelela tshedimosetso ya boleng ya ditsela tsa tiro mmogo le ditirelo tsa ditsela tsa tiro.

src: Loku kutawukwenta tikwati kwenta kukhetsa lokuhle futsi tibe nelwati lolwengetiwe ngekukhetsa umsebenti lowenta kutsi kube nekwetfulwa kwemazinga lasetulu emsebenti futsi kusite ekusimamiseni kukhula kwemnotfo eveni.
tgt: Seno se tla ba kgontsha go dira boitlhophelo jo bo botoka le jo bo sedimogileng jwa tsela ya tiro jo bo tla kgontshang seelo se se kwa godimo sa go thapiwa le go thusa go oketsa kgolo ya leruri ya ikonomi mo nageng.

src: IKhabhinethi isekela kusebentisa luhlelo lwekudzalula i-eDisclosure eMisebentini Yahulumende kusukela ngaMabasa 2014, lolungena esikhundleni seluhlelo lolwentiwa ngesandla lwekufaka, kwenta kanye nekucinisekisa kudzalulwa.
tgt: Kabinete e tshegetsa go tsenngwa tirisong ga thulaganyo ya eDisclosure mo Tirelosetšhabeng go tloga ka Moranang 2014, e e emelang ya maloba ya tlhagiso, tsamaiso le tlhomamiso ya ditshenolo.

src: I-eDisclosure iyirejista ye-elekthronikhi yekubamba kanye nekuphatsa kudzalulwa kwetimali tetisebenti letikhetsiwe (emalunga e-SMS) lokudzingeka tidzalule tinshisekelo tato letidzinga kubhaliswa kuSiphatsimandla Lesicondzisako sawo mhla tinge-30 kuMabasa njalo ngemnyaka.
tgt: eDisclosure ke rejisetara ya eleketoroniki go tsenya le go tsamaisa ditshenolo tsa ditšhelete tsa badiri ba ba rileng (ditokololo tsa SMS) ba ba tlhokang go senolela Bothatikhuduthamaga jwa bona ka dikgatlhego tsa bona tse di kwadisiwang ka la bo 30 Moranang ngwaga mongwe le mongwe.

src: Luhlelo lwe-e-Disclosure luyatfolakala kuwebhusayithi yeLitiko Letemisebenti Yahulumende Nekuphatsa – WEBTOKEN – futsi luchunywaniswe nalamanye emadathabhesi lakhona lanjengeKhomishini Yebunikati Bemphahla kanye Netinkampani, emahhovisi ekubhalisa bunikati betintfo kanye ne-eNatis ngetinjongo tekucinisekisa kanye nebufakazi.
tgt: Thulaganyo ya e-Disclosure e mo tsebegaeng ya setsha sa webe sa Lefapha la Tirelosetšhaba le Tsamaiso – WEBTOKEN - mme e golagane le dipolokelotshedimosetso tse dingwe tse di maleba di tshwana le Khomišene ya Ditlamo le Dithoto tsa Botlhale (Companies and Intellectual Property Commission), dikantoro tsa kwadiso ya dikano mmogo le eNatis malebana le go tlhomamisa le go netefatsa.

src: Loluhlelo luhlose kucinisa kuba nesibopho lokuvumelana neluhlelo lwahulumende lwekuyicedza nya inkhohlakalo.
tgt: Maikaelelo a thulaganyo ke go maatlafatsa maikarabelo go lepalepana le maitlhomo a puso a go se itshokele bobodu le go bo fedisa.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume kubanjwa Kwengcungcutsela Yebavikeli Beluntfu base-Afrika kanye nemigubho lehlobene nako eGauteng kusukela mhla tinge-24 kuya kumhla tinge-27 Indlovana 2014.
tgt: Kabinete e lemogile go amogelwa ga Samiti ya Ombudsman wa Aforika (the African Ombudsman Summit) le ditiragalo tse di amanang le tseo kwa Gauteng go tloga ka la bo 24 go ya go la bo 27 Tlhakole 2014.

src: Sikhungo Selucwaningo Lwebavikeli Beluntfu base-Afrika sitawubamba Ingcungcutsela ngaphansi kwengcikitsi: “Kucinisa Kuphatsa Kahle e-Afrika ngeNdzima Yebavikeli Beluntfu”.Inhloso yeNgcungcutsela kucwaninga ngeligalelo lelentiwa tikhungo Tebavikeli Beluntfu ekuciniseni intsandvo yelinyenti kanye nasekuphatseni kahle, lokwenta kube nekuthula kanye nekusimama kulivekati.
tgt: Tikwatikwe ya Dipatlisiso ya Ombudsman wa Aforika e tla amogela Samiti ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "Re maatlafatsa Bolaodi jo bo Siameng mo Aforika ka Seabe sa Ombudsman".Maikaelelo a Samiti ke go lebelela ditshwaelo tse di dirwang ke ditheo tsa Ombud go golaganya temokerasi le bolaodi jo bo siameng, ka go rialo di tshwaela mo kagisong le tsepamong mo kontinenteng.

src: Iphindze futsi inikete litfuba lekucoca ngekucinisa umbono Webuvikeli Beluntfu e-Afrika.
tgt: Gape e tlamela ka serala sa go buisana le go maatlafatsa mogopolo wa Ombudsman mo Aforika.

src: LeNgcungcutsela ifika ngesikhatsi lapho kugcizelelwa khona kakhulu kuphatsa lokuhlantekile, kuba nesibopho kanye nekwetfula kahle tinsita kubantfu labavamile kubohulumende base-Afrika.
tgt: Samiti e tla ka nako e go gatelelwang ntlha ya bolaodi jo bo phepa, maikarabelo le go tlamela batho fela ka ditirelo ka tshiamo mo mebusong ya Aforika.

src: Imitsetfosivivinyo.
tgt: Melaotlhomo.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume Sichibiyelo Semtsetfosivivinyo, 2014 Wekuhambisa Imphahla Letsengiswako Ngemkhumbi kutsi setfulwe ePhalamende.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse gore Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Dikepe tsa Kgwebo, wa 2014 o tlhagisiwe mo Palamenteng.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kuchibiyela Umtsetfo, nombolo 57 wanga-1951 Wekuhambisa Imphahla Letsengiswako Ngemkhumbi longaphambi kweMtsetfosisekelo, 1996 lokwenta kudzingeke kutsi uvumelaniswe netidzingo kanye nekubakhona kweMtsetfosisekelo futsi uphinde uvumelaniswe netiphakamiso tanyalo teMihlangano Yemave Emhlaba.
tgt: Maikaelelo a Molaotlhomo ke go baakanya Molao wa Dikepe tsa Kgwebo, wa bo57 wa 1951 o o nnileng gona pele ga Molaotheo, wa 1996 mme ka jalo o dira gore go nne botlhokwa gore go lepalepanngwe dintlhatheo le ditlamelo tsa Molaotheo mmogo le go o lepalepanya le Ditumelano tsa ga jaanong tsa Boditšhabatšhaba.

src: LeSichibiyelo Semtsetfosivivinyo futsi senta kube nekusebenta kwetiphakamiso teMhlangano Wetisebenti Taselwandle, 2006 kanye neteMhlangano Wetisebenti Tekudoba, 2007.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng gape o maatlafatsa Tumelano ya Bodiri jwa mo Mawatleng, ya 2006 le Tumelano ya Tiro ya Botshwaratlhapi, ya 2007.

src: Yomibili leMihlangano yemukelwa Yinhlangano yaMhlabuhlangene Yetisebenti Temave Emhlaba.
tgt: Ditumelano tseo tsotlhe di amogetswe ke Mokgatlho wa Badiri wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Ditšhabakopano.

src: Kuvumelanisa imitsetfo yalapha ekhaya netiphakamiso teMihlangano kuniketa iNingizimu Afrika emandla emhlaba wonkhe ekucinisekisa kuvikeleka emhlabeni wonkhe kwemalungelo alabasebenta elwandle kanye netimo tekusebenta netekuphila letincono.
tgt: Go lepalepanngwa ga melao ya selegae le Tumelano go tlamela Aforika Borwa ka sediriswa sa lefatshe ka bophara sa go netefatsa tshireletso ya lefatshe ka bophara ya ditshwanelo tsa badiri ba mo lewatleng mmogo le maemo a a seriti a tiro le botshelo.

src: Loku kutawenta iNingizimu Afrika ikwati kungenelela emacaleni emikhumbi yangaphandle lengena etikhumulweni tetfu temikhumbi yephule emalungelo alabasebenta elwandle.
tgt: Seno se tla kgontsha Aforika Borwa go tsereganya mo mabakeng a mo go ona dikepe tsa dinaga di sele tse di tsenang mo maemelakepeng a rona, di gatakakileng ditshwanelo tsa badiri ba mo lewatleng.

src: Kusebentisa loMtsetfosivivinyo kutawuphindze kutfutfukise kusebenta kanye nesitfombe semkhakha wetaselwandle, lokuyintfo ledzingekako ekuhwebelaneni nemave emhlaba nakumnotfo wemave emhlaba.
tgt: Go diragadiwa ga Molaotlhomo gape go tla tokafatsa ditiro le selebo sa madirelo a mo lewatleng, e leng se se botlhokwa mo dikgwebong tsa boditšhabatšhaba le mo ikonoming ya boditšhabatšhaba.

src: Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni tanyalo netentakalo letitako.1 IKhabhinethi igcizelele simemo saMengameli Jacob Zuma kuhulumende, kumabhizinisi kanye nasetisebentini kutsi basebente ndzawonye ekwakheni umnotfo wetfu ube sezingeni lelingakwati kwakha imisebenti leyengetiwe.
tgt: Ditshwetso tsa Kabinete mo mererong ya ga jaanong le mo ditiragalo tse di tlang Kabinete e gatelela gape boikuelo jwa Moporesitente Jacob Zuma go puso, kgwebo le badiri go dirisana mmogo go godisa ikonomi ka seelo se se kgonang go tlhama ditiro tse dingwe.

src: Inkhulumo Letfulelwa Sive kanye neNkhulumomcombelelo tibeke sisekelo sekucinisa kuphumeleliswa kweLuhlelo Lwentfutfuko Yavelonkhe kulethemu letako yekuphatsa lokusha.
tgt: Puo ya Maemo sa Setšhaba mmogo le Puo ya Tekanyetsokabo di tlhomile motheo wa go tsenngwa tirisong ka maatla ga Leano la Bosetšhaba la Tlhabololo mo pakeng e e latelang ya tsamaiso e ntšhwa.

src: Kwabiwa kweLiphakelo Lavelonkhe le-21 lalentsandvo yelinyenti kucoca indzaba lenhle mbamba yendlela lesintjintje ngayo live futsi sachubeka silwa netinsayeya letibalulekile tebuphuya, kungalingani kanye nekungasebenti – futsi, lokubalulekile, sikwenta loko ngemitfombotinsita lelinganiselwe lesinayo.
tgt: Tekanyetsokabo ya Bosetšhaba ya bo 21 ya puso eno ya temokerasi ruri e tlotla kgang e e monate ya ka moo re fetolang naga le go tswelela pele kgatlhanong le dikgwetlho tsa botlhokwa tsa lehuma, go tlhoka tekatekano le botlhokatiro - mme, e leng sa botlhokwa, re dira jalo ka ditlamelo tsa rona tse di lekanyeditsweng.2 Kabinete e nyaditse ka mafoko a a bogale dipolao tsa fa gautshwane tsa basetsanyana ba babedi ba go tweng ba bolailwe ka ntlha ya meetlo mengwe.

src: Tento letinjalo atinandzawo eveni letfu.
tgt: Dilo tsa mofuta oo ga di amogelesege mo nageng ya rona.

src: Ngetulu kwaloko Umtsetfosisekelo uvikela lilungelo lekuphila, nobe ngumuphi umuntfu lotawutfolakala anelicala kutawubukwana naye ngekuya kwemtsetfo ngalokuphelele.
tgt: Ka ntlha ya fa Molaotheo o na le tshwanelo ya botshelo, mongwe le mongwe yo o fitlhelwang a dirile molato o tla lebagana le bogale jotlhe jwa letsogo la molao.3 Kabinete e leboga maAforika Borwa otlhe le ditheo ka maiteko a bona a go boloka maatla, bogolo segolo ka ntlha ya fa tlamelo ya bosetšhaba e ntse e na le kgatelelo.

src: IKhabhinethi ibonga bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye netinhlangano ngetinyatselo tekonga emandla, ikakhulu ngesikhatsi luhlelo lwagesi lwesive lungaphansi kwekucindzeteleka.
tgt: Le fa naga e na le bokgoni jwa go fitlhelela tlhokego ya ga jaana, badirisi botlhe ba motlakase ba kopiwa go tsaya poloko-maatla jaaka mokgwatshelo.4 Kabinete e akgola dikolo tsotlhe le barutabana botlhe ba ba tlhophetsweng Dikgele tsa Bosetšhaba tsa Barutabana tsa 2013: Dikgele tsa Via Afrika People's Choice tse di tla tshwarwang ka la bo 6 Mopitlwe 2014 kwa Tikwatikweng ya Dikhonferense ya Birchwood kwa Gauteng.

src: Nanobe live linemandla ekuhlangabetana netidzingo talo tanyalo, bonkhe basebentisi bagesi bacelwa kutsi bemukele konga emandla njengendlela yekuphila.
tgt: Dikgele tseno ke nngwe ya ditsela tse Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le lemogang le go rotloetsa barutabana ba ba boineelo le ba ba kgathalang mo maitekong a bona a go tlhabolola barutwana go nna baagi ba ba maikarabelo ba Aforika Borwa wa temokerasi, yo o sa tlhaoleng go ya ka mmala le fa e le go ya ka bong.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela tonkhe tikolwa kanye nabothishela labakhetselwe Imiklomelo Yekufundzisa Yavelonkhe yanga-2013:Ye-Via Afrika People’s Choice Awards letakuba mhla ti-6 Indlovulenkhulu 2014 eBirchwood Conference Centre eGauteng.
tgt: Gape Kabinete e gatelela ditshwanelo tsa bana go ithuta mo tikologong e e babalesegileng le e e maleba.5 Kabinete e amogela tshegetso e e tswelelang pele ya Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji mo Moletlong wa Bosetšhaba wa Saense, o o itsegeng ka Scifest Africa, o o tla tshwarwang go tloga ka la bo 12 go ya go la bo 18 Mopitlwe 2014 kwa Grahamstown wa Kapa Botlhaba ka fa tlase ga moono wa "Go ya mo Sebakeng."

src: Le miklomelo ingulenye yetindlela Litiko Lemfundvo Lesisekelo lelibonga futsi likhutsata ngayo kutinikela kanye nekunakekela kwabothishela emitameni yabo yekutfutfukisa bafundzi njengetakhamuti letinesibopho teNingizimu Afrika lenentsandvo yelinyenti, lengabandlululi ngebuhlanga nangebulili.
tgt: Tiragalo eno ya ngwaga le ngwaga e tsweletsa saense, thekenoloji, boenjiniri le dipalo jaaka ditšhono tsa tiro mo bašweng ba rona mme e dira gore maAforika Borwa a tlhaloganye maphata ano botoka.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze yagcizelela emalungelo ebantfwana ekufundzela endzaweni lephephile kanye nalekahle.
tgt: Puso e tswelela go dira setlapele le go tsweletsa go tsewa ga Dipalo le Disaense jaaka karolo ya go tlhabolola bokgoni jwa botlhokwa jo bo tlhokwang ke ikonomi ya rona e e tlhabologang.6 Kabinete e amogela pego e e dirilweng ke Setlhopha sa Tikwatikwe ya Lenaane la Dipatlisiso tsa AIDS mo Aforika Borwa malebana le go bonwa ga dilwantshamegare tse dintšhwa tse di maatla tsa HIPatlisiso e ikaegile ka mokgwa yoo mmele wa ga mosadi wa kwa KwaZulu-Natal o tsibogetseng tshwaetso ya gagwe ya HIV ka tenga ka go bopa dilwantshamegare tse di maatla.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukela kusekela lokuchubekako kweLitiko Letesayensi Netheknoloji Umgubho Wesayensi Wavelonkhe, lowatiwa ngekutsi yi-Scifest Africa, lotakuba mhla ti-12 kuye kumhla ti-18 Indlovulenkhulu 2014 eRhini eMphumalanga Kapa ngaphansi kwengcikitsi: “Into the Space”.
tgt: Thutopatlisiso eno e e phasaladitsweng mo jenaleng ya maemo a a kwa godimo ya saense, Nature, e tlhalosa ka moo setlhopha sa babatlisisi se boneng le go supa dilwantshamegare tseno mo mading a mosadi yoo mme ba itsadisetsa tsa bone kwa laboratoring.

src: Lomgubho waminyaka yonkhe utfutfukisa isayensi, itheknoloji, bunjinyela kanye netibalo njengematfuba emsebenti kulusha lwetfu futsi wakha kucondza lokuncono ngalemikhakha kubantfu baseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Dilwantshamegare tse di dirilweng di ne tsa dirisiwa mo metseletseleng ya diteko kwa laboratori go senola tsela e e latetsweng ke masole a mmele a mosadi go dira dilwantshamegare tseno tse di maatla.

src: Hulumende uchubeka nekubeka embili kanye nekukhutsata kwentiwa kweTibalo neSayensi Yefiziksi njengencenye yekutfutfukisa emakhono labalulekile ladzingekako ekutfutfukiseni umnotfo wetfu.6 IKhabhinethi yemukela simemetelo lesentiwe yi-CAPRISA Consortium sekutfola emasotja ekuvikela umtimba lamasha lanemandla.
tgt: Kitso e ntšhwa e e bonweng go tswa mo mosading ono wa kwa KwaZulu-Natal malebana le tsibogelo ya masole a mmele a gagwe kgatlhanong le HIV e lere tsholofelo ya togamaano ya isago ya thibelo le kalafi ya HIThibololo eno ga se kalafi ya HIV/AIDS mme puso e ikuela go maAforika Borwa go tswelela go dira diteko tsa HIV gongwe go tswelela ka kalafi ya dianthiritrobaerale e e newang batho ba ba fitlhelwang ba na le HIV.7 Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tla rebola puo ya meletlo ya monongwaga ya Letsatsi la Ditshwanelo tsa Botho ka la bo 21 Mopitlwe 2014 ka fa tlase ga moono wa "Re keteka Dingwaga di le 20 tsa go fetola matshelo ka ditshwanelo tsa botho!"

src: Lucwaningo, lolushicilelwe kuyijenali lesembili, i-Nature, luchaza indlela licembu lelicwaningako lelitfole futsi labona ngayo lamasotja lavikela umtimba engatini yalomake futsi labese lakha emasotja ekuvikela umtimba elabhorethri.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go keteka go nna mo nageng e e netefaletsang gore ga go kitla go tlhola go diragala gore botho jwa rona bo tsewe go tswa mo moAforika Borweng ope, go sa kgathalasege lotso, bong, tumelo gongwe boitlhophelo jwa gore o ratana le batho ba bong bofe.

src: Emasotja ekuvikela umtimba lakhiwe abese ayasetjentiswa ekwenteni luchungechunge lwekuhlola elabhorethri ekuhlahleni indlela leya embili leyalandzelwa luhlelo lwemtimba lwekutivikela lwalomake ekwenteni lamasotja ekuvikela umtimba lanemandla.
tgt: Rotlhe re na le maikarabelo a go netefatsa gore rekoto le hisetori ya rona ya ditshwanelo tsa botho di somarelwa le go maatlafaletswa bana ba rona.8 Beke ya Bosetšhaba ya Metsi e tla tlhomiwa kwa Bushbuckridge ka la bo 14 Mopitlwe mme e tla tswelela ka ditiragalo di le mmalwa go fitlha ka la bo 23 Mopitlwe 2014.

src: Lokucondza lokusha lokutfolakele kulomake waKwaZulu Natal kwekutivikela kwemtimba ekuhlaselweni yi-HIV kuletsa litsemba lekuvikeleka esikhatsini lesitako kanye nakumachinga ekwelapha i-HILoku lokutfolakele akusho kutsi sekulikhambi lekwelapha i-HIV neNgculazi (i-AIDS) futsi hulumende umema bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi babotihlolela i-HIV nobe bachubeke nekusebentisa sidzambisingculazi sekuyitsintsibeta lenikwa bantfu labatfolakele kutsi banayo nabahlolwa.
tgt: Tiragalo ya go tlhoma e tla diragala go lebilwe go isiwa tlase ga dipompo kwa Šafoteng e e Tsepameng ya kwa Borwa ya moepo wa bogologolo wa ERPM go samagana le morero wa Tshologelo ya Esiti ya Meepo mo karolong ya Bogareng ya Mokgatshe wa Witwatersrand.

src: Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawetfula inkhulumo yemigubho Yelusuku Lwemalungelo Eluntfu mhla tinge-21 Indlovulenkhulu 2014 ngaphansi kwengcikitsi: “Kugubha Iminyaka lenge-20 yeluntjintjo lwetimphilo ngemalungelo eluntfu!” eTinkhundleni Tekhrikhethi taseSharpeville eGauteng.
tgt: Mo bekeng e e setseng go tla rebolwa diporojeke tsa phepafatso ya metsi a a leswe le tlamelo ya metsi mo diporofenseng di le mmalwa.

src: IKhabhinethi imema bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bagubhe kuphila eveni lelicinisekisa kutsi ngeke kuphindze kwenteke kutsi buntfu betfu butsatfwe kunobe ngubani muntfu waseNingizimu Afrika, kungakhatsaliseki buhlanga, bulili, inkholelo nobe bulili lotikhetsele bona.
tgt: Moono wa monongwaga ke "Metsi ke Botshelo - Dingwaga di le 20 tsa Tlamelo ya Metsi go Tlhabolola Loago le Ikonomi."

src: Liviki Lemanti Lavelonkhe litawetfulwa e-Bushbuckridge mhla ti-14 Indlovulenkhulu futsi litawuchubeka nemigubho leminyenti kute kube mhla tinge-23 Indlovulenkhulu 2014.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng go somarela metsi mme e boeletsa botlhokwa jwa tsamaiso e e netefaletsang go nna teng leruri ga tlamelo eno e e tlhaelang, gore go atolosediwe phitlhelelo go maAforika Borwa a le mantsi.9 Kabinete e tlhaloseditswe ka Presidential Youth Indaba ya ntlha e e atlegileng e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Ekurhuleni go tloga ka la bo 28 Tlhakole go ya go la bo 03 Mopitlwe 2014.

src: Umgubho wekuletfula utawentiwa ngekwehliswa kwemishini yekudvonsa emanti Emgodzini Locondze Phansi eNingizimu yemayini lendzala yase-ERPM kute ilungise inkinga Yesimunyo se-Asidi Yasemayini e-Central Witwatersrand Basin.
tgt: Indaba e ne e tsamaisiwa ke kantoro ya Moporesitente, Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi (EDD) le Setheo sa Bosetšhaba sa Tlhabololo ya Bašwa (NYDA).

src: Incenye lesele yeliviki futsi itawubona kwendluliselwa kwemisebenti yekuhlanta emanti langcolile kanye nemiklamo yekuniketwa emanti lamanyenti etifundzeni letinyenti.
tgt: Indaba e diragaditse Tumelano ya go Thapiwa ga Bašwa e e saenilweng ke puso, kgwebo le badiri ka Moranang 2013.

src: Ingcikitsi yalomnyaka itsi “Emanti Ayimphilo – Iminyaka lenge-20 Yekwetfulwa Kwemanti Ekutfutfukiseni Tenhlakalahle kanye Nemnotfo”.
tgt: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tlhagisitse puo ya dintlha tse di botlhokwa kwa Indaba, e e neng e tsenetswe ke bonnye jwa bašwa ba le 500 go tswa kwa diporofenseng tsotlhe.

src: IKhabhinethi imema bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bonge emanti futsi igcizelela sidzingo sekuphatfwa lokusimeme kwalensita lengatfolakali kalula, kute kwandziswe kutfolakala kwayo kubantfu labanyenti baseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Ditona tse di farologaneng di nnile le seabe mo dipuisanong tsa ditlhopha go tlhalosetsa bašwa ka manaane a puso a go thapiwa ga bašwa.

src: IKhabhinethi yatiswe ngekuvulwa ngemphumelelo kwe-Youth Indaba Lihhovisi LaMengameli labeyibanjelwe Ekurhuleni kusukela mhla tinge-28 Indlovana kuye kumhla ti-3 Indlovulenkhulu 2014.
tgt: Go tlaleletsa foo, go amogetswe ditogamaano tse di tsepameng tse di tla dirang gore Moporesitente le Ditona tse di farologaneng di buisane le bašwa gangwe le gape go dira gore go tlhamiwa ga ditiro e nne kgang yA nnete.10 Kabinete e lemogile Khonferense ya Bosetšhaba ya Patlomaikutlo e e ka ga Lekwalopuso la Matlhagolatsela la Pholisi ya Bosetšhaba e e KopanEtsweng ya Thekenoloji ya Ditlhaeletsano tsa Tshedimosetso (ICT) e e neng e tsenetswe ke bontsi e bile e atlegile, e e neng e tshwerwe ka la bo 3 Mopitlwe 2014.

src: Le Indaba beyingeniswe Lihhovisi LaMengameli, Litiko Lekutfutfukiswa Kwemnotfo (EDD) kanye neLuphiko Lwekutfutfukiswa Kwelusha Kuvelonkhe (NYDA).
tgt: Kabinete e rotloetsa baagi go nna le seabe mo ditheetsong tsa porofense tsa Lekwalopuso la Matlhagolatsela tse di simologang kwa Rustenburg ka la bo 7 Mopitlwe.

src: Le Indaba ibe ngumphumela wekusebenta kweSivumelwano Sekucasha Lusha lesasayinwa ngaMabasa 2013 nguhulumende, ngemabhizinisi kanye netisebenti.
tgt: Lekwalopuso la Matlhagolatsela le tla lebisa kwa go konosediweng ga Lekwalopuso la Mabudusatsela mo bogareng jwa ngwaga, mme seo se tla tlamela ka letlhomeso la go fetola molao ka ditsela tse di tla lebelelang diphetogo tse di gaketseng tsa ICT mo dingwageng tse di fa gautshwane.11 Kabinete e itumeletse go itse gore fa e sale go amogelwa "SA Connect", e leng Pholisi le Togamaano ya Broadband, ka la bo 4 Sedimonthole 2013, dikolo di le 782 di golagane ka dikhomphiutara le dilaboratori tse di nang le inthanete go tlhomilwe Setheo sa Inkamva e-Skills, mme go tlhamilwe Lekgotla la Bosetšhaba la Bogakolodi la Broadband.12 Lefapha la Merero ya Tikologo le tla tsamaisa Khonferense ya bo11 ya Maphata (COP11) go tloga ka di17 go ya go di21 Mopitlwe 2014, kwa Cape Town International Convention Centre, ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "Go Tsweletsa Kgolo mo Dikgwebong tsa kwa Mawatleng mo Aforika: Go Lebilwe Tsamaiso e e nnelang Leruri ya Ditlamelo tsa Lewatle."

src: Mengameli Jacob Zuma wetfule inkhulumo lesihlutfulelo ye-Indaba, labeyetsanyelwe bantfu labasha labacishe babe nge-500 labavela kuto tonkhe tifundza.
tgt: COP11 e e tshwarwang morago ga dingwaga tse dingwe le tse dingwe di le pedi e kopanya ditona tsa tikologo go tswa kwa dinageng di le 22 tse di ka fa tlase ga Tumelano ya Tirisanommogo mo Tshireletsong, Tsamaisong le Tlhabololo ya Tikologo ya Mawatle le Mabopo a Lebopo la Atlantic a Kgaolo ya Bophirima, Bogare le Borwa jwa Aforika.

src: Tindvuna letehlukene tahlanganyela etingcocweni tekwatisa bantfu labasha ngetinhlelo tahulumende tekucasha lusha.
tgt: Khonferense ya 2014 e tla sekaseka ditiro le ditshwetso tse di diragaditsweng mo pakeng ya 2012/13 tekanyetsokabo ya 2014/15, mme e swetse ka dikgato tse di tlhokegang go tsenya tirisong Tumelano le Maano a yona a Tiragatso.

src: 1.10 IKhabhinethi icaphele linani lelikhulu labelikhona kanye nekuba yimphumelelo kweNkhomfa Yekubonisana Yavelonkhe ngeNchubomgomo Yeliphepha Leliluhlata Leyinhlanganisela yeThekhinoloji Yelwati Lwetekuchumana (i-ICT) Yavelonkhe, leyabanjwa mhla ti-3 Indlovulenkhulu 2014.
tgt: Gape e tla tlhalosa ka moo maphata a ka amogelang mogopolo wa "Kgolo mo Dikgwebong tsa kwa Mawatleng " jaaka tsela ya go tsamaisa ditlamelo tsa lewatle le mabopo ka tsela e e nnelang leruri.13 Kabinete e akgotse setlhopha sa Bosetšhaba sa Aforika Borwa sa Khirikhete sa ba dingwaga tse di ka fa tlase ga di le 19 ka phitlhelelo ya sona e e gaisang ka go gapa Sejana sa bona sa ntlha sa Lefatshe sa ba Dingwaga tse di ka fa tlase ga di le 19 sa Lekgotla la Boditšhabatšhaba la Khirikhete (ICC) kwa Dubai.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhutsata sive kutsi sihlanganyela ekulaleleni luvo lwesive ngeLiphepha Leliluhlata etifundzeni lokutawucala eRustenburg mhla ti-7 Indlovulenkhulu.
tgt: Tiragatso e e susumetsang ya setlhopha e tshwanetse go rotloetsa batshameki botlhe ba bašwa go eletsa go fitlhelela seemo se se kwa godimo.14 Kabinete e amogetse Letsatsi le le tlang la Boditšhabatšhaba la Basadi - 8 Mopitlwe 2014.

src: Liphepha Leliluhlata litawuholela ekuphetfweni kweLiphepha Lelimhlophe phakatsi nemnyaka, lokutawenta luhlaka lwekuntjintja imitsetfo ngetindlela letitawucabangela tingucuko letisheshako ku-ICT eminyakeni yamuva.
tgt: Letsatsi le tlamela maAforika Borwa ka tšhono ya go gopola diphitlhelelo le go intsha setlhabelo ga basadi ba maAforika Borwa mo baaging ba rona.

src: 1.11 IKhabhinethi iyajabula ngekucaphela kutsi kusukela ekwemukelweni kwe-“SA Connect”, Inchubomgomo neLichinga le-Broadband, mhla titi-4 Ingongoni 2013, tikolwa leti-782 tinekuchumeka ngabongcondvomshini kanye nema-cyberlab Ikamva e-Skills Institute yetfulwa, futsi kwakhiwa Umkhandlu Wavelonkhe we-Broadband.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a tlhoka go lebelela tswelelopele ya baagi, setšhaba le naga ka bophara mo go tsweletseng ditshwanelo tsa basadi.

src: 1.12 Litiko Letesimondzawo litawungenisa Inkhomfa Yemacembu ye-11 (COP11) kusukela mhla ti-17 kuye kumhla tinge-21 Indlovulenkhulu 2014, eCape Town Convention Centre, ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Promoting Blue Growth in Africa: Towards Sustainable Management of Marine Resources”.
tgt: Le fa Molaotheo o tlamela ka dintlhatheo, ke maikarabelo a rona rotlhe go tlhokomela le go sireletsa basadi le go netefatsa gore ba a maatlafadiwa go nna le seabe jaaka baagi ba ba lekalekanang le ba bangwe mo tlhabololong ya ikonomi le naga.2 Ditsereganyo le dikatlenegiso tsa Kabinete Kabinete e aamogetse go simololwa ga thulaganyo e e anameng ya patlomaikutlo ka maikaelelo a go tlhagisa dialogane tse dintsi tsa porofešenale.

src: Lomhlangano we-COP11 lowenteka kanye ngemva kweminyaka lemibili uhlanganisa ndzawonye tindvuna tesimondzawo letivela emaveni lange-22 lahlanganiswa nguMhlangano Wekubambisana Ekuvikeleni, Ekuphatseni naseKutfutfukiseni Taselwandle kanye neSimondzawo Selugu Lwaselwandle eNshonalanga Yelugu lwe-Atlantic, Esifundzeni Lesiphakatsi kanye naseNingizimu ye-Afrika.
tgt: Seno se tla itsise letlhomeso la tshusumetsano e e tokafetseng, kgokaganyo le tirisanommogo magareng ga ditheo tsa porofešenale, makgotla a boleng, madirelo, ditheo tsa thuto e kgolwane mmogo le puso.

src: Inkhomfa yanga-2014 itawubuyeketa imisebenti kanye netincumo letitsatfwe phakatsi nesikhatsi sanga-2012/13 liphakelo langa- 2014/15, netinyatselo letidzinga kutsatfwa teMhlangano kanye neLuhlelo Lwalokutakwentiwa.
tgt: Seno se tla tshwaela mo tlhabololong ya badiri ba ba nang le bokgoni go tshegetsa tsela e e akaretsang ya kgolo.2 Kabinete e amogetse Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Inšorense ya Botlhokatiro wa 2014 gore o tlhagisiwe kwa Palamenteng.

src: Futsi itawuphindze incume indlela emacembu lokufanele amukele ngayo umbono “Wekumila Kwalokuluhlata” njengendlela yekuphatsa lokusimeme imitfombolusito yaselwandle naselugwini lwelwandle.
tgt: Seno ke paakanyo ya bobedi ya Molao wa Inšorense ya Botlhokatiro, wa bo 63 wa 2001.Dipaakanyo di tswelela go fokotsa ditlamorago tse di masisi tsa botlhokatiro mo ikonoming le loago ka go obamela dipeelo tsa Mekgatlho ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya Badiri, go akarediwa le barutwana ba ba mo boithutelatirong le badiredisetšhaba ba ga jaanong ba ba sa sirelediwang go ya ka Molao.

src: 1.13 IKhabhinethi ihalalisele licembu lekhrikhethi laseNingizimu Afrika Lesive Lalabangaphansi kweMinyaka leli-19 ngempumelelo yalo lenkhulu yekuwina kwekucala Indzebe Yemhlaba ye-ICC Yalabangaphansi kweMinyaka leli-19 eDubai.
tgt: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng, 2014, ga reng ga tse dingwe, o tla atolosa paka ya tuelo ya ditshiamelo tsa moabi, go tloga go dikgwedi di le 8 go ya go di le 12, mme ka go rialo o ba kgontsha go batla tiro e nngwe mme ba ntse ba amogela ditshiamelo mo pakeng e e telejana.

src: Kudlala ngekutimisela kwelicembu kusikhutsato kubo bonkhe badlali labasha kutsi baphokophelele emphumelelweni.
tgt: Gape moabi o tla nna le paka e e atolositsweng ya go ka tsenya topotuelo, go tloga mo dikgweding di le 6 go ya go di le Gape e tla dira gore go nne le go tlhophiwa ga baamogelatshiamelo mo mabakeng a ditshiamelo tsa loso.3 Go thapiwaKabinete e amogetse go thapiwa ga ba ba latelang:.

src: Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni tanyalo netentakalo letitako.
tgt: Ditshwetso tsa Kabinete mo mererong ya ga jaanong le mo ditiragalong tse di tlang.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukele kwetfula Umbiko Wekubuyeketa Iminyaka Lengemashumi Lamabili yeNtfutfuko yeNingizimu Afrika 1994-2014, nguMengameli Jacob Zuma, lobufakazi bentfutfuko leyentiwe nguhulumende ekucinisekiseni imphilo lencono kubo bonkhe.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse kgololo ya Pegelo ya Ditlhotlhomiso mo Aforika Borwa mo Dingwageng di le Masomamabedi go tloga ka 1994-2014, ka Moporesitente Jacob Zuma, e leng bosupi jwa tswelelopele e e dirilweng ke puso go netefatsa gore go nna le botshelo jo bo botoka go WEBTOKEN moweng wa gore Ditlhotlhomiso tseno di akgolele Moporesitente wa maloba Nelson Mandela, Khuduthamaga e ikuela mo maphateng otlhe a loago go sekaseka pegelo eno, go ikamanya le meletlo ya Dingwaga di le 20 tsa Kgololesego le go thusa go bopa dipuisano tsa bosetšhaba ka ga diphitlhelelo mmogo le dikgwetlho tsa rona.

src: Ngemoya Wekubuyeketa lokunikelwe kuMengameli wangaphambilini Nelson Mandela, IKhabhinethi imema tonkhe tinhlaka temmango kutsi titibandzakanye nalombiko, tihlanganyele emikhosini yekugubha Iminyaka lenge-20 Yenkhululeko futsi tisite ekwenteni inkhulumiswano yalesikwentile kanye netinsayeya.
tgt: Ditlhotlhomio di tlhomamisa tswelelopele e re e boneng mo go ageng temokerasi e e sa tlhaoleng ka semorafe, e e sa tlhaoleng ka bong, e e matlhagatlhaga e bile e susumetsa molaotheo wa temokerasi, go dira Aforika Borwa naga e go leng botoka go nna mo go yona.

src: LoKubuyeketa kucinisekisa intfutfuko lesiyentile ekwakheni sive lesingabandlululi ngebuhlanga, ngebulili, intsandvo yelinyenti lekumtsetfosisekelo lephilako kanye nalechumako, leyenta iNingizimu Afrika ibe live lelincono kuphila kulo.
tgt: Kabinete e gakolola maphata otlhe a loago gore 2014 e beetswe thoko go nna ya letsholo la Dingwaga di le 20 tsa Kgololesego.

src: Mabasa uyiNyanga Yenkhululeko.
tgt: Moranang ke Kgwedi ya Kgololesego.

src: Bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika nebalingani bayo bemave emhlaba kanye nalabatsintsekako bamenywa kutsi bahlanganyele emikhosini yekugubha Inyanga Yenkhululeko ngekucoca tindzaba tabo ngekutsi kutintjintje njani, kusebenta ngekubambisana, timphilo tebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika taba ncono.
tgt: Go lalediwa maAforika Borwa otlhe le balekane ba boditšhabatšhaba mmogo le baamegi go tsenela meletlo ya Kgwedi ya Kgololesego ka go anega dikgang tse di ikaegileng ka kgang ya gore, ka go dira mmogo, re kgonne go fetola matshelo a maAforika Borwa go nna botoka.

src: Njengobe siya etiteshini tekuvotela mhla ti-7 Inkhwekhweti 2014, asiphindze futsi sibonise kutsi sinentsandvo yelinyenti lephilako, lenemdlandla nalenekuthula.
tgt: Fa re leba kwa diteišeneng tsa go tlhopha ka la bo 7 Motsheganong 2014, a re supeng gape gore re temokerasi e e mafolofolo, e e tlhaga le ya kagiso.

src: IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi batibandzakanye ngemdlandla elukhetfweni kodvwa bakwente loko ngekuthula nangekubeketelelana kulilungelo labo bonkhe bavoti lekuvakalisa imibono yabo ebaleni kepha bente kukhetsa kwabo ngasese kuyindlwana lekuvotelwa kuyo.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng go nna le seabe se se tlhaga sa go ingokela batlhophi fela ba dire jalo ka kagiso le itshokelano go lebeletswe ditshwanelo tsa batlhophi botlhe tsa go tlhagisa maikutlo a bona mo phatlhalatseng le go dira boitlhophelo mo sephiring mo ntlwanatlhophelong.

src: Tinhlaka tekugcinwa kwemtsetso titawusebenta ngekutimisela ekuvikeleni lelilungelo, kucinisekisa kutsi tonkhe tindzawo telive tiyatibandzakanya kuyinchubo yentsandvo yelinyenti, lengumkhicito Wemzabalazo wetfu wenkhululeko.
tgt: Ditheo tsa tiragatso ya molao di tla bo di eme sejaro go sireletsa tshwanelo eno, go netefatsa gore dikarolo tsotlhe tsa naga di nna le seabe mo tsamaisong ya temokerasi, e leng yona kumo ya Kgaratlho ya rona ya kgololesego.

src: Njengencenye yekuphumelelisa lisu letakhiwonchanti lavelonkhe Lekhomishini Yekucondziswa Kwesakhiwonchanti yeLihhovisi laMengameli, Ikhabhinethi icaphelisa sive ngentfutfuko lenhle lelandzelako:1.
tgt: Jaaka karolo ya leano la bosetšhaba la go atolosa mafaratlhatlha la Khomišene ya Moporesitente ya Kgokaganyo ya Mafaratlhatlha, Kabinete e lemosa setšhaba ditlhabololo tse di latelang tse dintle:1.

src: Lidamu i-De Hoop eLimpopo litawucedvwa kwakhiwa ekupheleni kweNdlovulenkhulu 2014.
tgt: Letamo la De Hoop kwa Limpopo le tla rebolwa go fa go lebilwe kwa bokhutlong jwa Mopitlwe 2014.

src: Leli lidamu lesine lelikhulukati kusukela ngemuva kwekungena kwentsandvo yelinyenti.
tgt: Seno ke letamo la bone le legolo go gaisa le le agilweng morago ga puso ya rona ya temokerasi.

src: Lidamu litawusita ekuchubeni umsebenti wemnotfo, kwakha imisebenti futsi lisite ekwetfuleni tinsita esifundzeni kanye nalokunye.
tgt: Letamo leno le tla thusa go tsamaisa ikonomi, go tlhama ditiro mmogo le go thusa tlamelo ya ditirelo mo porofenseng le kwa mafelong a mangwe.

src: Bantfu labangetulu kwe-800 000 endzaweni yaseSekhukhune batawutfola kuniketwa emanti ekudla lahlobile nalangcono ngesikhatsi imisebenti yetimayini lemisha neyekulima nayo itawuphindze itfole kuniketwa emanti.
tgt: Batho ba feta 800 000 mo kgaolong ya Sekhukhune ba tla ungwelwa ka tlamelo e e sireletsegileng le e e tokafetseng ya metsi a legae fa ditiro tsa meepo le temothuo le tsona di tla ungwelwa ka ntlha ya tlamelo ya metsi.

src: Bomasipala endzaweni, ngekusekelwa nguhulumende wavelonkhe kanye newesifundza, basise imali leyengetwe ngemabhiliyoni lama-R3 kusakhiwonchanti sekwelapha nekusabalalisa emanti ekudla aye kubantfu labasetindzaweni tasemakhaya kanye nasemadolobheni.
tgt: Makgotlatoropo mo karolong eo, a tshegeditswe ke dipuso tsa bosetšhaba le tsa porofense, a beeleditse bokana ka R3 bilione ya tlaleletso mo mafaratlhatlheng go tlhatswa le go tlamela metsi kwa badirising ba metseselegae le metsesetoropo.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalise kwenetiseka ngeluhlelo Lekwetfula Sigaba Sesibili se-Lesotho Highlands Water Project mhla tinge-27 Indlovulenkhulu 2014.
tgt: Kabinete e kgotsofaditwe ke go tlhomiwa go go rulagantsweng ga Legato la II la Porojeke ya Metsi a Lesotho Highlands ka la bo 27 Mopitlwe 2014.

src: Lomklamo usibonelo lesikhulu salokungentiwa nangabe emave labomakhelwane abambisana futsi asebentisana ndzawonye.
tgt: Porojeke eno ke sekai sa botlhokwa sa gore go ka fitlhelelwa eng fa dinaga tsa boagisanyi di dirisana mmogo mme di dira go fitlhelela phitlhelelo e e tshwanang.

src: Kutfutfukiswa kwekwabelana imitfombo yemanti kuneligalelo lelikhulu ekuthuleni nasekuchumeni kwesifundza sase-Afrika leseNingizimu kanye nakuyinhlalakahle yebantfu bayo.
tgt: Go tlhabololwa ga ditlamelo tse di tlhakanetsweng tsa metsi go tshwaela e le ruri mo kagisong le khumo ya kgaolo ya Borwa jwa Aforika mmogo le katlaatlelo ya baagi ba teng.

src: IKhabhinethi ijabulile ngesinyatselo sekuvuselela luhlelo lwaloliwe waseNingizimu Afrika, ngekuniketwa kwe-Transnet inkontileka ya-R50 wemabhiliyoni kutsi akhe titimela letisembili ngebuchwepheshe kanye netesimanjemanje letiyi-1 064.
tgt: Kabinete e itumelela kgato ya go tsosolosa tsamaiso ya diporo tsa Aforika Borwa, jaaka Transnet e abile konteraka ya R50 bilione gore go agiwe diterena di le 1 064 tsa sešweng le tse di dirisang thekenoloji e e tsweletseng pele.

src: Indzima Yebunjinyela ba-Transnet esivumelwaneni kucinisekisa kutsi lencenye iyantjintjwa ibe ngumkhiciti wetimphahla telizinga lelisetulu lemhlaba wonkhe esikhatsini lesitako.
tgt: Seabe sa tiro ya Boenjenere jwa Transnet mo tumelanong eno ke go netefatsa gore karolo e fetolwa go nna motlhagisi wa didirisiwa tsa tshimologo wa lefatshe mo tsamaong ya nako.

src: Lesivumelwano sihlose kuntjintja imboni yetitimela taseNingizimu Afrika ngekukhulisa emabhizinisi lamancane kanye nekwakha lamasha.
tgt: Maitlhomo a konteraka eno ke go tlhabolola indaseteri ya diporo ya Aforika Borwa ka go godisa dikgwebopotlana tse di leng teng le go tlhama tse dintšhwa.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukela kwetfula kweSipopolo se-MeerKAT sekucala Litiko Letesayensi Nethekhinoloji esikhungweni sase-Square Kilometre Array (SKA) edvute ne-Carnarvon, eNshonalanga Kapa mhla ti-27 Indlovulenkhulu 2014.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go tlhomiwa ga antena ya ntlha ya MeerKAT ke Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji kwa setsheng sa botlhokwa sa Square Kilometre Array (SKA) gaufi le Carnarvon, kwa Kapa Bokone ka la bo 17 Mopitlwe 2014.MeerKAT, e leng sediriswa seo dikarolontsi jwa sona bo thadisitsweng le go agiwa mo gae, ke sesupo gape sa gore Aforika Borwa e ka gaisana le dinaga tse di gaisang fa go tla mo mererong ya dipatlisiso, boenjenere, saense le thekenoloji.

src: I-MeerKAT, ilithulusi lelinencenye lenkhulu leyakhiwe futsi yahlelwa lapha ekhaya, lokuphindze kubonise kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ingakwati kuchudzelana nemave lasembili emhlabeni nangabe kutiwa kutekucwaninga, bunjinyela, isayensi kanye nethekhinoloji.
tgt: E tla tsaya fela 25% ya Legato I la SKA.5 Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso kwa malapeng le ditsala tsa ba ba latlhegetsweng ke matshelo ka ntlha ya dipula tse di maatla tsa fa gautshwane.

src: Itawukwenta 25% weSigaba Sekucala se-SKIKhabhinethi ivakalisa kulilela imindeni netihlobo talabo labalahlekelwe timphilo ngenca yetimvula letinkhulu letisandza kubakhona.
tgt: Kabinete e netefaletsa maAforika Borwa gore Tikwatikwe ya Bosetšhaba ya Tsamaiso ya Matlhotlhapelo - ka popegotheo ya Bosetšhaba e e Kopanetsweng ya Tiro le Matlhale - e tla tswelela ka maiteko a go batla le go falodisa mmogo le namolo ya bopelonomi.

src: IKhabhinethi income kungenelela kwemibutfo yetekuvikela kumetamo yekuniketa lusito.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola tsereganyo ya maphata a tshireletso mo go thuseng maiteko a phaloso.

src: Bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulu labo labahlala etindzaweni letivame kuba netikhukhula, bacelwa kutsi bacaphelisise ngaletikhatsi tetimo telitulu letimbi.
tgt: Go kopiwa maAforika Borwa otlhe, bogolo segolo baagi ba ba nnang mo mafelong a a ratwang ke merwalela, go nna kelotlhoko thata mo dipakeng tsa maemo a bosa a a masisi.

src: Batali kanye nebanakekeli kufanele batsatse tinyatselo tekucinisekisa kutsi bantfwana baphephile.
tgt: Batsadi le batlhokomedi ba tshwanetse go tsaya dikgato tse di maleba go netefatsa gore bana ba nna ba babalesegile.

src: Ngetulu kwaloko, labahamba ngetimoto nalabahamba ngetinyawo kudzingeka bahlale bacaphele nangabe basebentisa imigwaco leshelelako.
tgt: Go tlaleletsa foo, bakgweetsi le batsamayakadinao ba tshwanetse go nna ba ntshitse matlho dinameng fa ba dirisa ditsela mo maemong a a bongola.6 Kabinete e rata go leboga setšhaba ka seabe sa sona mo go namoleng kgatelelo mo tlamelong ya bosetšhaba ya motlakase mo kgweding e e fetileng.

src: IKhabhinethi ibonga sive ngekudlala indzima yaso ekuhhamuleni kucindzeteleka kweluhlelo lwemandla agezi wavelonkhe kwangenyanga leyengcile.
tgt: Go rotloediwa badirisi ba ba ikemetseng mmogo le ditheo go tswelela go dirisa motlakase ka tlhokomelo le go somarela motlakase fa go kgonegang gona, bogolo segolo mo seemong sa ga jaana sa bosa.7 Aforika Borwa o tla tsenela Samiti ya Bone ya Makokokopano a Yuropa (EU)- le a Aforika e e diragalang kwa Brussels, Belgium ka la bo 2 le la bo 3 Moranang 2014.

src: Ingcikitsi yengcungcutsela itsi “Kusisa kuBantfu, Kuphumelela neKuthula”.
tgt: Moono wa Samiti ke "Re beeletsa mo Bathong, Lehumo le Kagiso.

src: Ingcungcutsela itawugcila emfundvweni nasekucecesheni bomake kanye nelusha, kanye nasekwandzeni kwebachamuki labasemtsetfweni nalabangekho emtsetfweni emkhatsini walamavekati lamabili.
tgt: "Samiti e tla tota thuto le katiso, basadi le bašwa, mmogo le kelelo ya bafudugedi ba ba mo molaong le ba ba seng mo molaong magareng ga dikontinente ka bobedi.8 Ka la bo 24 Mopitlwe 2014 e tla bo e le segopotso sa ngwaga le ngwaga sa Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Lehuba (TB).

src: IKhabhinethi ifisa kukhutsata bantfu baseNinizimu Afrika kutsi basebentisane naHulumende ekulweni nalolubhubhane.
tgt: Kabinete e rata go rotloetsa maAforika Borwa go dira mmogo le Puso go lwantsha leroborobo leno.

src: Lubhubhane lweSifo Sesifuba (-TB) belwandzile hhayi-nje kuphela eNingizimu Afrika kodvwa nakuso sonkhe Sifundza sase-Sub-Sahara.
tgt: Leroborobo la TB ga le a etegela fela mo Aforika Borwa, fela le mo Kgaolong yotlhe ya Sub-Sahara.

src: Imitamo yahulumende yekusebentisa kwelapha lokukhulukati kwe-HIV ne-AIDS kanye neluhlelo lwekuvikela lweMhlaba kuye kwavimbela ligagasi le-TB.
tgt: Dikgato tsa puso tsa go tsenya tirisong lenaneo le legolo la kalafi le thibelo ya HIV le AIDs mo lefatsheng le nopotse lekhubu la TB.

src: Tinhlelo tahulumende tekulwa ne-TB tiphindze tifake ekhatsi tindlela tekutfola kanye nekulandzelela, ngekusebentisa ithekhinoloji ye-GeneXpert ekusheshiseni kutfolakala kwe-TSiyatigcabha ngekutsi iNingizimu Afrika ihamba embili Emhlabeni ngekuba netakhiwo tetemphilo letinethekhinoloji ye-GeneXpert.
tgt: Mananeo a puso a go lwantsha TB a akareditse gape go batla dikgetse le go sala morago ba ba amaneng le tshwaetso, tiriso ya thekenoloji ya GeneXpert go akofisa go phekolwa ga TRe ipela ka gore Aforika Borwa ke moeteledipele wa Lefatshe ka go anamisa thekenoloji ya GeneXpert kwa ditlamelong tsa boitekanelo.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukela Umhlangano Wetindvuna lotako Wekuhlanganisa Tindlela Tesifundza Tekubhekana ne-TB eMkakheni Wetimayini tase-Afrika leseNingizimu.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela Simposiamo se se tlang sa Ditona se se ka ga Tepatepanyo ya Ditsibogo tsa Kgaolo malebana le TB mo Lephateng la Meepo mo Borwa jwa Aforika.

src: Lomhlangano lotawubanjelwa eSandton Convention Centre mhla tinge-25 Indlovulenkhulu 2014 utawuhlanganisa ndzawonye badlali tindzima kubohulumende beSifundza, uMkakha Wetimayini eNingizimu Afrika, tinhlangano Tetisebenti, Balingani Bentfutfuko kanye Nesive Ngalokuphelele.
tgt: Simposiamo se se tla tshwarelwang kwa Sandton Convention Centre ka la bo 25 Mopitlwe 2014, mme se tla kopanya bannileseabe mo dipusong tsa kgaolo, Lephata la Meepo la Aforika Borwa, Bodiri jo bo rulaganeng, Balekane ba Tlhabololo mmogo le Baagi.9 Kabinete e akgotse botlhe ba ba fitlheletseng makgaolakgang le ba ba amogetseng Dikgele tsa Bobedi tsa Ngwaga le Ngwaga tsa Dikgwebo tse di Gaisang tsa Aforika Borwa.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele bonkhe labangenele kanye nalabatfole Imiklomelo Yesibili Yaminyaka Yonkhe Yemabhizinisi Lahamba Embili aseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Dikgele di tsibogela tiragatso ya dikgwebo mo dikarolong tse di farologaneng mme di abilwe kwa tiragalong e e neng e tsenetswe ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma.

src: Lemiklomelo ibonga umsebenti lowentiwa ngemabhizinisi emikhakheni lehlukene futsi beyiniketwa emcimbini lobewuhanjelwe nguMegameli Jacob Zuma.
tgt: Gareng ga baamogedi ba ba akgotsweng ke Kabinete ke Rre Sam Motsuenyane yo o amogetseng Sekgele se se maleba sa Phitlhelelo ya Botshelo Jotlhe.10 Kabinete e lemogile pegelo ya forensiki e e neng e rebotswe ke Matlole a Bosetšhaba ka ga Khomišene e e Ikemetseng ya Ditlhopho (IEC).

src: Phakatsi kwalabayitfolile labahalaliselwe yiKhabhinethi nguMnu Sam Motsuenyane lotfole Umklomelo Wemphumelelo Yekuphila Konkhe.10 IKhabhinethi icaphele umbiko wekuphenywa kwebugebengu ngebuchwepheshe lowajutjwa Ngumgcinitimali Wavelonkhe ngeKhomishini Yelukhetfo Letimele.
tgt: Seno se latetse katlenegiso e e dirilweng mo pegelong ya Mosireletsi wa Setšhaba.

src: Yabele Indvuna yeLitiko Letasekhaya kutsi ilandzelele ludzaba futsi yatise iKhabhinethi.
tgt: E laetse Tona ya Merero ya Selegae go latedisisa morero oo le go begela Kabinete.11 Kabinete e kgalema ka mantswe a a bogale bosenyi jwa digongwana jo bo tswelelang pele kwa Kapa Bophirima, jo gantsi bo tletseng ditlhaselo tse di maswe le setlhogo mo baaging le, bogolo segolo mo baneng.

src: Loku ngeke kubeketelelwe njengobe kusongela loko lesikuzuze kuyintsandvo yelinyenti yetfu.
tgt: Re ka se itshokele seno gonne se tshosetsa diphitlhelelo tse re di fitlhetletseng mo temokerasing ya rona.

src: IKhabhinethi ibonga umsebenti lowentiwa Luphiko Lwemisebenti Yemaphoyisa AseNingizimu Afrika ekulweni nemacembu emagenge futsi imema imimango letsintsekako kutsi isebentisane nemaphoyisa ekuvikeleni ummango wetfu kulolubhubhane.
tgt: Kabinete e lemoga tiro ya Tirelo ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa mo go lwantsheng bosenyi jwa digongwana mme e ikuela mo baaging ba ba amegang go dirasana le mapodisi go sireletsa baagi ba rona kgatlhanong le bosula jono.12 Kabinete e fetisa boutlwelobotlhoko le matshediso go balelapa le ditsala tsa ga Mme Martha Mahlangu yo e neng e le mmaagwe Mokaulengwe wa maloba wa MK, Solomon Mahlangu.

src: Martha Mahlangu labengumake wesishoshovu seMkonto Wesive lesingasekho Solomon Mahlangu.
tgt: Motsesetoropo wa Tshwane o direla Mme Mahlangu phitlho ya setšhaba mme difolaga di tla folosiwa go fitlha kwa bogareng go mo tlotla.

src: Mahlangu umgcwabo wembuso futsi imibhelebhele itawundizela phansi njengeluphawu lwekumhlonipha.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo mafapheng otlhe le diporefense go tswelela go tokafatsa boleng le lebelo la dipatlisiso tsa dingogorego gonne go kgotsofala ga baagi go le botlhokwa mo seriting sa Mogala wa Boikuelo go Moporesitente.

src: IKhabhinethi imema onkhe ematiko kanye netifundza kutsi titfutfukise lizinga kanye nekusheshisa luphenyo ngetikhalo njengobe kwenetiseka kwetakhamuti kubalulekile ekuhlonipheni Lucingo Lwamahhala Lwelihhovisi LaMengameli.
tgt: E tla re mo tsamaong ya nako, Tona ya Merero ya Selegae a sedifatse thulaganyo e e tla latelwang le letlha la tshimologo ya seo.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume kusetjentiswa kweLuhlelo Lwaminyaka yonkhe Lwekuphindza Kusebenta Kwenchubomgomo Yetimboni (IPAP) 2014/15-2016/17 lwesitfupha.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse gore ditsereganyo tsa Karolo ya 100 (1)

src: Umgomo lomkhulu we-IPAP kuvikela kuncipha kwetimboni kanye nekusekela kukhula kanye nekwehlukana kumkhakha wekukhicita eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: kwa Limpopo di tswelele pele, go letla gore go nne le ditlhotlhomiso ka Seetebosigo 2014 morago ga puso e ntšhwa e sena go tsena mo tirong.

src: Indvuna yeLitiko Letekuhwebelana Netetimboni itawukhuluma nebetindzaba ngesikhatsi sekutfulwa kwe-IPAP enyangeni letako.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse Ditlhotlhomiso tsa Phemelo ya Aforika Borwa ya 2014, mme ya laela gore e tlhagisiwe mo Palamenteng.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume indlela yekubukana nekuphelelwa kwetimvume letiniketwe ngaphansi kwemklamo Wekuniketa Imvume Lekhetsekile Bantfu baseZimbabwe (DZP).
tgt: Ditlhotlhomiso di tlamela ka pholisi ya phemelo ya pakatelele mmogo le tsela ya togamaano ya Phemelo e e tla latelwang ke naga mo dipakeng tse di latelang di le nne tsa Letlhomeso la Togamaano la Pakagare.

src: Bantfu labanalemvume kutawufanele baphindze bafake sicelo setimvume tabo eveni labo lekutalwa.
tgt: Lekwalo leno le tla abelanwa le setšhaba gonne se nnile le seabe mo dipatlomaikutlong tsa botlhe tse di neng di tshwerwe go ralala naga mo ngwageng o o fetileng.6 Kabinete e rebotse gore Pegelo ya Komiti ya Tona e e ka ga Pholisi ya Dipuo e phasaladiwe mo Kaseteng ya Puso gore setšhaba se tshwaele.

src: Indvuna yeLitiko Letasekhaya ngesikhatsi lesifanele itawuniketa inchazelo lebanti ngalenchubo kanye nelusuku lwekucala kwayo.
tgt: Pegelo e sekaseka tsamaiso ya thuto le katiso ya morago ga sekolo go lebeletswe bokao jwa ikonomi ya loago.

src: Loku kutawucinisekisa kuchubeka kwekungenelela kute kulungiswe tinsayela letisekhona.
tgt: E tlamela Tona ya Thuto le Katiso e Kgolwane ka dikatlenegiso tsa gore go ka tloswa jang dikgoreletsi tse di sa tlhokegeng tse di thibelang tswelelopele ya baithuti.

src: Loku kutawucinisekisa kutsi intfutfuko yesimo setimali etifundzeni nekwetfula tinsita tetenhlalakahle kanye naleminye imikhakha kuyachubeka kusebenta.
tgt: Pholisi ya Dipuo e kaya kgokaganyo e e rulaganeng ya ditheo tsa thuto, mananeo le borutegi gore baithuti ba kgone go tswelela mo ditseleng tse ba di itlhophetseng tsa thuto ka tsela e e bokgoni.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume Kubuketa Umbutfo Wekuvikela WaseNingizimu Afrika 2014, futsi yayala kutsi kwetfulwe ePhalamende.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse gore Pegelo go tswa kwa Setlhopheng sa Tiro sa Tona se se ka ga Mananeo a Motheo a Dipalo le Saense, e phasaladiwe mo Kaseteng ya Puso gore setšhaba se tshwaele.

src: Kubuketa kuniketa inchubomgomo yetekuvikela yesikhatsi lesidze kanye nelichinga Letekuvikela lelitawulandzelwa live kuletikhatsi letitako letine teLuhlaka Lwelichinga Lesikhatsi Lesiphakatsi.
tgt: Setlhopha sa Tiro sa Tona se romilwe go tlhama Lenaane la Motheo la Dipalo le Saense la Thuto le Katiso ya Tiro ya Setegeniki kwa Kholetšheng.

src: Loluhlaka lutawuhlanganyelwa nemmango, njengobe watibandzakanya ekubonisaneni nesive lokwentiwa kulo lonkhe live emnyakeni lowengcile.
tgt: Seno se tla thusa go oketsa palo ya baithuti ba ba tsenang kwa yunibesithi ba Saense le Dipalo le go tokafatsa bokgoni jwa boitlhamedi jaaka go tlhagisitswe mo Leanong la Bosetšhaba la Tlhabololo.

src: Umbiko ucwaninga imfundvo yengemuva kwesikolwa neluhlelo lwekucecesha kusimo senhlalo-mnotfo.
tgt: Lenaane le totile ba ba eletsang go tsena mo lephataneng la Thuto le Katiso ya Tiro ya Setegeniki, ba ba setseng ba le kwa dikholetšeng tsa thuto le katiso ya tiro ya setegeniki mme ba eletsa go tswelela pele le go ikwadisa kwa diyunibesithi, mmogo le barutwana ba Mophato wa 12 ba ba eletsang go ikwadisa kwa diyunibesithi fela ba sa kgotsofatse ditlhokego tsa Dipalo le Saense.

src: Uniketa tincomo eNdvuneni yeLitiko Letemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha ngendlela yekususa tihibe kanye netiphatamiso letivimba nobe tibambelele intfutfuko yebafundzi.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse gore diphitlhelelo tsa patlisiso ya 2012/13 ya kabo ya matlole a setšhaba malebana le ditiro tsa saense le thekenoloji di phasaladiwe.

src: Inchubomgomo yelulwimi ibhekisela ekuchumaneni lokuhlelekile kwetikhungo temfundvo, kanye neticu kute bafundzi bakwati kuchubeka netifundvo labatikhetsile ngendlela lekahle.
tgt: Mafapha a Bosetšhaba a beeleditse madi a a fopholediwang go R.5 bilione mo ditirong tsa saense le thekenoloji ka 2012/13, mme seo se emetse 3% ya kabelo ya tekanyetsokabo yotlhe ya puso ya bosetšhaba.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume Umbiko Welitsimba Lelisebentako Letindvuna Ngetinhlelo Letisisekelo Tetibalo Nesayensi, kutsi ushicilelwe kuGazethi Yahulumende kute sive siphawule ngawo.
tgt: Seno ke tokafalo go tswa kwa palogareng ya dingwaga tse nne ya 2.9% magareng ga 2008/09 go ya go 2011/12.Gape go totobetse gore puso e tlamela ka matlole bontsi jwa dipatlisiso tsa saense tse di diragalang mo Aforika Borwa, le gore bogolo jwa go tsenngwa tirisong ga tsona bo kwa ntle ga mafapha a bosetšhaba, go tewa kwa makgotleng a saense le kwa ditheong tsa thuto e kgolwane.

src: Litsimba Lelisebentako Letindvuna lajutjwa kutsi litfutfukise Luhlelo Lolusisekelo Lwemfundvo Yebuciko Bemisebenti Yetandla kanye Nekuceceshwa kwaseKolishi-lokusekelwe Kutibalo Nesayensi.
tgt: Kabinete e tlhaloseditswe ka tekanyetso e e dirilweng ke Lefapha la Tekolo le Tshekatsheko ya Tiro ka ga 'Ditlamorago tsa go Itsesewe ga Mophato wa R mo Dipoelothutong'.Dipeeletso tsa go sale gale mo kgolong le tlhabololo ya bana ba bannye di ka fokotsa go tlhoka tekatekano le go godisa tlhagiso, bogolo segolo mo baneng ba bannye.

src: Loku kutawusita ekwandziseni sibalo salabacala enyuvesi Tibalo Nesayensi futsi kukhulise likhono lekusungula tintfo njengobe ligcamiswe eLuhlelweni Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela diphitlhelelo tse di bonalang mo katolosong e e boitshegang ya Mophato wa R o go tlhokegang gore o godise bokgoni jwa ona gore o nne le dipoelo tse di botoka mo tiragatsong ya thuto.

src: Luhlelo lucondze kulabo labanenshisekelo yekungena kumkhakha weTifundvo Tebuciko Bemisebenti Yetandla kanye Nekuceceshwa, labo lasebenta tifundvo tebuciko bemisebenti yetandla nekuceceshwa emakolishi labafuna kutfutfuka futsi bangene emanyuvesi, kanye nakubafundzi beLibanga 12 labafuna kungena emanyuvesi kodvwa labangahlangabetani netimfuneko teTibalo neteSayensi Yefiziksi.8 IKhabhinethi ivume lokutfolakele kuluhlolombono 2012/13 ngetimali tekusekela sive emisebentini yetesayensi neyebuchwepheshe kutsi kushicilelwe.
tgt: Kabinete e itsesitswe ka diphitlhelelo tsa Lenaane la Tekolo ya Tlamelo ya Ditirelo tse di kwa Mantlheng mo ngwageng wa 2013.Kabinete e akgola e bile e rotloediwa ke tokafalo go tswa mo mafapheng a bosetšhaba a a maikarabelo, ka botsamaisi jwa togamaano le bookamedi jwa tiragatso ya kwa ditlamelong.

src: Ematiko Kuvelonkhe asise cishe R29,4 wemabhiliyoni emisebentini yesayensi kanye neyebuchwepheshe nga-2012/13, lokumelela 3% linani selilonkhe leliphakelo lahulumende lavelonkhe.
tgt: Diphitlhelelo tsa ditlamelo di le 186 (tse dilekolwang lwa ntlha) go ralala diporofense tsotlhe ka 2013 di supile gore palogare ya tekanyetso ya tlhokomelo e e seriti, lefelo le phitlhelelo mmogo le dinako tsa go bula le go tswala di lekanyeditswe bontle ke baagi le baelatlhoko.

src: Futsi kubufakazi bekutsi hulumende usekela ngetimali kucwaninga kwesayensi lokunyenti lokwentiwa lapha eNingizimu Afrika, futsi incenye lenkhulu yakho ingaphandle kwematiko avelonkhe, njengemikhandlu yesayensi kanye netikhungo temfundvo lephakeme.
tgt: Diphitlhelelo go tswa kwa ditlamelong di le 77 tse di etsweng tlhoko gape go lekanyetsa ditokafalo le tsona di bontshitse ditekanyetso tse di tokafetseng mme seo se bontsha matshwao a a siameng go lebeletswe go tsamaisa tiragatso ya kwa ditlamelong jaaka setlapele sa togamaano.

src: IKhabhinethi yatiswe ngeluhlolo Litiko Letekucaphela Nekulinganisa Kusebenta Kwahulumende mayelana ‘Nemtselela Wekwetfula Imiphumela Yekufundza Yelibanga R’.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse go amogelwa ga Kopano e e Kgethegileng ya Mokgatlho wa Tlhabololo ya Borwa jwa Aforika (SADC) ya Ditona tse di ikarabelang mo go tsa ICT, Tlhaeletsano le Ditirelo tsa Poso go tloga ka la bo 23 go fitlha ka la bo 25 Mopitlwe 2014, kwa Johannesburg.

src: IKhabhinethi iyancoma futsi ikhutsatekile ngentfutfuko yematiko avelonkhe lanesibopho, ngelichinga lawo lekuphatsa kanye nekwengamela tindzawo tekusebenta.
tgt: Mme Elaine Alexander mo phatlhatirong ya Motlatsamokaedikakaretso: Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi, Kgwebisano le Papatso kwa Lefapheng la Temothuo, Jalo ya Dikgwa le Bodirelatlhapi.

src: Lokutfolakele ngetindzawo leti-186 (letihlolwe kwekucala) kuto tonkhe tifundza phakatsi na-2013 kubonise kutsi silinganiso lesiphakatsi nendzawo sekuphatfwa ngenhlonipho, indzawo nekufinyeleleka kanye netikhatsi tekuvula netekuvala silinganiswe kahle takhamuti kanye nebahloli.
tgt: Mme Nkidi Dinah Mohoboko mo phatlhatirong ya Motlatsamokaedikakaretso: Akatemi ya go Ithuta kwa Lefapheng la Merero ya Selegae.

src: Tindzawo tekusebentela letidzinga kunakwa nguleti kuphatfwa kwetikhalo, kubonakala netimphawu, kulawulwa kwemalayini netikhatsi tekulindza kanye nekuphepha.
tgt: Rre Sam Themba Mtshisa mo phatlhatirong ya Motlatsamokaedikakaretso: Ditirelo tsa Setheo kwa Lefapheng la Ditiro tsa Puso.

src: Lokutfolakele etindzaweni letinge-77 letiphindze tahlolwa kute kubonakale intfutfuko futsi tibonakalise intfutfuko ngesilinganiso sato, timphawu tekutfutfuka ekuphatseni indzawo nelizinga lemsebenti njengelichinga lelisembili.
tgt: Mme Malijeng Theresa Ngqaleni mo phatlhatirong ya Motlatsamokaedikakaretso: Dikamano tsa mo gare ga Mafapha kwa Lefapheng la Matlole a Bosetšhaba.

src: 2.11 IKhabhinethi yemukele kungeniswa eNingizimu Afrika Kwemhlangano Wekutfutfukiswa Kwemave lase-Afrika leseNingizimu Longakavami weTindvuna letiphetse i-ICT, Tekuchumana kanye Netinsita Teliposi losukela mhla tinge-23 kuye kumhla tinge-25 Indlovulenkhulu 2014, eJozi.
tgt: Rre Michael Sass mo phatlhatirong ya Ramatlotlokakaretso kwa Lefapheng la Matlole a Bosetšhaba.

src: Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni tanyalo.
tgt: Seemo sa Kabinete mo mererong ya ga jaanong.

src: IKhabhinethi iyitfokotele Inkhulumo Yebunjalo Belive yesikhombisa leyetfulwe nguMengameli Jacob Zuma ngaLesibili, 17 Inhlaba, 2014.
tgt: Kabinete e itumeletse Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba ya bosupa e e tlhagisitsweng ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ka Labobedi wa Seetebosigo 2014.

src: Tinhlelo letigcanyiswe nguMengameli letibuye futsi ticondziswe Luhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (i-NDP) titawuhlahlelwa kulamaviki letako ngemacembu eTindvuna.
tgt: Manaane a a tlhagisitsweng ke Moporesitente mme a kaelwa ke Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) a tla tlhalosiwa ka botlalo ke ditlhopha tse di farologaneng tsa Ditona mo dibekeng tse di tlang.

src: Ngekwemoya weSisonkhe Sichubekisela INingizimu Afrika Embili, iKhabhinethi imema yonkhe imikhakha kutsi ibambisane naHulumende ekulingeni kuphumelelisa Luhlelo Lwekusebenta lolusha, lolwakhela etikwetimphumelelo letizuzwe kuleMinyaka Yenkhululeko lenge-20 leyendlulile.
tgt: Ka mowa wa Mmogo tla re tsweletseng pele Aforika Borwa, Kabinete e ikuela mo makaleng otlhe a setšhaba go dirisana le puso mo go tsenyeng tirisong Lenaane la Tiro le lentšhwa, le le agelelang mo godimo ga dikatlego tse di fitlheletsweng mo Dingwageng di le 20 tsa Kgololesego.2 Kabinete e itumeletse go khutlisiwa ga ditshupetso tse di neng di tsweletse mo dikgweding di le tlhano mo Ditlamong tsa Polatinamo.

src: Lesiteleka lesidvonse sikhatsi lesidze sibe nemphumela lomubi kakhulu kutisebenti, bacashi nakumnotfo wetfu jikelele.
tgt: Ditshupetso tsa nako e telele tseno di nnile le ditiragalo tse di sa itumediseng mo badiring, mo bathaping mmogo le mo ikonoming ya rona yotlhe.

src: Nanoma nje lilungelo lekuteleka livikelekile kuMtsetfosisekelo wetfu nakumitsetfo lebukene netisebenti, iKhabhinethi icela bacashi nembutfo wetisebenti kutsi uphetse masinyane tingcoco tekubonisana nekutsi kungwenywe letiteleka letitsatsa sikhatsi lesidze kuphela.
tgt: Le fa tshwanelo ya go dira ditshupetso e sireleditswe ke Molaotheo wa rona le mo melaong ya ditiro, Kabinete e ikuela mo bathaping le mo mekgatlhong ya ditiro ka bobedi go rarabolola dipuisano ka potlako le go efoga ditshupetso tsa mothale oo tsa nako e telele.

src: Kuphumelela kwetinhlelo tetfu tekutfutfukisa kusime emnotfweni losimeme nalochubekela embili ngekukhula ngemandla.
tgt: Katlego ya manaane a rona a tlhabololo e ikaegile mo ikonoming e e tsepameng le go dira bontle.

src: Njengebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, sonkhe sinesibopho sekukhulisa umnonotfo walelive.3 IKhabhinethi ikubonile kwehliswa kweNingizimu Afrika yehliswa ngema-Ejensi lahlolako, i-Standard and Poor’s, kanye ne-Fitch kuleliviki leliphelile.
tgt: Jaaka maAforika Borwa, rotlhe re na le maikarabelo a go godisa ikonomi ya naga.3 Kabinete e etse tlhoko go pagololwa ga Aforika Borwa ke ditheo tsa tekanyetso e leng sa Standard and Poor’s, le sa Fitch mo bekeng e e fetileng.

src: IKhabhinethi nayo isho ngekuphindzelela kutsi hulumende uticaphele letinselele tekukhula kwemnotfo iNingizimu Afrika lebukene nato.
tgt: Kabinete a santse e buseletsa gore puso e itukiseditse dikgwetlho tsa kgolo tseo Aforika Borwa e tobaneng le tsone.

src: Hulumende sewubeke embili kusheshisa kulinga kuphunyeleliswa kwe-NDP, kanye netilungiso lekuhloswe ngato kutsi tikhulule emandla ekutfutfuka kweNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Puso e potlakisitse tsenngotirisong e e potlakisitsweng ya NDP ka dipaakanyo tse di ikaeletseng go tlhagisa bokgoni jwa kgolo jwa Aforika Borwa.

src: Hulumende utinikele ekwenteni kancono kulawula, kunciphisa kweswelakala kwemakhono kanye nekusheshisa luhlelo lwelutjalomali lwesakhiwonchanti sako njengencenye yekususa tikhinyabeto letivimba kukhula.4 IKhabhinethi yemukela loko lokutfolwe Luklayo Lwemakhaya Jikelelelwanga-2013 lolusandza kukhululwa beLihhovisi Lelubalobalo laseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Puso e ikemiseditse go tokafatsa tikologo ya melawanataolo, ka go fokotsa tlhokego ya bokgonile go potlakisa lenaane la yone la peeletso mo mafaratlhatlheng jaaka karolo ya go tlosa dikgwetlho tse di kgoreletsang kgolo.4 Kabinete e amogetse diphitlhelelo tsa Dipatlisisokakaretso tsa Malapa tse di tlhagisitsweng ke Lefapha la Mananepalo la Aforika Borwa mo malobeng.

src: Loku lokutfoliwe kucinisekisa lokuhle lokungakhulunywa ngako kwekutsi tinchubomgomo netinhlelo tahulumende leticinile tigucula timphilo tebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika tiba nguletincono.
tgt: Diphitlhelelo tseno di netefaletsa naane e ntle ya gore manaane le dipholisi tsa puso tse di nonofileng di fetola matshelo a maAforika Borwa gore a nne botoka.

src: Loluklayo lucinisekisa kutsi kufinyelela tinsita letifana nemanti, kubutfwa kwekhukhuma, kuniketwa tindlu nemfundvo yamahhala kukhombise kukhula njalo kulesikhatsi.
tgt: Dipatlisiso tseno di netefaletsa gore phitlhelelo ya ditirelo e e jaaka ya metsi, go rwalwa ga ditlakala, dintlo le thuto e e sa duelelweng di itshupile di gola ka nanabelo mo tsamaong ya nako.

src: Linani lebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labatfola emanti empompi likhule laya kulange-89,9% kwatsi linani lemakhaya lasachunyelwe gezi lifike kulange-85% nga-2013.Luhlelo lwemali lesibonelelo sahulumende luyachubeka nekuba siphephelo semindeni kanye nemimango lebeyingahlukubeteka kakhulu ihlukubetwe buphuya lobucakile nekungasebenti.
tgt: MaAforika a a nang le metsi a dipompo a oketsegile go fitlha mo 89,9% fa malapa a a tsentsheditsweng motlakase a e eme mo 85% ka2013.Lenaane la puso la dithebolelo tsa loago le tswelapele go abelana ka madi a tshireletsego mo malapeng le mo baaging bao ntle le thuso ya mothale o ba tla sotlegang le go feta ka leuba la bohuma le go tlhoka ditiro.

src: Linani lebantfu lelifinyelela sibonelelo sahulumende likhule kusuka kulaba-13,7% nga-2003 laya kulange-45,5% nga-2013.
tgt: Palo ya batho ba ba bonang dithebolelo tsa loago e oketsegile go tloga mo 13,7% ka 2003 go fitlha mo 45,5% ka 2013.

src: Emaphesenti ebantfu labalambako lehle lesuka kulabange-29,3% nga-2002 laya kula-13,4% nga-20.5 IKhabhinethi yemukele litsimba laseNingizimu Afrika lelisezingeni lelisetulu leliholwa nguMengameli Jacob Zuma leliyohlanganyela kuNgcungcutsela Yemave Ase-Afrika Lahlangane ye-23 lemayelana nalengcikitsi: “Kucinisekiswa Kwetekulima Nekudla e-Afrika”.Lengcungcutsela itawubanjwa kusukela mhla tinge-20 kuya kumhla tinge-27 Inhlaba 2014 eMalabo eRiphabhulikhi ye-Equatorial Guinea.
tgt: Diphesente tsa malapa a a robalang ka tlala e wetse kwa tlase go tloga mo 29,3% ka 2002 go fitlha mo 13,4% ka 20.5 Kabinete e tsibogetse boeteledipele jo bo kwa setlhoeng jo bo etilweng pele ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma jo bo emetseng Aforika Borwa ka go tsenela Samiti ya Mokgatlho wa Aforika ya bo 23 ka moono yo o reng “Temothuo le Tlhagiso e e sa Tlhaeleng ya Dijo mo Aforika.” Samiti e simolola ka la bo 20 go fitlha ka la bo 27 Seetebosigo 2014 kwa Malabo e e kwa Rephaboliking ya Equatorial Guinea.

src: Njengencenye yalelivekati, iNingizimu Afrika itawufaka ligalelo ku-ajenda ye-Afrika futsi itawufaka emandla nemfutfo kuleNgcungcutsela kute kwentiwe kancono tinhlelo tekutfutfukisa lelive lakitsi.6 IKhabhinethi incoma Litiko Letebuciko Nemasiko kanye ne-Ejensi Yetekutfutfukisa Lusha Lwavelonkhe mayelana nekuhola imisebenti Yenyanga Yelusha ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi “Lusha Luchubekisela INingizimu Afrika Embili”.Lapho sichubeka nekugubha umkhosi weNyanga Yelusha, iKhabhinethi isho ngekuphindzelela luhlelo lwahulumende lwekusebenta nebantfu labasha kutsi bagucule timphilo tabo babuye futsi bagucule nalelive.
tgt: Jaaka karolo ya kontinente, Aforika Borwa e tla bo e nna le seabe mo dipuisanong tsa maitlhomo ka ga tlhabololo ya Aforika mme se tla thusa samiti go matlafatsa manaane a tlhabololo mo nageng.6 Kabinete e lebogisitse Lefapha la Botsweretshi le Setso le mmogo le Setheo sa Tlhabololo ya Bašwa sa Bosetšhaba ka go etelapele ditiragalo tsa Kgwedi ya Bašwa ka moono wa “Bašwa ba tsweletsa pele Aforika Borwa.”Jaaka re tswelapele go keteka Kgwedi ya Bašwa, Kabinete a santse e buseletsa lenaane la puso la go dirisana le bašwa go fetola matshelo a bone le go tlhabolola WEBTOKEN dingwageng di le tlhano fela, R2,7 bilione e beetswe kwa thoko go tshegetsa ka matlole boitlhamedikgwebo jwa bašwa, dibasari tsa baithuti di menagane gabedi mme manaane a go simolola sekolo go sa le gale a thusitse kgato ya motheo mo baneng.

src: Kuleminyaka lesishlanu leyendlulile iyodvwana, kwabekwa eceleni imali letigidzigidzi le-2.7 yekwelekelela kumabhizinisi elusha, imifundzate yebafundzi iphindzeke kabili netinhlelo tekufundza tebantfwana labancane titfutfukise sigaba lesisisekelo sebantfwana.
tgt: Ditsereganyo tsa mothale o di tla tswelapele go nna tsepamisomogopolo ya puso, jaaka re laletsa bašwa go dirisana mmogo le rona mo go tsweletseng pele Aforika Borwa.

src: Tincumo teKhabhinethi Letibalulekile.
tgt: Ditshweetso tse di botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.

src: IKhabhinethi inconyiwe ngenchubekela embili lesiyentile ekwakheni Inchubomgomo Yavelonkhe Yekubukana Nekugucuka Kwesimo Selituli (i-NCCRP): Tinhlatiyo Tekunciphisa Imimoya Lebanga Sivuvu Esibhakabhakeni (i-GHG).
tgt: Kabinete e tlotlomaditse kgatelopele e re e dirileng mo go tlhabololeng Pholisi ya Bosetšhaba ya Phetogo ya Maemo a Loapi: Gase ya Mowa wa Lefaufau (GHG) e e ka ga Ditlharololo tsa Phokotso Bogale.

src: Lombiko uhlatiya kusebenta kweNingizimu Afrika ekulawuleni ngemphumelelo lifutse lekugucuka kwesimo selitulu, ibuye futsi ibeke tincomo teligalelo leNingizimu Afrika kumitamo yemhlaba jikelele yekunciphisa kushuba kwe-GHG .
tgt: Pegelo e tlharolola tiro eo Aforika Borwa e e dirileng mo bolaoding jo bo utlwalang mo ditiragalong tsa phetogong ya loapi, mme e dira dikatlenegiso tsa tseokarolo ya Aforika Borwa mo maitekong a lefatshe ka bophara a go fokotsa kitlano ya GHG e e kwa lefaufaung.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze yatfola umbikoluhlaka lomayelana neLuhlu Loluphelele LweNingizimu Afrika Lwemimoya Lebanga Sivuvu Esibhakabhakeni, lwanga-2000 – 2010.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gape le pegelotlhomo ya Lenanethoto la Gase ya Mowa wa Lefaufau la Bosetšhaba, mo nakong ya 2000-2010.

src: Loku kuhambisana neLuhlaka Lwavelonkhe Loluhlangene lwesivumelwane lesimayelana nekuGucuka Kwesimo Selitulu lesasayinwa yiNingizimu nga-1997.
tgt: Seno se tsamaisana le tumelano ya Letlhomeso la Dinagakopano ka ga Phetogo ya Loapi leo Aforika Borwa e le saenileng semmuso ka 1997.Go ya ka tumelano eno dinaga di tshwanetse go neelana ka dipegelo tsa tsona tsa kgatelopele mo ntlheng eno mo morago ga dingwaga tse dingwe le tse dingwe di le pedi.

src: Umbikoluhlaka lokhona kwamanje ukhululiwe kute ummango uphawule ngawo.
tgt: Pegelotlhomo ya ga jaanong e phasaladitswe gore setšaba se dire ditshwaelo ka ga yone.

src: Utawupolishwa kute uphetfwe ulungele kungeniswa ekuhambeni kwalomnyaka.
tgt: E tla konosediwa le go baakanyediwa go abelana ka yona kwa bofelong jwa ngwaga.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuvunywa kwendzawo lensha lekufanele ivikelwe, Indzawo Yetemagugu Nemafa Emhlaba yaseMapungubwe Likomidi Lemhlaba Letemagugu Nemafa le-Unesco lelabamba Umhlangano walo we-38 eDoha, Qatar, kusukela mhla ti-15 kuya kumhla tinge-25 Inhlaba 2014.Lendzawo lensha yetemagugu nemafa lekufanele ivikelwe ingumphumela wetingcoco tekubonisana letitsetse sikhatsi lesidze letifake ekhatsi banikati bemihlaba, bameleli bemimango, tinhlangano letingesito tahulumende, tinkampani letimba timbiwa kanye nalabanye labanyenti bahulumende labatsintsekako.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse tetlelelo ya Komiti ya Ngwaoboswa ya Lefatshe ya Unesco ka ga lefelo le lentšhwa la ditshomarelo e e neng e tshwere Kopano ya yone ya bo 38 kwa Doha, Qatar go simolola ka la bo 15 go fitlha ka la bo 25 Seetebosigo 2014.Lefelo leno le lentšhwa la ditshomarelo ke ka ntlha ya thulaganyo e telele ya dipuisano magareng ga beng ba naga, baemedi ba baagi, mekgatlho e e seng ya puso, ditlamo tsa meepo mmogo le batsayakarolo ba ba farologaneng ba puso.

src: Lokuvunywa kwalendzawo lensha yetemafa nemagugu lekufanele ivikelwe kuyimitamo yeNingizimu Afrika leyemukelekako letawenta kancono kulawulwa nekuvikelwa kwendzawo yayo yetemafa nemagugu yemhlaba kube futsi kuvunyelwa kutfutfuka lokunesibopho nenchubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo.
tgt: Tetlelelo ya lefelo le lentšhwa la ditshomarelo leno ke kamogelo ya tlhabololo ya matsapa a Aforika Borwa a go tokafatsa bolaodi le tshireletso ya ngwaoboswa ya yone ya mafelo a lefatshe a ngwaoboswa fa e letlelela tlhabololo le maikarabelo a leruri.

src: INingizimu Afrika itawube ibambisane neLubanjiswano Lwetemphilo Yabomake, Maswane kanye Nebantfwana ekungeniseni Umhlangano Weforamu Yelubanjiswano lotawube ubanjelwe eSandton Convention Centre, Gauteng, kusukela mhla tinge-30 Inhlaba kuya kumhla lu-1 Kholwane 2014.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e tla bo e thusa go tsamaisa Kopano ya Foramo ya Tirisanommogo mo Tirisanommogong ya Boitekanelo jwa Bomme ba bana, Masea a a sa Tswang go Belegwa le jwa Bana kwa Tikwatikweng ya Kopanelo ya Sandton kwa Gauteng go simolola ka la bo 30 Seetebosigo go fitlha ka la bo 1 Phukwi 2014.

src: Lolubanjiswano luyinhlangano yemave emhlaba lolungeniswa yiNhlangano Yetemphilo Yemhlaba.
tgt: Tirisanommogo eno ke mokgatlho wa lefatshe ka bophara o o tsamaisiwang ke Mokgatlho wa Boitekanelo wa Lefatshe.

src: Kuhlanganyela ekungeniseni leForamu kuvula inkhundla lemayelana nekucinisa temphilo yabomake, bantfwana basesebancane eNingizimu Afrika kanye nekwenta yonkhe imikhakha yemmango kutsi ifake ligalelo kulomtamo.
tgt: Go thusa go tsamaisa foramo eno go neela tšhono ya go tsepamisa mogopolo mo botlhokweng jwa go natlafatsa didirisiwa, boitekanelo jwa masea a a sa tswang go belegwa le jwa bana mo Aforika Borwa mmogo le go tshwaraganya makala otlhe a setšhaba go tsayakarolo mo matsapeng ano.

src: Kukhululwa kweMbiko Wemave Emhlaba mayelana nekutsi umhlaba uchuba njani ekuhlangabetaneni neMgomo Wekutfutfukisa Welikhulumnyaka Wesine Newesihlanu kutawubuye kwente labo labatawube bahlangene bemikhakha yetemphilo nalengesiyo yetemphilo babukisise inchubekela embili netifundvo.
tgt: Phasalatso ya dipalo tsa ka fao lefatshe le dirang ka gone mo go fitlheleleng Maitlhomo a Tlhabololo a Ngwagakete a bo 4 le a bo 5 le one a tla letlelela batsayakarolo go tswa kwa makaleng a boitekanelo le a e seng a boitekanelo go itemogela kgatelopele le go ithuta.

src: Kutawubuye futsi kukhutsate kutiphendvulela nekuba nesibopho mayelana nabomake, bantfwana labasandza kubelekwa, kubantfwana nalasebangena esigabeni sebudzala, ibente bakhone kubona emalungelo abo ezingeni lelisetulu letemphilo lelingatfolakala eminyakeni kuya ku-2015 nekwendlula lapho.
tgt: E tla rotloetsa gape le maikarabelo a magolo mo basading, mo maseeng a a sa tswang go belegwa, mo baneng ba bannye le mo baneng ba bosima, go ba thusa go fitlhelela tshwanelo ya go iponela maemo a a kwa godimo a a fitlhelesegang a boitekanelo mo dingwageng tsa 2015 le go feta.2 Aforika Borwa e tla bo e tshwere Dikgaisano tsa Bosetšhaba tsa Dipalo (IMO).

src: I-IMO ingumchudzelwano wemnyaka wekusombulula tibalo webafundzi betikolwa temabanga lasetulu, lobanjelwa emaveni lehlukene njalo ngemnyaka.
tgt: IMO ke dikgaisano tsa ngwaga tsa go rarabolola mathata tsa baithuti ba dikolong tse dikgolo, tse di tshwarelwang kwa dinageng tse di farologaneng ngwaga yo mongwe le yo mongwe.

src: Leli litfuba lelive letfu lekutsi likhombise likhono lekungenisa imikhosi yemhlaba lesezingeni lelisetulu ibuye futsi ikhombise, iphakamise bongcondvongcondvo betetibalo baseNingizimu Afrika labasezingeni lelisetulu.
tgt: Eno ke tšhono ya go bontsha bokgoni jwa naga ya rona jwa go tsamaisa meletlo ya maemo a a kwa godimo le go bontsha baithuti ba ba dirang bontle mo go tsa dipalo mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Samba semave la-109 asavele abhalisile kutsi atawuyingenela le-IMKubekwa etikhundleniIkhabhinethi ivume kubekwa etikhundleni kwanaba labalandzelako:.
tgt: Palogotlhe ya dinaga di le 109 di setse di ikwadiseditse IMGo thapiwaKabinete e amogetse go thapiwa ga ba ba latelang:.

src: Mnu GO Hollamby njengeLisekela Lemcondzisi Jikelele: Tetimali Nekulawulwa Kwalokutsengwako kuLitiko Letasekhaya.
tgt: Rre GO Hollamby go nna Motlatsamokaedikakaretso: Botsamaisi jwa Matlole le Tlamelo ya Taolo ya Dithoto kwa Lefapheng la Merero ya Selegae.

src: Ibhodi Yenhlangano Yelutjalomali Yahulumendea) Mnu Mcebisi Hubert Jonas, njengemcondzisi longasilophetse naSihlalo (ngesikhatsi aLisekela Lendvuna Yetetimali) b) neMnu Roshan Morar njengeLisekela laSihlalo (iminyaka lemitsatfu).
tgt: Lekgotla la Koporasi ya Dipeeletso tsa Bosetšhabaa) Rre Mcebisi Hubert Jonas, go nna tokololo e e seng ya bolaodi le go nna modulasetilo (mo nakong ya gagwe jaaka Motlatsatona wa Matlole) leb) Rre Roshan Morar go nna Motlatsa modulasetilo (sebaka sa dingwaga di le tharo).

src: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuta bonkhe bantfu baseNingizumu Afrika kutsi bahloniphe baphindze bakhumbule Mengameli waphambilini Nelson Mandela lotsandzekako kuleNyanga yaMandela ngekutsi bahlanganyele ngemdlandla kuMkankhaso weku“Hlanta iNingizimu Afrika”.
tgt: Kabinete e gakolola maAforika Borwa otlhe go tlotla le go gopola Moporesitente wa rona yo o rategang wa maloba, moswi Nelson Mandela mo Kgweding eno ya Mandela ka go nna le seabe se se tlhaga mo Letsholong la "Phepafatsa Aforika Borwa."

src: NgeLusuku lwaNelson Mandela mhla ti-18 Kholwane kanye nangalokubanti kakhulu kulenyanga lapho Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bafanele kutsi lokungenani banikele ngemaminitsi abo lange-67 bahlante iNingizimu Afrika ngekuya kwesimemo saMengameli Jacob Zuma ngesikhatsi etfula Inkhulumo yeBunjalo Belive.
tgt: Ka Letsatsi la Nelson Mandela ka la bo 18 Phukwi le go ralala kgwedi eno ka bophara, maAforika Borwa a tshwanetse go aba bonnye metsotso e le 67 go phepafatsa Aforika Borwa go ya ka kgoeletso ya Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ka nako ya Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba.

src: Mengameli waphambilini Nelson Mandela wasifundzisa kutsi nanoma ngabe ngubani angenta lifutse lelihle emmangweni wakubo.
tgt: Moporesitente wa maloba moswi Nelson Mandela o re rutile gore motho mongwe le mongwe a ka ama baagi ba gaabo ka tsela e e molemo.

src: Sonkhe sinesibopho sekuhlonipha imphilo yakhe ngekutsi sihlante, sente imimango yetfu kutsi ibe ncono futsi siyente ibe mihle.
tgt: Rotlhe re na le maikarabelo a go tlotla botshelo jwa gagwe ka go phepafatsa, go tokafatsa le go ntlafatsa ditšhaba tsa borona la rona.

src: IKhabhinethi iyalwemukela luhlelo lolukhulu lwekwentiwa kancono kwetitimela lwe-Ejensi Yetitimela Letitfutsa Bantfu YaseNingizimu (i-Prasa).
tgt: Kabinete e amogela lenaane le le kgolo la tsosoloso ya diporo la Setheo sa Diporo le Banamedi sa Aforika Borwa (PRASA).

src: Njengencenye yaloluhlelo, Indvuna Yetekutfutsa ivule idizayini yekugcina ye-Prasa yesitimela lesisha sha, sitimela sesimanje manje futsi lesisha lesitfutsa bantfu letichenya ngethekhnoloji yakamuva leniketwa yimboni yetitimela emhlabeni wonkhe jikelele.
tgt: Jaaka karolo ya lenaane leno, Tona ya Dipalangwa e sirolotse sethalo sa bofelo sa terena e ntšhwa, ya sešweng mme e babalesegile ya PRASA e e ipelang ka thekenoloji ya sešweng mo intasetering ya diterena go ralala lefatshe.

src: Leli ngulelinye ligcatsi lelikhetsekile lekutinikela kwahulumende kwakha sakhiwonchanti lesitawukhulisa umnotfo siphindze futsi sesekele kutsengwa.
tgt: Seno ke phitlhelelo e nngwe e e kgethegileng mo maitlamong a puso a go aga mafaratlhatlha a a tla susumetsang ikonomi le go tshegetsa theko ya selegae.

src: Sitimela sekucala se-Prasa silindzeleke kutsi sicale kuhamba nga-2015.
tgt: Go solofetswe gore terena ya ntlha ya PRASA e tla bo e le mo seporong ka 2015.

src: Lokuphuculwa kwenchubo yetitimela kutawenta kabusha tinsita temetro rail- ‘lokunguyona inkampani lenkhulu leletsa tingucuko kutetitfutsi temmango eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Go ntšhwafadiwa ga tsamaiso ya diterena go tla tokafatsa ditirelo tsa diterena tsa metro - 'sesusumetsi se segolo sa phetogo ya dipalangwa tsa botlhe mo Aforika Borwa.

src: I-Prasa itawusebentisa-R51 wetigidzigidzi kuleminyaka letako le-10 wekutsenga titimela letinge-600 letisezingeni lelisetulu tebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: PRASA e tla dirisa bokana ka R51 bilione mo dingwageng di le 10 tse di latelang go rekela batho ba Aforika Borwa diterena tsa maemo a a kwa godimo di le 600.

src: Samba lesinge-580 saletitimela titawakhiwa lapha eNingizimu Afrika efekhthri lensha letawakhiwa eDunnotar ngaphandle nje kwaseNigel Ekurhuleni kutawubita-R1 wesamba.
tgt: Palogotlhe ya diterena tseno di le 580 di tla agiwa mo Aforika Borwa kwa faboriking e ntšhwa e e tla dirwang kwa Dunnotar kwa ntle ga Nigel e e kwa Ekurhuleni ka ditshenyegelo tsa R1 bilione.

src: Lendzawo yekukhicita lenge-600 000 m2 yentelwe kutsi ikwati kufaka umshini wekukhicita, indzawo yekucecesha kanye nendzawo yetimboni letfutfukiswe ngalokuphelele.
tgt: Setheo sa bogolo jwa 600 000 m2 se diretswe go kgona go tsenya polante ya bodirelo, tlamelo ya katiso mmogo le phaka e e feletseng ya bodirelo.

src: Lomklamo utawakha imisebenti ngco le-8 088, leyincenye yemisebenti ngco nalengakacondzi ngco lengetulu kwe-33 000 esikhatsini seminyaka le-10, izuze lizinga lendzawo lalokucuketfwe lelingetulu kwe-65%.I-Prasa itawucecesha samba sebantfu laba-19 527 (bonjinela, labenta imisebenti yetandla, labasebenta ngetintfo tesithekhnikhi, bashayeli betitimela futsi, emkhatsini walabanye, bocwepheshe) ngesikhatsi salomklamo.
tgt: Porojeke e tla tlhama ditiro tsa tlhamalalo di le 8 088, e leng karolo ya ditiro di le 33 000 tsa tlhamalalo le tse e seng tsa tlhamalalo mo pakeng ya dingwaga di le 10, go fitlhelela tiragatso ya selegae ya go feta 65%.

src: Luhlelo Lwekwenta Kabusha Incumbi Yetitfutsi Letihamba Kujantji lubanti kakhulu kunekutsengwa kwetitimela, lumikhakha lemitsatfu letawubuyisela lemboni ekudvunyisweni kwayo kwaphambilini, luvusetele umkhakha webunjinela bajantji luphindze futsi lufake sandla ekutfutfukisweni kwemnotfo nekwenta tintfo letifanele simondzawo.
tgt: Palogotlhe ya batho ba le 19 527 (baenjiniri, badiri ka diatla, bategeniki, bakgweetsi ba diterena le, gareng ga ba bangwe, bathekenoloji) mo nakong ya porojeke.

src: IKhabhinethi iyawemukela Umshini Wekwakha Timoto Wekucala (i-FAW) WaseNingizimu Afrika nekusebenta kwawo eNdzaweni Yekutfutfukisa Timboni yase-COEGA (e-IDZ) leyetfulwe nguMengameli Jacob Zuma kuLidolobhakati laseNelson Mandela Bay eBhayi, eMphumalanga Kapa.
tgt: Lenaane la Ntšhwafatso ya Dipalangwa la Kgwebo ya Diterene ga le fela ka ga go rekwa ga diterena, le ka ga dipilara di le tharo tse di tla busetsang intaseteri eno kwa serodumong sa yona sa maloba, tsa tsosolosa lephata la rona la boenjiniri jwa diterena mmogo le go tshwaela mo tlhabololong ya ikonomi ya selegae.

src: Lomklamo lotawukhicita emaloli latigidzi letinge-600, lomise kuZone 2 we-COEGA IDZ usitwa ngetimali ngekuhlanganyela yiKoporasi Yelitsimba Le-FAW LaseShayina kanye neSikhwama Sekutfutfukisa Se-Afrika neShayina.
tgt: Kabinete gompieno e amogela go tlhongwa ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ga polante ya go lomaganya le go dira ya Ditirelo tsa Dikoloi tsa Ntlha (FAW) ya Aforika Borwa ya Kgaolo ya Tlhabololo ya Diintaseteri (IDZ) kwa COEGA kwa Motsemogolong wa Nelson Mandela Bay kwa Port Elizabeth, e e kwa Kapa Botlhaba.

src: Ngulolunye lwelutjalomali lolukhulukati lolwentiwe yiNkampani yemaShayina.
tgt: Polante ya go lomaganya dilori ya R600 milione e e fitlhelwang kwa Kgaolong ya 2 ya COEGA IDZ e tlamelwa ka matlole ke Koporasi ya Setlhopha sa China FAW mmogo le Letlole la Tlhabololo la China-Africa.

src: Lomshini utawufaka ligalelo lelikhulu kumigomo yavelonkhe yekutfutfukiswa kwemnotfo netenhlalo njengobe kulondvoletekile kuLuhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe(NDP), Indlela Yentfutfuko Lensha kanye neTinhlelo Tekusebenta Tenchubomgomo Yetimboni.
tgt: Polante eno e tla tshwaela mo go bonalang mo maitlhomong a bosetšhaba a tlhabololo ya ikonomi-loago jaaka a fitlhelwa mo Leanong la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP), Leano le Lentšhwa la Puso la Kgolo ya Ikonomi mmogo le Maanotiro a Pholisi ya Diintaseteri.

src: Tinzuzo teNelson Mandela Bay nesigodzi lesikhulu saseMphumalanga Kapa tifaka ekhatsi kukhicitwa kwelutjalomali ngco lwemave angaphandle lolutawakha imisebenti lechubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo luphindze lwente kubekhona ematfuba ekutfutfukisa emakhono nekucecesha.
tgt: Mesola e e bonwang ke Nelson Mandela Bay le kgaolo ya Kapa Botlhaba ka kakaretso e akaretsa go ngokiwa ga peeletso ya tlhamalalo go tswa kwa dinageng tsa kwa ntle e e tla lebisang kwa go tlhamiweng ga ditiro tsa leruri le go tlamela ditšhono tsa tlhabololo le katiso.

src: IKhabhinethi iyaphindza futsi igceka kwebiwa kwetintsambo tagezi kubojantji, takhiwonchanti temmango tagezi netamasipala.
tgt: Gape Kabinete e nyatsa bogodu jwa dikheibole go tswa mo mafaratlhatlheng a diterena, motlakase le makgotlatoropo.

src: Kweba kwaloluhlobo kukhinyabeta kuhamba busheleleti kwemnotfo walelive futsi kuletinye tehlakalo kufaka engotini timphilo tebantfu.
