tgt: Gape kabinete e amogela kitsiso ya gore mo ngwageng o o tlang lefapha le tla tlhoma porojeke e e tla dirang gore go agwe dintlo di le 60 000.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela inchubekelembili leyentiwe ngumklamo i-Tshepo 10 000, lesita ngekucedza kuswela umsebenti kwebantfu labasha eDolobheni laseTshwane.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela tswelelopele e e dirilweng ke porojeke ya Tshepo “Tsholofelo” 10 000, e e thusang go fedisa botlhokatiro jwa bašwa mo Toropokgolong ya Tshwane.

src: Lomklamo wetigidzigidzi temarandi lowentiwa Lidolobhakati, ngekuhlanganyela Nenyuvesi yasePitoli uhlose kucecesha bantfu labasha labangasebenti la-10 000 ngekutsi babanike emakhono nebungcweti lobudzingekako nawusungula imiklamo.
tgt: Go solofetswe fa porojeke eno ya dimilionemilione tsa diranta ya Toropokgolo, ka tirisanommogo le Yunibesithi ya Pretoria, e tla katisa bašwa ba le 10 000 ba ba sa direng ka go ba naya bokgoni le boitseanape jo bo tlhokegang go dira gore ba kgone go iponela tlamelo ya diporojeke.

src: Bantfu labasha nasebacedze kuceceshwa basungula tinhlangano tekusebenta ngekuhlanganyela batichube ngemphumelelo.
tgt: Morago ga go wetsa katiso, bašwa ba simolola le go tsamaisa dikoporasi tse di atlegileng.

src: Kute kube ngunyalo, kunetinhlangano letisebenta ngekuhlanganyela leti-190 lesetidale ematfuba emisebenti kubantfu labasha labanengi.
tgt: Go fitlha ga jaana, dikoporasi di feta 190 di tlametse bašwa ba le bantsi ka ditšhono tsa ditiro.

src: Kwengeta, ematiko elidolobhalakati acasha labanye balabantfu labasha labaceceshiwe.
tgt: Go tlaleletsa foo, mafapha a toropokgolo a thapa bangwe ba bašwa ba ba katisitsweng.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kwentiwa ncono kwemgwaco i-R25 (P6-1), umgwaco longemakhilomitha lange-42 lochumanisa iGauteng nesifundza saseLimpopo.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go ntšhwafadiwa ga tsela ya R25 (P6-1), tsela ya dikilomitara di le 42 e e golaganyang Gauteng le Limpopo.

src: Lomklamo walomgwaco, lodzabula emkhatsini weBapsfontein neBronkhorstspruit, ucashe bantfu labangetulu kwe-200.
tgt: Porojeke e e magareng ga Bapsfontein le Bronkhorstspruit, e thapile batho ba feta 200.

src: Kutawuphindza futsi kuzuze imikhakha yetekulima newetimayini lekulendzawo ngekutsi kugcugcuteleke kuhamba ngekushesha kwemaloli latfwala timphahla.
tgt: Gape e tla ungwela maphata a temothuo le meepo mo tikologong eo ka go tsweletsa motsamao o o bonako wa dilori tsa dithoto tse di rwalang dithoto le tsa ditirelo.

src: Tincumo TeKhabhinethi Letibalulekile.
tgt: Ditshwetso tse di botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.

src: IKhabhinethi yabikelwa ngalamafishane Litiko Letesayensi Nethekinoloji, lelitawube libambe liviki letesayensi lemmango: Inkhundla Yetesayensi yaseNingizimu Afrika ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “kucala inkhulumiswano mayelana netesayensi” kusukela mhla ti-8 kuya mhla ti-9 Ingongoni 2015, ePitoli.
tgt: Kabinete e begetswe ke Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji fa le tla bo le amogetse beke e kgolo ya saense: Foramo ya Saense ya Aforika Borwa 2015 ka moono wa: "Re tlhotlheletsa puisano ka ga saense" go tloga ka la bo 8 go fitlha ka la bo 9 Sedimonthole 2015 kwa Pretoria.

src: Lomcimbi unika labatsintsekako baseNingizimu Afrika, bakulelivekati kanye nebalingani bemave ngemave inkhundla yekubamba tinkhulumomphikiswano kanye nekufundza ngenchubomgomo lemayelana nesayensi nemmango.
tgt: Tiragalo eno e tlamela baamegi ba Aforika Borwa, balekane ba kontinente mmogo le ba boditšhabatšhaba ka serala sa go ganetsana le go ithuta ka dipholisi tse di malebana le mola magareng ga saense le baagi.

src: IKhabhinethi ivumile kutsi i-World Maritime Day Parallel Event ye-International Maritime Organisation (i-IMO) ibanjelwe eNingizimu Afrika nga-2020.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore Moletlo o o Paraletseng wa Letsatsi la tsa Mawatle wa Lefatshe wa Mokgatlho wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa tsa Mawatle (IMO) o tshwarelwe mo Aforika Borwa ka 2020.

src: Lihhovisi Lelitiko Letekutfutsa ngako-ke litawundlulisa lesincumo seKhabhinethi kuMkandlu we-IMO emhlanganweni lohlelwe kutsi ubanjwe mhla tinge-23 Lweti kute kube mhla ti-04 Ingongoni Imikhos letako.
tgt: Ka jalo Kantoro ya Tona ya Dipalangwa e tla fetisetsa tshwetso ya Kabinete kwa kopanong ya Lekgotla la IMO e e rulaganyeditsweng go tsena go tloga ka la bo 23 Ngwanaitseele go fitlha ka la bo 4 Sedimonthole Ditiragalo tse di tlang.

src: Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawube amukela umlingani wakhe waseChina Xi Jinping lotawuvakasha ngekwembuso emalanga lamabili kusukela mhla ti-02 kuya mhla ti-03 Ingongoni 2015.
tgt: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tla amogela molekane nae ka kemo wa kwa China Xi Jinping mo Leetong la Semmuso la matsatsi a le mabedi go tloga la bo 2 go fitlha la bo 3 Sedimonthole.

src: Lokuvakasha kuhlose kuphotfula Luhlaka Lweminyaka Le-5-10 LweChina neNingizimu Afrika lolumayelana neKusebentisana lolutawucinisa kucala kwekusebenta kwetivumelwane tetfu kusukela kwaphotfulwa Simemetelo saseBeijing nga-2010.
tgt: Maikaelelo a leeto ke go konosetsa Letlhomeso la Dingwaga di le 5-10 la Tirisanommogo ya China-Aforika Borwa le le tla tiisang tiragatso ya ditumelano tsa rona fa e sale go se na go konosediwa Tumelano ya Beijing ka 2010.

src: Lutawuphindza futsi lujulise luphindze lwandzise Budlelwane Bendlelalisu Lobuphelele lamave lamabili labelana ngabo.
tgt: Gape e tla maatlafatsa le go atolosa Selekane sa Togamaano se se Akaretsang se dinaga tseno di nang naso.

src: Budlelwane beNingizimu Afrika nelaseChina bumcoka ekufezekiseni luhlelo lwayo lwetentfutfuko ngekusebentisa inchubomgomo yayo yetangaphandle njengaloku yandzisa imitamo yekucalisa ngeLuhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwentfutfuko (i-NDP), kuhlanganyela kutekulima, kutemvelo, kutekuhwebelana netimboni kanye netetimali njengaloku lelive lichuba luhlelo lwekuchubela iNingizimu Afrika embili.
tgt: Dikamano tsa Aforika Borwa le China di botlhokwa mo go fitlheleleng morero wa tlhabololo ka pholisi ya boditšhaba jaaka di oketsa maiteko a go diragatsa Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP), go dirisana mmogo mo go tsa temothuo, merero ya tikologo, kgwebisano le indaseteri mmogo le ditšhelete jaaka naga e tsweletsa morero wa go tsweletsa pele Aforika Borwa.

src: Buphindze futsi budale litfuba lekubuketa inchubekelembili etintfweni letikhona tekuhwebelana kanye nekusebenta ngekuhlanganyela emkhatsini waletive letimbili, kanye nekuphotfula tindzawo letinsha tekusebenta ngekuhlanganyela.
tgt: Gape di tlamela ka tšhono ya go sekaseka tswelelopele mo dikarolong tse di ntseng di le teng tsa kgwebisano le tirisanommogo magareng ga dinaga di le pedi mmogo le go akofisa le go konosetsa dikarolo tse dintšhwa tsa tirisanommogo.

src: Mengameli Zuma utawuhola litsimba lelitawuya kuseshini yema-21 Yengcungcutsela Yemave yeLuhlaka Lwengcugcutsela YaMhlabuhlangene lemayelana neKuntjintja kweSimo Selitulu (i-UNFCCC) kanye neSeshini ye-11 yeNgcugcutsela yeMave lasebenta njengeKuhlangana kweMave kuSivumelwane saseKyoto (i-CMP11) letawubanjwa kusukela mhla tinge-30 Lweti kuya mhla ti-11 Ingongoni 2015 lapha eParis eFrance.
tgt: Moporesitente Zuma o tla etelela pele kemedi e e yang kwa kopanong ya bo 21 ya Khonferense ya Ditokololo tsa Tumelano ya Letlhomeso la Ditšhabakopano ya Phetogo ya Tlelaemete (UNFCCC) le Kopano ya bo 11 ya Khonferense ya Ditokololo tse di dirang kwa Kopanong ya Ditokololo tsa Phorotokholo ya Kyoto (CMP11) e e tla tshwarwang go tloga ka la bo 20 Ngwanaitseele go fitlha ka la bo 11 Sedimonthole 2015 kwa Paris, France.

src: Tinkhulumiswano tekucocisana temave ngemave mayelana nesivumelwane lesisha lesisemtsetfweni lesitakwakha indlela yekuphendvula mayelana nekuntjintja kwesimo selitulu, lesitawucala kusebenta kusukela nga-2020 kuya embili.
tgt: Dipuisano tsa boditšhabatšhaba tsa tumelano e ntšhwa ya semolao di tla rulaganya tsibogo ya phetogo ya tlelaemete, e e tla diragadiwang go tloga ka 2020 go ya pele, Go lepalepana le dikgatlhego tsa bosetšhaba tsa Aforika Borwa jaaka naga ya Aforika le e e tlhabologang e e tla tlhokang tshegetso morago ga 2020.

src: Ngekuhambisana naloko kwavelonkhe lokutsandvwa iNingizimu Afrika njengelive lelisatfutfuka lelitawudzinga kwesekelwa ngemuva kwa-2020, iNingizimu Afrika itawuchubeka ivikele tinchubomgomo te-UNFCCC letisisekelo tekulingana nekwehlukahlukana.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e tla tswelela go sireletsa dintlhatheo tsa botlhokwa tsa UNFCCC tsa tekatekano le dipharologano.

src: Emhlanganweni weMave lange-77 kanye neChina, iNingizimu Afrika itawuchubeka igcine iphindze icinise kubumbana kwemave lasatfutfuka kute itfole Sivumelwane saseParis lesingavuni muntfu, lesinenshisekelo lesisime kutesayensi nalesiveta litfuba lentfutfuko lemave lasatfutfuka.
tgt: Kwa kopanong ya Setlhopha sa 77+ kwa China, Aforika Borwa e tla bo e lebeletse go tshegetsa le go maatlafatsa kopano ya dinaga tse di tlhabologang go bona Tumelano ya Paris e e sa gobeleleng, e e mafolofolo, e e ikaegileng ka saense mme e neela dinaga tse di tlhabologang sebaka sa go tlhabologa.

src: Mengameli Zuma utakwetfula Umkhankhaso Wetinsuku le-16 Tenshukumo Yekulwa Neludlame lolucondziswe kubomake nakubantfwana mhla tinge-25 Lweti 2015 lapha eNaauwpoort, eMahikeng ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Angingene Nami: Sisonkhe Sichubekisela Embili iNingizimu Afrika Lete Ludlame.” Lomkhankhaso.
tgt: Moporesitente Zuma o tla tlhoma Letsholo la Matsatsi a le 16 a Kemokgatlhanong le Tshotlakako ya Basadi le Bana ka la bo 25 Ngwanaitseele 2015 kwa Naauwpoort, Mahikeng ka fa tlase ga moono: “Mpalelle: Mmogo re isa Aforika Borwa yo o senang tirisodikgoka pele'.

src: ugutjwa njengencenye yeTinsuku Letinge-365 Tenshukumo, lokungumkhankhaso lochubekako lokhutsata kucaphela ludlame lolucondziswe kubomake nakubantfwana nekugcugcutela lowo nalowo kutsi ahlanganyele naye kulenshukumo yemnyaka wonkhe.
tgt: Letsholo leno le ketekiwa e le karolo ya Matsatsi a le 365 a Kemokgatlhanong, e leng letsholo le le tswelelang pele le le tsibosang ka tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le basadi le bana, mme le rotloetsa batho go balelelwa mo kemokgatlhanong ya ngwaga otlhe.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bawusekele lomkhankhaso nekutsi basebentise lesikhatsi kugcugcutela imimango kanye nekuhlanganyela nahulumende ekucedzeni ludlame lolucondziswe kubomake nebantfwana - #Count me In.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe go tshegetsa letsholo leno le go dirisa paka eno go rotloetsa baagi le go dirisana mmogo le puso go fedisa tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le basadi le bana - #Count me In.

src: Lisekela laMengameli Ramaphosa utawuhola litsimba lahulumende ekucocisaneni kwabo lokubakhona njalo neNkhundla Yavelonkhe Yebahleli baseNingizimu Afrika (i-SANEF) mhla tinge-21 Lweti 2015 njengencenye yahulumende yekutinikela kanye neluhlelo loluchubekako lwekucinisa budlelwane nebetindzaba.
tgt: Motlatsamoporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etelela pele kemedi ya puso mo puisanong ya yona ya ka gale le Foramo ya Bosetšhaba ya Batseleganyi ya Aforika Borwa ka la bo 21 Ngwanaitseele 2015 jaaka karolo ya maitlamo a puso le lenaane le le tswelelang pele go maatlafatsa dikamano le bobegakgang.

src: Hulumende utawubikela bahleli ngalamafishane mayelana netindzaba letimcoka nangetinhlelo letitawkwentiwa ngaleyo ndlela bahleli batawutfola litfuba lekusho kuhulumende loko lokuyinshisekelo yabo.
tgt: Puso e tla bua le batseleganyi ka dintlha tsa botlhokwa mmogo le maano a a tlang mme e tla naya batseleganyi tšhono ya go tlhagisa dintlha tse ba nang le kgatlhego mo go tsona mo pusong.

src: INingizimu Afrika itawugubha Lusuku Lwemhlaba Lwe-AIDS ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi - “Situkulwane Lesite i-HIV: PHAKAMA YENTVIKELKUTE – ngumkhankhaso wekutsi imimango kube khona lekwentako.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e tla tshwaya Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS ka moono wa - "Go leba kwa Ditshikeng tse di senang HIV: EMTSAYA KGATSIRELETSLEFELA - e leng pitso ya gore baagi ba tseye dikgato.

src: Ingcikitsi yalomnyaka itsatselwe engcikitsini yaMhlabuhlangene yeLusuku Lwemhlaba Lwe-AIDS ya-2011 kuya ku-2015 letsi “Sente kutsi Kubete.” Lusuku Lwemhlaba Lwe-AIDS lwa-2015 lutawucinisa inkhulumiswano mayelana neluphawombi nekubandlululwa, kanye nekugcugcutela imimango kutsi ifinyelele ekuvikelekeni, ekwelashweni kanye nasekusekelweni.
tgt: Moono wa monongwaga o ikaegile ka moono wa Ditšhabakopano wa Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS wa 2011 go fitlha 2015 wa: "Go fitlhelela Lefela".

src: INingizimu Afrika iyachubeka ngekuba nemphumelo ekulweni ne-HIV ne-AIDS, njengaloku seyilwandzisise luhlelo lwalelive lwekwelapha i-HIV, lapho bantfu labangetulu kwetigidzi letintsatfu balshwa ngesidzambisigciwane, lokuyintfo lenciphisa kakhulu kwendluliseka kwesandvulelangculazi kumntfwana ngunina kanye netinkhomba letincono tesifo sesifuba.
tgt: Gape Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS la 2015 le tla maatlafatsa puisano e e ka ga mamodula le go tlhaolwa, le go rotloetsa baagi go tsiboga mmogo le go atolosa go fitlhelesega ga ditirelo tsa tshireletso, kalafi mmogo le tshegetso.

src: IKhabhinethi igcugcutela bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi batimbandzakanye emicimbini yeZimbizo letihlelwe kulo lonkhe lelive ngesikhatsi Seliviki Letimbizo Tavelonkhe kusukela mhla tinge-30 Lweti kuya mhla ti-6 Ingongoni 2015.
tgt: Tiragalo e kgolo ya go keteka Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS e tla tshwarwa kwa KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Letinkhundla tisita takhamuti kutsi ticocisane nemalunga eSigungu.
tgt: Seno se tla tlhagola tsela ya fa Aforika Borwa e tla bo e amogela Khonferense ya bo 21 ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya AIDS kwa Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre kwa Durban go tloga ka la bo 17 go fitlha ka la bo 22 Phukwi 2016.

src: Liviki Lembizo Yavelonkhe litawukwentiwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Sisonkhe Sichubekisela iNingizimu Afrika embili” futsi sitayatisa imimango mayelana nekucala kwekusebenta kweLisu Lemaphuzu Layimfica lahulumende macondzana nekugcugcutela kukhula kutemnotfo kanye nekudala imisebenti, njengaloku kwasho nguMengameli Zuma eNkhulumeni Yakhe Lemayelana Nesimo Selive ngenyanga yeNdlovulencane 2015.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e tswelela go nna le tswelelopele mo ntweng kgatlhanong le HIV le AIDS jaaka e atolositse lenaaneo la kalafi ya HIV la naga, moo batho ba ba fetang dimilione di le tharo ba leng mo kalafing ya antiretroviral, mme gape go fokoditswe tshwaetso ya go tswa go mme go ya go ngwana le go bona matshwao a a tokafetseng a bolwetse jwa lehuba.

src: Emalunga eSigungu atawuphindza futsi asebentise lelitfuba acinise kutimbandzakanye kwemmango ekusombululeni tinkinga tenhlalo letahlukahlukene, letifaka ekhata ludlame lolucondziswe kubomake nebantfwana.
tgt: Kabinete e rotloetsa maAforika Borwa go nna le seabe mo ditiragalong tsa Imbizo tse di rulaganyeditsweng go tla tshwarwa go ralala naga mo Bekeng ya Bosetšhaba e e totileng Imbizo go tloga ka la bo 30 Ngwanaitseele go fitlha ka la bo 6 Sedimonthole 2015.

src: Ingongoni Inyanga Yekubuyisana ngaleyo ndlela iNingizimu Afrika itawugubha Lusuku Lwekubuyisana mhla ti-16 Ingongoni lapha ePort Elizabeth eMphumalanga Kapa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kuvala Ligebe Lekwehlukana: Kwakha buve baseNingizimu lobuvamile lobuholela kumbuso wavelonkhe lonentfutfuko.” Lenyanga inekubaluleka lokukhetsekile esiveni ngobe ikhutsata kubuyisana, lucolo kanye nekubumbana ngekwetenhlalo lokuyintfo intsandvo yelinyenti lensha lesekelwe kuyo.
tgt: Beke ya Bosetšhaba e e Totileng Imbizo e tla diragala ka moono wa: "Mmogo re isa Aforika Borwa pele" mme e tla sedimosetsa baagi ka tiragatso ya puso ya Leano la Dintlharobongwe le le totileng go tlhotlhetsa kgolo ya ikonomi mmogo le go tlhama ditiro, jaaka le tlhagisitswe ke Moporesitente Zuma mo Puong ya gagwe ya Maemo a Setšhaba ka Tlhakole 2015.

src: IKhabhinethi igcugcutela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basebentise lenyanga kutsi bafinyelele kulowo nalowo njengaloku lesive sichubeka sisebenta ngekubambisana ekwakheni sive lesibumbene nalesiphumelelako.
tgt: Gape Ditokololo tsa Khuduthamaga di tla dirisa tšhono eno go susumetsa baagi go nna le seabe ka go samagana le mathata a a farologaneng a loago, go akarediwa merero e e amanang le tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le basadi le bana.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuta bakhokhi bentsela labangakangenise emafomu abo ekukhokha intsela anga-2014/15 kutsi lilanga lelingumncamulajucu lekuwangenisa ngumhla tinge-27 Lweti 2015.
tgt: Sedimonthole ke Kgwedi ya Poelano mme Aforika Borwa e tla keteka Letsatsi la Poelano ka la bo 16 Sedimonthole kwa Port Elizabeth, Kapa Botlhaba ka moono wa: "Go fedisa kgaogano: Go aga boAforika Borwa jo bo lebisang kwa nageng ya bosetšhaba ya tlhabologo".

src: IKhabhinethi ibonga bonkhe bakhokhi bentselo ngekuhlanganyela nahulumende ekunikeni ummango tisitakalo letidzingeka kakhulu letisa ekwenteni ncono timphilo tetinkhulungwane temimango lekhona kulo lonkhe lelive.
tgt: Kgwedi e na le bokao jo bo kgethegileng mo setšhabeng gonne e tsweletsa poelano, kagiso le tirisanommogo ya loago e leng seo puso e ntšhwa ya temokerasi ya naga e theilweng mo go sona.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Litiko Lekuntfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalakahle mayelana ne-Gender-Based Violence Command Centre (i-GBVCC) ngekuwina Umklomelo Wemhlaba wonkhe Wekuba Sikhungo Sekutsintsana Ngetincingo Lesiphuma embili lebewulapha eLas Vegas, eMelika ngaLesine ti-5 Lweti 2015.
tgt: Kabinete e rotloetsa maAforika Borwa otlhe go dirisa kgwedi go golagana jaaka setšhaba se tla bo se tswelela go dira mmogo go aga setšhaba se se kopaneng, se se humileng.

src: I-GBVCC isikhungo setincingo lesisebenta busuku nemini siletsa lusito lwekusekela nekululeka labo lavelelwe ludlame lwebulili.
tgt: Kabinete e leboga baduelalekgetho botlhe ka go dirisana mmogo le puso go tlamela ka ditirelo tse di tlhokegang bogolo segolo tse di thusang go tokafatsa matshelo a diketekete tsa baagi go ralala naga.

src: Lena ngulenye yetindzaba letimnandzi lekhombisa kutsi hulumende uyanakekela futsi utimisele ekulweni nekucedza ludlame lwebulili.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola Tikwatikwe e Kgolo e e Samaganang le tsa Bong e e Kgatlhanong le Tirisodikgoka (GBVCC) ya Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Loago ka go gapa Sekgele sa Global Best Contact Centre kwa Las Vegas, Amerika ka Labone, la bo 5 Ngwanaitseele 2015.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela baka-Eskom ngekusebenta tinsuku leti-100 ngaphandle kwekuncamula emandla agezi (kucisha gezi ngenhloso yekuwonga).
tgt: GBVCC ke tikwatikwe ya megala e e dirang bosigo le motshegare e e totileng go tlamela batswasetlhabelo ba tirisodikgoka e e ikaegileng ka bong ka tshegetso le tshegetso le thobomaikutlo.

src: Esikhundleni saloko, iKhabhinethi icela imimango kutsi ichubeke ilandzele tingenelelo tekonga emandla agezi.
tgt: Seno ke kgang e nngwe ya katlego e e bontshang puso e e kgathalang e e ikaeletseng go lwa go fedisa tirisodikgoka e e ikaegileng ka Bong.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela labo emagama abo lanyulwe kutsi bangene Umklomelo WaseNingizimu Afrika Wa-2015 Wetemidlalo lotawubanjwa mhla tinge-22 Lweti 2015 eSand du Plessis Theatre eMangaung, eFreyistata.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola Eskom ka go dira matsatsi a le 100 kwa ntle ga go kgaola tlamelo ya motlakase.

src: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bayagcugcutelwa kutsi basekele lomcimbi ngekutsi bavotele Inkhanyenti Yetemdlalo Yemnyaka wa-20.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola ba ba supetsweng Dikgele tsa Metshameko tsa Aforika Borwa tsa 2015 tse di tla tshwarwang ka la bo 22 Ngwanaitseele 2015 kwa Sand du Plessis Theater kwa Mangaung, Foreisetata.

src: INingizimu Afrika ime icinile ekusoleni kwayo konkhe kuhlasela lokucondziswe kubantfu bemmango labangati lutfo isaphindza isasho leme kuko kutsi buphekulasikhuni nome ngabe baluphi luhlobo futsi bentiwa ngubani, ngeke bucolelwe.
tgt: Dikgele, tse di tla tshwarwang ka moono wa: "Botswerere ga se ka go nna yo o gaisang ke ka ga go dira ka bojotlhe ka fao o ka kgonang", di keteka dingwaga di le 10 tsa go lemoga le go tlotla batho le ditlhopha tse di gaisang mo mabaleng le kwa ntle ga mabala.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakweseka kwenta kweLikomidi Lahulumende Letindvuna Lekuswelakala Kwemanti Nesomiso kunciphisa umphumela lomubi wesomiso kanye nekugcugcutela imimango kutsi isebentise emanti ngekuwongela likusasa.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a rotloediwa go tshegetsa tiragalo ka go tlhopha Naledi ya Metshameko ya Ngwaga wa Maemo a Kabinete mo Mererong e e Botlhokwa ya ga jaana.

src: Hulumende sewengete tigidzi letinge-R96,6 kuleto takucala letinge-R352,6 etigidzi letibekelwe eceleni kutsi tisekele imitamo yalelive yekulwa nesomiso.
tgt: Kabinete e golagane le Moporesitente Zuma mmogo le baagi ba boditšhabatšhaba go nyatsa ka mafoko a a bogale ditlhaselo tsa fa gautshwane tsa borukhutlhi tse di diragetseng kwa Beirut (Lebanon), Baghdad (Iraq), Yola (Nigeria) le Paris (France), tse di bakileng dintsho tsa batho ba ba senang molato mmogo le tshenyo ya dithoto.

src: Loku kufaka ekhatsi kutsengwa kwemaloli emathangi emanti lange-45 kute aletse emanti kuleto tindzawo letitsintsekile, kugujwa kwemigodzi yekudvonsa emanti, kongiwa kwemanti nekulawula kufuneka kwawo, kanye nekungeta imitfombo lapho kudzabuka khona emanti.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e tsepame mo go nyatseng ditlhaselo tsotlhe tse di totileng baagi ba ba senang molato mme e boeletsa seemo sa yona sa gore borukhutlhi, ka ditsela tsotlhe fela e bile go sa kgathalesege gore bo tswa kae, bo ka seke ba letlelelwa.

src: Litiko Letekutfutfukisa Kwetindzawo Tasemaphandleni Netingcuku Kutemhlaba kuleto tindzawo letitsintseke kakhulu litawuvumela kususwa kwemfuyo iyiswe emhlabeni wahulumende lapho kusanemadlelo khona lancono.
tgt: Kabinete e tshegetsa dikgato tsa Komiti ya Puso ya Ditona e e ka ga Tlhaelo ya Metsi le Komelelo ka go fokotsa ditlamorago tsa komelelo mme e ikuela mo baaging go somarela metsi go netefatsa tlamelo ya mo isagong.

src: Kwengeta kuloko, Litiko Letebusa Ngekubambisana Netendzabuko selichumane nabosodolobha kutsi kucale kusetjentiswe tinyatselo letahlukahlukene tekonga emanti ngaphasi kwekuholwa Litiko Letemanti Nekuhanjiswa Kwekungcola.
tgt: Kabinete e tlaleleditse ka R96,6 milione mo R352,6 milione e e neng e beetswe thoko kwa tshimologong go tshegetsa maiteko a naga a go namola.

src: Loku kufaka ekhatsi imikhawulo yemanti kweluswa kwekutsi iyagcinwa yini imikhawulo yemanti kusetjentiswa kwetigwebo lapho kudzingeka khona, kubeka embili kulungiswa kwetindzawo letivutisa emanti kusetjentiswa kwemathekinoloji longa emanti njengemathoyilethi lasebentisa emanti lamancane, kukhongotela emanti emvula kanye nekusebentisa emanti lamphunga nakuniselwa.
tgt: Seno se akaretsa go rekwa ga dilori tsa metsi di le 45 gore di rorele metsi kwa mafelong a a amegileng, go epiwa ga didiba le go di tsosolosa, tshomarelo ya metsi mmogo le tsamaiso ya tlhokego, mmogo le tshegetso ka metsi.

src: Mengameli Jacob Zuma uhole litsimba laseNingizimu Afrika kuNgcungcutsela Yebaholi be-G20 e-Antalya eTurkey kusukela mhla ti-15 kuya mhla ti-16 Lweti 2015.
tgt: Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Metseselegae le Ntšhwafastso ya Naga le tla letlelela gore mo mafelong a a amegileng thata go fudusediwe leruo kwa lefatsheng la puso koo go sa ntseng go na le mafulo a a botoka.

src: Ingcikitsi yalengcungcutsela bekukadze kubukhukhulelangoco, kutjala timali kekucala kusebentisa.
tgt: Go tlaleletsa foo, Lefapha la Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Setso le golagane le Boratoropo go diragatsa dikgato tse di farologaneng tsa go boloka metsi ka fa tlase ga kaelo ya Lefapha la Metsi le Kgeleloleswe.

src: Live laseNingizimu Afrika lisemkhatsini wemave lange-51 lasayine Sivumelwane Sekuntjintjiselana Ngekutentekela Ngelwatiso Lwentsela lapha eBerlin eGermany ngeMphala 2015.
tgt: Tsona di akaretsa go itsese tekanyetso ya metsi go tlhokomela kobamelo ya ditekanyetso tsa metsi go otlhaya ka detefiso fa go tlhokega go baakanya foo metsi a dutlang go nna setlapele go tsweletsa dithekenoloji tse di somarelang metsi di tshwana le ditanka tsa matlwana tse di sa diriseng metsi a mantsi go beeletsa metsi a pula mmogo le go nosetsa ka metsi a a dirisitsweng.

src: Mengameli Zuma wakwemukela kuphotfulwa kwetintfo lekumele tentiwe leti-15 temklamo we-G20/Inhlangano Yetekusebenta Ngekubambisana Kutemnotfo Nentfuntfuko Nekuntjintja Kwenzuzo, lebetikadze timcoka ekucinisekiseni kutsi imalingena yemave ase-Afrika aseningizimu neSahara iphatfwa ngalokufanele.
tgt: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o ne a eteletse pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa go ya kwa Samiting ya Baeteledipele ba G20 kwa Antalya, Turkey go tloga ka la bo 15 go fitlha ka la bo 16 Ngwanaitseele 2015.

src: Emalunga Omkhandlu Wetindvuna we-Southern African Customs Union (i-SACU) ahlangana mhla ti-11 Lweti 2015 lapha eWindhoek eNamibia ngembi kwekubekwa ngalokusemtsetfweni kwenhlokohhovisi ye-SACU kanye nekucocisana ngalokungekho emtsetfweni kweTinhloko tembuso te-SACU kanye naHulumende.
tgt: Moono wa samiti e ne e le kakaretso, dipeeletso le tiragatso.

src: Lomkhandlu wasebentisa lelitfuba kutsi ucabange ngemphumelelo leyentiwe mayelana neLisu Lemaphuzu Lasitfupha kusukela kumhlangano wawo wekugcina kanye nekugcizelela kabusha kutinikela kwawo ku-SACLomkhandlu wavumelana ngekutsi i-SACU kufanele kutsi isuke ekwabelananeni ngemalingena iye kutichamukelo tetentfutfuko letitawusekela kuhlangana kulesifundza.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e gareng ga dinaga di le 51 tse di saenileng Tumelano ya Thefosanyo ya Itiriso ya Tshedimosetso ya Lekgetho kwa Berlin, Germany ka Diphalane 2015.

src: Emalunga aphindza futsi amukela libalave kanye nelisu lekusebenta macondzana nengcungcutsela letawubanjwa ngeNhlaba 2016.
tgt: Dinaga di tla simolola go refosanya tshedimosetso ka 2017 mme seo se tla bo se maatlafadiwa ke molao o o fa pele ga Palamente ga jaana.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela Imiphumela Yekuhlolwa Kwemabhuku Ya-2014-15 yahulumende wavelonkhe newetifundza.
tgt: Moporesitente Zuma o amogetse go konosediwa ga dintlha tsa dikgato di le 15 tsa porojeke ya G20/Mokgatlho wa Tirisanommogo mo Ikonoming le mo Tlhabololong ya Motheo mo Dikgogolong le mo Tshutisong ya Dipoelo, tse di neng di le botlhokwa go netefatsa gore ga go gobelelwe le go netefatsa lotseno lwa Borwa jwa Aforika.

src: Lombiko ukhomba indlelamkhuba lesimeme mayelana nekuphatsa lokuhle kanye nekuphatfwa kwetimali lokuhleCabine kantsi loko kucinisekisa kuphatsa lokuhle njengaloku ematiko lamanyenti atfole imibiko yetimali lete emacashati.
tgt: Lekgotla le dirisitse tšhono go lebelela tswelelopele e e dirilweng mo Leanong la Dintlha di le Thataro fa e sale ka kopano ya bofelo mme la gatelela maitlamo a lona go SACLekgotla le dumelane gore SACU e tshwanetse go dira go feta go aroganngwa ga lotseno go nna maiteko a tlhabololo a a tla tshegetsang kgolagano mo kgaolong.

src: Lentfutfuko ikhombisa futsi kutsi hulumende usebenta kamatima kucinisekisa kutilandza kuto tonkhe tindzawo temsebenti wakhe.
tgt: Gape ditokololo di amogetse mosupatsela le leano la tiro le le lebisang kwa samiting e e tla tshwarwang ka Seetebosigo 2016.

src: Nanome kukhona lentfutfuko, hulumende uncume kutsi utawuchubeke asekele lawo matiko lanemibiko lengasimihle kanye nekucinisekisa kutsi wonkhe hulumende usebenta ngalokusezingeni lelisetulu.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela Dipoelo tsa Boruni tsa 2014-15 tsa puso ya bosetšhaba le tsa diporofense.

src: IKhabhinethi iyawahalalisela omabili lamajaji iphindze futsi iwafisele lokuhle emsebenti wawo lobaluleke nakangaka kuTebulungiswa taseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: E bontsha motsamao o o namatshang o o lebisang kwa taolong e e siameng mmogo le tsamaiso e e siameng ya ditšhelete mme e gatelela taolo e e siameng jaaka mafapha a le mantsi a bone boruni jo bophepa.

src: S’thembile Ngidi locophe umlandvo ngesikhatsi aba ngulomsikati lomnyama wekucala losati semhlata waKwaZulu-Natali lotfole ticu temfundvo takhe eKolishi Letekwelapha laseNingizimu Afrika aphindze futsi abe wesibili kulelive.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go thapiwa ke Moporesitente Zuma ga Moatlhodi Mandisa Muriel Maya jaaka Motlatsamoporesitente wa Kgotlatshekelokgolo ya Boikuelo go ya ka karolo ya 174(4) ya Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996 le Mosiamisi Nonkosi Zoliswa Mhlantla jaaka moatlhodi wa Kgotlatshekelo ya Molaotheo go ya ka Karolo ya 174(3) ya Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996.Go thapiwa gono go maatlafatsa maitlamo a Aforika Borwa a tekatekano ya bong kwa magatong a a kwa godimodimo mme go tsweletsa go fetolwa ga boatlhodi.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela umenti wemafilimu waseNingizimu Afrika Reina-Marie Loader idokhumentari yakhe letsi ‘Horn’ lezuze imiklomelo leminyenti, lokufaka ekhatsi kukhetfwa kwayo kuMkomelo Wekongiwa Kwabhejane 2015 ngaKholwane kumkhakha we-Best Awareness, Education and Funding, yazuza umklomelo i-Best Conservation Film ku-2015 International Film Festival eNew York City, eMelika.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola baatlhodi ka bobedi mme e ba eleletsa tsotlhe tse dintle mo tiragatsong ya maikarabelo ano a botlhokwa mo Bosiamising jwa Aforika Borwa.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa kudzabuka kwayo kumndeni nakubangani beLisekela Lendvuna Yetemanti Nekuhanjiswa Kwekungcola, MkPamela Tshwete, ngekushonelwa ngunina, MkRuth Nomzi Zondeki.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola Ngaka S'thembele Ngidi yo a dirileng hisetori fa a ne a aloga kwa Kholetšheng ya Bongaka ya Aforika Borwa jaaka moitseanape wa kankere (oncologist) wa ntlha wa mosadi wa KwaZulu-Natal mme e le wa bobedi fela mo nageng.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa kudzabuka kwayo kuhulumende waseNew Zealand, umndeni bangani kanye nakuNyonyana Yelicembu Lemboco yaseNew Zealand ngekushona kwesihlabani selibhola lembhoco, Jonah Tali Lomu, lobe nelifutse lelikhulu kulomdlalo.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola modiri wa dibaesekopo wa Aforika Borwa Reina-Marie Loader yo setshwantsho sa gagwe 'Horn' se amogetseng dikakgolo di le dintsi, go akarediwa go supiwa mo Dikgeleng tsa Tshomarelo ya Ditshukudu tsa 2015 ka Phukwi mo karolong ya Temogo e e Gaisang, Thuto le Matlole, mme se gapile sekgele sa Setshwantsho se se Gaisitseng sa Tshomarelo kwa Moletlong wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Dibaesekopo kwa New York City, Amerika.

src: Kubekwa etikhundleniKonkhe kucashwa kuya ngekucinisekiswa kweticu tabo kanye nekuvunywa lokufanele.
tgt: Kabinete e romela matshediso kwa go balelapa le ditsala tsa Motlatsatona wa Lefapha la Metsi le Kgeleloleswe, Mme Pamela Tshwete, ka loso la ga mmaagwe, Mama Ruth Nomzi Zondeki.

src: Kunwetjwa kweNkontileka ibe minyaka lesihlanu yaMnu Maswahle Diphofa – Umcondzisi Jikelele (i-DG): Litiko Letemisebenti Yahulumende Nekuphatsa.
tgt: Kabinete e romela matshediso kwa pusong ya New Zealand, balelapa, ditsala le Mokgatlho wa Rakabi wa New Zealand ka loso lwa naledi ya rakabi, Jonah Tali Lomu, yo o nnileng le seabe se segolo mo motshamekong.

src: Kunwetjwa kweNkontileka ibe tinyanga leti-12 taMkNonkululeko Sindane – I-DG: Litiko Letebulungiswa Nekutfutfukiswa Kwemtsetfosisekelo.
tgt: Go atolosiwa ga Konteraka ya ga Rre Maswahle Diphofa – Mokaedikakaretso (DG): Lefapha la Bodiredipuso le Tsamaiso ka dingwaga di le tlhano.

src: Umnu Livhuwani Tommy Makhode njengeLisekela leMcondzisi Jikelele: Institutional Planning and Support kuLitiko Letesayensi Nethekinoloji.
tgt: Go atolosiwa ga Konteraka ya ga Mme Nonkululeko Sindane – DG: Lefapha la Bosiamisi le Tlhabololo ya Molaotheo ka dikgwedi di le somepedi.

src: Umnu Rory Gallocher njengeSisebenti Lesikhulu se-Social Housing Regulatory Authority.
tgt: Rre Livhuwani Tommy Makhode Motlatsa Mokaedikakaretso (DDG): Maano a Setheo le Tshegetso mo Lefapheng la Saense le Thekenoloji.

src: Pradish Rampersadh njengeMcondzisi weSigungu lomusha weMkandlu waseNingizimu Afrika weTingcweti Tesayensi.
tgt: Rre Rory Gallocher jaaka Motlhankedikhuduthamagamogolo (CEO) wa Bothati jwa Taolo ya Dintlo tsa Loago.

src: Umnu Mark Barnes njengeMphatsi Lomkhulu weTemaposi aseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Ngaka Pradish Rampersadh jaaka Mokaedikhuduthamaga yo montšhwa wa Lekgotla la Diporofešene tsa Saense ya Tlhago la Aforika Borwa.

src: Ibhodi yeLibhange Lentfutfuko Yemave lase-Afrika lengaseNingizimu:i. Umnu Jabulani Philip Moleketi – (uphindze futsi wakhetfwa futsi unguSihlalo)ii.
tgt: Rre Mark Barnes jaaka CEO wa Setlhopha sa Kantoroposo ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Umnu Msokoli Frans Baleni – (uphindze futsi wakhetfwa futsi uLisekela laSihlaloe)iii.
tgt: Boto ya Bankatlhabololo ya Borwa jwa Aforika:i. Rre Jabulani Philip Moleketi – (o thapiwa gape mme ke Modulasetilo)ii.

src: MkMartie Janse van Rensburg – (Ungumcondzisi longasilo lilunga leSigungu Lesiphetse)iv.
tgt: Rre Msokoli Frans Baleni – (o thapiwa gape mme ke Motlatsamodulasetilo)iii.

src: Kucala kwekusebenta kwetinhlelo letimcoka tahulumende.
tgt: Go Tsenngwa Tirisong ga Manaane a Puso a a Botlhokwa.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukele kusayinwa kwetivumelwane letinge-26 letilinani letigidzigidzi letinge-R94 ngesikhatsi Sekuvakasha Lokusemtsetfweni lokusandza kwentiwa nguMengameli Xi Jinping waseChina.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go saeniwa ga ditumelano di le 26 tsa boleng jo bo kanaka R94 bilione go tswa mo Ketelong ya Puso ya Moporesitente wa China Xi Jinping ya mo malobeng.

src: Letivumelwane letisayiniwe tifaka ekhatsi tigidzigidzi leti-R12 tekwakha sakhiwonchanti sekukhicita timoto eNingizimu Afrika, Emadola aseMelika (i-US$) lasigidzi lesinge-$500 esisetjentiswa semalimboleko lecondziswe ku-Eskom yekutfutfukisa sakhiwonchanti kanye nesigidzigidzi semadola aseMelika lange-$2.5 semali lecinisekisiwe yeTransnet levela eBhange Lekutfutfukisa laseChina.
tgt: Ditumelano tse di saenilweng di akaretsa R12 bilione ya go aga bodutelo jwa dikoloi mo Aforika Borwa, ya madikadimo a a kanaka US$500 milione go tsamaisa ditlhabololo tsa mafaratlhatlha a Eskom le ya tlamelo e e netefaleditsweng e e kanaka US$2.5 bilione go thusa Transnet go tswa kwa Bankeng ya Ditlhabololo ya China.

src: Njengencenye yeMhlangano we-2 weLubanjiswano lweChi ne-Afrika (i-FOCAC), Mengameli Xi Jinping wetsembise sigidzigidzi semaDola aseMelika lange-$60 sekutfutfukisa i-Afrika.
tgt: Jaaka Foramo ya Bobedi ya Tirisanommogo ya China-Aforika (FOCAC),Moporesitente Jinping o ikanne go beeletsa US$60 bilione tebang le tlhabololo mo Aforika.

src: Kwemukelwa kweSivumelwano neLuhlelo Lwekusebenta lolusha (2016-2018) e-FOCAC kuyahlanganisa kubuye futsi kucinise lobudlelwane lobukhulako lobusemkhatsini we-Afrika neChina, lokutawuvula ematfuba lamasha ekuhweba nelutjalomali lokutawusita kubanga kutsi kukhule umnotfo.
tgt: Kamogelotiragatso ya Tlhomamiso e ntšhwa mmogo le Leanotiro la (2016-2018) kwa FOCAC le sobokanya kgolo ya tirisanommogo magareng ga Aforika le China, e leng se se tla bulelang ditšhono tse ditšhwa tsa kgwebisano le dipeeletso go thusa go tlhatlosa kgolo ya ikonomi.

src: Umnotfo uchubekile watfola kwesekelwa ngekwemnotfo ngebaka-BMW eNingizimu Afrika labamementele lutjalomali lwetigidzigidzi leti-R6 kusakhiwonchanti sabo lesiseRosslyn, ePitoli, lesibufakazi bekusebentisana lokusemkhatsini webhizinisi nahulumende, kanye nendzima ledlalwa yibhizinisi ekutfutfukiseni umnotfo.
tgt: Ikonomi e amogetse gape le tshegetso ya ikonomi go tswa kwa Setlhopheng sa BMW sa Aforika Borwa ka go tlhagisa dipeeletso tsa bokanaka R6 bilione kwa bodutelong jwa yone jwa Rosslyn, Pretoria, e leng se se pakang tirisano mmogo e e botlhokwa e e leng teng magareng ga kgwebo le puso, mmogo le tiro eo kgwebo e e jarileng mo go tlhabololeng ikonomi.

src: NgaLesibili, mhla ti-8 Ingongoni, Mengameli Zuma unike takhamuti taseNingizimu Afrika kanye nebekuchamuka emaveni angaphandle labahloniphekile Imiklomelo Yesive labafake ligalelo ekutfutfukisweni kwebantfu.
tgt: Ka labobedi, 8 Sedimonthole, Moporesitente Zuma o apesitse baagi ba Aforika Borwa mmogo le batswantle ba ba tlotlegang bao ba nnileng le seabe mo go rotloetseng ditirelo tsa botho Matshwao a Tlotlo a Bosetšhaba.

src: Lemiklomelo Yesive asikhatsi lesikhulu sekubuyeketa, sekugubha umkhosi kanye neligcabho lebantfu betfu.
tgt: Matshwao a Tlotlo a Bosetšhaba ke motsotswana wa go lebelela kwa morago, go keteka le go ikgantsha ka batho ba borona.

src: Bagubha umkhosi wekuzuza kwebantfu, kutinikela kwebantfu kanye nemitabo yebantfu leyenta live letfu kutsi libe yindzawo lencono.
tgt: A keteka diphitlhelelo tsa botho, go ikentsha setlhabelo ga batho le kgaratlho ya batho eo e dirang gore naga ya rona e nne lefelo le le botoka.

src: Siyabahalalisela lababo laklonyeliswe leMiklomelo Yavelonkhe yanga-2015.
tgt: Re bontsha tlotlo go baamogedi ba Matshwao a Tlotlo a Bosetšhaba ba 2015.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basebentise emanti ngekuwonga.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo go maAforika Borwa otlhe go somarela metsi.

src: Loku kukwesekela tinyatselo letinyenti letitsetfwe kute kutsi kuncishiswe kweswelakala kwemanti, lokubhebhetseliswe ligagasi lekushisa lelive lelihlangabetene nalo kulamaviki lendlulile.
tgt: Seno ke go tshegetsa dikgato di le dintsinyana tse di tserweng go ka fokotsa tlhaelo ya metsi, e leng seo se gagamaditsweng ke mogote oo naga e itemogetseng one mo dibekeng tse di fetileng.

src: Nanoma nje timvula letisandza kuna kuletinye tincenye talelive tiletse kuhhamuleka, kweswelakala kwemanti kulelive kuyachubeka nekuba yinsayeya mbamba futsi kudzinga kutsi sonkhe sisebentise emanti ngekuwonga nangalokunesibopho.
tgt: Le fa e le gore pula ya mo malobeng kwa dikarolong tse dingwe tsa naga e fokoditse kimologo, tlhaelo ya metsi ya naga e tswelela go nna kgwetlho e kgolo mme go tlhokega gore rona rotlhe re somarele metsi le go a dirisa ka maikarabelo.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalise kubonga kubo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ngekutsi bahlanganyele kuMkankhaso Wemalanga la-16 Ekulwa Nebudlova Lobentiwa kuBomake neBantfwana, laphele itolo.
tgt: Kabinete e tlhagisitse ditebogo tsa yone mo maAforika Borweng otlhe ka go tsaya karolo mo Letsholong la monongwaga la Matsatsi a le 16 a Bolweladitshwanelo Kgatlhanong le Tiririsodikgoka mo Basading le mo Baneng, le le konoseditsweng ka la bo 10 Sedimonthole 2015.

src: Lucwaningo lwakwamuva lukhombisa emanani lamakhulu etehlakalo letinsha tekungenwa yisandvulelangculazi (i-HIV), ikakhulu kubomake labasesebancane nemantfombatana e-Afrika labasemkhatsini weminyaka yebudzala le-15 nalenge-24.Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bakutsatwa kutsi bachubeke nekulwa kwabo kube kwa-onkhe emalanga njengencenye yemklamo we#365 Days Campaign Wekulwa Nebudlova Lobentiwa kuBomake neBantfwana kanye nemklamo we- #CountMeIn lochubekela emnyakeni lotako.
tgt: Dipatlisiso tsa sešweng di bontsha gore palo e e kwa godimo ya ditshwaetso tse dintšhwa, bogolosegolo mo makgarebeng le mo basetsanyaneng mo Aforika, e mo bao ba leng magareng ga dingwaga di le 15 le 24.MaAforika Borwa a rotloediwa go gatelapele ka ditiro tsa manaane a bolweladitshwanelo a letsatsi le letsatsi jaaka karolo ya go nna Kgatlhanong le Tirisodikgoka mo Basading le mo Baneng ya #365 Days Campaign le ya letsholo la #CountMeIn e leng tse di diragadiwang ngwaga otlhe.

src: Ngalomkhankhaso we-#365 Days Campaign kanye ne-#CountMeIn, lelive lifanele kutsi lichubeke ligcogce emalunga emmango, ikakhulu emadvodza, kutsi abambisane nahulumende ekubukaneni nalolubhubhane.
tgt: Ka go dirisa #365 Days Campaign le #CountMeIn, naga e tlhoka go tswelela go golaganya ditokololo tsa baagi, bogolosegolo banna, go golagana le puso mo go samaganeng le leuba WEBTOKEN maikarabelo a naga, ka bongwe jwa rona kgotsa ka go golagana ga rona, go fedisa go ata ga kokwanatlhoko ka go tlhokomela boitekanelo jwa rona le jwa batho ba bangwe.

src: Kusibopho sesive, semuntfu ngamunye nangekubambisana, kutsi kuvinjwe kwandza kwaleligciwane ngekutsi sinakekele temphilo yetfu kanye nentalabanye.
tgt: Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke kgatelopele e e dirilweng ke Lekgotla la Dipatlisiso tsa Saense le Intaseteri ka go tlhagisa thulaganyo ya tlhagiso ya melemo ya HIV.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayitfokotela inchubekela embili leyentiwe nguMkandlu Welucwaningo Lwetesayensi Netimboni (i-CSIR) ekwenteni inchubo yekukhicita emasotja emtimba e-HIV kulokuphilako.
tgt: Seno se atumetsa intaseteri ya boitekanelo gaufi le kalafi ya thibelobolwetse e e sa jeng madi a mantsi.

src: Loku kusondzeta imboni yetemphilo dvutane kakhulu nemakhambi ekwelapha ekuvikela langabiti kakhulu.
tgt: Fa naga e ssantse e tsweletse go kgarakgadiwa ke go batlana le kalafi ya go fedisa HIV le AIDS, maAforika Borwa a tswelela go rotloediwa go tsenela thobalano e e babalesegileng le go obamela metheo ya ABC (Ikilele mo thobalanong, Ikanyege mme o Dirise Mosomelwana).6 Kabinete e akgotse barutwana botlhe, baithuti, barutabana, bafatlhosi, dikolo le ditheo tsa thuto e kgolwane ka go konosetsa ngwaga wa dithuto o o atlegileng, le fa go nnile le dikgwetlho tse go itemogetsweng tsone mo gare ga ngwaga.

src: IKhabhinethi futsi ibafisela lokuhle eluhlolweni lwabo lolutako labo labavuma kuhlehlisa tinhlolo tekuphela kwemnyaka batihlelela kutsi tibhalwe nga-2016.
tgt: Kabinete gape e lakaletsa masego bao ba dumetseng go sutisa letlha la ditlhatlhobo go tshwarwa ka 2016.

src: Litiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalakahle, libambisene neLitiko Letekuvikela ne-Ejensi Yekutfutfukisa Lusha Yavelonkhe (i-NYDA), litawumba Inkhomfa Yelusha Yavelonkhe ye-6.
tgt: Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Loago, ka tirisanommogo le Lefapha la Phemelo mmogo le Setheo sa Naga sa Tlhabololo ya Bašwa, ba tla tshwara Kopano ya bone ya Bašwa ya Bosetšhaba ya bo Leno ke lenaale la tlhabololo ya boeteledipele leo maitlhomo a lone e leng go fetola maitshwaro le go natlafatsa bašwa ka ditšhono tse di leng fa pele ga matlho a bone.

src: Lolu luhlelo lwekutfutfukisa baholi belusha lolufuna kugucula indlela yekutiphatsa, timongcondvo kanye nekuhlomisa lusha ngematfuba labangawasebentisa.
tgt: Kopano eno gape e thusa ka go ruta basimanyana go ka nna banna ba ba tlotlang basadi.

src: Lenkhomfa iphindze futsi isite ngekulandzelela nefundzisa bafana labancane mayelana nekutsi bakhule babe ngemadvodza labenta bomake ligugu babuye futsi babahloniphe.8 Sivumelwano lesihlanganyelwe lesisayiniwe lesisemkhatsini weNdvuna Yetemfundvo Lephakeme neKucecesha Indvuna, Dkt.
tgt: Tumelano e e kopanetsweng e e saenilweng ke Tona ya Lefapha la Thuto le Katiso tse di Kgolwan, Ngaka Blade Nzimande, mmogo le balekane ba BRICS e leng – Brazil, Russia, India le China – e ikemiseditse go ka tlhagisa letlhomeso la tirisanommogo mo thutong mo nakong e e tlang.

src: Blade Nzimande, nebahlanganyeli be-BRICS – iBrazil, iRussi, i-India neChina – sihlose ekwakheni luhlakamsebenti lwekubambisana kutemfundvo eskhatsini lesitako.
tgt: Tumelano e akaretsa thutokakaretso, togamaano ya dipholisis tsa thuto, dikholeje le dithuto tse dikgolwane tsa Katiso le Thuto ya Diatla le ya Setegenik (TVET) Dikholeje tsa TVET di na le bokgoni jwa go bulela ditšhono tsa ikonomi mo bašweng ba borona, fa ka fa letlhakoreng le lengwe di baakanya dikgwetlho tsa botlhokatiro, tlhokotekatekano le lehuma.

src: Lesivumelwane sifaka ekhatsi imfundvo jikelele, indlelalisu yenchubomgomo yetemfundvo, Emakolishi Ekufundzela Umsebenti (TVET) netemfundvo lephakeme.
tgt: Tumelano, e e tla tokafatsang boleng jwa go ithuta le jwa thuto ya barutabana, gape e dira gore diyunibesiti tsa BRICS di ipofe go tshegetsa diporojeke tsa dipatlisiso tse di kopanetsweng, go rotloetsa manaane a tirisanommogo mo maemong a thuto ya morago ga go konosetsa dithuto tsa ntlha tse digolwane, a bongaka le a a kwa godimo ga a bongaka mmogo le go phasaladiwa sebedi ga dipoelo tsa saense.

src: Emakolishi e-TVET anemandla ekuvula ematfuba etemnotfo ebantfu bentfu labasesebancane, kube kubukwana nensayeya yekungacashwa, kungalingani nebuphuya lobukhatsata imimango.
tgt: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji le ne le tshwere Foramo ya Saense ya Aforika Borwa ka fa tlase ga moono “Re tlhotlheletsa dipuisano ka ga saense”.

src: Lesivumelwane, lesitawuphucula lizinga lekufundzisa nemfundvo yabothishela, siphindze futsi sente kutsi emanyuvesi e-BRICS esekele imiklamo yelucwaningo yelubanjiswano, ikhutsate tinhlelo telubanjiswano emazingeni e-postgraduate, doctoral newe-postdoctoral kanye nekushicelelwa ngekubambisana imiphumela yetesayensi.
tgt: Palo e e fetang dikete di le 45 e tsenetse dikganetsano ka ga kipano le saense, thekenoloji le boitlhamedi mmogo le baagi, bogolosegolo go totilwe tlhabololo.

src: Litiko Letesayensi Netheknoloji langenisa Umhlangano Wetesayensi YaseNingizimu Afrika ngaphansi kwengcikitsi: “Kulumeka tingcoco mayelana netesayensi”.
tgt: Gape foramo e nnile le karolo ya go matlafatsa ditirisanommogo tsa boitlhamedi tsa thekenoloji, saense ya boditšhabatšhaba tsa togamaano ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Lomhlangano wabuye wacinisa budlelwane betendlelalisu yetesayensi yaseNingizimu Afrika, itheknoloji nekwenta lokusha.10 INingizimu Afrika itawumelelwa kuMkandlu Wetinhlangano Letibukene Netaselwandle.
tgt: Eno ke kgato e kgolo go ka fitlhelela bokgoni jwa naga le jwa kontinente mo lekaleng la tsa kwa Lewatleng.

src: Lesi sinyatselo lesikhulu sekuzuza emandla lakhona kulelive kanye newalelivekati emkhakheni wetaselwandle.
tgt: Mokgatlho o rwele maikarabelo a go tsenyatirisong ditshwetso mo mererong ya tsa kwa lewatleng ya lefatshe, go simolola ka Ikonomi ya kwa Mawatleng, dikgato tsa thuso mmogo le dintlha tsa pabalesego le tshireletsego kwa lewatleng.

src: Lenhlangano inesibopho sekwemukela tincumo etindzabeni tetelwandle temhlaba, kusukela kuMnotfo Waselwandle, imitamo yekutakula kanye netindzaba tekuphepha nekuvikeleka elwandle.
tgt: Go tseeng karolo mo mokgatlhong ono go tla tshegetsa lenaane la puso la go bulela bokgoni jwa mawatleng jwa naga ka go dirisa Buka ya Togamaano ya Ikonomi ya kwa Mawatleng mmogo le Operation Phakisa, e eleng tseo di ikaeletseng go ka tlhola ditiro tse di ka fetang milione wa ditiro ka 2033.‎.

src: Kuhlanganyela kwalenhlangano kutawusita luhlelo lwahulumende ekuvuleni emandla etelwandle alelive ngekweNdlelalisu yeMnotfo weBlue Oceans ne-Operation Phakisa, lehlose kwakha imisebenti lengetulu kwesigidzigidzi nga-2033.‎1.11 Umbutfo Wetekuvikela Wavelonkhe waseNingizimu Afrika kuleliviki leliphelile ucale inchubo yekuphucula Siteshi Semphi Yaselwandle Sihlenge saseSalisbury eDurban kutsi sibe sikhungo setemphi yaselwandle lesisebenta ngalokuphelele.
tgt: Sesole sa Tshireletso ya Naga ya Aforika Borwa (SANDF) se simolotse mo bekeng e e fetileng thulaganyo ya tlhabolola Seteišene sa Sesole sa kwa Metsing sa Setlhake sa Salisbury kwa Durban go ka nna kampa e e dirang ka botlalo ya sesole sa kwa metsing.

src: Kuphuculwa kwalesikhungo kutawenta kancono emakhono etekuvikela kuphindze futsi kufake ligalelo ekutfutfukiseni umnotfo waselwandle.12 Litiko Letemphilo, libambisene neSoul City neTimes Media, letfule ishaneli yetemphilo neyendlela yekuphila i-The Good Life Network ku-DStv shaneli-199.
tgt: Ntšhwafatso ya mafelotiriso e tla tokafatsa bokgoni jwa tsa tshireletsego mmogo le go nna le seabe mo ikonoming ya kwa mawatleng.

src: Leshaneli iniketa, kutijabilisa lokwehlukahlukene nekudlanchanti lokunemaseko lamatsatfu kwasekhaya, temphilo nemtimba locinile, emalungelo eluntfu, temacasi telusha, i-HIV nesifo semaphaphu (i-TB), kanye nemalungelo ebatsengi newebulili.
tgt: Lefapha la Boitekanelo ka tirisanommogo le Soul City le Times Media, le thankgolotse kanale ya thelebišene e e samaganang le tsa boitekanelo tsa mokgwa wa go itlhokomela ya The Good Life Network mo kanaleng ya 199 ya DStv.

src: IKhabhinethi imema bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bayibukele leshaneli.
tgt: Kanale e abelana ka diteng tsa fa gae tsa mmatota tse di dirang gore o itise tse di farologaneng ka ga dijo, go ikatisa, ditshwanelo tsa botho, dirwe tsa thobalano mo bašweng, HIV le TB, mmogo le ditshwanelo tsa bareki le tsa bong jo bo farologaneng.

src: Tincumo teKhabhineti letibalulekile.1 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweMtsetfo Lodzingidvwako lomayelana neMshwalwensi Wetemphilo Wavelonkhe (i-NHI) weNingizimu Afrika, kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng go bogela kanale eno.

src: Lenchubomgomo ihlongota likhono lahulumende lekuniketa tinsita tekwelashwa kubo bonkhe labavakashela tikhungo takhe.
tgt: Kabinete e letleletse gore go phasaladiwe Lokwalotemoso lwa lefapha la puso ka ga Inšorense ya Bosetšhaba ya Boitekanelo, Inšorense ya Bosetšhaba ya Boitekanelo (NHI) mo Aforika Borwa gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo.

src: Itawutfola imali emalini lehlanganisiwe lekutawuphindze futsi kwentiwe kutsi iytfolwe nangulabasebenta ngetimphilo bangasese labafuna kuhlanganyela kulesikimu.
tgt: NHI ke karolo e kgolo ya puso ya ntšhwafatso ya lekala la boitekanelo.

src: Naseyiphetsiwe, lenchubomgomo itawetfulwa eminyekeni lemitsatfu futsi igcile kakhulu ekutsini icale etindzaweni letingatfoli tinsita.
tgt: Pholisi e tshitshinya bokgoni jwa puso jwa go abelana ka ditirelo tsa boitekanelo mo go botlhe bao ba etelang mafelotiriso a bone a boitekanelo.

src: Aaron Motsoaledi, lamuhla utawukhuluma nebetindzaba mayelana nekwetfulwa kwe-NHI.2 IKhabhinethi iyivumile Inchubomgomo Lehlanganisiwe Yekutfutfukisa Bokhewana (i-ECD).Lenchubomgomo yentiwa ngekubonisana nalabanye labatsintsekako kulomkhakha.
tgt: E tla tlamelwa ka matlole ka go dirisa motlamedi wa matlole otlhe ao a tla dirisediwang gape le go duelela badiredi ba ditlamo tsa boitekanelo tsa poraefete bao ba batlang go nna le karolo mo sekemeng seno.

src: Lenchubomgomo ye-ECD lehlanganisiwe itawucinisekisa kutsi bonkhe bantfwana labancane kanye nebanakekeli babo bayakhona kufinyelela tinsita te-ECD letiphelele kusukela ekucaleni bate baye kuLibanga Lenchubomgomo ichubela lensita kubantfwana labaneminyaka lesiphohlongo labanebulukhunu bekukhula.
tgt: Fa e fetswa go konosediwa, pholisi eo e tla tsenngwatirisong mo pakeng ya dingwaga di le tharo mme e tla tsepamisa mogopolo bogolosegolo mo go simololeng go thusa mafelo a a sa boneng ditirelo tse di lekaneng.

src: Lenchubomgomo iyachubeka iniketa luhlakamsebenti lwekulandzelela nekuhlola kucinisekisa kutsi ifezekiswa ngalokuyimphumelelo kubo bonkhe bantfwana ngekunganaki buhlanga, bulili noma inkholo.3 IKhabhinethi iwuvumile Umtsetfo Lodzingidvwako lomayelana Nemalungelo Ebantfu Labaphila Nekukhubateka kanye neSimo Sekufezekiswa kwawo.
tgt: Tona ya Boitekanelo, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, gompieno o tla ema ka lefoko bobegakgang mabapi le go tsenngwatirisong ga NHKabinete e atlenegisitse Pholisi e e Kopanetsweng ya Bosetšhaba ya Thuto ya Bana ya go sa le Gale (ECD).Pholisi e tlhagisitswe ka go buisana le bannaleseabe ba ba farologaneng mo lekaleng leno.

src: Loku kuhambisana neMigomo Yekutfutfukisa Lechubekela Embili Ngalokungenamkhawulo lefaka ekhatsi labakhubatekile, leyemukelwa nguMhlangano Jikelele Wamhlabuhlangene (i-UN) (i-UNGA) ngeNyoni 2015.Lenchubomgomo itawusheshisa tingucuko kanye nekulungisa mayelana nekufaka ekhatsi ngalokuphelele, kuhlanganisa kanye nekulingana kwebantfu labakhubatekile.4 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweNchubomgomo Yekuhanjiswa Kwendle Yavelonkhe kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngayo.
tgt: E ne ya isiwa kwa baaging gore ba dire ditshwaelo ka Tlhakole 2015.Pholisi eno e e kopanetsweng ya ECD e tla netefatsa gore bana botlhe le batlhokomedi ba bone ba kgona go fitlhelela ditirelo tse di boleng tse di mosola tsa ECD go tswa kwa tshimologong go fitlha kwa Mophatong wa Pholisi eno e atolosa ditirelo go fitlha mo baneng ba dingwaga di le robedi ba ba nang le dikgwetlho tsa go ithuta.

src: Lenchubomgomo ibeka inhlalakahle yebantfu ekutfutfukeni lokubalulekile ngekwenta kutsi kube khona kusimama emkhatsini wekwabiwa kwemitfombolusito yekwesekela lutjalomali emazingeni laphakeme etinsita, inikete tinsita kumakhaya langatfoli tinsita, ibe futsi igcina esimeni lesifanele iphindze futsi ilungise takhiwonchanti tekuhanjiswa kwendle letikhona.5 IKhabhinethi ikuvume kutsi kwetfulwe ePhalamende yaseNingizimu Afrika Umbiko we-5 Wesikhatsi Lesibekiwe (2009-2014) lomayelana neKufezekiswa Kwenkhomfa lemayelana Nekupheliswa kwato tonkhe Tinhlobo Telubandlululo lolwentiwa kuBomake.
tgt: Gape pholisi e abelana le ka letlhomeso la tekolo le tshekatsheko go netefatsa fa e tsenngwatirisong ka tshwanelo mo baneng botlhe go sa kgathalesege lotso lwa bone, bong jwa bone kgotsa tumelo ya bone.

src: Lombiko uniketa sibutsetelo sekusebenta ngemphumelelo kwemitsetfo, tinchubomgomo netinhlelo letifezekisiwe nekugcamisa lokuzuzwe ngulelive ekuhlonyisweni kwabomake nekulingana ngebulili.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Lokwalotemoso lwa lefapha la puso tebang le Ditshwanelo tsa Batho ba ba nang le Bogole mmogo le Dikgatosenngotirisong tsa lone.

src: Lombiko uphindze futsi ubeke kutsi kusesenetinsayeya letingaphelimandla netihibe ekulweni kuncotjwe kungalingani kanye nelubandlululo kulelive.6 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweLuhlaka lweLisu Lekusebenta Lavelonkhe leKulwa Nelubandlululo, Kubandlulula ngekwelibala, Kutondza bachamuki kanye neKungabeketelelani Lokuphatselene nako, kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngalo.
tgt: Seno se bapisitswe le Dipeelo tsa Tlhabololo ya Tshomarelo ya go akaretsa bagolofadi, tseo di amogetsweng ke Kopanokakaretso ya Dinagakopano (UNGA) ka Lwetse 2015.Pholisi e tla gatelela phetolothefosano le dipaakanyo mabapi le kakaretso yotlhe, go kopanngwa le tekatekano tebang le batho ba ba nang le bogole.

src: Loluhlelo luyindlelalisu yavelonkhe lehlanganisiwe nalehlelekile lekuhloswe ngayo kutsi kuliwe nekubandlulula futsi kwakhiwe iNingizimu Afrika yentsandvo yelinyenti mbamba lengabandlululani futsi nalengabandlululani ngekwebulili.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Pholisi ya Kgeleloleswe ya Bosetšhaba gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo.

src: Luniketa luhlakamsebenti lwetinyatselo letichumene naletichubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo letifanele kutsi titsatfwe ngulelive lonkhe liphelele libukane nemshiyandvuku welubandlululo nekubandlulula ngekwelibala.
tgt: Pholisi e beela boitekanelo jwa batho kwa setlhoeng mo tlhabololong ka go dira gore go nne le tekatekano tebang le go abelana ka metswedi ya matlole go ka tshegetsa dipeeletso mo maemong a a kwa godimo a ditirelo, go abela ditirelo kwa malapeng a a tlamelwang ka ditirelo tse dinnye, ntse go tsweletswe go tlhokomela le go ntšhwafatsa mafaratlhatlha a a santseng a le teng a kgeleloleswe.

src: Loku kusita iNingizimu Afrika kutsi ihlangabetane netibopho tayo temave emhlaba, tesigodzi netavelonkhe, ikakhulu Sifungo saseDurban neLuhlelo Lwekusebenta lolwemukelwa yi-UN kuNkhomfa Yemhlaba lwekulwa neLubandlululo nga-20.7 IKhabhinethi yatiswa ngenchubekela embili yeluhlelo lwekuntjintjela ekusakateni ngekwedijithali.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go tlisiwa kwa Palamenteng ya Aforika Borwa ga Pegelo ya Dipaka di le Tlhano (2009-2014) ka ga Go Tsenngwa Tirisong ga Melao ya go Fedisa Mekgwa yotlhe ya Tlhaolele mo Basading.

src: Ikuvumile kucala kwesikhatsi lesifishane lapho khona tinkhomba tekusakata ngekwedijithali ne-analogi kutawusebenta kanyekanye ngembi kwekutsi kucishwe i-analogi eNingizimu Afrika mhla lu-1 ngeNdlovana 2016.Kusuka ekusakateni ngekwe-analogi kuyiwe kutinsita tekusakata ngekwedijithali kukhulula emagagasi emsakato wemoya ladzingeka kakhulu lafanele tinsita letihambako letisebenta ngekushesha.
tgt: Pegelo e tlamela ka lemorago la mesola ya melao e e farologaneng, dipholisis le manaane ao a tsentsweng tirisong mmogo le go neela dintlhakgolo tsa dikatlego tsa naga fa go tla mo matlafatsong ya basadi le tekatekano ya bong.

src: Lombiko usebentisa tinkhomba letibalulekile kuhlola kusebenta neligalelo lelifakwa yi-NSI etintfweni tavelonkhe letihamba embili letibekwe kuLUhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (i-NDP) nalamanye emadokhumenti enchubomgomo lafaka ligalelo ekutfutfukiseni umnotfo netenhlalo.
tgt: Pegelo gape e tlhagisa gore go na le dikgwetlho tse di tsweletseng le dikgoreletso go ka fedisa tlhokotekatekano le tlhaolele mo nageng.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kuhlelwa kabusha kwetigodzi tamantji kute kutsi tisebente kancono eLimpopo naseMpumalanga, kanye nesikhundla seNkantolo Yamantji yaseLephalale njengesihlalo seDivishini yeLimpopo yeNkantolo Lephakeme, njengesilungiso sesikhashana kute kube ngulapho sekwakhiwe sihlalo lesehlukile sendzawo salomphelo saleDivishini.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Leanotirotlhomo la Bosetšhaba la Twantsho ya Ditiro tsa Tlhaolele, Tlhaolele go ya ka Lotso, Tlhaolele go ya ka Semorafe mmogo le Ditiragalo tse Dingwe tsa Tlhoko Itshokelano, gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo.

src: Lokuhlelwa kabusha kwenkantolo yesigodzi yamantji kanye netindzawo letingaphasi kwalamaDivishini eNkantolo Lephakeme kuyincenye yekulungiswa kwalenchubomgomo lekuhloswe ngayo kutsi ilungise umshiyandvuku loko lokungesibo bulungiswa bendzawo besikhatsi lesendlulile.
tgt: Leano leno ke togamaano ya bosetšhaba e e rulagantsweng e bile e kopanetswe ka maitlhomo a go lwantshana le tlhaolele go ya ka lotso mme go agiwa Aforika Borwa wa boammaruri wa temokerasi yo a senang tlhaolele go ya ka lotso le go ya ka bong.

src: Kuphindze futsi kube yincenye yesibophelelo lesikhulu seluntjintjo lsekwenta kancono kufinyelela bulungiswa, lokuhambisana neMtsetfosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika wanga-19.10 IKhabhinethi iwuvumile umbiko lomayelana nenchubekela embili macondzana nekufezekiswa kweticondziso temtsetfo teKhabhinethi eLimpopo ngekwemibandzela yeSigaba 100 (1)
tgt: Le neelana ka letlhomeso la dikgato tse di rulaganeng tsa leruri tse di ka tsewang ke naga ka bojotlhe go ka samagana le lefa la ditiro tsa tlhaolele le la tlhaolele go ya ka lotso.

src: mhla tinge-31 Indlovulenkhulu 2016 kulamatiko aseLimpopo lalandzelako: Temphilo Tekutfutsa Temisebenti Yahulumende Temigwaco Nesakhiwonchanti neTemafa.
tgt: Seno se thusa Aforika Borwa go ka fitlhelela maikano a yone a boditšhabatšhaba, a kgaolo le a bosetšhaba, bogolosegolo Kgoeletso ya Durban le Leanotiro tse di amogetsweng ke Dinagakopano (UN) kwa Khonferenseng ya Lefatshe e e kgatlhanong le Ditiro tsa Tlhaolele ka 2001.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze yavuma kususwa ngalokunembandzela kweSigaba 100 (1)
tgt: Kabinete e nopoletswe ka kgatelopele e e dirilweng mo lenaaneng la phetolelokgaso go ya go ya dijithale.

src: kuTemfundvo kute kuvulele Umgcinimafa Wesifundza indlela yekutsi afezekise ngemphumelelo Sigaba 18 seMtsetfo Wekulawulwa Kwetimali Tesive, 1999 (Umtsetfo 1 wanga-1999) kuLitiko Letemfundvo laseLimpopo, ngekwelekelelwa litiko letemfundvo lavelonkhe.
tgt: E amogetse gape le tshimololo ya paka ya kgasopedi mabapi le kgaso ya dijithale mo Aforika Borwa go ka simolola ka la bo 1 Tlhakole 2016.Phetogelo e no ya go tswa mo ditirelong tsa kgaso ya analoko go ya go ya dijithale e tlhagisa makhubu a a tlhokegang thata a kgaso a a nang le matshwanedi a go abelana ka ditirelo tse di latelelang tsa porotebente.

src: IKhabhinethi itivumile leticondziso letilandzelako kuNdvuna Yesifundza nebaphatsisatiko (abo-MEC) beteTimali neTemfundvo:a) Kwengeta tisebenti kumatiko esifundza ngekutsi kufunwe tisebenti letinemakhonob) Kuphetsa kubekwa etikhundleni kwebaphatsi labakhuli kanyec) Nekubukana ngemandla nangemphumelelo nekwehluleka kwebaholi nenkhohlakalo.11 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ingenise Inkhomfa yelizinga leliphakeme Yekulwa Netidzakamiva kusukela mhla ti-11 kuya kumhla ti-12 Indlovulenkhulu 2016, letawube ingaphansi kweLubumbano Lwe-Afrika (i-AU).Loku kutawusebenta njengesikhatsi sekulandzelela seMhlangano Wekulwa Netindzakamiva weRussia ne-Afrika, lohlose kwetfula simo lesihlanganene mayelana nekubukana nelenkinga yetidzalamiva yemhlaba.
tgt: Seno se tla oketsa kgaisano ya ikonomi ya Aforika Borwa ka go tsosolosa intaseteri ya kgaso, go natlafatsa intaseteri ya botlhagisi jwa ditlhagisiwa tsa ileketeroniki, go tlhola ditiro, mmogo le go tlhagisa mananeo a kgaso a a farologaneng a mantsi a fa gae.

src: Loku kutawetfulwa eMhlanganweni Lokhetsekile we-UNGA ngaMabasa 2016.Kulwa netidzakamiva letingekho emtsetfweni kuhambisana ne-NDP kantsi futsi loMhlangano utawuniketa inkhundla yekutsi kuchutjekwe kwentiwe kancono Luhlelo Lolukhulu Lwetidzakamiva Lwavelonkhe (2013-2017).12 IKhabhinethi imvumile kutsi Litiko Lekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu libambisane neLuhlelo Lwekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu Lwe-UN lingenise “Tingucuko Letihola Embili eDolobheni: Inkhommfa Yetekusuka Emikhukhwini Kuyiwe Etindzaweni Tekuhlalisa Bantfu Letifaka Ekhatsi Konkhe, Letiphephile, Letimela Tonkhe Timo, Naletichubekela Embili Ngalokungenamkhawulo, ngeNdlovana 2016.Lenkhomfa yesekela kokubili i-ajenda yekutfutfukisa yavelonkhe kanye ne-ajenda yekutfutfukisa emakhaya ngekucinisa kweselwa kweMgomo we-11 weMigomo Yekutfutfukisa Lechubekela Embili Ngalokungenamkhawulo.
tgt: Kabinete e nopoletswe ka ga diphitlhelelo tsa Pegelo ya Ditshupetso tsa Boitshimololedi le tsa Saense le Thekenoloji mo Aforika Borwa ya 2014 mmogo le setlwaedi sa tiragatso ya Thulaganyo ya Boitshimololedi ya Naga (NSI), tse di tlhagisiwang ngwaga le ngwaga ke Lekgotla la Dikeletso ka Boitshimololedi la Bosetšhaba.

src: Kwenta emadolobha lamakhulu nekuhlaliswa kwebantfu kufake ekhatsi konkhe aphephe, emelanine netimo tonkhe futsi achubekele emnbili ngalokungenamkhawulo.
tgt: Pegelo e dirisa ditshupetso tse di diphatsa go ka sekaseka tiragatso le seabe sa NSI mo ditlapeleng tse di botlhokwa tsa bosetšhaba tse di tlhagisitsweng ke Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) mmogo le ditokomane tse dingwe tsa dipholisi tse di nang le seabe mo tlhabololong ya ikonomi ya loago.

src: Lenkhomfa yenta incenye yetingcoco letimayelana nekufezekisa i-Ajenda Yekutfutfukisa Ye-UN yangemuva kwa-2015 kanye "ne-Ajenda Yasedolobheni Lensha” letawemukelwa yi-UN nga-20.13 IKhabhinethi ivumile kutsi Umkhandlu Welucwaningo Wetekulima ungenise Inkhomfa Yemave Emhlaba Lemayelana Nelucwaningo Kutekulima Kutekutfutfukisa ye-3 ngaMabasa 2016.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go phosololwa ga dikgotlatshekelo tsa magiseterata tebang le Limpopo le Mpumalanga, mmogo le go tlhomiwa ga Kgotlatshekelo ya Magiseterata ya Lephalale jaaka kantoro ya tikologo ya Karolo ya Limpopo, go nna monamaotshwere go fitlhelela kantoro ya tikologo ya karolo ya leruri e agiwa mo lefelong leo.

src: Lenkhomfa itawukhomba: lucwaningo lwemave emhlaba kanye nekwenta lokusha lokuhamba embili enchubeni yekwenta lokusha kute kutsi kuzuzwa kwemigomo yekutfutfukisa yesikhatsi lesitako, ikakhulu yemindeni lelimako nemimango lephuyile.
tgt: Go phosololwa ga dikgotlatshekelo tsa magiseterata mmogo le mafelo a taolo a Dikarolo tsa Kgotlatshekelo e Kgolo ka karolo ya ntšhwafatso ya pholisi maitlhomo a yone ke go baakanya lefa la thulaganyo ya bodulo e e sa siamang ya mo malobeng.

src: Lomtsetfosivivinyo uniketa luhlakamsebenti lwekuvula emandla emnotfo waselwandle ngekukhutsata kubambisana ekuhleleni indzawo.
tgt: Ke karolo gape ya phetolothefosano e e namileng go ka thusa go ka fitlhelela bosiamisi, e leng seo se lepalepisitsweng le Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa ya 1996.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawusita timiso te-Operation Phakisa lesevele tikhona.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse pegelo ka ga kgatelopele mabapi le go tsenngwatirisong ga ditaelo tsa Kabinete kwa Limpopo go ya ka Karolo ya bo 100 (1)

src: Indvuna Yetakhiwonchanti Tetekuchumanisa Netinsita Teliposi, Dkt.
tgt: go fitlha ka Mopitlwe 2016 mo mafapheng a a latelang a porofense ya Limpopo: Lefapha la Boitekanelo Lefapha la Dipalangwa Lefapha la Ditirelo tsa Puso Lefapha la Ditsela le Mafaratlhatlha go akaretsa le Lefapha la Matlole.

src: Siyabonga Cwele, utawuhola litsimba laseNingizimu Afrika ku-UNGA kuNgcungcutsela Yemhlaba Yenhlangano Yelwatiso (i-WSIS) kusuka mhla ti-15 kuya kumhla ti-16 Ingongoni 2015, lapho khona kutawetfulwa kuma kwelive laseNingizimu Afrika, ekufakeni ligalelo Ekungabini khona Kwemaphepha WSIS+.
tgt: mo Thuto go ka ala tsela gore Lefapha la Matlole la Porofense le tsenya ka matlhagatlhaga Karolo ya bo 18 ya Molao wa Botsamaisi jwa Madi a Puso (PFMA), 1999 (Molao wa bo 1 wa 1999) kwa Lefapheng la Thuto la Limpopo, ka tshegetso go tswa kwa pusong ya bosetšhaba.

src: Ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi: “Kulungisa likusasa le-Afrika nebantfu: ligalelo letiphatsimandla tase-Afrika tendzawo ku-ajenda-2063 weBunye be-Afrika”, lengcungcutsela, ledvose baphatsidolobha laba-15 000 nemakhansela lange-500 000, ngulenye yemitamo lemikhulu kakhulu yekwakha bunye be-Afrika.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse ditaelo tse di latelang tebang le Tonakgolo le Bakhuduthamaga (di-MEC) tsa Matlole le tsa Thuto:a) Go tlamela ka badiredi mafapha a porofense ka go thapa badiredi ba ba gaisangb) Go konosetsa go thapa botsamaisi jo bogolo lec) Go samagana ka tshwanelo le go retelelwa le bogwenegwene jwa boeteledipele.

src: Lengcungcutsela igcile ekuciniseni bohulumende basekhaya kulo lonkhe lelivekati lase-Afrika, ikakhulu kulawulwa kwetimali kanye nekutfola sisekelo lesivikelekile semali lengenako, kute kutfolwe i-Ajenda 2063 – i-Afrika lesiyifunako.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore Aforika Borwa e tshware Khonferense ya maemo a a kwa godimo ya Dipuisano tse di leng Kgatlhanong le Diritibatsi go simolola ka la bo 11 go fitlha ka la bo 12 Mopitlwe 2016, e leng seo se tla nnang ka fa tlase ga taolo ya Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika (AU).Seno se diragadiwa jaaka kopano ya go lekola ya Dipuisano tse di Kgatlhanong le Diritibatsi magareng ga Aforika le Russia, e leng seo se ikaeletseng go tlhagisa maemo a a kopanetsweng tebang le go samagana le mathata a lefatsha a a ka ga diritibatsi.

src: Lengcungcutsela yesekela imigomo ye-NDP lapho khona emadolobhakati nahulumende wasekhaya kudlala indzima lebalulekile ekutfutfukeni kwetfu konkhe.
tgt: Seno se tla tlhagisiwa kwa Kopanong e e Itlhophileng ya UNGA ka Moranang 2016.Ntwa kgatlhanong le diritibatsi tseo di seng mo molaong e tsamaisana le NDP e bile Dipuisano eno e tla tlhagisa serala sa go ka tsweletsa go gagamatsa Leano la Botlhokwa la Diritibatsi la Bosetšhaba (2013-2017).

src: IKhabhinethi isesenelitsemba lekutsi lapho kusachubeka tingcoco tekubonisana kuNkhomfa ye-21 Yemacembu (i-COP21) kuSivumelwano Seluhlakamsebenti Lwe-UN mayelana Nekugucuka Kwesimo Selitulu (i-UNFCCC), kutawufinyelelwa kusivumelwane lesifanele nalesisibopho.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore Lefapha la Bonno jwa Batho le tshware mmogo Khonferense le Lenaane la Bonno jwa Batho la “Ketelelopele ya Diphetogo mo Motseteropong: go tswa kwa megoafatsheng go lebisa kwa Bonnong jwa Batho jo bo akaretsang botlhe, jo bo babalesegileng, jo bo sa Tseweng ke Ditsuatsue le jwa Leruri” ka Mopitlwe 2016.Khonferense e tshegetsa maphata ka bobedi e leng lephata la tlhabololo la boditšhabatšhaba mmogo le lephata la tlhabololo la fa gae ka go gagamatsa tshegetso Peelong ya bo 11 ya Dipeelo tsa Tlhabololo ya Leruri: Go dira gore diteropokgolo le bonno jwa batho di fitlhelesege, di babalesege, di se tsewe ke ditsuatsue mme e nne tsa leruri.

src: Kugucuka kwesimo selitulu kuyinkinga yemave emhlaba ledzinga sisombululo semave emhlaba, lokungabukwana nako ngemphumelelo ngekwemikhakha leminyenti, ngaphansi kwekufaneleka lokubanti kwe-UNFCCC ngekutsi futsi onkhe emacembu afake ligalelo.
tgt: Khonferense ke karolo ya dipuisano tse di ka ga go tsenngwatirisong ga Lenaneo la Tlhabololo la Dinagakopano (UN) la morago ga 2015 mmogo le “Lenaneo le Lentšhwa la Teropo” leo le tla amogelwang ke Dinagakopano (UN) ka 2016.

src: Letinchubomgomo tesekelwa ngumtsetfomgomo lomkhulu wekutfutfuka lokuchubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo, lokusisekelo seMbonchanti 2030 njengoba ubekiwe ku-NDP.3 Njengoba lona ngumhlangano weKhabhinethi wekugcina wanga-2015, IKhabhinethi ifisela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika sikhatsi semaholide aKhisimusi lesihle.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore Lekgotla la Dipatlisiso tsa Temothuo le tshware Khonferense ya Boraro e e ka ga Dipatlisiso tsa Temothuo tebang le Tlhabololo ka Moranang 2016.

src: Kuwo umoya walesikhatsi kanye nekuhambisana nemoya webuntfu, iKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basite labo labeswele kanye nemindeni emimangweni yabo.
tgt: Khonferense e tla nopola: dipatlisiso tsa boditšhabatšhaba le ditlapele tsa boitshimololedi mmogo le ditlhokego mo thulaganyong ya boitshimololedi mo nageng gore go kgonagale go ka fitlhelela dipeelo tse di tlang tsa tlhabololo, bogolosegolo mo malapeng a balemirui mmogo le baagi ba ba humanegileng.

src: Sisive lesinakekelanako, lesihloniphanako futsi leseseka labo labanenhlanhla lencane.
tgt: Molaotlhomo yoo o abelana ka letlhomeso la semola go ka bulela bokgoni jwa ikonomi ya kwa mawatleng ka go rotloetsa tiromaano ya sekgoba sa dikoporasi.

tgt: Moporesitente Zuma o tla etelela pele mokete wa naga wa Letsatsi la Poelano ka la bo 16 Sedimonthole kwa Port Elizabeth, Kapa Botlhaba ka fa tlase ga moono: "Go fokotsa dikgaogano: Go aga Legae la Setšhaba sa Aforika Borwa se se lebisang kwa pusong e tlhabololang setšhaba.

tgt: Ikonomi.

src: IKhabinethi ihlangene kute icocisane ngesimo setemnotfo kanye nangetindzaba letiphatselene nebhajethi.
tgt: Kabinete e kopane go buisana ka maemo a ikonomi le merero e e amang tekanyetsokabo.

src: IKhabhinethi ibone kutsi kunemaphuzu lamanengi lanelifutse emnotfweni walelive.
tgt: Kabinete e ne ya amogela dintlha tse dintsi tse di amang ikonomi ya naga.

src: Simo semnotfo emhlabeni wonkhe sibe ngulesibi kakhulu kuletinyanga letisandza kwendlula.
tgt: Maemo go ralala lefatshe a koafetse mo dikgweding tse di fetileng.

src: Kukhula komnotfo lokuhamba kancane emhlabeni wonkhe kukhomba kutsi, kahle hle kunebutsakatsaka emnotfweni kanye nebungoti lobusetulu kumave lamanyenti lasatfutfuka, lokufaka ekhatsi nelive lase-China.
tgt: Kgolo e e bokoa ya lefatshe lotlhe e supa tiragatso e e bokoa le dikotsi tse di kwa godimo mo dinageng tse di botlhokwa tse di tlhabologang, go akaretsa China.

src: Lokuvuka kwemnotfo lokulindzeleke e-USA kunawubanga kutsi kube nekwenyuka, emhlabeni wonkhe, kwemali loyikhokha nawuboleke imali.
tgt: Poelomannong e e amogelegang e e solofelwang kwa USA e ka baka tlhatlogo ya dieelo tsa morokotso go ralala lefatshe.

src: Kwehla kwemtsamo wekuhwebelana kanye nekungatinti etimakethe temhlaba tekutsenga nekutsengisa emasheya kusho kutsi kunesidzingo sekutsi tive ticine futsi tente tintfo ngekucophelela kulesikhatsi lesitako.
tgt: Methamo e e ka fa tlase ga kgatelelo ya kgwebisano le maemo a a sa iketlang mo mebarakeng ya lefatshe ya matlole di gatelela tlhokego ya gore ditšhaba di tlhome tsepamo le go gata ka tlhoafalo mo dipakeng tse di latelang.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze futsi yabona kutsi kube nekuzuza lokutsite ngekuba phasi kwentsengo yawoyela longakahlutwa.
tgt: Kabinete e ne gape ya amogela gore go na le dipoelo dingwe tse di siameng ka ntlha ya tlhwatlhwa e e kwa tlase ya oli e e sa tlhotlhiwang.

src: Live laseNingizimu Afrika njengaloku lelive lelihweba kakhulu ngekutfumela timbiwa ngephandle, likhatsatekile ngalokuchubeka kwekwehla kwentsengo yekutsengwa kwetimbiwa.
tgt: Jaaka moromelantle wa diphatlho o mogolo, Aforikaborwa e tlhobaediwa ke bokoa bo bo tswelelang ba ditlhwatlhwa tsa diphatlho.

src: Hulumende uyachubeka ngekwakha etikwalesimo semnotfo salelive lesihlukahlukene, kantsi netinzuzo talokutfunyelwa ngephandle kuyachubeka ngekusima kakhulu kulokuyinsimbi kanye nasetintfweni letisengakaguculwa.
tgt: Puso e tswelela go agelela mo maemong a ikonomi ya naga a mefutafuta, le dipoelo tsa thomelontle di tswelela go ikaega go le gontsi ka dimetale le dire tse di tlhotlhilweng go se kae.

src: Lokwehla kwentsengo yetimbiwa kutawuphindza futsi kubuyele esimeni sako ngekushesha.
tgt: Go wa ga ditlhwatlhwa tsa diphatlho go ka se dirologe ka bonako.

src: Loko kutakwenta kutsi kube nemphumela losimeme emnotfweni waseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemave amanengi abalingani betfu elivenikati lase-Afrika.
tgt: Se se tla nna le ditlamorago tse di tla tswelelang mo ikonoming ya Aforika Borwa le tsa dinaga tse dingwe tse dintsi tse e leng balekane ba rona mo kontinenteng ya Aforika.

src: Kwehla kwemandla eLirandi kuleminyaka lembalwa leyengcile kunika ematsemba lancono ekukhula kwemtsamo wetimpahla letitfunyelwa ngephandle, kanye nekuhlangana nentsengo lephasi yawoyela, kusite ekutseni kwehlise kucindzeteleka kwisikhwama semali yelive.
tgt: Kwelotlase ya Ranta mo dingwageng di le mmalwa tse di fetileng e tlamela ka ditšhono tse di botoka tsa kgolo ya thomelontle mme, mmogo le tlhwatlhwa e e kwa tlase ya oli, e thusitse go fokotsa kgatelelo mo akhaontong ya matlole ya naga.

src: Noma kunjalo, lokukhula lokubutsakatsaka kumave labahwebelana neNingizimu Afrika kusho kudzingeka ngendlela lephasi kwemikhicito yaseNingizimu Afrika kumave angaphandle.
tgt: Le fa go le jalo, kgolo e e bokoa mo balekaneng ba Aforika Borwa ba kgwebisano e kaya topo e e fokotsegileng ya ditlhagiswa tsa Aforika Borwa kwa dinageng tse dingwe.

src: Simo semnotfo wemhlaba wonkhe sitsatseka njengalesinensayeya kumave lasafufusa, lokuhambisana nentsengo lephasi yetimbiwa kanye nekucina kwenchubomgomo yetemnotfo eMelika lokuyintfo leletsa kucindzeteleka kulutjalotimali nekukhula lokulindzelekile.
tgt: Maemo a lefatshe a tsewa a gwetlha mo mebarakeng e e alogang, ka ditlhwatlhwa tse di kwa tlase tsa diphatlho le go gagamadiwa ga pholisi ya ditšhelete kwa USA e leng se se beileng kgatelelo mo kelelong ya madi le ditsholofelo tsa kgolo.

src: Loku kubange kutsi kube nekungatinti lokukhulu kutimakthe temhlaba tekutsenga nekutsengisa emasheya.
tgt: Se, se bakile ketsaetsego mo mebarakeng ya madi.

src: Lirandi laseNingizimu Afrika, lelisemkhatsini wetimali temave lasafufusa lekuhwebelana ngato kakhulu, lishayeke kakhulu kulamaviki lengcile.
tgt: Ranta ya Aforika Borwa, e leng lengwe la madi a mebaraka e e alogang le go gwebisanwang thata ka lona, e utlwisitswe botlhoko, segolo mo dibekeng tse di sa tswang go WEBTOKEN maemong a a bokete a a lefatshe, a mo go ona diikonomi tsotlhe di lebaganeng le dikgwetlho tse dikgolo, Kabinete e gateletse tlhokego ya gore puso e tsereganye ka botlhale le ka go tsaya tshwetso go busetsa segalo sa kgolo ya ikonomi.

src: Luhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (i-NDP) luniketa letinyatselo tekungenelela.
tgt: Leanotlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) le tlamela ka ditsereganyo tse.

src: Hulumende utawufinyelela kubalingani, ikakhulu betemabhizinisi netinhlangano tebasebenti, kute kwakhiwe lokutawuvunyelwana ngako macondzana nalokutawukwentiwa ngekuhlanganyela kute kusimamiswe umnotfo, kwakha kutsembeka, kwenyusa lizinga lelutjalotimali nekubuyisela iNingizimu Afrika endleleni yekukhula lokungukhukhulelangoco kutemnotfo.
tgt: Puso e tla golagana le balekane ba loago, segolo kgwebo le mekgatlo ya badiri, go bopa tumalano mo dikgatong tse di kopanetsweng tse di tlhokegang go tsepamisa ikonomi, go bopa tshepo, go tsholetsa maemo a peeletso le poelo mo Aforika Borwa go ya ntlheng ya kgolo ya ikonomi e e akaretsang.

src: Inkhulumo Yebunjalo Belive mhla ti-11 Indlovana itawuchaza ngalowo msebenti.
tgt: Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba (SoNA) ka 11 Tlhakole e tla tsaya tsia tiro e. Kabinete e tiisitse mekgwa e e maatla ya go busetsa tsela e e isegang ya matlole go lebilwe koafalo e e nnileng teng mo ikonoming ya lefatshe le ditlamorago tsa yona mo gae.

src: IKhabhinethi yesekele tinyatselo letimatima tekubuyisa indlela lesimeme yetimali tahulumende, ngekubuka lesimo lesibutsakatsaka setemnotfo wemhlaba wonkhe kanye nemphumela waso lapha kulelive.
tgt: Tona ya Matlotlo, Pravin Gordhan, o tla ribolola ditsela tse fa a ala tekanyetsokabo ya bosetšhaba ka 24 Tlhakole Tlamelo ka matlole go Thuto e KgolwaneKabinete e amogetse diphetolo mo dikabong tsa tekanyetsokabo ya bosetšhaba tse di tla fetisang matlole go thusa diyunibesithi ntle le go fetisa ditekanyetso tse di begilweng tsa tirisong ya matlole.

src: Indvuna Yetetimali Pravin Gordhan utawuchaza leto tinyatselo ngesikhatsi etfula ibhajethi yavelonkhe mhla tinge-24 Indlovana Kusitwa ngetimali Kwemfundvo LephakemeIKhabhinethi itivumile tichibiyelo kuluphakelo lwebhajethi yavelonkhe letitawugudluta imali kute kusitwe emanyuvesi ngetimali ngaphandle kwekuphula imikhawulo yencitfomali lemenyetelwe phambilini.
tgt: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma le Tona ya Thuto e Kgolwane le Katiso, Blade Nzimande, go sa le gale ba supile gore dikabo tse di tla dirisediwa gore dituelo di se tlhatlosiwe jaaka go dumelanwe mo ngwageng wa ga jaana wa dithuto, go phimola sekoloto sa baithuti sa Sekema sa Thuso ya Matlole sa Baithuti sa Bosetšhaba le go thibela kokotsego ya sekoloto se mo pakagareng.

src: Letinyatselo tekungenelela tingumphumela wemihlangano leminyenti lebekhona lecale ngeMphala 2015 kantsi nanyalo solo isachubeka.
tgt: Mekgwa e ya tsereganyo ke tsibogo ya ditherisano di le mmalwa tse di simolotseng ka Diphalane 2015 e bile di santse di tswelela.

src: Indvuna Yetemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha kanye nelitsimba lakhe letekulawula babambe imihlangano leminyenti nebaholi be-SASCO, Imikhandlu Lemele Bafundzi (ema-SRC), Inhlangano Yemanyuvesi aseNingizimu Afrika, Inyonyana Yebafundzi baseNingizimu Afrika, ema-CEO ema-SETA, Inhlangano Yeluntjintjo Kwetemfudvo Lephakeme kanye neLikomidi lasePhalamende lelibukene nemfundvo lephakeme.
tgt: Tona ya Thuto e Kgolwane le Katiso le setlhopha sa gagwe sa bolaodi o tshwere dikopano di le mmalwa le boeteledipele ba SASCO, Makgotla a Dikemedi tsa Baithuti otlhe, Foramo ya Diyunibesithi tsa Aforika Borwa, Kopano ya Baithuti ba Aforika Borwa, boCEO ba diSETA, Mokgatlo wa Tlhabololo ya Thuto e Kgolwane le komiti ya Palamente e e nang le maikarabelo a thuto e kgolwane.

src: Mengameli uphindze futsi wabamba umhlangano nebaholi bebafundzi waphindze wamemetela kutsi utawusukumisa Likhomishana lelitawuhlola letinkinga letivele kuTemfundvo Lephakeme.
tgt: Moporesitente o kopane gape le boeteledipele ba baithuti e bile o ba begetse ka go tlhongwa ga Khomišene e e tla lebang dintlha tse di tlhagisitsweng ka ga Thuto e Kgolwane.

src: Letinkhulumiswano tisachubeka njengaloku singuhulumende sifuna kutfola likhambi lesikhatsi lesidze.
tgt: Ditherisano tse di santse di tswelela pele gonne re dumela gore jaaka puso re batla go dira go bona tharabololo ya leruri.

src: Letimfuno tebafundzi tihambisana netinjongo teluhlelo lwahulumende lolumayelana netemfundvo.
tgt: Ditopo tsa baithuti di nyalana le maitlhomo a thulaganyo ya puso tebang le thuto.

src: Njengesinyatselo lesiphutfumako, sekukhokhwe tigidzigidzi le-R2,33 kute kusonjululwe kushoda kwemali mayelana netimali tekusebenta kwemanyuvesi ngenca yalesivumelwane sekwenyusa imali yekufundza yanga-2016 nga-0%.
tgt: Mo maemong a ga jaana, dibilione tsa diranta tse 2.33 di abetswe go samagana le tlhaelo mo go tlameleng diyunibesithi ka matlole ka ntlha ya tumalano ya koketso ya dituelo ka 0% ka Mo ngwageng wa ditšhelete wa 2016/17, puso e abile sešwa dibilione tsa diranta di le 2.543 tsa matlole a Puso go abelwa NSFAS go tlamela ka dikadimo tsa go thusa baithuti ba ba supilweng ke NSFAS ba le 71 753 mme ba ne ba tlametswe ka seripa fela kgotsa ba sa tlamelwa gotlhelele ka matlole mo dingwageng di le tharo tse di fetileng tsa dithuto.

src: Ngemnyakamabhuku wanga-2016/17, hulumende ubeke embili R2,543 yetigidzigidzi temali yembuso yekusita kutsi yabelwe i-NSFAS kutsi inikete kubolekiswa kwemali kute kusitwe bafundzi labange-71 753 lababonakele kutsi bayafaneleke kutsi basitwe ngetimali i-NSFAS kepha bangasitwa ngalokugcwele nome abazange sebasitwe sanhlobo vele kuyo yonkhe leminyakakufundza lemitsatfu leyengcile.
tgt: Se se kaya gore baithuti ba ba tshwanelwang ba, ba ka se ganediwe go tsweletsa dithuto tsa bona ka ntlha ya fa ba na le dikoloto tse di saletseng morago tsa diyunibesithi.

src: Loku kusho kutsi labo bafundzi labafanele kutsi basitwe ngeke bavinjelwe kutsi bachubeke netimfundvo tabo ngobe bakwelata emanyuvesi imali yekufundza lesilele.
tgt: Dibilione tse dingwe tsa diranta di le 2.039 di abetswe NSFAS mo ngwageng wa ditšhelete wa 2016/17 go tshegetsa baithuti ba ba senang matlole kgotsa ba matlole a a tlhaelang ba ba santseng ba le mo diyunibesithing ka 2016 go konosetsa dithuto tsa bona.

src: Letinye futsi tigidzigidzi leti-R.039 titawukwabelwa i-NSFAS ngemnyakamabhuku wanga-2016/17 kute kusekelwe ngetimali bafundzi labangakasitwa ngetimali nome labasitwe kancane kepha labasasenyuvesi nga-2016 kute baphotfule tifundvo tabo.
