tgt: Matlole a ke tlaleletso mo godimo ga dibilione tsa diranta di le 10 tse NSFAS e tla di rebolang mo ngwageng wa dithuto wa 2016.Puso e ineetse go tlamela ka thuto ya morago ga sekolo, go baithuti botlhe ba ba tshwanelwang, ya mahala go batlhoki le ba maemo a a kwa tlase a badiri, mo teng ga ditekanyetso tse di diregang tsa matlole.

src: Letimali tengeta kuletigidzigidzi leti-R10 i-NSFAS letatisebentisa ngemnyakakufundza wanga-2016.Hulumende utimisele kunika imfundvo yamahhala ngemuva kwamatekuletjeni kubo bonkhe bafundzi labafanele ngekwetemfundvo labaphuyile nalabo bantfu labasebentako, ngekungengci imikhawulo lesimeme yetetimali tahulumende.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go baithuti, badiri, batlhatlheledi le batsamaisi ba diyunibesithi go dirisana mmogo le puso go fitlhelela maikaelelo a. Dikgato tse di kgoreletsang dithuto kgotsa di tlholang maemo a a sa iketlang kgotsa go solofela dilo tse di ka se fitlhelelegeng, ga di na thuso epe.

src: Ludlame nekuwesabisa akwemukeleki.
tgt: Tirisodikgoka le matshosetsi ga di amogelege.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika babone kutsi kunetimo letiyinsayeya esikhatsini lesitako.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go lemoga gore go na le maemo a a gwetlhang mo pakeng e e tlang.

src: Timo tetemnotfo temhlaba wonkhe tibutsakatsaka.
tgt: Maemo a ikonomi ya lefatshe a koafetse.

src: Lifutse lelibi lentsengo lephasi yetimbiwa selivele liyavela eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Seabe sa ditlhwatlhwa tse di kwa tlase tsa diphatlho se setse se utlwala mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Kudvonsa kamatima kwalelive njengekunganeli kwekuphakelwa kwagezi solo kusekhona.
tgt: Mathata a selegae jaaka tlamelo e e sa lekanang ya motlakase, a santse a le teng.

src: Lesomiso lesikhulu sibanga bumatima etifundzeni letinengi.
tgt: Komelelo e kgolo e baka mathata mo diporofenseng di le mmalwa.

src: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba kutsi bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika batawukhombisa kuba sive lesicinile lesikwatiko kubaluleka kwekusebenta ngekubambisana ngekuthula nangekuvana.
tgt: Kabinete e na le bonnete ba gore maAforika Borwa a tswelela go nna setšhaba se se maatla se se itseng boleng ba go dira mmogo ka kagiso le kutlwano.

src: Lokuvela kwalabo labanebuhlanga lokusandza kwenteka kucinise kutinikela kwetfu sonkhe ekwakheni sive lesite buhlanga, lesite kucwasana ngebulili nalesiphumelelako.
tgt: Go senoga ga sešweng ga batho ba ditumelo tsa go tlhaola ka mmala go maatlafaditse boineelo ba rona rotlhe ba go aga setšhaba se se sa tlhaoleng go ya ka mmala, ka bong mme e le setšhaba se se tswelelang.

src: Kubekwa etikhundleniIKhabhinethi ikuvumile kubekwa etikhundleni kwalaba labalandzelako:.
tgt: Go thapiwaKabinete e amogetse go thapiwa ga ba ba latelang:.

src: UMnu Shonisani Mathews Munzhedzi njengeLisekela Lemcondzisi Jikelele (i-DDG): Kongiwa Nekuhlukahlukana Kwalokuphilako kuLitiko Letemvelo.
tgt: Rre Shonisani Mathews Munzhedzi jaaka Motlatsa Mokaedikakaretso (DDG): Mefutafuta ya Botshelo le Tshomarelo mo Lefapheng la Merero ya Tikologo.

src: Kufezekiswa kwetinhlelo tahulumende letibalulekile.
tgt: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga manaane a botlhokwa a puso.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukele Inkhulumo yaMengameli Jacob Zuma Yebunjalo Belive layetfule ngaLesine, mhla ti-11 Indlov.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba ya ga Moporesitente Jacob Zuma e e tlhagisitsweng ka Labone, 11 Tlhakole.

src: Lenkhulumo ibe ngumhlahlandlela wendlelalisu lekucala kwekusebenta kwetinhlelo tahulumende.
tgt: Puo e tlhomile mosupatsela wa togamaano wa tiragatso ya Lenaanetiro la Puso.

src: Mengameli ucele hulumende, betemisebenti kanye nebetemabhizinisi kutsi basebentisane ekutfoleni tisombululo tekukhula kwemnotfo losimeme.
tgt: Moporesitente o ikuetse mo pusong, mekgatlho ya badiri mmogo le mo kgwebong go dira mmogo go bona ditharabaololo tsa kgolo ya ikonomi e e nnelang leruri.

src: IKhabhinethi iyatisekela letinyatselo tekunciphisa tindleko letimemetelwe nguMengameli, Indvuna Yetetimali letawuphindza yenabe kabanti ngato mhla tinge-24 Indlovana.
tgt: Kabinete e tshegetsa dikgato tsa go fokotsa ditshenyegelo tse di itsesitsweng ke Moporesitente tse di tla tlhalosiwang ke Tona ya Ditšhelete ka la bo 24 Tlhakole.

src: Inkhulumo Yemcombelelo yanga-2016/17 itawuphindza futsi ichaze kabanti ngekuphakelwa kwemitfombolusito letawucondziswa etinhlelweni letahlukahlukene tahulumende njengaloku kugcizelelwe nguMengameli.
tgt: Puo ya Tekanyetsokabo ya 2016/17 e tla tlhagisa kabelo ya ditlamelo go ya kwa manaaneng a a farologaneng a puso go ya jaaka Moporesitente a gateletse.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukele imphumelelo yeMining Indaba, lebeyibanjelwe lapha eKapa kusukela mhla ti-8 kuya mhla ti-11 Indlovana.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Indaba ya Meepo e e atlegileng e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Motsekapa go tloga ka la bo 8 go fitlha ka la bo 11 Tlhakole.

src: Baholi labamelele umkhakha wetimayini kanye nabohulumende labanengi base-Afrika bashiyelene ngekuvisisa kwabo lokujulile mayelana nekutsi lomkhakha ungatihola kanjani tekusisa ngetimali kanye nekusebentisa lamatfuba lakhona lapha e-Afrika.
tgt: Baemedi ba ba eteletseng pele go tswa kwa lephateng la meepo le dipuso tse di farologaneng tsa Aforika ba arogane megopolo ya bona malebana le ka moo lephata le ka tsamaisang dipeeletso ka teng mmogo le go dirisa ditšhono tse di leng teng mo Aforika.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuncomile kakhulu kutinikela kwahulumende waseJapani kutsi utawukhulisa tekusisa tawo lapha eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Kabinete e lebogetse maitlamo a a dirilweng ke puso ya Japane a go oketsa dipeeletso tsa yona mo Aforika Borwa.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze yakucinisekisa futsi kutinikela kwayo kutsi kube nemkhakha wetimayini losimeme nalochumako.
tgt: Kabinete e boeleditse maitlamo a yona a lephata la meepo le le tsepameng e bile le dira ka katlego.

src: Sivumelwane seLuhlakamsebenti Lwemboni Yetimayini Lesimeme sisekele imboni yetimayini kulesimondzawo lesikhona lesimatima.
tgt: Tumelano ya Letlhomeso la Indaseteri ya Meepo e e nnelang Leruri e tshegetsa indaseteri ya meepo mo seemong sa ga jaana se se boima.

src: Hulumende uyachubeka nekunika siciniseko setekulawula futsi utawucinisekisa kutsi Umtsetfosivivinyo Wetimbiwa Nekutfutfukiswa Kwemitfombolusito Yephethroliyamu, losasetandleni tePhalamende uyaphotfulwa.
tgt: Puso e tswelela go tlamela ka netefaletso ya taolo mme e tla netefatsa gore go konosediwa Molaotlhomo wa Tlhabololo ya Dimenerale le Ditlamelo tsa Peteroliamo, o o fa pele ga Palamente.

src: Tincumo teKhabhinethi Letibalulekile.
tgt: Ditshwetso tse di botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.

src: IKhabhinethi iyivumile Inchubomgomo yekugcina Yavelonkhe Yekugembula, lebukana netinsayeya letikhinyabeta kusebenta ngemphumelelo kweMtsetfo Wavelonkhe Wetekugembula, 2004 (Umtsetfo we-7 wa-2004).
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Pholisi ya Bosetšhaba ya makgaolakgang ya Itekolesego, e e samaganang le dikgwetlho tse di kgoreletsang go dira sentle ga Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Itekolesego, wa 2004 (Molao wa bo 7 wa 2004).Pholisi e setse e fetile mo tsamaisong ya patlomaikutlo a setšhaba.

src: Lenchubomgomo seyivele seyihanjisiwe yayiswa kummango kutsi ucale inchubo yekubonisana ngayo.
tgt: Pholisi e tshitshinya dipaakanyo mo letlhomesong la taolo ya dipopegotheo tsa diboto tsa itekolesego mme e maatlafatsa didirisiwa tsa taolo go fokotsa tiriso e e botlhaswa ya itekolesego.

src: Lenchubomgomo iphakamisa tichibiyelo kuluhlakamsebenti lwesakhiwo sekulawula semabhodi etekugembula kanye nekucinisa tindlela tekuphatsa kute kuncishiswe kusetjentiswa kabi kwekugembula.
tgt: E ama dikhasino, dibingo, metšhini e dituelo tsa yona di lekanyeditsweng mmogo le go betšha dipitsi.

src: Loku kusebenta kumakhasino, kumabhingo, emishinini yekukhokha kanye nekubheja emahhashi.
tgt: Pholisi e tla emisetsa Boto ya Bosetšhaba ya Itekolesego ka Molaodi wa Bosetšhaba wa Itekolesego o o tla ikarabelang ka tlhamalalo kwa Lefapheng la Kgwebisano le Intaseteri.

src: Lenchubomgomo itakwenta kutsi Umlawuli Wavelonkhe Wetekugembula atsatse sikhundla seBhodi Yavelonkhe Yetekugembula lotawubika ngco kuLitiko Letekuhweba Netimboni.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse tlhagiso ya Pegelo ya Tshekatsheko ya Dingwagapotlana tsa go Golegwa Bosenyi kwa Palamenteng, e leng se se tlhokegang go ya ka Molao wa Bosiamisi wa Bana, wa 2008 (Molao wa bo 75 wa 2008).

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa kweMbiko Lomayelana Nekubuketwa Kwemnyaka Webudzala Lophasi Wekucala Kwenta Bugebengu ePhalamende, lokudzingekako kuMtsetfo Webulungiswa Bebantfwana, wanga-2008 (Umtsetfo we-75 wanga-2008).
tgt: Pegelo e atlenegisa gore naga e amogela maitlamo a boditšhabatšhaba le a kgaolo malebana le dingwagapotlana tsa go golegelwa bosenyi tsa bana ba ba iphitlhelang ba na le kgotlhang le molao.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kugazetwa Kwetindzawo Tekutfutfukisa Emandla Lavusetelelekako (i-REDZ).
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go tsenngwa mo kaseteng ga Dikgaolo tsa Tlhabololo ya Maatla a a Ntšhwafadiwang (REDZ).

src: Loku kutawuhlela kahle inchubo yekulawula, kutfolwe tindzawo lapho umoya netheknoloji yekushisa kwelilanga i-Photovoltaic ingakhutsatwa khona kanye nalapho igridi ‘lejulile’ ingacondziswa khona.
tgt: Seno se tla rulaganya thulaganyo ya taolo, sa supa mafelo a go ka maatlafadiwang dithekenoloji tsa motlakase wa phefo le wa letsatsidi ka bonwang le moo go ka atolosiwang tlamelo ya mafaratlhatlha a a boteng gona.

src: Lama-REDZ atawusicinisekisa kuntjintjela kumnotfo lonekhabhoni lephasi, kutsi kube nentfuntfuko yesakhiwonchanti lesisheshisako, kanye nekufaka ligalelo lelibumbene kanye neluhlakamsebenti lolulawulako lolucombelekako lolunciphisa indendende yekulandzela kuhleleka kwetintfo letiphatselene netindleko tekuhambelana.
tgt: Di-REDZ tseno di tla netefatsa kgabaganyo ya go ya kwa ikonoming e e tlhagisang khabone e e kwa tlase, di akofise tlhabololo ya mafaratlhatlha, le go tshwaela mo letlhomesong le le rulaganeng e bile le bonelwa pele la taolo le le fokotsang tsamaiso e e amanang le ditshenyegelo tsa go obamela.

src: IKhabhinethi yatjelwa ngalamafisha mayelana naloko lokwatfolwa nguMbiko wa-2014 weSayensi yaseNingizimu Afrika, Ithekhinoloji Netinkhomba Tekwenta Lokusha weMkandlu Wavelonkhe Wetekweluleka mayelana Nekwenta Lokusha.
tgt: Kabinete e boleletswe ka diphitlhelelo tsa Pegelo ya Aforika Borwa ya 2014 ya Disupi tsa Saense, Thekenoloji le Boitlhamedi mo Lekgotleng la Bosetšhaba la Bokgakolodi jwa Boitlhamedi.

src: Lombiko unika tindlelamkhuba ekusebenteni kweLuhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwekwenta Lokusha (i-NSI).
tgt: Pegelo eno e tlamela ka mokgwa wa tiragatso wa Tsamaiso ya Bosetšhaba ya Boitlhamedi (NSI).

src: Ihlola kusebenta kanye neligalelo le-NSI etintfweni tavelonkhe letibekwe embili njengaloku kusho Luhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwentfuntfuko.
tgt: E sekaseka tiragatso le tshwaelo ya NSI mo ditlapeleng tsa botlhokwa tsa bosetšhaba tse di tlhagisitsweng mo Leanong la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NPD).

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kusetjentiswa kwebafundzisi bemfundvo lephakeme lesetitsatse umhlalaphasi kanye netisebenti tahulumende leticashwe ngalokugcwele kutsi tisebente eSikolweni Savelonkhe Sahulumende (i-NSG)I-NSG yatfulwa ngemnyaka wa-2013, kutsi itsatse sikhundla seBuholi Bekuphatsa Ummango Nekulawula Temfundvo (i-PALAMA), futsi igunyatwe kutsi itfutfukise emagugu lachubekela embili kanye nemitsetfomgomo lebusa kuphatfwa kwemmango kanye nekwenta ncono bunjalo, nekuchubekisela embili lifutse letentfutfuko yemtfombolusito lebantfu kuletikhungo.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse tiriso ya badiredisetšhaba ba ba rotseng tiro le ba ba dirang jaaka batlhatlheledi kwa Sekolokatisong sa Bosetšhaba sa Puso (NSG).NSG e tlhomilwe ka 2013, e tsena mo legatong la Setheo sa Tsamaiso le Boeteledipele jwa Botsamais jwa Thuto mo Pusong (PALAMA), mme thomo ya yona ke go tsweletsa phitlhelelo e e tswelelang ya boleng le dintlhatheo tse di laolang tsamaiso ya puso le go tokafatsa boleng, katoloso le ditlamorago tsa tlhabololo ya bokgoni jwa badiri mo ditheong.

src: Lesichamkelo sitawulingwa kusebenta kanye nekucala kusetjentiswa kweLuhlelo Loludzingekile Lwekutayatisa tisebenti tahulumende.
tgt: Maiteko ano a tla lekelediwa ka go tsenngwa tirisong ga Lenaane le le Pateletsang la Kitsisotiro la badiredisetšhaba.

src: Lendlela isita tisebenti tahulumende kutsi tibe nguletineligalelo emsebentini wahulumende.
tgt: Mokgwa ono o kgontsha badiredisetšhaba go oketsa boleng mo tirelong setšhaba.

src: Titawundlulisa sipiliyoni sato, bungcwethi, emakhono kanye nelwati lwekufundzisa kanye nekucecesha tisebenti tahulumende.
tgt: Ba tla dirisa maitemogelo a bona, bokgoni le kitso go tataisa le go rotloetsa badiredisetšhaba.

src: Lesichamukelo sitawuphindza futsi sente ncono kutsi kube nekuletfwa kwetinsitakalo kubantfu letisezingeni ngemiphumela futsi ngendlela lengabiti.
tgt: Gape maiteko ano a tla tokafatsa boleng jwa ditirelo tse re di nayang setšhaba ka tsela e e bokgoni e bile e le tlhotlhwatlase.

src: IKhabhinethi iwuvumile Umbiko waseNingizimu Afrika Wesigaba Sekugcina se-3 Selive lomayelana Nekucala Kwekusebenta Kwenhlangano Yetemnotfo Yekusebenta Ngekubambisana kanye Nentfutfuko (i-OECD), (Ingcugcutsela Lelwisana Nekudiza).
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Pegelo ya Naga ya Aforika Borwa ya Legato la Bofelo la bo 3 le le malebana le go Tsenngwa tirisong ga Mokgatlho wa Tirisanommogo ya Ikonomi le Tlhabololo (OECD) (Tumelano e e kgatlhanong le Pipamolomo).

src: Lombiko utatakwetfulwa kuLicembu Lekusebenta le-OECD Lekudiza.
tgt: Pegelo e tshwanetse go neelwa Setlhopha sa Tiro sa Pipamolomo sa OECD.

src: Lombiko ukhombisa inchubekelembili leseyentiwe nguhulumende mayelana netingenelelo takhe tekulwa nekudiza lokwentiwa mave angaphandle ngekutsi akutfungatse akutfole, akuphenye aphindze ashushise labo labakwentako.
tgt: Pegelo e tlhalosa tswelelopele e e dirilweng ke naga ka ditsereganyo tsa yona tsa go fedisa pipamolomo ka go e supa, go batlisisa mmogo le go e sekisetsa.

src: Lombiko uphindze futsi ugcamise sichamukelo lesesentiwe sekucaphelisa ummango mayelana nalobugebengu.7 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kutsi Litiko Letasekhaya (i-DHA) lehlukaniswe libe ngephasi Kwebulungiswa, Kuvikela Bugebengu kanye Neliphiko Lekuphepha Ligunya leLitiko Letasekhaya kutsi ligcine bunguye bemuntfu lobuphephile, nekubhaliswa lokungiko kanye nesimo sabo bonkhe labangekhatsi kulomncele walelive, lokusinyatselo lesimcoka sekwenta yonkhe leminye imisebenti yembuso.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae (DHA) le aroganngwe gape ka fa tlase ga Setlhopha sa Bosiamisi, Thibelo ya Bosenyi le Pabalesego.

src: Liphindze futsi lagunyatwa kutsi lilawule luhlelo lwekungena nekufika kulelive, lokuyintfo lenelifutse ngco ekuphepheni kwavelonkhe, kubumbana kutenhlalo kanye nekufezekiswa kwetinjongo tentfutfuko.
tgt: Thomo ya Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae ke go tshola le go babalela rejisetara ya boammaaruri ya boitshupo le seemo sa botlhe ba ba mo nageng ya rona, e leng sa botlhokwa se se kgontshang ditiro tse dingwe tsotlhe tsa mmuso.

src: Ngaphambilini i-DHA beyihleleke njengensitakalo letayelekile yekuphatsa yekusekela lengaphasi kweKulawula neLiphiko Letekuphatsa.
tgt: Gape le romilwe go tsamaisa tsamaiso ya bofudugedi, e e amang ka tlhamalalo pabalesego ya bosetšhaba, tirisano ya loago mmogo le phitlhelelo ya diphitlhelelo tsa WEBTOKEN malobeng DHA e ne e arogantswe jaaka ditirelo tsa tshegetso ya tsamaiso ka kakaretso ka fa tlase ga Setlhopha sa Bolaodi le Tsamaiso.

src: Imitsetfosivivinyo.1 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuvikela, Kukhangisa, Kutfutfukisa kanye Nekulawulwa Kwelwati Lwendzabuko.
tgt: Molaotlhomo.1 Kabinete e amogetswe go tlhagisiwa ga Molaotlhomo wa Tshireletso, Tsweletso, Tlhabololo le Tsamaiso ya Kitso ya Tshimologo kwa Palamenteng.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo, wekuvikela, kukhangisa, kutfutfukisa kanye nekulawula Lwati Lwendzabuko.
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono ke wa go sireletsa, go tsweletsa le go tsamaisa dithulaganyo tsa Kitso ya Tshimologo.

src: Unika emandla ekusungula kanye nemisebenti yelihhovisi Lelwati Lwendzabuko Lwavelonkhe, kulawulwa kwemalungelo alabo labanelwati lwendzabuko, kusungulwa kanye nemisebenti yelitsimba lelilulekako macondzana nelwati lwendzabuko.
tgt: O dira tlamelo ya go tlhomiwa le ditiro tsa kantoro ya Bosetšhaba ya dithulaganyo tsa Kitso ya Tshimologo, tsamaiso ya ditshwanelo tsa batshodi ba kitso ya tshimologo, go tlhamiwa le ditiro tsa phanele ya Bogakolodi ya dithulaganyo tsa kitso ya tshimologo.

src: Uphindze futsi uvumele kutsi ukhone kufinyelela kanye netimo tekuvunyelwakulwati lwendzabuko kanye nakumimango yendzawo, kusungulwa kwesilulu savelonkhe selwati lwendzabuko, kubhaliswa, kuvunyelwa ngekucinisekiswa kanye nekunikwa sitifiketi kwalabo labasebenta ngelwati lwendzabuko, kuhambisa nekuchumanisa lwati lwendzabuko lolweyame ekwenteni lokusha.
tgt: Gape o letlelela phitlhelesego le seemo sa phitlhelesego ya kitso ya merafe ya tshimologo le ya selegae, go tlhamiwa ga thulaganyo ya bosetšhaba ya go rekotiwa ga dithulaganyo tsa kitso ya tshimologo, go kwadisiwa le go tlhomamisiwa ga badiragatsi ba tshimologo, kgokaganyo ya boitlhamedi jo bo ikaegileng ka kitso ya tshimologo.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawusebentisana Nemtsetfo Wekuchibiyela Imitsetfo Yemphahla Loticambele, 2013 (Umtsetfo we-28 wa-2013).IKhabhinethi iluvumile lushicilelo lweMtsetfosivivinyo wa-2015 Wekuchibiyela Kubhaliswa Kwematayitela kute ummango uphawule ngalo.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o tla tshegetsa Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Melao ya Dithoto tsa Tlhaloganyo, wa 2-13 (Molao wa bo 28 wa 2013).Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Molaotlhomo o Baakantsweng wa Makwadisetso a Dikano, wa 2015 gore go tshwaelwe mo go ona.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibiyela Umtsetfo Wekubhaliswa Kwematayitela, 1937 (Umtsetfo we-47 wa-1937) kute kusukwe kutindleleni tekusebentisa emaphepha kepha kuyiwe kutindlela telihhovisi lematayitela le-elekthroniki.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o baakanya Molao wa Makwadisetso a Dikano, wa 1937 (Molao wa bo 47 wa 1937).

src: Ubukana netindzaba tekuphepha ngobe unika kutsi labandluliswa ematayitela babhalise njengalabasebentisa loluhlelo lwekubhalisa lwe-elekthroniki.2 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wa-2015 Wekuphila Kwetitfombo (i-Phytosanitary).
tgt: Molaotlhomo o ikaeletse go baakanya Molao wa Makwadisetso a Dikano, wa 1937 (Molao wa bo 47 wa 1937) gore go fudugiwe go tswa kwa kantorong ya dikano ya dipampiri go ya kwa go ya mokgwa wa eleketoroniki.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo wenta kutsi kushaywa kwemtsetfo waseNingizimu Afrika kuhambisane netibopho letifanele kanye nemazinga kute kube nekuhwebelana lokuphephile nalokungavuni licala kwemave ngemave kute kutsi kwehwebelana ngetitfombo nangemikhicito yetitfombo kwasekhaya nekwemave ngemave kwalelive kube ngulokuphephile.
tgt: O samagana le merero ya tshireletsego ka go tlamela ka kwadiso ya diphetiso jaaka badirisi ba ba mo molaong ba thulaganyo ya kwadiso ya dikano ya eleketoroniki.2 Kabinete e amogetse go itsesewe ga Molaotlhomo wa Boitekanelo jwa Dimela, wa 2015 kwa Palamenteng.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo nasewuphasisiwe, live lase Ningizimu Afrika litawukhona kuvikela kungena kweluhlupho lolubuya emaveni langephandle kanye netifo letingabhebhetsekisa loluhlupho loluyingoti kanye netifo tetitfombo kulelive.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o lepalepanya melao ya Aforika Borwa le maitlamo a a maleba le dipeelo go gokaganya kgwebisano ya boditšhabatšhaba e e babalesegileng e bile e sa gobelele go netefatsa kgwebisano ya naga ya selegae le ya boditšhabatšhaba ya dimela le ditlhagiswa tsa dimela.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wa-2015 Wekuchibiyela Umtsetfo Wetinkantolo.
tgt: Fa Molaotlhomo o setse o fetisitswe, Aforika Borwa o tla kgona go thibela go tlisiwa ga ditshenekegi le malwetsi a dinaga di sele a a tswaletsweng tse di ka anamisang ditshenekegi le malwetsi a a kotsi mo dimeleng tsa naga.3 Kabinete e amogetse go tlhagisiwa ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Dikgotlatshekelo tsa Molao, wa 2015 kwa Palamenteng.

src: LoMtsetfo uchibiyela Umtsetfo Wetimantji Tetinkantolo, 1944 (Umtsetfo we-32 wa-1944) kanye Nemtsetfo Wekuchibiyela Tinkantolo Letiphakeme, 2013 (Umtsetfo we-10 wa-2013).Letichibiyelo tihlose kudzambisa inhlupheko yalabakweletako labatikhandza sebachashatwa nguloluhlelo lwekugcogca tikweleti etinkantolo tetimantji kanye nekubandzakanya umklamo weLitiko Letekuhweba Netimboni wekususa lwatiso lolungasiluhle lwebatsengi.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o baakanya Molao wa Dikgotlatshekelo tsa Bomagiseterata, wa 1944 (Molao wa bo 32 was 1944) le Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Dikgotlatshekelo tse di Kwa Godimo, wa 2013 (Molao wa bo 10 wa 2013).Paakanyo e lebeletse go fokotsa mathata a bakoloti ba ba iphitlhelang ba sotlakakiwa ke thulaganyo ya go koleka dikoloto kwa dikgotlatshekelong tsa bomagiseterata le go amogela porojeke ya Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Madirelo ya go tlosa tshedimosetso e e maswe ya sekoloto ya badirisi.

src: LoMtsetfo uhlose kuchibiyela tigaba teMtsetfo Wetimantji Tetinkantolo, 1994 (Umtsetfo we-32 wa-1994) (I-MCA) kute kulungiswe kuchashatwa kuMtsetfo Wekuchibiyela Tinkhokhelo (i-EAO).
tgt: Maikaelelo a Molaotlhomo ke go baakanya dikarolo tsa Molao wa Dikgotlatshekelo tsa Bomagiseterata, wa 1994 (Molao wa bo 32 wa 1994) (MCA), go samagana le tshotlakako e e mo Taelong e e Baakantsweng ya Tuelo (EAO).Molaotlhomo o ikaelela go samagana le go fedisa dikatlholo tse di rebolwang e se ka fa molaong, gantsi di dirwa ke ditlelereke tsa kgotlatshekelo kwa ntle ga bookamedi jwa bosiamisi, mme gantsi ka ntlha ya go tlhoka maitemogelo, gongwe go dirisana le ba ba kolotwang, babueledi gongwe ba ba kolekang sekoloto.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kulungisa nekucedza tehlulelo letiphuma ngalokungemtsetfo, ikakhulu letikhishwa bomabhalane betinkantolo ngaphandle kweliso letebulungiswa, etikhatsini letinyenti ngekungabi nesipiliyoni nome ngekuvumelana nalabakweletwako, bameli babo nome bagcogci betikweleti.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o tla netefatsa gore bakoloti ba newa katlholo e e obamelang taelo ya tuelo gongwe Taelo ya Go Tsewa ga Tuelo e e obamelang melao ya tuelo.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawucinisekisa kutsi labakweletako baniketwa tehlulelo letihambisana nemtsetfo wesitolimende nome Umtsetfo Wetinkhokhelo Nekudliwa letisemtsetfweni wekukhokha titolimende.
tgt: Ditiragalo tse di tlang.1 Mafelo a beke a ntlha a go ikwadisetsa ditlhopho a Ditlhopho tsa Pusoselegae tsa 2016 e tla nna go tloga ka la bo 5 go fitlha la bo 6 Mopitlwe 2016.

src: Imikhosi letako.1 Imphelasontfo yekucala yekubhaliswa kwebavoti babhalisela Lukhetfo Lwabohulumende Basekhaya lwa-2016 itawuba kusukela mhla ti-5 kuya mhla ti-6 Indlovulenkhulu 2016.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforikaborweng otlhe go dirisa tšhono eo le go tlotla temokerasi e e bonweng ka bothata ka go ya go dirisa ditshwanelo tsa bona tsa go kwadisa le go tlhopha mo ditlhophong tse di tlang.2 Moporesitente o tla tsaya Leeto la Semmuso go ya kwa Rephaboliking ya Islamo ya Iran go tloga ka la bo 28 go fitlha la bo 29 Tlhakole 2016.Leeto le tla maatlafatsa dipuisano tsa rona tse di tswelelang pele tsa sepolotiki le ikonomi le Iran le go susumetsa dikamano tsa Dinaga tsa Borwa jwa Mogarafatshe.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi balisebentise lelitfuba bahloniphe futsi lentsandvo yelinyenti leyatfolwa kamatima ngekutsi baphume bayowusebentisa lilungelo labo lentsandvo yelinyenti babhalise baphindze bavote kulolukhetfo lolutako.2 Mengameli Zuma utawube avakashele ngekwembuso e-Islamic Republic of Iran kusukela mhla tinge-28 kuya mhla tinge-29 Indlovana2016.Lokuvakasha kutawucinisa budlelwane betfu betepolitiki nebetemnotfo nelive lase-Iran kanye nekugcugcutela budlelwane emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika ne-Iran.
tgt: Jaaka Molaodimogolo wa Sesole sa Tshireletso ya Naga ya Aforika Borwa (SANDF), Moporesitente Zuma o tla bo a tsamaisa kwa karolong ya botlhano ya meletlo ya Letsatsi la Matsholo a a Tlhometseng kwa Port Elizabeth, Kapabotlhaba, ka la bo 21 Tlhakole 2016.

src: NjengeMkomuzi Lomkhulu Wembutfo Wavelonkhe Wetekuvikela waseNingizimu Afrika (i-SANDF), Mengameli Zuma utawugubha Lusuku Lwembutfo Lohlomile lwesigaba sesihlanu eBhayi, eMphumalanga Kapa, mhla tinge-21 Indlovana 2016.
tgt: Moletlo ono wa ngwaga le ngwaga o supa tshegetso le ditebogo go banna le basadi ba SANDF.3 Moporesitente Zuma o tla bua kwa pulong ya Ntlo ya Bosetšhaba ya Dikgosi/Ntlo ya Bosetšhaba ya Baeteledipele ba Setso kwa Palamenteng, Motsekapa ka la bo 26 Tlhakole 2016.

src: Lomcimbi lowentiwa minyaka yonkhe wekukhombisa kwesekela nekubonga bomake nabobabe labaseMbutfweni Wavelonkhe Wetekuvikela waseNingizimu Afrika.3 Mengameli Zuma utawukhuluma ekuvulweni Kwendlu Yavelonkhe Yebaholi Bendzabuko ePhalamende, eKapa mhla tinge-26 Indlovanae 2016.
tgt: Botsalano magareng ga puso le baeteledipele ba setso bo botlhokwa jaaka mmogo ba direla go tokafatsa matshelo a batho.4 Ka Lamatlhatso, la bo 20 Thakole 2016, Motlatsamoporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etelela pele kemedi ya Ditona kwa Dipontshong tsa Moporesitente tsa Tlhabololo ya Bašwa kwa Grace Bible Church kwa Pimville, Soweto.

src: Budlelwane emkhatsini wahulumende nebaholi bendzabuko bubalulekile njengaloku bonkhe basebentela kwenta ncono timphilo tebantfu.4 NgeMgcibelo mhla tinge-20 Indlovana2016, Lisekela Mengameli Cyril Ramaphosa utawube ahola litsimba Letindvuna lelitawuya eMbukisweni WaMengameli Wekutfutfukisa Lusha lotawubanjelwa lapha eGrace Bible Church ePimville, eSoweto.
tgt: Dipontsho tseno di tshegediwa ke mafapha a Merero ya Selegae, Badiri, Tlhabololo ya Loago le Phemelo.

src: Lombukiso wesekelwa ngematiko eTindzaba Tasekhaya, Lemisebenti, Lekutfutfukisa Tenhlalo kanye Neletekuvikela.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo bašweng ba lefelo leo go tsenela dipontsho, tse di tla tlamelang ka tshedimosetso ya gore ba ka tsweletsa dithuto tsa bona jang, ba itshimololela dikgwebo jang gongwe go ungwelwa mo maitekong a puso a tshegetso.5 Kabinete e amogetse go amogelwa ga Seminara ya Kgaolo ya Aforika ka ga Tshireletso ya Batho go ya ka Boitlhophelo jwa Bona jwa Bong, Boitshupo le Itlhagiso ya Bong, ke Khomišene ya Ditshwanelo tsa Botho ya Aforika Borwa, go tloga ka la bo 3 go fitlha la bo 5 Mopitlwe 2016.Seminara e tla gokaganya puisano gore go tlhaloganngwe botoka modi le go tlhagelela ga dikgwetlho tseno gore go bonwe ditharabololo tse di dirang mmogo le boitlhophelo jo bo gona mo Mebusong go samagana le dikgatako tseno.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu labasha kulendzawo kutsi baye kulombukiso, ngobe utawubanika lwatiso mayelana nekutsi bangatichuba njani tifundvo tabo, bangawasungula njani emabhizinisi nome yini labangakuzuza kuleto tichamukelo tekubasekela letentiwa nguhulumende.5 IKhabhinethi iwuvumile Umhlangano Wesifundza lomayelana Nekuvikela Bantfu ngalokuphatselene Nebulili Lobuguculiwe, Ngekwebulili kanye Nekukhuluma, lobitwe Ikhomishani yaseNingizimu Afrika Yemalungelo Eluntfu, kusukela mhla ti-3 kute kube mhla ti-5 Indlovulenkhulu 2016.Lomhlangano utawenta kutsi kube nekukhulumisana kute kube nekuvisisana lokukhulu netimbangela letisisusa kanye nekubonakala kwaletinsayeya kute kutfolakale tisombululo letiphatsekako kanye netindlela letikhona embusweni ekulungiseni nalokukuchashatwa.6 IKhabhinethi ibafisela lokuhle bonkhe bafundzi lababhala luhlolo Lwekuchibiyela libanga lamatekuletjeni.
tgt: Kabinete e eleletsa barutwana botlhe ba ba kwalang ditlhatlhobo tsa Tlaleletso tsa Setifikeiti se Segolwane/Materiki masego.

src: Bafundzi bayagcugcutelwa kutsi bafinyelele ekutfoleni loluhlelo lwelitfuba lesibili lolusha losandza kwetfulwa lwekusekela bakamatekuletjeni lolutfolakala kuto tonkhe tifundza lolusita bafundzi etifundvweni tabo ngemitfombolusito leyahlukahlukene.
tgt: Barutwana ba rotloediwa go fitlhelela Lenaane le le sa tswang go tlhomiwa la tshegetso la tšhono ya bobedi ya materiki le le fitlhelwang kwa diporofenseng tsotlhe mme le thusa barutwana ka dithuto tsa bona ka ditlamelo tse di farologaneng.

src: Injongo Yaloluhlelo Lwelitfuba Lesibili Lwamatekuletjeni kunika bantfu labasha labangakaphumeleli kutsi bakhone kuhlangabetana netidzingo Tesitifiketi Savelonkhe Samatekuletjeni (i-NSC) litfuba lesibili lekutsi batfole matekuletjeni ngaleyo ndlela bente ncono lizinga letimphilo tabo.
tgt: Maitlhomo a Lenaane la Materiki la Tšhono ya Bobedi ke go tlamela bašwa ba ba sa kgonang go fitlhelela ditlhokego tsa Setifikeiti sa Bosetšhaba se Segolwane (NSC), tšhono ya bobedi go amogela materiki mme ka go rialo ba tokafatse boleng jwa matshelo.

src: Luhlolo lwekuchibiyela luyincenye Yeluhlelo lwelitiko Lwelitfuba Lesibili Lwamatekuletjeni futsi lunika bafundzi labahlulekile kutfola tindzingo letiphasi tekuphumelela netekutfola sitifiketi, kepha labadzinga tifundvo letimbili letisetulu kute batfole i-NSC.
tgt: Ditlhatlhobo tsa tlaleletso ke karolo ya Lenaane la lefapha la Tshegetso la Tšhono ya Bobedi ya Materiki mme le naya barutwana ba ba iseng ba fitlhelele ditlhokegopotlana tsa go fetisiwa le go bona setifikeiti, ba ba tlhokang dirutwa tse pedi go fitlhelela NSC, tšhono ya go dira jalo.

src: IKhabhinethi iyasemukela simemetelo lesentiwe nguMengameli semagama emalunga eLikhomishani Yekuphenya Imfundvo Lephakeme.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela kitsiso ya Moporesitente ya maina a ditokololo tsa Khomišene ya Dipatlisiso ya Thuto e Kgolwane.

src: Ikhabhinethi icela bonkhe labatsintsekako Kutemfundvo Lephakeme kutsi bafake ligalelo kulomsebenti welikhomishani kute kutfolakale sisombululo sesikhatsi lesidze saletinsayeya Imfundvo Lephakeme lebukene nato.
tgt: E ikuela mo baameging botlhe ba ba nang le kgatlhego mo Thutong e Kgolwane go tshwaela mo tirong ya khomišene gore go bongwe tharabololo ya leruri ya dikgwetlho tse di lebaganeng le Thuto e Kgolwane.

src: Lokushiwo yiKhabhinethi mayelana netindzaba letimcoka eveni.1 Indvuna Yetimbiwa Mosebenzi Zwane, Indvuna Yelihhovisi Lamengameli Susan Shabangu kanye Nendvuna Yetentfutfuko Yebantfu Bathabile Dlamini – labebakhetfwe nguMengameli kutsi basekele hulumende wesifundza, tisebenti tasemayini kanye nemindeni letsintsekile emva kwalengoti leyenteke eLily Gold Mine eBhabutini – babikela Ikhabhinethi kafishane mayelana nalokusha lokwentekako.
tgt: Tona ya Ditlamelo tsa Dimenerale Mosebenzi Zwane, Tona kwa Lefapheng le le mo Kantorong ya Moporesitente Susan Shabangu le Tona ya Tlhabololo ya Loago Bathabile Dlamini - ba ba neng ba tlhomilwe ke Moporesitente Zuma go tlamela tshegetso go puso ya porofene, beng ba moepo mmogo le malapa a a amegileng go latela matlhotlhapelo a kwa Moepong wa Gauta wa Lily kwa Barberton - ba tlhaloseditse Kabinete dintlha tsa ga jaana.

src: Ikhabhinethi ihlanganyela kanye naMengameli ekuceleni sive kutsi sikhumbule letisebenti tasemayini letintsatfu letisolo tivaleleke ngephasi kwemgodzi kanye nemindeni yato sitithandazele sicabange ngato futsi.2 IKhabhinethi ikhatsatekile ngesomiso lesisolo sihlasele letinye tincenye talelive.
tgt: Kabinete e ikamantse le Moporesitente ka go ikuela mo setšhabeng go baya badiri ba moepo ba ba sa ntseng ba gaeletswe ka fa tlase ga lefatshe mmogo le bamalapa a bona mo dithapelong.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyabonga kakhulu kulabo bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, labasekela imitamo yekulwa nesomiso.
tgt: Kabinete e sa ntse e tshwentswe ke komelelo e e sa ntseng e amile dikarolo dingwe tsa naga.

src: IKhabhinethi itsandza kuvakalisa kudvumisa kwayo kulabo labalalele lesicelo sekubika nome ngabe ngukuphi kuvuta kwemanti ngekusekela Umkhankhaso Wekulwa Nekuvuta loholwa yiNdvuna Yetemanti Nekuhanjiswa Kwekungcola Nomvula Mokonyane.
tgt: E tlhagisitse ditebogo go maAforika Borwa otlhe, a a tshegetsang maiteko a namolo ya komelelo.

src: IKhabhinethi iyawudvumisa sibili lomoya weBuntfu lokhonjiswe ngulesichamkelo lebesiholwa i-Operation Hydrate lesente umehluko emimangweni lebeyihlukumetekile.3 IKhabhinethi ibambe tinkhulumomphikiswano yaphindze yawuphuma umphumela logcwele waloMtsetfo Wekuchibiyela Imitsetfo Yemtselo, 2014.
tgt: Kabinete e leboga botlhe ba ba tsibogetseng boikuelo jwa go bega go dutla go tshegetsa Letsholo la Ntwa ya go Dutla le le eteletsweng pele ke Tona ya Metsi le Bophepa Nomvula Mokonyane.

src: Loku kusho kutsi kusukela ngalolo lusuku, tinzuzo tesikhwama sephrovidenti netinzuzo tesikhwama sempeshini titawuphatfwa ngalokufananako ngendlela yekutsi emalunga langaphasi kwesikhwama sephrovidenti atawutsi nakasatsatsa umhlalaphasi avunyelwe kutsi atsatse kunye kulokutsatfu etinzuzeni tesikhwama sawo sephrovidenti lokungukheshi njengenkhokhelo lesamba bese kutsi kubili kwalokutsatfu lokusele batawukusebentisela kutfola imiholo yenyanga nasetsatse umhlalaphasi.
tgt: Kabinete e itumelela mowa wa Botho/Ubuntu o o bontshitsweng ke maiteko a a eteletsweng pele ke Operation Hydrate a a dirileng pharologano mo baaging ba ba neng ba le mo tlalelong.

src: Sekuyintfo lefananako njenganyalo nakulawo malunga langaphasi kwesikhwama sempesheni.
tgt: Kabinete e ganetsane le go lebelela ditlamorago ka botlalo tsa go simolola go dirisiwa ga Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Melao ya Kgethiso, 2014.

src: Letingucuko kulomtsetfo titsintsa labo labahola kakhulu kanye nabo bonkhe labangaphasi kwalesikhwama sephrovidenti.
tgt: Go ya ka Molao, go fetolelwa ga ditshiamelo tsa letlole la tlamelo go nna tse di duelwang ka paka e e rileng go tla simolola ka la bo 1 Mopitlwe 2016.

src: Tinhlangano letinyenti kanye nebantfu bavakalise kukhatsateka kwabo mayelana nekucala kusebenta kwaletingucuko letinsha ngaleyo ndlela base benta tetfulo kuhulumende ngaloko.
tgt: Seno se kaya gore go tloga ka letlha leo, ditshiamelo tsa letlole la tlamelo le ditshiamelo tsa letlole la phenšene di tla tsewa ka go lekalekana ka gore e tla re fa ditokololo tsa letlole la tlamelo di rola tiro di letlelelwe go tsaya nngwetharong ya ditshiamelo tsa tsona tsa letlole la tlamelo e le tuelo ya madi a a seatleng mme peditharong e e setseng ya ditshiamelo tsa bona ba tla e dirisa go reka tlamelo e e duelang madi ka paka e e rileng gongwe annuity.

src: Kuyabonakala kutsi nanome kube netinchubo tekubonisana kabanti ngembikwekutsi lomtsetfo uphasiswe, loko kukhatsateka kusasekhona nekutsi loko kukhala kufanele kutsi kubukwe ngekushesha kute kucinisekiswe kutsi ngesikhatsi letingucuko tetinzuzo kusikhwama sephrovidenti ticala kusebenta kufanele tenteke kahle futsi ngemphumelelo.
tgt: Ditlamelo tseo ke tse di dirang mo ditokololong tsa matlole a phenšene ga jaana.

src: Lokubonisana kungaholela kulokunye futsi kuchibiyelwa kwalemitsetfo.
tgt: Diphetogo tsa molao di ama baamogedi ba ba kwa godimo mmogo le batho botlhe ba e leng ditokololo tsa matlole a tlamelo.

src: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibiyela utakwetfulwa ePhalamende kuletinsuku letimbalwa letitako.
tgt: Ditheo di le mmalwa le batho ba tlhagisitse matshwenyego ka go tsenngwa tirisong ga diphetogo tse dintšhwa mme ba dirile ditlhagiso kwa pusong malebana le go tsenngwa tirisong.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindza futsi ivakalisa kudzabuka kwayo ngekundlula emhlabeni kwaMabhalane Jikelele waphambilini waMhlabuhlangene (i-UN) Shifu Boutros Boutros-Ghali.
tgt: Kabinete e romela matshediso ka ntlha ya go tlhokafala fa gautshwane ga Moitshepi Bishopo Glayton Modise wa Kereke ya International Pentecostal Holiness Church.

src: Wacala kusebenta nga-1992 ngesikhatsi lapho kunemtselela waMhlabuhlangene macondzana nemphi yaseGulf, wasebenta ithemu yinye yesikhatsi seminyaka lesihlanu.
tgt: Bishopo Modise o eteletse pele phuthego ya ditokololo tse di fetang dimilione di le tharo go ralala borwa jwa Aforika, go latela go tlhokafala ga ga rraagwe le mosimolodi wa kereke, Moitshepi Comforter Frederick Modise ka 1996.

src: Utawukhunjulwa ngeligalelo lakhe labenalo etindzabeni tekuthula netentsandvo yelinyenti.
tgt: O tsene mo kantorong ka 1992 ka nako ya fa tshusumetso ya UN e ne e gola go latela seabe sa botlhokwa kwa ntweng ya Kgokgometso, mme a dira paka e le nngwe ya dingwaga tse tlhano.

src: Imilayeto yekuhalalisela.
tgt: Dikakgolo.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Umnu Kevin Govender lobuya eHhovisi leliseKapa Lelwatitinkhanyenti kute kube Nentfutfuko kanye Nenyonyana Yemave Ngemave Yelwatitinkhanyenti yabosotinkhanyenti lotawuba aklonyeliswa ngekuhlanganyela Indondo yase-Edinburg ya-2016 ngekusungula Lelihhovisi Lelwatitinkhanyenti Kute kube Nentfutfuko leliseKapa.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola Rre Kevin Govender wa Kantoro ya Motsekapa ya Bolepanaledi go lebeletswe Tlhabololo mmogo le Mokgatlho wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Bolepanaledi yo a tla abelwang mmogo Metale o o Tlotlegang wa Edinburgh wa 2016 ka ntlha ya go tlhoma Kantoro ya Bolepanaledi go lebeletswe Tlhabololo kwa Motsekapa.

src: Govender uwekucala waseNingizimu Afrika kutsi atfole lomklomelo kutesayensi nethekhinoloji lefaka ligalelo ekuvisiseni nakutenhlalakahle yeluntfu.
tgt: Govender ke moAforika Borwa wa ntlha go amogela sekgele seno se se tlotlegang sa diphitlhelelo tsa saense le thekenoloji e e tshwaelang mo go tlhaloganyeng le itekanelong ya batho.

src: IKhabhinethi imshayela lihlombe umdansi webhaleyi loneminyaka le-16 budzala Leroy Mokgatle lozuze umklomelo Wekutsandvwa Tetsameli kanye nemfundzate e-Prix de Lausanne International Ballet Competition eSwitzerland.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola motantshi wa dingwaga di le 16 wa ballet, Leroy Mokgatle yo a gapileng sekgele sa Audience Favourite mmogo le sekolašipi kwa Kgaisanong ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya Ballet ya Pris de Lausanne kwa Switzerland.

src: Ungumuntfu wekucala waseNingizimu Afrika kutfola lomfundzate eminyakeni lenge-28 aphindze abe wesibili emlandvweni walelive.
tgt: Ke moAforika Borwa wa ntlha go gapa sekolašipi mo dingwageng di le 28 le wa bobedi mo hisetoring ya naga.

src: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela kanye naMengameli Zuma ekuhalaliseni labo labaphumelele kuMkomelo Wesibili Wemnyaka Webuntfu.
tgt: Kabinete e ikamanya le Moporesitente Zuma go akgola bafenyi ba Dikgele tsa bo 2 tsa Ngwaga le ngwaga tsa Ubuntu.

src: Lemiklomelo ihlonipha bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika embonini yebaholi kanye nebantfu labatiwako ngeligalelo labo ekukhangiseni emhlabeni wonkhe lokutsandvwa ngulelive kanye nemagugu etfu avelonkhe.
tgt: Dikgele tseno di akgola baeteledipele ba indaseteri ba Aforika Borwa mmogo le batho ba ba tlhagelelang ka ntlha ya ditshwaelo tsa bona go tsweletsa dikgatlhego tsa rona tsa bosetšhaba mmogo le dintlhatheo tsa maitsholo a rona go ralala lefatshe.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela umshayi wemfiliji Wouter Kellerman, i-cappella group Ladysmith Black Mambazo kanye nemculi wemculo welukholo Neville D ngekukhetfwa kwabo ku-2016 Grammy.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola flautist Wouter Kellerman, setlhopha sa cappella Ladysmith Black Mambazo le moopedi wa mmino wa sedumedi Neville D ka ntlha ya go supiwa mo dikgeleng tsa Grammy tsa 2016.

src: Lamaciko abantfu labasivusela inshisekelo futsi baphakamisela etulu umjeka waseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Batsweretshi bano ba a rotloetsa e bile ba fofisetsa folaga ya Aforika Borwa kwa godimo tota.

src: Kubekwa etikhundleniKonkhe kucashwa kuya ngekucinisekiswa kweticu tabo kanye nekuvunyelwa lokufanele.
tgt: Go thapiwaGo thapiwa gotlhe go tla diragadiwa fa makwalothuto otlhe a netefaditswe mme go amogetswe tetlelelo e e matshwanedi:.

src: Kucala kwekusebenta kwetinhlelo letimcoka tahulumende IKhabhinethi iyemukele Inkhulumomcombelelo ya-2016 letfulwe yiNdvuna Yetetimali Pravin Gordhan mhla tinge-24 Indlovana 2016.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Puo ya Tekanyetsokabo ya 2016 e e dirilweng ke Tona ya Ditšhelete Pravin Gordhan ka la bo 24 Tlhakole 2016.

src: LoMcombelelo ukhombisa kukhona kwetfu kumelana nebumatima, kutinikela kanye nekuhlakanipha njengaloku sikhona kubhukula kulesikhatsi sesimo semnotfo lesibi emlandvweni losandza kwendlula.
tgt: Tekanyetsokabo eno e bontsha go tsetsepela ga rona, maitlamo a rona mmogo le mosola wa rona fa re ntse re samagane le paka eno e e maswe go gaisa ya ikonomi mo ya mo malobeng.

src: Lomcombelelo uhlangabetana naloko lelive lelikudzingako uphindze udale kutsi siwetsembe lomnotfo ngekutsi sibeke lelive endleleni yetekukhula kwemnotfo longukhukhulelangoco, losimeme nalesingawetsemba futsi.
tgt: Tekanyetsokabo e tsibogela se naga e se tlhokang mme e dira gore go nne le boikanyego mo ikonoming ka go baya naga mo tseleng e e ikanyegang, ya leruri le e e ka diregang mme e akaretsa ya kgolo ya ikonomi.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze futsi iyachubeka yemukela tinyatselo letimcoka letitsatsiwe tekunciphisa tindleko iphindze futsi iyatinikela ekusebentisaneni ngekuhlanganyela nayo yonkhe imikhakha ekufakeni ligalelo lemtamo wavelonkhe kutsi kucale kusebente letinyatselo letishiwo nakwetfulwa umcombelelo.
tgt: Gape kabinete e amogela dikgato tsa botlhokwa tsa go fokotsa ditshenyegelo mme e itlama go dira mmogo le maphata otlhe go tshwaela mo maitekong a a tlhakanetsweng a bosetšhaba a go diragatsa kgato eno e e tlhomilweng ke tekanyetsokabo.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukela Licembu Lebetindzaba Lamengameli (i-PPC) leletfulwe nguMengameli Jacob Zuma.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go tlhomiwa ga Setlhopha sa Bobegakgang sa Moporesitente (PPC) ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma.

src: Le-PPC itawakhiwa bahleli betepolitiki, bachumanisi betepolitiki, lababika ngetepolitiki kanye netintsatseli teteminotfo letigunyatwe kutsi tibike ngetindzaba letitsintsa Lihhovisi Lamengameli ngalokuchubekako kanye nangalokugcwele.
tgt: PPC e tla akaretsa batseleganyi ba dikgang tsa sepolotiki, bakwaladikgang ba sepolotiki, babegakgang ba dipolotiki mmogo le babegakgang ba ikonomi ba ba tlhomamisitsweng go bega dikgang tsa Kantoro ya Moporesitente ka dinako tsotlhe.

src: Inhloso ye-PPC kutsi betindzaba banike kufinyelela lokuncono kulwatiso.
tgt: Maitlhomo a PPC ke go tlamela bobegakgang ka phitlhelesego e e tokafaditsweng ya tshedimosetso.

src: Itawuphindza futsi yente kube ncono kutsi betindzaba bafinyelele kuMengameli kanye naseHhovisi Lamengameli, kute kucinisekiswe kutsi tintsatseli nato titfola lwatiso lolwendvulelako kanye netinchubo kute tente ncono kuvisisa kwato kanye nekubika kwato.
tgt: Gape e tla tokafatsa go fitlhelesega ga Moporesitente le Kantoro ya Moporesitente mo bobegakgannyeng go netefatsa gore babegakgang ba amogela tshedimosetso ya lemorago le dithulaganyo go tokafatsa go tlhaloganya le go bega ga bona.

src: Emalunga elicembu labetindzaba lasisekelo nawo futsi atawutjelwa ngalamafisha Lisekelamengameli kanye nangunome ngabe nguyiphi Indvuna lemenywa nguMengameli kutsi yabelane ngetinhlelo telive letibalulekile.
tgt: Ditokololo tsa setlhopha sa bobegakgang di tla amogela dipego go tswa go Motlatsamoporesitente le Tona nngwe le nngwe e Moporesitente a e laletsang go arogana manaane a botlhokwa a bosetšhaba.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalise kudvumisa kwayo ngeligalelo leNingizimu Afrika lebenalo ekwenteni kutsi kube nekuthula eBurundi, lokuyintfo lehambisana nenchubomgomo yetfu yemave angephandle yekutinikela kutsi sicinisekise kutsi kunekuthula nekutinta kulelivekati.
tgt: Kabinete e tlhagisitse ditebogo ka ntlha ya karolo eo Aforika Borwa e nnileng le yona malebana le go busetsa kagiso kwa Burundi, go lepalepana le maitlamo a rona a dipholisi tsa dinaga di sele go netefatsa gore go nna le kontinente e e renang kagiso e bile e tsepame.

src: Iphindze futsi Ikhabhinethi yayemukela imiphumela ye-inclusive Inter-Burundian Dialogue lebeyibanjiwe ngesikhatsi kuvakashe litsimba leliphakeme Letinhloko Tembuso kanye naHulumende teLubumbano Lwe-Afrika (i-AU) eBujumbura eBurundi, lebeliholwa nguMengameli Zuma.
tgt: Gape e amogetse dipoelo tsa Puisano e e akaretsang ya ka fa gare ga Burundi e e neng e tshwerwe ka nako ya leeto la kemedi ya maemo a a kwa godimo ya Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika (AU), e e neng e eteletswe pele ke Moporesitente Zuma.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kukhetfwa kwaMengameli Zuma nguMabhalane Jikelele waMhlabuhlangene (i-UN) Ban Ki-moon, kutsi abe ngusihlalo ngekuhlanganyela weKhomishini Lephakeme Yetekucasha Kutemphilo kanye Nekukhula Kutemnotfo naMengameli François Hollande waseRiphabhulikhi yaseFrance.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go thapiwa ga Moporesitente Zuma ke Mokwaledikakaretso wa Ditšhabakopano (UN) Ban Ki-moon, go tlhakanela bodulasetilo jwa Khomišene ya Maemo a a kwa Godimo ya Boitekanelo, Ditiro le Kgolo ya Ikonomi le Moporesitente François Hollande wa Rephaboliki ya France.

src: Loku akusiko kwekucala kutsi Mengameli Zuma akhetfwe ngumtimba wemhlaba kutsi ente umsebenti wemhlaba wonkhe.
tgt: Ga se la ntlha Moporesitente Zuma a thapiwa ke setheo sa lefatshe go dira tiro mo seraleng sa lefatshe.

src: Lokukhetfwa kwakhe kuyindlela yekutsatsela etulu umsebenti webuhloli lobuhle lobentiwa nguMengameli wetfu esigabeni semave ngemave.
tgt: Go thapiwa gono ke ka ntlha ya go lemoga boeteledipele jo bo gaisang jo bo bontshitsweng ke Moporesitente wa rona mo seraleng sa lefatshe.

src: LeKhomishini itawukhutsata kudaleka kwematfuba emsebenti lamasha emkhakheni wetemphilo kuwo onkhe emave, ikakhulu emaveni lasengakatfutfuki kuyaphi.
tgt: Khomišene e tla susumetsa go tlhamiwa ga ditšhono tsa ditiro tse dintšhwa mo lephateng la boitekanelo go ralala dinaga tsotlhe, bogolo segolo tse di sa tlhabologang mo go kalo.

src: Loku futsi kuphindze kucinise kucala kwekusebenta kwe-Ajenda Ya-2030 Yentfutfuko Lesimeme, letawudlala indzima lenkhulu ekulungiseni lensayeya lemihiba lemtsatfu yekusweleka kwemsebenti, buphuya nekungalingani.
tgt: Gape seno se maatlafatsa go diragadiwa ga Lenaane la 2030 la Tlhabololo e e nnelang leruri, e leng se se tla thusang go samagana le dikgwetlho tse di maphata mararo a botlhokatiro, lehuma le go tlhoka tekatekano.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kwetfulwa kweLuklayo Lwavelonkhe Lwemmango Lwa-2016 eMamelodi lapha ePitoli lolwentiwe yiNdvuna yaseHhovisi Lamengameli Jeff Radebe kanye naSolubalo Jikelele Pali Lehohla.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go tlhomiwa ga Tshekatsheko ya Bosetšhaba ya Baagi ya 2016 kwa Mamelodi, Pretoria ke Tona mo Kantorong ya Moporesitente Jeff Radebe le Radipalopalokakaretso Pali Lehohla.

src: Luklayo lwalonyaka lwentiwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “INingizimu Afrika Lengiyatiko, Likhaya Lengilivisisako” futsi kuhloswe ngalo kufinyelela emakhaya langetulu kwetigidzi leti-1.5 – lolukhulu kakhulu nalucatsaniswa nalolo lolwentiwa eminyakeni lesihlanu leyengca lapho kwatsatfwa khona kuphela emakhaya la-300 000.
tgt: Tshekatsheko ya monongwaga e dirwa ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "MoAforika Borwa yo ke mo itseng, legae le ke le tlhaloganyang" mme go totilwe magae a feta 1,5 milione - e leng palo e kgolo go gaisa fa e bapisiwa le e e neng e totilwe mo dingwageng di le tlhano tse di fetileng mo go neng go dirilwe tshekatsheko ya magae a le 300 000 fela.

src: Loluklayo lutakwentiwa ngenyanga yaMabasa kantsi imiphumela yalo itakwatisa ekupheleni kwenyanga yeNhlaba 2016.
tgt: Tshekatsheko e tla dirwa ka Moranang mme dipholo di tla itsesewe kwa bokhutlong jwa Seetebosigo 2016.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhatsatekile ngembiko lowetfulwe yiNhlangano Yemhlaba Yetemphilo kanye neNhlangano Yetemnotfo Nekubambisana Nentfutfuko kuLuphenyo Lwemakethe Yetemphilo lobeluholwa nguJaji Sandile Ngcobo.
tgt: Kabinete e nopotse ke go tshwenngwa ke pegelo e e tlhagisitsweng ke Mokgatlho wa Lefatshe wa Boitekanelo (WHO) le Mokgatlho wa Tirisanommogo ya Ikonomi le Tlhabololo mo Patlisisong ya Mmaraka wa Boitekanelo e e eteletsweng pele ke Moatlhodi Sandile Ngcobo.

src: Lemibiko ikhomba kutsi iNingizimu Afrika inika bantfu tinsita tetemphilo letibita kakhulu nakucatsaniswa nalamanye emave.
tgt: Pegelo e supa gore Aforika Borwa e tlamela ka ditirelo tsa kalafi tse di tlhotlhwagodimo go gaisa fa e bapisiwa le dinaga tse dingwe.

src: Ikhabhinethi itawulindza kuphotfulwa kwaloluphenyo ngembikwekutsi iphefumule ngaloludzaba.
tgt: Kabinete e tla emela go konosediwa ga patlisiso pele ga go dira kgoeletso ka morero ono.

src: Tincumo letimcoka teKhabhinethi IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweNdlelalisu Yesikhashana Yekulungisa Kungcoliseka Kwemoya eMimangweni Leminyene Lenemalingena Lencane yaseNingizimu Afrika kute ummango uphawule.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Togamaanotlhomo ya go Samagana le Kgotlhelego ya Mowa mo Baaging ba Lotseno lo lo kwa tlase ba ba nnang mo go kitlaneng gona mo Aforika Borwa gore go dirwe ditshwaelo.

src: Lendlelalisu ihlose kunika indlela yekwenta tintfo legcilile kute kubukanwe nemazinga lasetulu ekungcoliseka kuletinye taletindzawo letiminyene temimango lenemalingena lencane.
tgt: Maikaelelo a togamaano ke go tlamela ka tsela e e tsepameng go samagana le seelo se se kwa godimo sa kgotlhelego mo baaging bangwe ba ba bonang lotseno lo lo kwa tlase mme ba nna mo go kitlaneng gona.

src: Lendlelalisu inika indlela yekwenta tintfo lechumene yekucala kusebenta kwalemitamo yekunciphisa kusha kwemafutsa asemakhaya.
tgt: E tlamela ka tsela e e gokaganeng ya go tsenngwa tirisong ga maiteko a go fokotsa go fisa dituki mo magaeng.

src: Lesingenelelo sekucinisekisa kutsi letindzawo tenta tintfo ngekuhambisana ne-National Ambient Air Quaity Standards.
tgt: Tsereganyo eno e ikaelela go netefatsa gore dikarolo tseno di obamela Seemo sa Bosetšhaba sa Boleng jwa Mowa wa Tikologo.

src: Lendlelalisu legcilile itawusekela indlelalisu yavelonkhe levele ikhona yekubukana nekungcoliseka kwemoya kulelive.
tgt: Togamaano eno e e tsepameng e tla tshegetsa togamaano e e leng teng ya bosetšhaba ya go samagana le kgotlhelego ya mowa mo nageng.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kubanjwa ngekuhlanganyela kweNgcungcutsela Yengculazi Ye-21 Yemave Ngemave (i-AIDS 2016) emkhatsini wahulumende kanye neNhlangano Yemave Ngemave Ye-AIDS lapha e-International Convention Centre (e-ICC) eDurban kusukela mhla ti-18 kuya mhla tinge-22 Kholwane 2016.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go amogelwa ga Khonferense ya bo 21 ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya AIDS (AIDS 2016) ke puso le Mokgatlho wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa AIDS kwa International Convention Centre (ICC) kwa Durban go tloga ka la bo 18 go fitlha ka la bo 22 Phukwi 2016.

src: Kubanjelwa kwalengcungcutsela kulelive kutakwenta kutsi kulwa kwalelive ne-HIV kanye nesifo sesifuba kube setulu kuphindze kube nelifutse kuyinye yetinsayeya letibaluleke kakhulu lapha eNingizimu Afrika, kulesifundza kanye nasemhlabeni wonkhe.
tgt: Go amogela khonferense go tla tokafatsa tsibogo ya naga ya rona ya HIV le TB fa go ntse go ama nngwe ya dikgwetlho tsa botlhokwa tota mo Aforika Borwa, mo kgaolong le mo lefatsheng.

src: Lengcungcutsela itawenta kutsi kube nenkhundla yebacwaningi labavela emhlabeni wonkhe kutsi bashiyelane ngelwati lolusha kulendzima, kufundziswane ngebungcweti balomunye kanye nekutfutfukisa tindlelalisu tekwenta ncono yonkhe imikhakha yemitamo yetfu lehlanganisiwe yekwelapha nekuvikela i-HIUmtsetfosivivinyo IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wa-2015 Wekuchibiyela Tekutfutsa Tavelonkhe Tendlela Yaseveni, lochibiyela Umtsetfo Wavelonkhe Wetekutfutsa Wendlela Yaseveni, wa-2009 (Umtsetfo we-5 wa-2009).
tgt: Khonferense eno e tla naya babatlisisi go tswa lefatsheng ka bophara serala sa go arogana dikgatelopele tsa ga jaana tsa saense mo lephateng, go ithuta mo boitseanapeng jwa ba bangwe mmogo le go tlhama maano a go tsweletsa dikarolo tsotlhe tsa maiteko a re a tlhakanetseng a go alafa le go thibela HIMolaotlhomo.

src: Letichibiyelo taloMtsetfo Wavelonkhe Wetekutfutsa Wendlela Yaseveni wa-2009 utawuchubela embili lenchubo yekuntjintja nekwakha kabusha luhlelo lwavelonkhe lwetekutfutsa lwendlela yaseveni.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse tlhagiso ya Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa 2015 wa Dipalangwa tsa Bosetšhaba tsa mo Lefatsheng, o o baakanyang Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Dipalangwa tsa mo Lefatsheng, 2009 (Molao wa bo 5 wa 2009).

src: Loku kutawuba neligalelo lelihle lelitawuholela ekutseni kube nensita yekutfutsa ummango lephephile, lenekufinyeleleka, lengabiti kanye nalephumelelako.
tgt: Dipaakanyo tsa Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Dipalangwa tsa mo Lefatsheng wa 2009 di tla tsweletsa thulaganyo ya go fetola le go aga sešwa thulaganyo ya bosetšhaba ya dipalangwa tsa mo lefatsheng.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uyinkhombandlela, emkhatsini waletinye tintfo, tekutfutsa letingasito timoto tinsita tekutfutsa te-ehailing kanye nekutihlanganisa netekutfutsa temmango.
tgt: Seno se tla tshwaela mo tirelong ya dipalangwa tsa botlhe e e babalesegileng, e e fitlhelesegang mme e le bokgoni.

src: Uphindze futsi unike kutsi kube nekuphatfwa lokukhanyako mayelana nemandla lanikiwe kanye nemitsetfo macondzana nekukhishwa kwetimvume tekusebenta kwetitfutsi temmango.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o dira tlamelo ya ditlhabololo tse dintšhwa mo lephateng la dipalangwa tsa botlhe.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawuphindza futsi usite ekucaleni kwekusebenta kwe-Integrated Public Transport Networks kantsi futsi uyincenye yeLuhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwesakhiwonchanti kanye Nemklamo we-7 Wendlelalisu Lehlanganisiwe, lolugcile ekusebentiseni intfutfuko lechumanisiwe yasedolobheni kanye nenethiwekhi lehlanganisiwe kute kwentiwe kutsi emadolobhakati abe tinjini tekukhula.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o tlamela ka kaedi ya, magareng ga tse dingwe, dipalangwa tse di senang dienjene, ditirelo tsa dipalangwa tse di bidiwang ka tiriso ya diselefounu gongwe dikhomphiutara mmogo le go tshwaya dipalangwa tsa botlhe.

src: Lokuvakasha ngekweLuhlelo Lwembuso kutawucinisa budlelwane lobukhona emkhatsini walamave lamabili kuphindze futsi kwente ncono kuhwebelana emkhatsini walesifundza.
tgt: Gape o sedimosa ntlha ya tsamaiso malebana le dithata tse di roletsweng mmogo le melawana malebana le go rebolwa ga dilaesense tsa go dira tsa dipalangwa tsa botlhe.

src: Inyanga Yemalungelo eLuntfu ngeNdlovulenkhulu 2016 itawugujwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “INingizimu Afrika ibumbene ekulweni nebuhlanga.” Litiko Letebuciko Nemasiko lidvwebe luhlelo lwenyanga yonkhe lolufaka ekhatsi luchungechunge lwetinkhulumiswano letimayelana nekusebenta ngekubambisana ekwakheni ummango wentsandvo yelinyenti longabandlululani ngebuhlanga, longabandlululani ngebulili kanye nalolinganako.
tgt: Gape molaotlhomo ono o tla kgontsha go anamisiwa ga Mafaratlhatlha a a Lotaneng a Dipalangwa tsa Botlhe mme ke karolo ya Leano la Bosetšhaba la Mafaratlhatlha le Porojeke ya Togamaano e e Lotaneng ya 7 e e totileng go dirisa tlhabololo e e gokaganeng ya mafaratlhatlha a a lotaneng a dipalangwa go dira gore ditoropokgolo e nne madutelo a kgolo ya ikonomi.

src: I-Russia-Africa Anti-Drug Dialogue letawuba se-ICC eDurban kusukela mhla ti-8 kuya mhla ti-9 Indlovulenkhulu 2016 inika kutsi kube nenkhundla yekwenta ncono Luhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lolukhulu Lwetidzakamiva (2013-2017).
tgt: Moporesitente Zuma o tla tsaya Leeto la Semmuso go ya kwa Rephaboliking ya Bofederale ya Nigeria go tloga ka la bo 8 go fitlha ka la bo 9 Mopitlwe 2016.

src: Kulwa netidzakamiva letingekho emtsetfweni kuhambisana neLuhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwentfutfuko kantsi lenkhulumiswano ingaphasi kweliso laMhlabuhlangene ngekulandzela tibophelelo teTingcungcutsela taMhlabuhlangene Tetidzakamiva kanye Nebugebengu Lobuhlelekile Bemave Ngemave, Luhlelo Lwamhlabuhlangene Lwekwenta lolumacondzana Nekulawula Tidzakamiva (2013-2017) kanye netincumo te-BRICS (iBrazil, iRussia, iIndia, iChina neNingizimu Afrika).
tgt: Leeto la Semmuso le tla tokafatsa dikamano tsa ga jaana tsa sebedi le go tsweletsa gape kgwebisano ya mo kgaolong.

src: Lengcungcutsela inguMhlangano wekulandzelela we-Russia-Africa Anti-Drug Dialogue, lehlose kwetfula livi linye lelibumbene kutsi baholi bemhlaba bahlose kulwa njani nalenkinga yetidzakamiva yemave ngemave.
tgt: Kgwedi ya Ditshwanelo tsa Botho ka Mopitlwe 2016 e tla ketekwa ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "Aforika Borwa e kopane kgatlhanong le tlhaolele ya bosemorafe."

src: Hulumende – ngekuhlanganyela naMabhalane Wemave e-Commonwealth, Inyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-UNISA) kanye ne-Sikhungo Savelonkhe Sekutfutfukiswa Kwelusha – batawube babambe Ingcungcutsela Yesibili Yemave e-Commonwealth lemayelana neMsebenti Welusha letawube ibanjelwe lapha ekhempasini yase-UNISA ePitoli kusukela mhla ti-8 kuya mhla ti-10 Indlovulenkhulu 2016.
tgt: Lefapha la Botsweretshi le Setso le rulagantse leano la kgwedi le le akaretsang metseletsele ya dipuisano tse di ka ga go dira mmogo go aga setšhaba se se sa tlhaoleng go ya ka bosemorafe, bong, se se nang le tekatekano le sa temokerasi.

src: Lengcungcutsela itawube yenteka ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kumbandzakanya Bantfu Labasha eKwakheni Sive: Indzima Yelusha Yekusebenta” futsi itawuhlola kabusha indzima ledlalwa lusha lolusebentako kanye netifundziswa ekumbandzakanyeni bantfu labasha ekutfutfukiseni emave abo.
tgt: Kabinete e laletsa maAforika Borwa go tshwaela mo Leanotirong la Bosetšhaba la go lwantsha Bosemorafe, Tlhaolo go ya ka Bosemorafe, Letlhoo la Batswakwantle mmogo le Go tlhoka itshokelano go go Amanang le tseo (2016-2021) pele ga la bo 30 Seetebosigo 2016.

src: Lokushiwo yiKhabhinethi mayelana netindzaba letimcoka eveni IKhabhinethi iyawuphindza umlayeto waMengameli Zuma wesidzingo sekuhlonipha tikhungo netinchubo letisungulwe ngekulandzela Umtsetfosisekelo waseRiphabhlikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika wa-1996 kanye nemtsetfo.
tgt: Leano le tlamela ka motheo wa pholisi ya botlhe e e kgatlhanong le go tlhaola go ya ka bosemorafe e e tla thusang go diragatsa maitlamo a rona a boditšhabatšhaba a ditshwanelo tsa botho.

src: Mengameli Zuma ulungisa loludzaba lweKhomishana ye-SARS kanye neNdvuna Yetetimali ngekusebentisa tindlela letingito nekulandzela tindlela letisemtsetfweni.
tgt: Puisano ya Russia-Aforika e e Kgatlhanong le Diritibatsi kwa ICC kwa Durban go tloga ka la bo 8 go fitlha ka la bo 9 Mopitlwe 2016 e tlamela ka serala sa go tokafatsa Leanolegolo la Bosetšhaba la Diritibatsi (2013-2017)Ntwa kgatlhanong le diritibatsi tse di seng mo molaong go lepalepana le Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) mme puisano e ka fa tlase ga bookamedi jwa AU go latelelwa maitlamo go ya ka Ditumelano tse di maleba tsa UN tsa Bosenyi jo bo Rulagantsweng go ralala Dinaga, Leano la Tiragatso la AU la Taolo ya Diritibatsi (2013-2017) le ditshwetso tsa BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China le Aforika Borwa).Khonferense ke kopano e e latelang Puisano ya Russia-Aforika e e Kgatlhanong le Diritibatsi, e maikaelelo a yona e leng go tlhagisa seemo se se gokaganeng malebana le gore baeteledipele ba lefatshe ba ikaelela go samagana jang le bothata jwa boditšhabatšhaba jwa diritibatsi.

src: IKhabhinethi icela kutsi bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika babhalisele Lukhetfo Lwahulumende Wendzawo lwa-2016 mhla ti-5 kanye namhla ti-6 Indlovulenkhulu 2016.
tgt: Puso - ka tirisanommogo le Bokwaledi jwa Kgweranoditšhaba, Yunibesithi ya Aforika Borwa (UNISA) mmogo le Setheo sa Bosetšhaba sa Tlhabololo ya Bašwa - e amogela Khonferense ya bo 2 ya Kgweranoditšhaba e e ka ga Tiro ya Bašwa kwa khamphaseng ya Unisa kwa Pretoria go tloga ka la bo 8 go fitlha ka la bo 10 Mopitlwe 2016.

src: Akufani njenganakunelukhetfo lwavelonkhe, lukhetfo lwahulumende wendzawo ludzinga kutsi ubhalise kulelo wadi lohlala kulo.
tgt: Khonferense e tshwarwa ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "Go akaretsa Bašwa mo Kagong ya Setšhaba: Seabe sa Modiri wa Mošwa" mme e tla sekaseka gape seabe sa badiri ba tiro ya bašwa mmogo le barutegi ba ba akaretsang bašwa mo tlhabololong ya dinaga tsa bona.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe labasha nalabavota kwekucala kutsi babhalise kute batewuvota.
tgt: Moporesitente o baakanya dikgato tsa go samagana le dintlha tseno ka maikarabelo le ka tsela e e siameng gore botlhe ba bone molemo.

src: Ngekuvota kwakho kusho kutsi utsatse sinyatselo sekutsi uvakalise livi lakho etincumeni letikutsintsako naletitsintsa ummango wakho.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo maphateng otlhe a a nang le dikgatlhego go diga makgwafo le go itshwara mme ba neele sebaka sa gore morero ono o rarabololwe ka go dirisiwa ga ditsela tse di siameng.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayisola kakhulu imishuco yebafundzi leneludlame ekhatsi, letsikamete kufundza kulamanye emanyuvesi lokuholele ekucekeleni phasi kwemphahla.
tgt: Ditlhopho tsa pusoselegae di farologane le ditlhopho tsa bosetšhaba mme di tlhoka gore o ikwadise mo otong e o nnang mo go yona.

src: Lemishuco incisha bafundzi labafanele litfuba lekuchuba tifundvo tabo kanye nekukhinyabeta lilungelo labo lemfundvo lephakeme.
tgt: Go botlhokwa gore o nne le Lekwaloitshupo (ID) - go tla amogelwa ID e e tala e e nang le bar-code mmogo le karata ya Boitshupo - le go tlhola seemo sa gago sa ikwadiso, nomoro ya oto kwa diteišeneng tse di farologaneng tsa ditlhopho.

src: Hulumende uvule tindlela tekuchumana nabo bonkhe labatsintsekako emfundvweni lephakeme kutsi kucocisanwe futsi kube netinkhulumiswano.
tgt: Dikantoro tsotlhe tsa Merero ya Selegae di tla bo di butswe go tloga ka 08:00 go fitlha ka 17:00 ka la bo 5 le la bo 6 Mopitlwe 2016, mme seo ke go lepalepana le diura tsa tiro tsa Khomišene ya Ditlhopho e e Ikemetseng (IEC) mo matsatsing a mabedi ao.

src: Loku kuholele ekutseni simo sibuyele kulesingiso kanye nekugcugcutela kutsi kube nekubumbana kutenhlalo emanyuvesi etfu ngenhloso yekutfola tisombululo tesikhatsi lesisemkhatsini kuya esikhatsini lesidze taletinsayeya letilumbene nekuntjintjwa kwalomkhakha njengaloku kuchaziwe kutincumo teNgcungcutsela ya-2015 Yekuntjintja Imfundvo Lephakeme.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo batlhophing botlhe ba bašwa mmogo le ba ba tla bong ba tlhopha la ntlha go ikwadisetsa go tlhopha.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayesekela imitamo yema-ejensi ekugcinwa kwemtsetfo kucinisekisa kutsi lisiko letekufundza libuyela esimeni salo, nekutsi imphahla iyavikeleka kanye nemalungelo alowo nalowo ayavikeleka.
tgt: Ka go tlhopha o tsaya kgato ya go dira gore lentswe la gago le utlwale mo ditshwetsong tse di go amang le tse di amang baagi ba gaeno.

src: Kusebenta kwemtsetfo kungetulu kwako konkhe futsi kufanele kutsi kugcinwe ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi.
tgt: Kabinete e nyefola ditshupetso tse di tletseng tirisodikgoka tsa baithuti, tse di kgoreleditseng dithuto kwa diyunibesithi tse dingweng mme di lebisitse kwa tshenyong ya dithoto.

src: Kuthula nekuzotsa kufanele kutsi kubuyiselwe emanyuvesi etfu kute kutsi tinhlelo tekufundza tichubeke ngesikhatsi kusalungiswa letinsayeya tesikhatsi lesisemkhatsini netesikhatsi lesidze.
tgt: Ditshupetso tseno di lomeletsa baithuti ba ba nang le tshiamelo tšhono ya go tsweletsa dithuto mme gape di ama tshwanelo ya bone ya go iponela thuto e kgolwane.

src: IKhabhinethi ibashayela lihlombe labo bafundzi labakhombise kubumbana bema balwa nebuhlanga kanye nemcondvo longamukeleki wekulwa nalabamhlophe, lokube sibonelo lesihle sekutsi singasebentisana sonkhe ngekuhlanganyela ekwakheni kulenchubekelembili kanye nakuloko lesesikuzuzile kulomkhakha wetemfundvo lephakeme ngekulungiselela lomnyaka wekufundza lesikuwo.
tgt: Puso e buletse dipuisano le baamegi botlhe ba thuto e kgolwane go buisana le go ganetsana.

src: Kufanele kutsi siyivikele leyo nchubekelembili siphindze futsi sivumele kutsi kubuye kuthula nemtsetfo kuwo onkhe emanyuvesi etfu.
tgt: Seno se buseditse maemo sekeng le tsweletso ya kgolagano ya loago kwa diyunibesithing tse di batlang go bona ditharabololo tsa dikgwetlho tsa pakagare le pakatelele tse di amanang le go fetolwa ga lephata jaaka go tlhalositswe mo ditshwetsong tsa Samiti ya 2015 ya Diphetogo mo Thutong e Kgolwane.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindza futsi icela bonkhe labatsintsekako kutsi basebente ngekubambisana kute kutsi emanyuvesi etfu abe baholi bekumbandzakanya wonkhe wonkhe kanye neluntjintjo.
tgt: Kabinete e tshegetsa maiteko a ditheo tsa tiragatso ya molao go netefatsa gore go busediwa setso sa go ithuta, le gore go sirelediwa dithoto le ditshwanelo tsa batho.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa kukhatsateka kwayo ngekulahleka kwemisebenti lokutawubakhona kulesiphakamiso kanye nekuncipha kwemisebenti ngalokukuhlanganiswa.
tgt: Go tshwanetse ga busediwa maemo sekeng kwa diyunibesithing tsa rona gore manaane a thuto a tswelele pele fa go ntse go samaganwe le dikgwetlho tsa pakagare le pakatelele.

src: Ngekubuka lizinga lelisetulu lekuswelakala kwemisebenti, Ikhabhinethi icela kutsi leto tinkampani tente siciniseko sekutsi imisebenti ayilahleki kanye nekutsi nemazinga lasekhatsi emisebenti agcinwa anjalo.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse baithuti ba ba emeng mmogo kgatlhanong le bosemorafe le letlhoo la basweu, e leng sekai sa gore re ka dira mmogo go agelela mo tswelelopeleng le diphitlhelelong tse di dirilweng mo lephateng la thuto e kgolwane go baakanyetsa ngwaga ono wa dithuto.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Umnu Xavier Carim Lolincusa laseNingizimu Afrika eNhlanganweni Yemhlaba Yekuhwebelana (i-WTO), lokhetfwe kutsi abe ngusihlalo Wemtimba Losombulula Tinchabano weMkandlu Jikelele Wenhlangano Yemhlaba Yetekuhwebelana.
tgt: Gape kabinete e ikuela mo baameging botlhe go dira mmogo gore diyunibesithi tsa rona e nne baeteledipele ba puisano e e akaretsang le diphetogo.

src: LoMkandlu Jikelele ungumtimba lophakeme lotsatsa tincumo we-WTO emkhatsini Wengcungcutsela Yetindvuna.
tgt: Kabinete e nopotse kgolagano e e tshitshintsweng ya ditheo tse tharo tsa mabotlolo tsa Setlamo sa Coca Cola mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Kukhetfwa kweLincusa Carim kuyincenye yekuvuma kubaluleka kwendzima ledlalwa yiNingizimu Afrika ku-WTO kuphindze futsi kube yincenye yebufakazi ngebunjalo lobuhle beLincusa Carim.
tgt: Kabinete e lemoga gore morero o tla reediwa kwa Lekgotleng la Dikgaisano.

src: IKhabhinethi isivile simemetelo se-Barclays PLC sekunciphisa emasheya ayo lange-62.3% eBarclays Africa Group Limited (i-BAGL) kuleminyaka lemibili letako kuya kulemitsatfu.
tgt: Kabinete e tlhagisa matshwenyego a yona ka tatlhegelo ya ditiro e e tshitshintsweng mmogo le phokotso ya ditiro mo dikgatong tsa kgolagano eno.

src: I-Barclays PLC, ikakhulu i-CEO, ichumane nelihhovisi leSikhwama Savelonkhe kanye neLibhangesilulu LeNingizimu Afrika ekukhulumisaneni lokuvulekile, futsi siyakwemukela kutinikela kwalenkampani kutsi icale kusebentisa indlelalisu lensha yayo ngendlela letawunciphisa lifutse kutemnotfo lapho i-BAGL isebenta khona.
tgt: Ka ntlha ya botlhokatiro jo bo kwa godimo, Kabinete e ikuela mo ditlamong go netefatsa gore ga go nne le ditiro tse di latlhegang mme go tsholwa seemo sa ditiro.

src: IKhabhinethi yetfulela sigcoko bonkhe labo labakhetsiwe nalabo labazuze imiklomelo emcimbini Wemklomelo Wavelonkhe Wabothishela lebewukadze umhla tinge-27 Indlovana 2016.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola Moambasadara wa Aforika Borwa wa Mokgatlho wa Lefatshe wa Kgwebisano (WTO), Rre Xavier Carim, yo o tlhophilweng modulasetilo wa Setheo sa Tharabololo ya Dikgotlhang sa Lekgotlakakaretso la WTLekgotlakakaretso ke setheo se se tsayang ditshwetso tse di kwa godimo sa WTO magareng ga Dikhonferense tsa Ditona.

src: Laba bothishela labatinikele labachubela embili live lakitsi ngekucinisekisa kutsi emaklasi abo akhicita bafundzi labanenshisekelo labatawuba neligalelo ekutfutfukiseni iNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Go thapiwa ga Moambasadara Carim go lemosa seabe sa botlhokwa sa Aforika Borwa mo WTO mme gape ke sesupo sa maitshwaro a ga Moambasadara Carim.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela i-Market Theatre eJozi ngekugubha iminyaka lenge-40 yaba khona.
tgt: Kabinete e lemogile kitsiso ya Barclays PLC ya maikaelelo a yona go fokotsa 62.3% ya botsholadišere jwa yona mo Barclays Africa Group Limited (BAGL) mo dingwageng tse di latelang di le pedi go ya go di le tharo.

src: Ngesikhatsi seminyaka yelubandlululo lenkhundla yetekukhombisa imidlalo yasesiteji yagucuka yaba luphawu Lwemzabalazo ngekutsi iteke indzaba lengiyo yaseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Barclays PLC, bogolosegolo Motlhankedikhuduthamagamogolo, o buisane le Matlotlo a Bosetšhaba le Bankakgolo ya Aforika Borwa mme re amogela maitlamo a setlamo a go diragatsa togamaano e ntšhwa ka tsela e e tla fokotsang ditlamorago mo ikonoming e BAGL e dirang mo go yona.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela thishela wetemculo, Umnu Chad Hendricks, waseRetreat eCape Flats ngekuwina umklomelo Wemcudzelwano i-Len van Zyl Conductors eKapa.
tgt: Bankakgolo ya Aforika Borwa e tla dira le Barclays PLC le BAGL go netefatsa gore go fokodiwa matshosetsi otlhe a a ka nnang teng mo tiragatsong eo le gore go tsewa dikgato tse di maleba go samagana le motsamao wa ditšhelete o o tla bakwang ke tiragatso eo.

src: Umklomelo wakhe ufaka ekhatsi umfundzate wetinyanga letintsatfu aseMelika lokutawutsi ngaleso sikhatsi Umnu Hendricks utawube afundza ePhiladelphia Orchestra futsi utawube aceceshwa nguSolwati lowatiwako Victor Yampolsky eChicago.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola botlhe ba ba fitlheletseng makgaolakgang mmogo le bafenyi ba Dikgele tsa Bosetšhaba tsa Barutabana tse di neng di tshwerwe ka la bo 27 Tlhakole 2016.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela umkhiciti wemafilimu, UmnuAnant Singh, ngekulala kwakhe kwesitsatfu waklonyeliswa ngelifilimu lelitsi, Shepherds and Butchers ku-Panorama Audience Award for Fiction Film eBerlin International Film Festival.
tgt: Barutabana bano ba ba ititeileng sehuba ba tsweletsa naga ya rona pele ka go netefatsa gore diphaposiborutelo di tlhagisa barutwana ba ba rotloetsegileng ba ba tla tshwaelang mo tlhabololong ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Lena yimphumelelo lenkhulu ngobe lelifilimu belicudzelane nemafilimu lange-55 lavela emaveni lange-33.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola Market Theatre kwa Johannesburg ka go keteka ngwaga wa bo 40 e ntse e le teng.

src: Kubekwa etikhundleni Konkhe kucashwa kuya ngekucinisekiswa kweticu tabo kanye nekuvunyelwa lokufanele.
tgt: Ka paka ya tlhaolele teatere e nnile sekao sa Kgaratlho ka go anela dikgang tsa boammaaruri tsa Aforika Borwa.

src: Kunwetjwa kwenkontileka yaMnu Lionel October njengeMcondzisi Jikelele (i-DG) eTikweni Letekuhwebelana Netimboni, sikhatsi seminyaka lesihlanu.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola morutabana wa mmino, Rre Chad Hendricks, go tswa kwa Retreat kwa Cape Flats ka ntlha ya go fenya Kgaisano ya maemo ya Batshwaratakata ya Len van Zyl kwa Motsekapa.

src: Mantlhake J Maboya njengeLisekela Lemcondzisi Jikelele (i-DDG): Inchubomgomo Yekharikhulamu neKwelusa eLitikweni Letemfundvo Lesisekelo.
tgt: Dimpho tsa gagwe di akaretsa sekolašipi sa dikgwedi di le tharo kwa Amerika koo Rre Hendricks a tla ithutang kwa Philadelphia Orchestra mme a katisiwa ke Moporofesara Victor Yampolsky kwa Chicago.

src: Kucashwa kwaMake Shamilla Chettiar njengeLisekela Lemcondzisi Jikelele: Inchubomgomo neTinsita Telwati eTikweni Letekuvakasha.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola motlhagisi wa difilimi, Rre Anant Singh, ka ntlha ya go abelwa maemo a boraro ka filimi ya Shepherds and Butchers kwa Panorama Audience Award for Fiction Film kwa Moletlong wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Difilimi wa Berlin.

src: Kucashwa kweMnu Mbulelo Tshangana njengeMcondzisi Jikelele eLitikweni Letekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu.
tgt: Seno ke phitlhelelo e kgolo ka ntlha ya fa filimi e ne e gaisana le difilimi di le 51 go tswa kwa dinageng di le Go thapiwaGo thapiwa gotlhe go tla diragadiwa fa makwalothuto otlhe a netefaditswe mme go amogetswe tetlelelo e e matshwanedi:.

src: Kucashwa futsi kweMnu Kutoane Obed Kutoane njengeSikhulu Lesilawulako e-Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Limited.
tgt: Katoloso ya konteraka ya ga Rre Lionel October jaaka Mokaedikakaretso (DG) mo Lefapheng la Kgwebisano le Indaseteri, sebaka sa dingwaga di le tlhano.

src: Kucashwa kweMnu Vuyo Mafata njengeKhomishina Yekuncephetelisa: Sikhwama Sekuncephetelisa eLitikweni Letemisebenti.
tgt: Go thapiwa ga Ngaka Mantlhake J Maboya jaaka Motlatsamokaedikakaretso (DDG): Pholisi ya Kharikhulamo le Tekolo mo Lefapheng la Thuto ya Motheo.

src: Kucashwa ku-Takeover Regulation Panel sikhatsi seminyaka lesihlanu:a) Make Neo Phakama Dongwana (Sihlalo)b) Solwati Stephanie Marie Luiz (Lisekela Lasihlalo)c) Solwati Shirley Zinn (lilunga lephaneli)d) Adv Rory Voller (lilunga lelikhetsekile)e) Make Wendy Ndlovu (lilunga lelikhetsekile)f) Make Annalie de Bruyn (lilunga lelikhetsekile) kanyeg) NeMnu Nano Abram Matlala (lilunga lephaneli).
tgt: Go thapiwa ga Mme Shamilla Chettiar jaaka DDG: Ditirelo tsa Pholisi le Kitso kwa Lefapheng la Bojanala.

src: Kucashwa kuBhodi yaseNingizmu Afrika Yemandla eNozi sikhatsi seminyaka lemitsatfu:a) Umnu Nqaba Ngcobob) Dkt.
tgt: Go thapiwa ga Rre Mbulelo Tshangana jaaka DG mo Lefapheng la Manno a Batho.

src: Tincumo teKhebhinethi letimcoka.
tgt: Ditshwetso tse di botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyihlolile Imibiko Yemiphumela Yekota Yesitsatfu yesikhatsi senyanga yeMphala neNgongoni 2015.
tgt: Kabinete e sekasekile Dipegelo tsa Dipoelo tsa Dikgatelopele tsa Kotara ya Boraro tsa paka ya Diphalane go fitlha Sedimonthole 2015.

src: Lemibiko ikhomba inchubekelembili lemcoka ekucaliseni kwekusebenta kwetinhlelo tahulumende letinelifutse lelicondze ngco ekwenteni ncono timphilo tebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Dipegelo di bontsha kgatelopele e e utlwalang malebana le go tsenngwa tirisong ga manaane a puso a a amang ka tlhamalalo tokafatso ya matshelo a maAforika Borwa.

src: Lemibiko Yemiphumela Yenchubekelembili ikhomba bufakazi bekutsi hulumende uphumelele ekufezeni tinjongo taloko bekuhlosiwe kuThemu Lesemkhatsini Yendlelalisu Yeluhlelomsebenti lwa 2014-2019.
tgt: Dipegelo tsa Dipoelo tsa Dikgatelopele di naya bosupi jwa gore puso e dirile kgatelopele go fitlhelela diphitlhelelo tse di neng di tlhagisitswe mo Letlhomesong la Togamaano ya Pakagare la 2014-2019.

src: Lemibiko iphindze futsi isisondzete edvute kutsi sifezekise Umbononchanti 2030, njengaloku kusho Lisu Lavelonkhe Lentfutfuko (i-NDP), lokuhloswe ngalo kulwa nebuphuya, kuswelakala kwemsebenti kanye nekungalingani.
tgt: Gape di re atametsa le go fitlhelela Ponelopele ya 2030 jaaka e tlhagisitswe mo Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP), le maitlhomo a lona e leng go samagana le lehuma, botlhokatiro le go tlhoka tekatekano.

src: IKhabhinethi iyibonile inchubekelembili lebonakalako leyentiwe ekufezeni tinhloso letimcoka kanye nemiphumela.
tgt: Kabinete e lemogile tswelelopele e e amogelesegang e e dirilweng go fitlhelela diphitlhelelo le ditlhagiso tsa botlhokwa.

src: IKhabhinethi nanome iyibonile imphumelelo lemcoka macondzana netinkhomba letinyenti, kusenetindzawo lapho kusadzingeka khona tingenelelo letichumanisiwe tahulumende.
tgt: Kabinete e lemogile gore le fa go nnile le tswelelopele e e bonalang malebana le bontsi jwa disupi, go sa ntse go na le dikarolo tse di tlhokang tsereganyo e e gokaganeng ya puso.

src: Kucala kwekusebenta kwetinhlelo letimcoka tahulumende.
tgt: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga manaane a botlhokwa a puso.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa kubonga kwayo kubo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labalalele sicelo seKhomishini Letimele Yelukhetfo(i-IEC) kutsi bantfu babhalise, bahlole simo sabo sekubhalisa kanye nekwenta kutsi imininingwane yabo leseluhlwini lwebavoti ibe sesikhatsini ngalemphelasontfo yamhla ti-5 namhla ti-6 Indlovulenkhulu 2016.
tgt: Kabinete e tlhagisitse Ditebogo tsa yona go maAforika Borwa a a tsibogetseng boikuelo jwa Khomišene ya Ditlhopho e e Ikemetseng (IEC) jwa gore batho ba ikwadise, ba tlhole seemo sa bone sa ikwadiso mmogo le go ntšhwafatsa dintlha tsa bona mo lenaneng la batlhopi ka mafelo a beke a la bo 5 le la bo 6 Mopitlwe 2016.

src: Kube nebantfu labalinganiselwa etigidzini letintsatfu labavakashele titeshi tekuvota eveni lonkhe kanye nebavoti labasha lababhalisile labange-544 552 (78.6%) bebangaphasi kweminyaka lenge-30, lokuyindlela yekukhombisa kutimisela kwebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ekutimbandzakanyeni kutsi bakhe intsandvo yetfu yelinyenti.
tgt: Batho ba ka nna dimilione di le tharo ba etetse diteišene tsa ditlhopho naga ka bophara mme baikwadisi ba bantšhwa ba le 544 552 (78%) ba ne ba le dingwaga tse di ka fa tlase ga 30, e leng sesupo sa keletso ya maAforika Borwa go nna le seabe mo go ageng temokerasi ya rona.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basebentise lilungelo labo lentsandvo yelinyenti ngekutsi bahambe bayewubhalisela kuvota iphindze futsi igcugcutele nalabo lababhalise phambilini kutsi bahambe bayewucinisekisa imininingwane yabo yekuvota ngobe kunemaphuzu lamanengi labange kutsi kube netingucuko kuluhlu lwebavoti.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng go diragatsa tshwanelo ya bona ya molaotheo ka go ikwadisa mme e rotloetsa ba ba ikwadisitseng mo nakong e e fetileng go tlhomamisa dintlha tsa bona tsa ikwadiso ya ditlhopho ka ntlha ya fa go na le mabaka a le mmalwa a a bakileng diphetogo mo lenaneng la batlhopi.

src: Imphelasontfo yekubhalisela kuvota itawuba mhla ti-9 kanye namhla ti-10 Mabasa 2016 lapho tonkhe tikhungo tekuvota titawube tivuliwe futsi kusukela ngensimbi ye-8:00 kuya ngensimbi ye-17:00.
tgt: Beke ya bofelo ya ikwadiso e tla nna ka la bo 9 le la bo 10 Moranang 2016 fa diteišene tsa ditlhopho di tla bo di butswe gape go tloga ka ura ya bo 8:00 mo mosong go fitlha ka ura ya bo 17:00 mo maetsiboeng.

src: Leli kutawube kulitfuba lekugcina lekutsi bavoti babhalise kanye nekwenta kutsi imininingwane yabo yekubhalisela kuvota ibe sesikhatsini, bakwente etikhungweni tabo tekuvota.
tgt: Seno e tla bo e le tšhono ya bofelo ya gore batlhophi ba ikwadise le go ntšhwafatsa dintlha tsa bona tsa ikwadiso kwa diteišene tsa ditlhopho.

src: Nome kunjalo, kubhalisa kuyachubeka emahhovisi e-IEC endzawo ngesikhatsi sema-awa ekusebenta kusukela ngeMsombuluko kute kube ngaLesihlanu, kudzimate kufike sikhatsi lapho luhlu lwebavoti Lwelukhetfo Lwabomasipala lwa-2016 luvalwa khona ngelusuku lapho lukhetfo lumenyetelwa khona.
tgt: Le fa go le jalo, go ikwadisa go tswelela pele kwa dikantorong tsa selegae tsa IEC ka dinako tsa tiro go tloga Mosupologo go fitlha ka Labotlhano, go fitlha lenane la batlhophi la Ditlhopho tsa Makgotlatoropo tsa 2016 le tswalelwa ka letsatsi le go tla bong go itsesiwe letlha la ditlhopho ka lona.

src: IKhabhinethi iyaluhlaba ludlame lolube khona kuletinye tindzawo lapho luvimbele khona imphelasontfo yekubhalisa lokusandza kwendlula iyaphindza futsi itsi kute umuntfu longavimbela nome ngabe ngumuphi umuntfu waseNingizimu Afrika kutsi asebentise lilungelo lakhe lentsandvo yelinyenti kutsi abhalisele kuvota.
tgt: Kabinete e kgalema ka bogale tirisodikgoka e e neng e aparetse mafelo a beke ya ikwadiso fa gautshwane kwa mafelong mangwe mme e boeletsa gore ga gona motho ope yo o tshwanetseng go thibela moAforika Borwa ope go diragatsa tshwanelo ya gagwe ya tmolaotheo ya go ikwadisetsa go tlhopha.

src: IKhabhinethi iyachubeka icela bonkhe labo labenta loko kutsi bahlukane nalemisebenti yebugebengu nekutsi labo labatsintsekile bakubike kuma-ejensi ekugcinwa kwemtsetfo loko.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela gape mo go botlhe ba ba rweleng maikarabelo go tila dikgato tseo tsa bosenyi le gore ba ba amegang ba bege ditiragalo tseo kwa ditheong tsa tiragatso ya molao.

src: IKhabhinethi icela onkhe ema-ejensi ekugcinwa kwemtsetfo kutsi atsatsele labo labephula umtsetfo sinyatselo lesimatima.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo ditheong tsotlhe tsa tiragatso ya molao go tsaya dikgato tse di bogale kgatlhanong le batlolamolao.

src: Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawuvakashela eBhayi mhla ti-8 Mabasa 2016 kuyowuhlola inchubekelembili mayelana nekutfutfukiswa kwesakhiwonchanti setekutfutsa ngemanti lokuyintfo leyiyincenye yesichamukelo salelive seMnotfo Waselwandle.
tgt: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tla etela Port Elizabeth ka la bo 8 Moranang 2016 go tlhatlhoba kgatelopele e e dirilweng tebang le go tlhabolola mafaratlhatlha a dipalangwa tsa mo lewatleng jaaka karolo ya maiteko a naga a Ikonomi ya Lewatle.

src: Umnotfo Waselwandle ungulomunye walenye yetingoni te-Operation Phakisa futsi isondzeta lelive ekuvuleni emandla lagcineke etilwandle taseNingizimu Afrika, Loku kungafaka ligalelo lelingafinyelela etigidzigidzini leti-R177 kusamba semkhicito welive kuphindze kudale imisebenti lemisha lengetulu kwesigidzi sinye.
tgt: Ikonomi ya Lewatle ke nngwe ya maphata a le mararo a Operation Phakisa mme e atametsa naga gaufi le go bula bokgoni jwa mawatle a Aforika Borwa, a a nang le bokgoni jwa go nna le seabe sa bokana ka R177 bilione mo ikonoming ya naga le go tlhama ditiro tse dintšhwa di feta milione.
