src: Kutjala imali kusakhiwonchanti, kufaka ekhatsi tindzawo tekufundzisa nelucwaningo, tisetjentiswa kanye netindzawo tekuhlala bafundzi letikahle kubaluleke kakhulu ekwenteni siciniseko sekutsi emanyuvesi enta kahle umsebenti wayo wekufundzisa.
tgt: Peeletso mo mafaratlhatlheng, go akaretsa mafelo a go ruta le ditlhotlhomiso, didirisiwa, le mafelo a a siametseng bonno jwa baithuti e botlhokwa mo go netefatseng gore diyunibesithi di diragatsa morero wa tsona wa matlafatso.

src: Indvuna yeLitiko Letetisebenti, Mildred Oliphant, utawuhola umkhankhaso wavelonkhe wekufundzisa nekucaphelisa ngeNyanga Yetisebenti yanga-2017 ngaphasi kwalengcikitsi: “Wati emalungelo netibopho takho njengendlela yekukhutsata kutfobela umtsetfo”.Lomkhankhaso utawufudzisa tisebenti eNingizimu Afrika ngemalungelo ato kanye netibopho letihambisana nawo.
tgt: Tona ya Ditiro, Mildred Oliphant, o tla etelela pele letsholotsiboso la Kgwedi ya Badiri la 2017 ka fa tlase ga setlhogo “Itse ditshwanelo le maikarabelo a gago e le tsela ya go rotloetsa go ikobela melao botoka”.Letsholo le le tla tsibosa badiri mo Aforika Borwa ka ga ditshwanelo le maikarabelo a bona.

src: Utawuphindze futsi uphakamise loko lokuzuzwe tisebenti eNingizimu Afrika nekuhlola lizinga lekutfobela imitsetfo yetisebenti.
tgt: Le tla tlhagisa gape le diphitlhelelo tsa badiri mo Aforika le go lekola go ikobela melao ya badiri.

src: Lenyanga itawufaka ekhatsi kuhlola ngekutuma imikhakha leyatiwa ngekutsi ihlala njalo itigilamikhuba.
tgt: Kgwedi e e tla akaretsa diketelo tsa tlhatlhobo tse di sa begwang mo makaleng a a tsewang a tlwaetse go tlola melao.

src: Hulumende uphasise umtsetfo lobukene nekungalingani lokubi kabi kanye nekubandlululwa ngalokungafanele lesakutfola njengelifa.
tgt: Puso e fetisitse molao o o samaganang le go tlhoka tekatekano le kgethololo e e gobelelang e re e fitlhetseng e le teng.

src: Inhloso yemitsetfo yetfu yetisebenti kutfutfukisa kukhula kwemnotfo, bulungiswa betenhlalo, kuthula kutetisebenti kanye nekwenta tindzawo temisebenti kutsi tibe tentsandvo yelinyenti.
tgt: Mooko wa melao ya rona ya badiri ke go tsweletsa tlhabololo ya ikonomi, bosiamisi jwa loago, kagiso ya badiri le temokerasi mo mafelong a ditiro.

src: Ikhabhinethi imema yonkhe imikhakha kutsi idlale tindzima tayo ekulungiseni kungalingani kwesikhatsi lesendlulile ngekutsi ilungise sivinini setingucuko lesihamba kancane etindzaweni temisebenti.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go makala otlhe go diragatsa karolo ya ona mo go samaganeng le go tlhoka tekatekano ga maloba ka go rarabolola ntlha ya seelo se se bonya mo go tlhabololeng mafelo a ditiro.

src: Hulumende ungenele Liviki Lavelonkhe leSitfupha Lekugcila Kutimbizo lalohulumende lowatsatsa lulawulo nga-2014 kusukela mhla ti-17 kuya kumhla tinge-23 Mabasa 2017.Leliviki linemihlangano yekukhulumisana leminyenti emkhatsini wemalunga esigungu lesiphetse netakhamuti futsi ineligalelo kuluhlelo lwahulumende lolubanti lwekwenta timphilo tato tonkhe takhamuti taseNingizimi Afrika kutsi tibe ncono.
tgt: Puso e nnile le Beke ya Bosetšhaba ya Imbizo ya bo 6 ya puso ya ga jaana go tloga ka la bo 17 go fitlha ka la bo 23 Moranang 2017.

src: Ikhabhinethi ibonga yonkhe imimango lehlanganyele kule-Izimbizo netikhulu tahulumende kulo lonkhe lelive, ngenhloso yekulungisa tinsayeya tisebenti tahulumende letibukene nato kanye nekutiketa wonkhe umuntfu imphilo lencono.
tgt: Beke e e nnile le paka ya ditherisano magareng ga ditokololo tsa khuduthamaga le baagi mme e nna le seabe mo leanong le le anameng la puso go tokafatsa matshelo a baagi botlhe.

src: Letinye Izimbizo tifake ekhatsi: kwetfulwa kweSikhungo seTemabhizinisi ekolishi le-TVET eGoldfields eWelkom, eFreyistata yiNdvuna yeTekutfutfukiswa Kwemabhizinisi Lamancane, Make Lindiwe Zulu.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola baagi ba ba nnileng le seabe mo go di-Imbizo le batlhankedi ba puso go ralala naga, ka maitlhomo a go rarabolola dikgwetlho tsa thebolo ya ditirelo le go tlamela ka botshelo jo bo botoka go botlhe.

src: Lesikhungo sifaka ligalelo ekubukaneni netinsayeya yekungatfoli imisebenti kwelusha ngekutsi sisite bantfu labasha esigabeni sekucala seluhambo lwetebhizinisi.
tgt: Di-Imbizo tse dingwe di ne di akaretsa: go thankgololwa ga Tikwatikwe ya Kgwebo kwa Kholejeng ya Thuto le Katiso ya Tiro ya Setegeniki (TVET) ya Goldfields kwa Welkom, Foreisetata ke Tona ya Tlhabololo ya Dikgwebopotlana Mme Lindiwe Zulu.

src: Kubanjwe mihlangano yekukhulumisana lenge-34 kulo lonkhe lelive.
tgt: Go nnile le dikopano di le 34 go ralala naga.

src: Mengameli Jacob Zuma uhole imigubho yemikhosi yavelonkhe yeLilanga Lenkhululeko ye-27 Mabasa 2017 ngaphasi kwalengikitsi “Umnyaka wa-OR Tambo: Sisonkhe sijulisa inkhululeko nekwakha imimango lephephile nalete bugebengu.”Umhlangano waMengameli eManguzi, Umhlabuyalingana uyincenye yemkhankhaso wavelonkhe wekulwa nebugebengu, lokuphindze futsi ulandzelele Luhlelo laMengameli, i-Presidential Siyahlola Monitoring Programme ngeNdlovulenkhulu 2017.Ugcamisa sidzingo sekutsatsa tinyatselo ngalokuphutfumako kubukwane nebugebengu lobenteka eminyeleni ikakhulu kuhlwetfwa kwetimoto.
tgt: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o eteletse pele mekete ya bo 23 ya Letsatsi la Kgololesego la bosetšhaba ka la bo 27 Moranang ka fa tlase ga setlhogo “Ngwaga wa ga OR Tambo: Mmogo re tiisa temokerasi le go aga mafelo a a babalesegileng e bile a se na bosenyi”.Go nna le seabe ga ga Moporesitente kwa Manguzi, Umhlabuyalingana ke karolo ya letsholo la bosetšhaba la ntwa kgatlhanong le bosenyi, le gape le latelang Lenaneo la Tekolo la Siyahlola la ga Moporesitente ka Mopitlwe 2017.

src: Hulumende umatasatasa kulendzawo ucedza bugebengu kanye nekulungisa tindzaba temmango wase-Umhlabuyalingana, kufaka ekhatsi tinsayeya letimayelana ne-Isimangaliso Wetland Park.
tgt: Le tlhagisa tlhokego ya kgato e e bonako go samagana le bosenyi jwa kgabaganyo ya melelwane segolo bogodu jwa dijanaga.

src: Lemigubho yemikhosi ibuka loko lesekuzuzwe ngulelive kusukela nga-1994 ibe futsi ikhumbula umsebenti losadzinga kutsi wentiwe ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika lebumbene mbamba, lengabandlululani ngekwebuhlanga, lengabandlululani ngekwebulili, lenentsandvo yelinyenti futsi lephumelelako.
tgt: Puso e semeletse mo ntlheng ya go fedisa bosenyi le go rarabolola dikgwetlho tsa baagi ba Umhlabuyalingana, go akaretsa dikgwetlho go dikologa Phaka ya Isimangaliso Wetland.

src: Kulenyanga yeNkhululeko sigubha umkhosi weligalelo lelafakwa enkhululekweni nakuntsandvo yelinyenti yetfu, nguMengameli we-ANC waphambilini kanye nelichawe lavelonkhe, Oliver Reginald Tambo, longabe utsatsa iminyaka le-100 kube bekasaphila.
tgt: Mekete e di supa diphitlhelelo tsa naga fa e sale ka 1994 go sa lebalwe tiro e e santseng e tshwanetse go dirwa go aga Aforika Borwa yo o tshwaraganeng, a sa kgetholole go ya ka mmala, bong, mme e le wa temokerasi le katlego.

src: Njengencenye yeLuhlelo lweNyanga yeNkhululeko Indvuna yeTekuchumana, Ayanda Dlodlo, usungule ingcoco yelusha njengencenye yekucocisana lokuchubekako nelusha mayelana nekutsi kusho kutsini kubo kuthi “IBA MNIKATI WENKHULULEKO YAKHO”, umbhalo losotjentiswa kulandzela tingcoco kutetindzaba te-inthanethi.
tgt: Mo kgweding ya Kgololesego re keteka seabe sa kgololesego le temokerasi ya rona, sa Moporesitente wa maloba wa ANC le mogaka wa bosetšhaba, Oliver Reginald Tambo, o a ka bong a le dingwaga di le 100 monongwaga fa a ka bo a ne a santse a tshela.

src: Ikhabhinethi imema lusha kutsi lusebentise emalungelo alo netibopho tawo ngekucophelela kanye nekuhlonipha labo labalwela inkhululeko, kutsi itfokotelwe nguwonkhe wonkhe kulelive letfu lentsandvo yelinyenti.
tgt: Jaaka karolo ya lenaneo la Kgwedi ya Kgololesego, Tona ya Lefapha la Ditlhaeletsano, Ayanda Dlodlo, o tlhomile dipuisano tsa bašwa jaaka karolo ya dipuisano tse di tswelelang ka ga bokao jwa “NNA MONG WA KGOLOLESEGO YA GAO”, e leng setlhogo se se dirisiwang go nna le seabe mo dipuisanong ka tlhaeletsano ya thekenoloji.

src: Ikhabhinethi yemukela umhlangano wekucala weNchubo yeNingizimu Afrika neChina yelizinga leliphakeme Yekusebentisana Kwebantfu (i-PPEM) lebeyikhona mhla tinge-24 kuya kumhla tinge-27 Mabasa.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go bašwa go dirisa ditshwanelo le maikarabelo a bona ka botlhale le go tlotla ba ba lwetseng kgololesego ya rona, gore e itumelelwe ke botlhe mo nageng ya rona ya temokerasi.

src: Loku kube kufezekiswa kwesivumelwane seKuvakasha ngeKwemsebenti weMbuso kwanga-2015 eNinggizimu Afrika lobekusemkhatsini waMengameli Jacob Zuma naMengameli Xi Jinping.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela kopano ya ntlha ya Aforika Borwa-China ya maemo a a kwa godimo ya Mokgwa wa Thefosano ya Batho-ka-Batho (PPEM) e e neng e tshwerwe go tloga ka la bo 24 go fitlha ka la bo 27 Moranang.

src: I-IMC yeNchubo Yekusebentisana Kwebantfu, lebeyiholwa yiNdvuna Nathi Mthethwa yangenisa Lisekela laNdvunankhulu Lui Yandong kanye nelitsimba lePeople’s Republic of China.
tgt: Se e ne e le tiragatso ya tumelano ya Leeto la Semmuso ka 2015 go tla mo Aforika Borwa magareng ga ga Moporesitente Jacob Zuma le Moporesitente Xi Jinping.

src: Kwasayinwe tivumelwane letinyenti telubanjiswano letingena kuletingcikitsi letimbili letibanti – kuTfutfukisa Tisebenti, kanye neLucwaningo neNtfutfuko.
tgt: Komiti ya Ditona tsa Naga (IMC) ka ga Mokgwa wa Thefosano ya Batho-ka-Batho, e e neng e eteletswe pele ke Tona Nathi Mthethwa e ne ya amogela Motlatsa Tonakgolo Lui Yandong le baeng go tswa kwa Rephaboleking ya Batho ya China.

src: Kukhula kwemnotfo lozuzisa wonkhe umuntfu kubonakala ngetingcuko temnotfo netenhlalo letimandla kuhambisana nekwakha emakhono ebantfu betfu, ikakhulu ulusha emazingeni lamanyenti lehlukene.
tgt: Go ne ga saeniwa ditumelano tse di farologaneng tsa tirisano tse di welang mo teng ga merero e mebedi e e anameng – Tlhabololo ya Batho, le Ditlhotlhomiso le Tlhabololo.

src: Ikhabhinethi yemukela umnikelo wesisetjentiswa setekwelashwa (lesakhiwe eNingizimu Afrika) lesinikelwe nguhulumende waseChina, njengencenye yesivumelwano selubanjiswano kutemphilo emkhatsini we-Afrika neChina, loku kutawufaka ligalelo ekwenteni kancono lizinga letinsita letetfulwa etibhedlela tahulumende.
tgt: Kgolo ya ikonomi e e akaretsang e e bonalang ka phetolo e e tseneletseng ya ikonomi e nyalana le go bopa methamo ya batho ba rona, segolo bašwa kwa maemong a a farologaneng.

src: Ngaletivumelwane tekubambisana omabili lamave atinikele ekwakheni lubanjiswano kwetebucwepheshe, kutekucecesha bothishela kanye nekuntjintjiselana ngabocwepheshe emkhakheni wetemfundvo, ikakhulu kuTibalo, Isayensi neTebuwepheshe njengetitini tekwakha umnotfo losebentisa lwatiso.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go neelwa didirisiwa tsa boitekanelo (tse di dirilweng mo Aforika Borwa) go tswa kwa pusong ya China jaaka karolo ya go nna le seabe mo go tokafatseng boleng jwa ditirelo kwa maokelong a puso.

src: Letinye tindzawo telubanjiswano loluncono tifaka ekhatsi: temasiko tekuchumana temphilo tesayensi tetebucwepheshe imidlalo kuvakasha tindzaba tabomake nelusha.
tgt: Ka ditumelano tsa tirisanommogo, ditšhaba ka bobedi di ineetse go tsweletsa tirisano e e tseneletseng ya setegeniki, dithefosano tsa katiso ya barutisi le boitseanape, segolo ka Mmetse, Saense le Thekenoloji jaaka metheo ya kgolo mo kitsong ya diikonomi.

src: Ikhabhinethi yendlulisa emavi endvudvuto emindenini nakubangani bebantfu labange-235 labashone etingotini temigwaco kulamaholidi eLiphasika.
tgt: Makala a mangwe a tirisano e e oketsegileng a akaretsa: setso ditlhaeletsano boitekanelo saense le thekenoloji metshameko bojanala le merero ya basadi le bašwa.

src: Tibalobalo talesikhatsi tikhombisa kutsi bantfu labange-50% labashonile bekubantfu labahamba ngetinyawo, bese kulandzela bantfu labebatfutfwa labange-24% bese kutsi bashayeli baba ngu-19%.
tgt: Kabinete e fetisetsa melaetsa ya matshediso go ba malapa le ditsala tsa batho ba le 235 ba ba latlhegetsweng ke matshelo mo dikotsing tsa tsela mafelong a beke ya Paseka.

src: Ikhabinethi ijoyina Mengameli Jacob Zuma ekuvakaliseni kudzabuka lokukhulunekwetfuka mayelana nekushona kwebantfwana besikolwa laba-18, nebantfu labadzala lababili kunhlekelele yeteksi letfutsa bantfwana besikolwa leyenteke eBronkhorstspruit, ngaphandle nje kwePitoli.
tgt: Dipalopalo tsa paka e di supa gore 50% ya batho ba ba tlhokafetseng ke batsamaya ka dinao, go latele banamedi ka 24% le bakgweetsi ka 19%.

src: Natsi sihamba emagameni esimemetelo lesentiwe nguMengameli Zuma sekutsi ema-ejensi lacinisekisa kulandzelwa kwemitsetfo kutsi aphenye ngekushesha imbangela yalengoti.
tgt: Kabinete mmogo le Moporesitente Jacob Zuma e supa kutlobotlhoko e e tseneletseng le kgamarego ka go tlhokafala ga barutwana ba le 18 le bagolo ba le babedi mo kotsing e e masisi ya thekesi kwa Bronkhorstspruit, ka fa ntle ga Pretoria.

src: Ikhabhinethi ibonga onkhe ematiko, tinhlangano letingekho ngephasi kwahulumende (ema-NGO), tingcweti kanye nemabhizinisi lasita lemindeni letsintsekile kanye nebantfu nabothishela beSikolwa iMahlenga High kanye neSikolwa iRefano Primary ngalesikhatsi lesimatima.
tgt: Re tlatsa mafoko a Moporesitente Zuma a gore ditheo tsa tiragatso ya molao di dire ka bonako go batlisisa gore kotsi e e bakilwe ke eng.

src: Kushona kwebantfu labanyenti emigwacweni, ikakhulu ngesikhatsi semaholidi eNingizimu Afrika, kuyachubeka nekuba yintfo yavelonkhe lekhatsatanako.
tgt: Kabinete e leboga mafapha otlhe a puso, di-NGO, baporofešenale le bagwebi bao ba tshegetsang malapa gammogo le baithuti le badiri ba kwa Sekolong se Segolo sa Mahlenga le Sekolopotlana sa Refano mo nakong e ya kutlobotlhoko.

src: Esikhatsini lesinyenti letingoti letibangela kushona kwebantfu titingoti lebetingavikelwa ngekutiphatsa ngendlela lefanele kanye nekusetjentiswa kahle kwemigwaco yalelive.
tgt: Dikotsi tsa ditsela, segolo ka dinako tsa maikhutso mo Aforika Borwa e tswelela go nna tlhobaboroko mo nageng.

src: Kushayela budlabha akwemukeleki futsi bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bacelwa kutsi bacaphele emigwacweni.
tgt: Mo mabakeng a mantsi, dintsho tse di ka bo di ne di thibetswe ka maitsholo le tiriso e e maikarabelo ya ditsela tsa rona.

src: Ikhabhinethi incoma umkhakha wetitfutsi letingemabhasi ngekubuyela emsebentini ngemuva kwesiteleka lesite budlova, lokukhombisa indlela lefanele yekubhikisha kwetisebenti.
tgt: Go kganna botlhaswa le maitsholo a a maswe mo tseleng ga di amogelege mo tseleng mme maAforika Borwa otlhe a elediwa go rwala maikarabelo ka bobona gore ba babalesege mo ditseleng.

src: Indzima ledlalwe yiNdvuna yeTetisebenti ifanele kutsi ibongwe ngekwenta kutsi siphele lesiteleka salomkhakha wetemnotfo wetfu lobalulekile.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola lekala la dipalangwa tsa dibese ka go boela ditirong morago ga go ngala ditiro ntle le tirisodikgoka, e leng sekai se se siameng sa boipelaetso.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyakhatsateka mayelana nekuvuka kwebudlova eVuwani ngemuva kwesincumo lesentiwe yiBhodi Yekujuba Iminyele YaBomasipala sekutsi ifakwe kumasipala lomusha.
tgt: Seabe sa Tona ya Lefapha la Badiri se tshwanetse go akgolwa ka go tsereganya gore go ngala ditiro go khutle mo lekaleng le le botlhokwa le la ikonomi ya rona.

src: Ikhabhinethi igxeka ngemandla kusetjentiswa kwebantfwana betfu njengelithulusi lekukhulumisana nekubonisa, emaviki ekuvalwa kwesikolwa afiphalisa likusasa lalabantfwana labafakwa ngaphasi wencindzetelo leyengetiwe.
tgt: Kabinete e tlhobaediwa ke go runya ga go sa le gale ga dikhuduego kwa Vuwani morago ga tshwetso ya Boto ya Melelwane ya Bommasepala gore e tsenngwe mo mmasepaleng o mošwa.

src: Budlova, kwesabisa, kumosha imphahla, noma tinyatselo letiholela ekutsini tikolwa timoshwe noma bafundzi bangakhoni kuya esikolweni kute indzawo kulentsandvo yetfu lelinyenti.
tgt: Kabinete e kgalema ka bogale tiriso ya bana jaaka didirisiwa tsa ditherisano.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyawemukela umsebenti lowentiwe yi-IMC, leholwa yiNdvuna Yetekubusa Ngekubambisana Netendzabuko Des Van Rooyen kanye nekuvakashelwa yiNdvuna yeTemaphoyisa, Fikile Mbalula, iphindze futsi iqinisekise umbono wekutsi imisebenti yebugebengu lefaka ekhatsi kumoshwa nekulinyatwa kwemphahla angeke kubeketelelwe.
tgt: Dibeke tse dikolo di tswetsweng mo go tsona di mpampetsa bokamoso jwa bana ba ba beilweng ka fa tlase ga kgatelelo ya megopolo.

src: Mengameli Jacob Zuma uhlelelwe kuyohlangana neNkhosi yeVhaVenda uToni Mphephu Ramabulana kanye nebaholi bendzabuko besigodzi saseVhembe mayelana nemitamo yekuletsa kuthula kuleya ndzawo.
tgt: Tirisodikgoka, matshosetsi, tshenyo ya dithoto, kgotsa dikgato tse di bakang gore dikolo di senngwe kgotsa go dira gore baithuti ba seka ba ya sekolong, ga di a amogelesega mo temokerasing ya rona.

src: Ikhabhinethi igcizelela kutsi imali kanye nemitfombolusito leyasetjentiswa kute kutsi kube nalokumelela tikolwa letamoshwa beyiyaletinye tuihlelo.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela tiro e e setseng e dirilwe ke IMC, e e eteletsweng pele ke Tona ya Lefapha la Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Setso (COGTA), Rre Des Van Rooyen le leeto ka Tona ya Sepodisi, Fikile Mbalula, e e mametlelelwang ka ntlha ya gore ditiragalo tsa bosenyi go akaretsa le tsa tshenyo ya dithoto ke dilo tse di ka se itshokelweng.

src: Ikhabhinethi iphindze yacela kutsi kube nekuthula nekutinta ngemuva kwemibhikisho lebe nebudlova edolobheni laseLichtenburg neLilokishi iBlydeville, kuMasipala Wendzawo waseDitsobotla, naseNyakatfo Nshonalanga.
tgt: Go rulaganngwa gore Moporesitente Jacob Zuma a kopane le Kgosi ya VhaVenda Kgosi Toni Mphephu Ramabulana le baeteledipele ba setso ba kwa sedikeng sa Vhembe ka maiteko a go tlisa tolamo.

src: Tikolwa taphatamiseka, titolo tebelwa imphahla kwaphindze futsi kwashiswa timoto kanye netindlu letinyenti.
tgt: Kabinete e gatelela gore madi le didirisiwa tse di dirisitsweng go baakanya dikolo tse di sentsweng a ne a beetswe mananeo a mangwe.

src: Ndvunankhulu waseNyakatfo Nshonalanga, Supra Mahumapelo, sewusungule licembu lelibunjwe ngebaphatsiswatiko (abo-MEC) labasihlanu nebosodolobha lababili kutsi liphenye libuye futsi lilungise tinsayeya tekwetfulwa kwetinsita kulendzawo.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuetse gape gore go nne botsitso le tolamo morago ga dikhuduego kwa toropong ya Lichtenburg le Motsesetoropo wa Blydeville, kwa Mmasepaleng wa Selegae wa Ditsobotla, Bokone Bophirima.

src: Ikhabhinethi icela ummango waseColigny, eNyakatfo Nshonalanga uyekele imibhikisho lenebudlova ubuye futsi uvumele Luphiko Lwemaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) eColigny kutsi lucedze luphenyo lwalo lolumayelana nekushona kwemntfwana, kucinisekisa kutsi bulungiswa buyentiwa.
tgt: Dikolo di ne tsa kgorelediwa, mabenkele a tseelwa dithoto mme dijanaga le dintlo di le mmalwa di ne tsa jewa ka molelo.

src: Takhamuti ticelwa kutsi tiyise kukhatsateka kwato kutinhlaka letikhona kanye futsi nangekhatsi kwemtsetfo.
tgt: Tonakgolo ya Bokone Bophirima, Supra Mahumapelo, o tlhomile setlhopha sa Bakhuduthamaga (di-MEC) ba le batlhano le bommeyara ba le babedi go sekaseka le go samagana le dikgwetlho tsa thebolo ya ditirelo mo lefelong leo.

src: Hulumende ubonga ema-ejensi lacinisekisa kulandzelwa kwemtsetfo ngekucinisekisa kutsi tigilamkhuba letibhebhetsela budlova lobentiwa kubomake nebantfwana tiyabanjwa futsi tijeziswe.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go baagi ba Coligny, kwa Bokone Bophirima go emisa ditshupetso tse di tletseng tirisodikgoka le go letla Tirelo ya Sepodisi sa Aforika (SAPS) kwa Coligny go konosetsa dipatlisiso tsa bona tebang le loso lwa ngwana, go netefatsa gore molao o a diragadiwa.

src: Mayelana nako loku, Ikhabhinethi yemukela sinyastelo lesesheshako lesitsetfwe Luphiko lwema-Hawk Lolubukene Nekushushunjiswa Kwebantfu kanye neLicembu Lemasumasu Lekuphendvula le-SAPS lelibophe umfundzisi waseDurban ngelicala lekushushumbisa bantfu eBhayi.
tgt: Puso e akgola ditheo tsa tiragatso ya molao ka go tsiboga le go tshwara badiri ba tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le basadi le WEBTOKEN ntlheng e, Kabinete e amogela dikgato tse di bonako tse di tserweng ke Yuniti ya Kgwebisano ka Batho ya Hawks le Setlhopha sa Tsibogo sa SAPS ka go tshwara moruti wa kwa Durban ka ditatofatso tsa kgwebisano ka batho kwa Port WEBTOKEN tiro le maikarabelo a maAforika Borwa go dirisana le bothati go sireletsa basadi le bana mo dilalomeng le go netefatsa gore re dira karolo ya rona gore mafelo a rona a babalesege.

src: Imibiko.
tgt: Melaetsa.

src: Ikhabhinethi ihalalisela Zolani Tete ngekutfola sicu sesigaba seNhlangano Yetesibhakela Yemhlaba (i-WBO) sekubitwa ngekutsi yi-bantamweight.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola Zolani Tete ka go fenya sekgele sa boimatlhofo.

src: Loku kumbeka esigabeni sesicu sekuhlanganisa emave emhlaba – lokusho kutsi manje sewuyakwati kungenela insayeya yeticu temave emhlaba kutinhlangano tesibhakela temhlaba letinkhulu letine.
tgt: Se se mmaya mo maemong a go gwetlha dijana tsa lefatshe kwa mekgatlong e mene ya mabole e megolo: Lekgotla la Mabole la Lefatshe, Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Mabole, Feterasi ya Boditšhaba ya Mabole le Mokgatlo wa Mabole wa Lefatshe (WBO).

src: INhlangano Yetesibhakela Yemhlaba (i-WBO), Umkhandlu Wesibhakela Wemhlaba (i-WBC), Inhlangano Yesibhakela Yemhlaba (i-WBA) kanye neNhlangano Yesibhakela Yemave Emhlaba (i-IBF).
tgt: Kabinete mmogo le Moporesitente Jacob Zuma e romela matshediso go ba lelapa le ditsala tsa mokatisi le motlhatlheledi yo o manontlhotlho wa mabole, Nick Durandt, yo a neng a itsege ka bokgoni jwa gagwe jwa go tlhagisa bommampodi ba mabole le go ntsha basimanyana mo mebileng mme a ba fetole bommampodi.

src: Ikhabhinethi yahlangana ngaLesitsatfu, mhla ti-10 Inkhwekhweti 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.
tgt: Kabinete e ne e tshwere kopano ya yona ka la bo, 10 Motsheganong 2017, kwa Tuynhuys, Motsekapa.

src: Iforamu Yetemnotfo Yemhlaba Lemayelana ne-Afrika.1 Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kungeniswa ngemphumelo kweForamu Yetemnotfo Yemhlaba ye-27 lapho khona Mengameli Jacob Zuma bekahola Litsimba laseNingizimu Afrika, Tinhloko teMibuso naBohulumende letivela kulivekati lase-Afrika, baholi bemave emhlaba betimboni namabhizinisi kanye nebaholi betinhlangano temmango.
tgt: Foramo ya Ikonomi ya Lefatshe (WEF) e e ka ga Aforika.

src: Lekhomfa beyibanjwe ngaphasi kwalengcikitsi: “Kuzuza kukhula lokuphelele: baholi labaphendvulako nalabanakekelayo”.2 Leseshini ye-27 yeForamu Yetemnotfo Yemhlaba lemayelana ne-Afrika (i-WEFA) icinisekise umhlaba kabusha kutsi iNingizimu Afrika iyachubeka nekuba live lelinemandla lekungatjalwa kulo imali kulelivekati lase-Afrika.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go tshwara kopano go go atlegileng ga WEF e e ka ga Aforika ya bo 27 eo mo go yona Moporesitente Jacob Zuma a neng a eteletse pele Setlhopha sa Barongwa sa Aforika Borwa, Ditlhogo tsa Dinaga le tsa Dipuso go tswa mo kontinenteng ya Aforika, baeteledipele ba lefatshe mo diintasetering le mo dikhomeseng mmogo le baeteledipele ba setšhaba.

src: Bachumanisi bacinisekise kutsi betingetulu kwe-1000 titfunywa lebetingenele lomcimbi, linani lelingakate selibe khona phambilini uma kucatsaniswa ne-WEFA yaphambilini.3 Umoya lonemandla webudlelwano emkhatsini wahulumende kanye nabosomabhizinisi ngesikhatsi se-WEFA bewumuhle ngalokusezingeni leliphakeme kakhulu.
tgt: Khonferense eno e ne e tshwerwe ka moono o o reng: “Go fitlhelela kgolo e e akaretsang botlhe: boeteledipele bo bo tsibogelang e bile bo le maikarabelo”.

src: Lengcoco lenotsile inike iNingizimu Afrika litfuba lekukhombisa inchubelekelembili leyentako mayelana nekuzuza kukhula kwemonotfo lophelele noma-ke lofaka konkhe ekhatsi kanye nekukhombisa kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ivulekele ibhizinisi.
tgt: Kopano eno ya bo 27 ya WEF e e ka ga Aforika e tota e netefaletsa lefatshe gore e santse e le karolo ya mafelo a go ka beelediwang mo go ona mo kontinenteng ya Aforika.

src: Titfutsi.1 Kwetfulwa kwetitimela letinsha te-Ejensi YaseNingizimu Afrika Yetitimela Letitfutsa Bantfu (i--Prasa) netinsita tetitimela, nguMengameli Jacob Zuma mhla ti-9 Inkhwekhweti 2017 eSiteshini ePitoli yincenye yekutinikela kwahulumende lokuchubekako kucinisekisa kuba khona kwetitfutsi letingabiti kakhulu futsi letititfutsi temmango lekungatsenjelwa kuto, tiphindze futsi tente sakhiwonchanti semnotfo walelive kutsi sibe ncono.
tgt: Barulaganyi ba kopano eno ba netefaleditse gore baeteledipele ba feta ba le 1 000 ba tsenela kopano eno, e leng palo e ntsi go fetisisa fa a bapisiwa le ya WEF e e ka ga Aforika e e fetileng.

src: Titimela letinsha (tekutfutsa Bantfu) takaMetrorail tiyincenye yetitimela letinsha letitawetsengwa nguhulumende kuleminyaka le-10 kuya kule-15 letayo njengencenye yeLuhlelo Lwe-Prasa Lwekutfutfukisa.
tgt: Mowa o o tebileng wa tirisanommogo magareng ga puso le bagwebi mo kopanong ya WEF e e ka ga Aforika e ne e le o o itumedisang.

src: Lomtamo utawakha imisebenti leminyenti lesimeme kanye nematfuba emisebenti, ngenca yefekthri yekukhicita titimela leyakhiwako eNigel, e-Ekurhuleni.
tgt: Dipuisano tse di tseneletseng tseno di neile Aforika Borwa tšhono ya go bontsha kgatelopele eo e e dirileng mo go kgolo ya ikonomi e e akaretsang botlhe le go bontsha gore Aforika Borwa e buletse dikgwebo.

src: Sicalo sekusebenta kweSivumelwano seFrance neBrazil lesasayinwa baka-Prasa ne-Alstom.3 Letitimela letinsha takaMetrorail (letitfutsa Bantfu) letiyincalakuvela tiniketa buntofontofo netinsita letingeke tilinganiswe nalokunye, futsi titawugucula simo sekuhamba sebagibeli.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e santse e semeletse mo go tsenyeng tirisong Leano la yona la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) mo go fokotseng maemo a khumanego, tlhokotekatekano le botlhokatiro.

src: Tiyincenye yetekutfutfukisa umnotfo kwahulumende ngekutfutfukisa sakhiwonchanti lesikhulukati futsi tilungele nalabo labakhubatekile.4 Ikhabhinethi icele bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi batigcabhe ngaletitimela letinsha baphindze futsi bativikele etentweni tekumosha imphahla.
tgt: Go thankgolowa ga diterene tse dintšhwa tsa Setheo sa Banamedi ba Diterene sa Aforika Borwa (PRASA) mmogo le ditirelo tsa diterene, ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ka la bo 9 Motsheganong 2017 kwa seteišeneng sa kwa Pretoria.

src: Tibhelu tasevuwani.1 Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kungenelela ngemphumelelo lokwentiwe nguMengameli Zuma eVuwani, eLimpopo.
tgt: Diterene tse dintšhwa tsa motseseteropo (tseo di itsegeng ka gore ke diterene tsa batho) ke karolo ya diterene tse dintšhwa tse di tla thankgololwang ke puso mo dingwageng tse di tlang di le 10 go ya go di le 15 jaaka karolo ya Lenaane la Dintšhwafatso la PRASKe tshimologo ya tirisanommogo ya PRASA le Alstom ka tumelano e e saenilweng magareng ga Fora le Brazil.

src: Mengameli wahlangana neSilo Inkhosi Toni Mphephu Ramabulana weSive semaVenda, nalabanye labatsintsekako bemmango kute kutsi batfole tisombululo letinesizotsa tekusombulula tinkinga letiphakanyisiwe.2 Kulomhlangano kwemukelwa siphakamiso seSilo sekutsi Masipala weSigodzi saseVhembe ufanele kutsi etfule tinsita kubantfu baseVuwani lapho kusafunwana nesisombululo salomphelo sekutjutjwa kwemnyele.
tgt: Diterene tse dintle tse dintšhwa tsa motseseteropo (tseo di itsegeng ka gore ke diterene tsa batho) di abelana ka maemo a a farologaneng a boiketlo le ditirelo, mme adi tla fetola megopolo ya banamedi ka go tsaya maeto.

src: Lesisombululo lesiphakanyisiwe siyahambisana nemtsetfo lowengamele bomasipala.3 Kuphindze futsi kwachutjekwa kwancunywa kutsi ematiko ahulumende lafanele etifundza newavelonkhe afanele kutsi asekele masipala wesigodzi ekwenteni lomsebenti lomusha.
tgt: Ke karolo ya puso ya go tlhabolola ikonomi ka go aga mafaratlhatlha a magologadi mme e bile di bonolo go ka dirisiwa le ke batho ba ba nang le bogole.

src: Nanoma kunjalo, lomhlangano wagcizelela kutsi lesincumo asisho kutsi lomasipala lomusha (i-LIM 345) angeke usasungulwa.
tgt: Kabinete e dirile boikuelo mo maAforika Borweng go ikgantsha le go tlhokomela diterene tseno tse dintšhwa kgatlhanong le ditiragalo dipe tsa tshenyo ya thoto ya puso.

src: Lesincumo siyincenye yekutinikela kwahulumende ekutfoleni sisombululo lesifaka konkhe ekhatsi.4 Mihlangano lebibanjwe nguMengameli nabo bonkhe labatsintsekako ibe nemphumela wekutsi tikolwa nemabhizinisi abuyele esimeni sawo asebente ngalokwetayelekile.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela ditsereganyo tse di atlegileng tsa Moporesitente Zuma kwa Vuwani, Limpopo.

src: Ikhabhinethi incoma labatsintsekako ngekutsi bacinesikise kufezekiswa kwetivumelwano letentiwe yiNkhosi.
tgt: Moporesitente o ne a kopana le Kgosi Toni Mphephu Ramabulana wa Vha-Venda, mmogo le bannaleseabe ba bangwe mo baaging gore go bonwe fa go ka se fitlhelelwe ditharabololo tseo ba ka di utlwanelang mo dingongoregong tseo di tlhagisitsweng.

src: Mengameli utinikele ekutsini utawubuyela emuva kulommango waseVuwani ayococisana nawo ngelusuku lekusatawuvunyelwana ngalo neSilo Inkhosi Toni Mphephu Ramabulana nabo bonkhe labatsintsekako kulendzawo.5 Ikhabhinethi icela batali nemmango kutsi besekele tinyatselo tekungenelela tematiko kucinisekisa kutsi bafundzi babuyela emaklasini futsi bagcila etifundvweni tabo nasekutfoleni tifundvo lasebasalele emuva kuto ngekusebentisa imitamo leyentiwa tikolwa.
tgt: Mo kopanong go utlwanetswe gore tshitshinyo ya Kgosi ya gore Masepala wa Kgaolo wa Vhembe o tshwanetse go tlamela ka ditirelo baagi ba Vuwani fa go santse go sekwasekwa ditharabololo tse di tla nnelang ruri tse di mabapi le dintlha tsa go kgaoganngwa ga mebasepala.

src: Imibhikisho lenebudlova.1 Ikhabhinethi icela imimango kutsi iyekele kwenta budlova, kwesabisa nekuntjontja uma ivakalisa tikhalo tayo.
tgt: Tharabololo e e tshitshintsweng eno e tsamaelana le molao o o leng teng ga jaana o o laolang mebasepala.

src: Ikhabhinethi igceka ngemandla budlova netento tekuntjontja nekumoshwa kwemphahla yemabhizinisi lokusandza kwenteka eColigny, Eldorado Park, nase-Ennerdale.2 Ikhabhinethi imema yonkhe imimango kutsi ivakalise tikhalo tayo ngendlela lefuna tisombululo ngaphandle kwekubhubhisa imphahla yesive noma kunyatsela emalungelo alamanye emalunga emmango.3 Mengameli wenta simemetelo nga-2015 ngesikhatsi eTfula Inkhulumo yakhe Yebunjalo Belive (i-SoNA), wacela Sicheme Setebulungiswa, Kuvikela Bugebengu kanye neTekuphepha (i-JCPS) kutsi ibukane nekucedza imibhikisho lenebudlova nalemoshako, Ikhabhinethi iphindza leso simemo futsi sekutsi labo labephula umtsetfo batawubukana ngalokuphelele nesandla semtsetfo.4 Ikhabhinethi icela bonkhe labatsintsekako kutsi bahlanganyele kumbono wekusombulula tincabano ngekushesha e-Ennerdale, Eldorado Park naseColigny.
tgt: Go ne gape ga swetswa ka gore mafapha a a maleba a puso ya bosetšhaba le a puso ya porofense a tshwanetse go tshegetsa masepala ono wa kgaolo mo maikarabelong ano a o sa tswang go a rwala ga jaana.

src: Umtsetfo Wekuchibela Sikhungo Setemshoshampansi Wetetimali (i-FICA)5.1 Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kusayinwa nguMengameli Zuma kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Sikhungo Setemshoshampansi Wetetimali kutsi ube ngumtsetfo.
tgt: Le fa go le jalo, kwa kopanong eno go gateletswe gore ditshwetso tse di tserweng ga di ree gore masepala o montšhwa ono (LIM 345) o a fedisiwa.

src: INingizimu Afrika njengencenye yenhlangano yemave emhlaba lelwa nemisebenti yetimali lengekho emtsetfweni, itawuhambisana nekungenelela kwemave emhlaba lokuhlose kulwa nekutfolwa kwetinsambansamba tetimali ngalokungekho emtsetfweni kanye nekwesekelwa kwebuphekulasikhuni ngetimali.2 LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawufaka ligalelo ekuciniseni kwenta tintfo ngekungafihli lutfo kanye nesizotsa kunchubo yetimali yaseNingizimu uphindze futsi wente kutsi kube lukhuni kakhulu kutsi tigebengu letibandzakanyeka ekungakhokheni umtselo, kutfola tinsambansamba temali ngalokungekho emtsetfweni kungena nekuphuma kwetimali lokungekho emtsetfweni kugwema kusebentisa tinchubo tetimali taseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Dipuisano tsa Moporesitente le bannaleseabe botlhe di dirile gore dikolo le dikgwebo di boele di dire jaaka gale.

src: Wenta incenye yelamanye emathulusi lesinawo njengelive lesihlasela ngawo bugebengu lobentiwa bocwepheshe emkhakheni wahulumende newangasese.3 INdvuna yeTetimali yatise Ikhabhinethi kutsi kukhulumisana kusachubeka futsi kutawuphetfwa masinyane nje kucinisekisa inchubo yekumemetela imitsetfomgomo letawenta kutsi Umtsetfo we-FICA ucale kusebenta.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola bannaleseabe mo go gateleleng gore go tsenngwetirisong ditumelano tse di utlwanetsweng tse di tlhagisitsweng ke Kgosi.

src: Tincumo tekhabhinethi.1 Indvuna yeTetimali yatise Ikhabhinethi ngemihlangano yeNtfwasahlobo yeLibhange leMhlaba neSikhwama Semali Semhlaba (i-IMF), Imihlangano neBatjalimali kanye nemihlangano ye-WEF lemayelana ne-Afrika.
tgt: Moporesitente o ikanne gore o tla boa go tla go buisana le baagi ba Vuwani mme letlha leo le santse le tla utlwanelwa le Kgosi Toni Mphephu Ramabulana mmogo le bannaleseabe botlhe ba lefelo leo.

src: Wachubeka watisa mayelana neSivumelwano se-G20 netiphakamiso te-Afrika kanye netikhalo tebatjalimali nema-ejensi laBukana neMazinga eTemnotfo.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo batsading le mo baaging gore ba tshegetse ditsereganyo tsa lefapha go netefatsa gore bana ba boela sekolong mme ba ithuta le go gatela pele ka tseo ba saletseng morago ka tsona ka matsholo ao a diriwang kwa dikolong tsotlhe.

src: Kube netingcoco letijulile mayelana nesimo semnotfo wemave emhlaba newesigodzi, kanye nalekufanele sikwente kubuyisela lokwehliselwa ezingeni letemnotfo lelingentasi.2 Ikhabhinethi iphindze yakucinisa kutsi iyachubeka nekutinikela kunchubomgomo yetimali temtselo levetwe kuNkhulumo yeLwabiwomali yanga-2017 kufezekiswa kwetingcucuko kute kwentiwe kancono kuphatsa etinkampanini tembuso kugcina umkhawulo wekusetjentiswa imali usezingeni lelifanele kanye nekucinisekisa kutsi tikweleti tahulumende atikhuphuki.
tgt: Ditiragalo tsa tirisodikgoka le dikgato tsa bogodu jwa dithoto le tsa go senya dithoto tsa bagwebi tseo di ntseng di tsweletse malobanyana fa kwa Coligny, Eldorado Park, le Ennerdale di nyefolwa ka bogale ke Kabinete.

src: Luhlelo lwahulumande lwekusheshisa kufezekiswa kwetingucuko letihlelekile lekuhloswe ngato kukhuphula kukhula kwemnotfo njengoba kubekiwe kuLuhlelo Lwemaphutu Layimfica luyachubeka nekuba ngulolufanele kubukana naletinye tetinsayeya letiphakanyiswe ngumtjalimali6.3 Ikhabhinethi iyawemukela umbiko losandza kwetfulwa yifemu i-EY Consultancy lomayelana neLutjalomali Ngco lweMave angaphandle e-Afrika.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa mo baaging go tlhagisa matshwenyego a bona ka tsela eo e batlang ditharabololo go sena tlhokego ya gore go senngwe dithoto tsa puso kgotsa go gatakaka ditshwanelo tsa baagi ba babangwe.

src: Lombiko utsi iNingizimu Afrika ingulelinye lemave lanemnotfo lemikhulu nekutsi futsi yaba yesibili kuNkhomba yeKuheha yase-Afrika yanga-20.4 Ikhabhinethi yaphindze futsi yatiswa ngema-Ejensi laBukene neMazinga eTemnotfo mayelana nekuvakasha lokutako kwekuhlangana netinhlangano letinyenti kanye netikhulu tahulumende.5 Ikhabhinethi iluvumile Luhlaka loluBuyeketiwe lweLuhlelolisu lweTitfutsi Tasemaphandleni.
tgt: Mo nakong ya Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba (SoNA) ya Tlhakole 2015, Moporesitente Zuma o ne a dira boikuelo jwa gore Setlhopha sa Bosiamisi, Thibelobosenyi le Tshireletsego (JCPS) se samagane ka tshwanelo le ditshupetso tse di renang dikgoka e bile di na le tshenyo ya dithoto.

src: Loluhlelolisu luphendvula etintfweni letifanele kutsi kube ngito letentiwa kucala kunaletinye tabomasipala besigodzi sasemaphandleni nebetifudza, ngekutsi kulungiswe Sakhiwonchanti seTitfutsi taseMaphandleni kanye netinsita letibeka umkhawulo tiwubekele kutfutfukiswa kwemnotfo netenhlalo.
tgt: Kabinete e boeletsa ntlha eno gore bao ba tshelang molao ba tla kopana le dinta di fuduga.

src: Kufezekiswa kwalelisu kutawufaka ligalelo ekutfutfukisweni kwemnotfo wamasipala newetifundza ngekwenta kancono kufinyelelwa kwetitfutsi temmango.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo bannaleseabeng botlhe gore ba buisanele dintlha tseo ba lebile gore ba di rarabolole ka bonako kwa Ennerdale, Eldorado Park le kwa Coligny.

src: Loku kutawukhulisa kuchumana emkhatsini wetindzawo tasemaphandleni netasemadolobheni, ngemcondvo wekufaka tindzawo tasemaphandleni kumnotfo welive lobanti.6 Ikhabhinethi iyivumile Inchubomgomo Lephelele yeTitfutsi taseLwandle.
tgt: Aforika Borwa, jaaka karolo ya lefatshe ka bophara eo e samaganeng le go lwantsha ditiragalo tse di seng mo molaong tsa matlole e tla samagana le ditsereganyo tsa boditšhabatšhaba tseo di lekang go lwantshana le dithulaganyo tse di sa lolamang tsa matlole le dithuso tsa madi a menolopuso.

src: Loku kukhombisa kutinikela kwaHulumende ekukhuleni, kutfutfuka kanye nekugucuka kwemkhakha wetitfutsi taselwandle waseNingizimu Afrika, kwesekela kutfutfukiswa kwemnotfo netenhlalo ube futsi ufaka ligalelo kutekuhwebelana kwemave emhlaba.
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono o tla nna gape le seabe mo go natlafatseng botlhokalehunela le mo seriting sa thulaganyo ya matlole ya Aforika Borwa le go ketefaletsa basenyi bao ba tlolang melao ya go duelang lekgetho, bao ba amegang mo dithulaganyong tse di sa lolamang tsa matlole le dithulaganyo tse di seng mo molaong tsa go tila go latela melao ya thulaganyo ya matlole ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Loku kuhambisana netintfo tahulumende letibekwa embili letimayelana neluhlelo lwe-Operation Phakisa ekukhuliseni Umnotfo waseLwandle.
tgt: Ke karolo ya didirisiwa tseo re nang le tsone mo nageng tsa go lwantsha bosenyi jwa matlole mo makaleng ka bobedi a poraefete le a puso.

src: Iphindze futsi ihambisane nemigomo lebanti yekukhutsata kukhula kwemnotfo kanye nekundlondlobalisa kwakheka kwematfuba emisebenti, njengobe kubekiwe ku-NDP kanye neLuhlelo Lwesakhiwonchanti Lwavelonkhe.7 Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweLuhlaka Lwelisu Letitfutsi Letite Ngoti Kumvelo kute ummango uphawule ngalo.
tgt: Kabinete e ne ya tsiboswa ke Tona ya Matlole gore dipuisano di tsweletse mme di tla konosediwa go ise go e kae gore kgato ya go phasalatsa melawana e tsee kgato e e tla amang FICDitshwetso tsa Kabinete.

src: Titfutsi tidlala indzima lebalulekile ekwenteni kutsi kuhwebelana kwemave emhlaba kuchubeke kahle ngendlela lesimamisa umnotfo, tenhlalo kanye nemvelo.
tgt: Tona ya Matlole o ne a tsopolela Kabinete ka kopano ya mo malobeng ya Setheo sa Matlole sa Boditšhabatšhaba (IMF)/kopano ya Dikgakologo ya Banka ya Lefatshe, Dipontsho tsa Dipeeletso mmogo le WEF e e ka ga Aforika.

src: Tinchubo tetitfutsi tingumgogodla wemisebenti yaseNingizimu Afrika yetemnotfo netenhlalo ngekwenta kutsi bantfu nemikhicito bakhone kuhamba.
tgt: O ne gape a tsopolela Kabinete ka ga Kopano ya G20 ka ditshitshinyo tsa Aforika tsa go rarabolola dingongorego tsa babeeletsi le Ditheo tsa Tshekatsheko Maemo a Ikonomi.

src: Nanoma kunjalo, imimoya lengcolile lekhicitwa ngumkhakha wetitfutsi ifaka ligalelo kusamba semimoya lengcolile letfunyiswa emoyeni (i-GHG), bese kutsi titfutsi temgwaco tona tifaka ligalelo lelikhulu kakhulu.
tgt: Go nnile le dipuisano tse di tseneletseng tse di mabapi le sebopego sa maemo a ikonomi ya mo tikologong le ya mo lefatsheng, maeo a a tikologo go tsopotswe tseo di tshwanetsweng ke go diriwa go busetsa morago tshwetso ya go folosiwa mo maemong a ikonomi.

src: Lelisu lifuna kuphakamisa tinyatselo tekungenelela letitawunciphisa kutfuyiswa kwe-GHG ngekhatsi kwetinchubomgomo tekutfutfuka lokusimeme.8 Ikhabhinethi ivumile kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ijoyine i-Smart Africa Alliance.
tgt: Kabinete e gateletse gore e santse e ikemiseditse go sala morago moano wa pholisi ya matlole o o tlhalositsweng mo Puong ya Tekanyetsokabo ya 2017 go tsenngwatirisong ga dipaakanyo tsa go tokafatsa puso mo Ditlamong tsa Puso (di-SOC) go se sutise maemo a a beilweng a go lekanyetsa tiriso ya madi mmogo le go netefatsa gore dikoloto tsa puso ga di tswe mo taolong.

src: Lena yinhlangano yekusebentisana leholwa yi-Afrika lenenjongo yekutfutfukisa tisombululo kanye nekwabela imitfombolusito yekubukana netinsayeya tentfutfuko lelivekati lelibukene nato.
tgt: Lenaane la puso le le totileng go salamorago tshalelomorago e e ka ga go tsenya tirisong dipaakanyo tsa maemo a baeteledipele le ikaeletse go tlhotlhetsa kgolo ya ikonomi, jaaka e tlhalosiwa ka fa teng ga Leano la Dintlharobongwe, mme le santse le le matshwanedi go ka samagana le matshwenyego a mangwe a a tlhagisitsweng ke babeeletsi.

src: Kubeka Ithekhinoloji Yelwati Lwetekuchumana enkhabeni ye-ajenda yetentfutfuko yemave ase-Afrika yanga-2063.INingizimu Afrika itawuzuza ngekwetemnotfo netepolitiki ngekuhlanganyela kwayo kuSmart Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse pegelo e e sa tswang go gololwa malobanyana ke ba feme ya EY Consultancy e e mabapi le Peeletso ya Dinaga tsa kwa Ntle e e Tobaneng le Aforika.

src: Ngekubeka timboni nemakhono aseNingizimu Afrika enkhabeni ye-ajenda yentfutfuko ye-Smart Africa, iNingizimu Afrika itawufaka ligalelo ekukhuleni kwemabhizinisi endzawo kulesigodzi.9 Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kumenyetelwa kweNchubomgomo yaVelonkhe yeLitiko Letemfundvo Lesisekelo yeLigciwane leNgculazi (i-HIV), Tifo Letitsatselwana Ngekwemacansi (ema-STI) kanye neSifo Sesifuba (i-TB).Inchubomgomo yanga-1999 yagcila ekucapheleni jikelele nakutinhlangotsi tekuvikela tebhayoloji nekwelashwa, futsi yagcila kancane kukuhleleka, nakuloko lokuchubela embili i-HIV kwetenhlalo kanye netindlela tekutiphatsa.
tgt: Pegelo eno e nopola Aforika Borwa jaaka lefelo le lengwe le le nang le ikonomi e kgolo le gore e mo maemong a bobedi mo Tshupaneng ya Ngokelo ya Aforika ya 2017.

src: Lenchubomgomo iphakamisa indlela leyehlukile yekubukana neSandvulelangculazi (i-HIV) njengeludzaba loluyinkhaba lwekulawula kusetjentiswa indlela yetemphilo yemmango, kanye nekufaka ekhatsi kubekwa embili kwekwelashwa kwesifo sesifuba etikolweni, emkhatsini waletinye tintfo.
tgt: Kabinete gape e ne ya tlotlomadiwa ka maeto a a tla diragalang a go etelwa ke ditheo tsa ditshekatsheko tsa maemo a ikonomi a a leng ka ga go buisana le mekgatlho e le mmalwa mmogo le baeteledipele ba puso.

src: Lenchubomgomoitawufaka ekhatsi bantfu labanyenti labafana nebafundzi, bothishela, kanye netikhulu, etikolweni tahulumende kanye nasetikolweni letitimele.
tgt: Togamaano eno e tsibogela ditlapele tsa dimasepala tsa kgaolo ya metseselegae mmogo le diporofense, ka go samagana le tlamelo e e tlhaelang ya Mafaratlhatlha a Dipalangwa tsa Metseselegae e leng seo se thibelang tlhabololo ya ditiragalo tsa ikonomi ya loago.

src: Imitsetfosivivinyo.1 Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kwetfulwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Inkampani Yetikhumulo Tetindizamshini, wanga-2017 neMtsetfosivivinyo weKuchibela Tethrafikhi Yasemoyeni neTinsita neKutfola Indlela yekuhamba.
tgt: Go tsenngwatirisong ga togamaano eno go tla nna le seabe mo tlhabololong ya ikonomi ya tikologo le ya porofense ka go tokafatsa phitlhelelo ya dipalangwa tsa setšhaba.

src: Kuchitjelwa kwaleMitsetfosivivinyo lemibili kwenta kutsi kube khona Simiso Sekulawula salomphelo.
tgt: Seno se tla oketsa kgolagano magareng ga mafelo a kwa metseselegae le a kwa metseseteropong, ka maitlhomo a go dira gore tikologo ya metseselegae e nne karolo ya ikonomi ya naga.

src: Letichibelo tiphindze futsi tente kutsi kusungulwe emakomidi lekutawendluliselwa kuwo tikhalo, latawusebenta kusombulula tindzaba tetincabano letinyenti.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse Pholisi e e Golaganeng ya Dipalangwa tsa kwa Mawatle.

src: Imikhosi letako.1 Mngameli Jacob Zuma utawetfula inkhulumo yekuvula i-Indaba Yetekuvakasha yanga-2017 letawube ingeniswe esikhungweni setikhomfa e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre eDurban emkhatsini wamhla ti-16 nemhla ti-18 Inkhwekhweti 2017.Lena yi-indaba yemave emhlaba letawuphindze futsi ikhangise imikhicito kanye netinsita taseNingizimu Afrika emkhakheni wetekuvakasha nekwemukela bantfu.
tgt: Yona e tlhalosa maitlhomo a puso mabapi le kgolo, tlhabololo le phetolothefosano ya lekala la Aforika Borwa la dipalangwa tsa kwa mawatle mo go tshegetseng tlhabololo ya ikonomi ya loago fa mo letlhakoreng le lengwe e tsenya letsogo mo kgwebisanong ya boditšhabatšhaba.

src: Loku kungetulu kakhulu kwesilinganiso sekukhula semave emhlaba lesisemkhatsini sa-3% sangaleso sikhatsi.
tgt: Seno se tsamaisana le ditlapele tsa puso tseo di amanang le Operation Phakisa mo go godiseng Ikonomi ya Mawatle.

src: Ngalesikhatsi se-indaba yeTekuvakasha, iNingizimu Afrika itawuzuza kulelinani letitfunywa letitawufika kulelive.2 Indvuna yeTemandla Make Mmamoloko Kubayi kulenyanga utawuhola umkhankhaso weNyanga yeMandla ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi “Kukhutsata tinhlobo letahlukene temandla letisimeme futsi letingabiti kakhulu kwesekela tingucuko temnotfo letinemandla’.
tgt: Gape e tsamaisana le dipeelo tse di atolositsweng tseo maitlhomo a tsona e leng go rotloetsa kgolo ya ikonomi mmogo le go tshegetsa go tlhamiwa ga ditiro jaaka go tlhalositswe mo go NDP le mo go Leano la Mafaratlhatlha a Naga.

src: Lomkhankhaso utawufundzisa, ucaphelise uphindze futsi ukhulumisane nemmango mayelana nekusebentisa kahle emandla, kutfola emandla lanele, naletinye tindzaba tetinye tinhlobo temandla nekutsi konkhe loku kubaluleke kanjani kutindlela lasetjentiswa ngato emandla emakhaya, emabhizinisini nasetimbonini.3 Lwabiwomali lweMatiko lwanga-2017 lwangeNkhwekhweti 2017 luveta litfuba lekutsi ematiko etfule ePhalamende nakummango jikelele kutsi atawuyisebentisa kanjani Imali labelwe yona nga-2017.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse go phasaladiwa ga Sekwalwatlhomo sa Togamaano ya Dipalangwa tse di sa Kgotlheleng Tikologo gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo ka ga sona.

src: Atawuphindze futsi asebentise lelitfuba kwabelana nemmango kutsi tinhlelo tawo ticuketse ini kulomnyakatimali.
tgt: Dipalangwa di na le seabe se segolo mo go kgontsheng gore go nne le kgwebisano mo lefatsheng ka bophara e e siametseng go ka somarela ikonomi, loago le tikologo.

src: Ikhabhinethi imema ummango kutsi uhlangenyele kuletinkhulumo temcombelelo wematiko lapho tetfulwa ngekwetinchubo tePhalamende.4 Litiko leTemanti neKuhanjiswa Kwekungcola Ngemanti litawungenisa Liviki leKuhanjiswa Kwekungcola Ngemanti emkhatsini wamhla ti-16 nemhla tinge-22 2017 ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi: “Kuhanjiswa kwekungcola ngemanti ngalokuhlantekile kweTemphilo neSitfunti”.
tgt: Dithulaganyo tsa dipalangwa ke karolo ya seikokotlelo sa ditiragalo tsa ikonomi ya loago ya Aforika Borwa ka go kgontsha gore batho le dithoto tse di rekisiwanng di kgone go kgabaganya melelwane.

src: Hulumende utinikele kunika bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika sitfunti ngekutsi abanike tinsita tekuhanjiswa kwekungcola ngemanti ngalokuhlantekile.
tgt: Le fa go le jalo, semoko se se tswang mo dijanageng se na le seabe mo semokong sotlhe se se tlhodiwang ke naga (GHG), mo dipalangwa tsa mo tseleng e leng tsone tse di eteletseng pele ka semoko se sentsi.

src: Lokutawugcilwa kuko kuleliviki Luhlelo Lwekupheliswa Kusetjentiswa Kwemithoyi Yemabhakade.
tgt: Togamaano eno e senka go tlhagisa ditsela tse di ka fokotsa semoko sa GHG go ya ka melawanatheo ya tlhabololo ya leruri.

src: Kuleliviki kutawuniketelwa imithoyi lesebentisa emanti kumimango yaMasipala weNdzawo waseNketoana, eFreyistata, nakuMasipala weNdzawo waseDawid Kruiper, eNyakatfo Kapa njengencenye yekusheshisa tinsita kususwe imithoyi yemabhakade.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore Aforika Borwa e nne karolo ya Smart Africa Alliance.

src: INingizimu Afrika igubha umkhosi weNyanga yase-Afrika ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi: Kwakha i-Afrika Lencono neMhlaba Loncono.
tgt: Eno ke tirisanommogo e e etilweng pele ke Aforika mme e lebeletse go tlhagisa ditharabololo tse di matshwanedi le go abelana didirisiwa go samagana le dikgwetlho tsa tlhabololo tse di totileng kontinente.

src: Kunemisebenti leminyenti leyentekako leholwa Litiko Letebuciko Nemasiko lekuhloswe ngayo kukhutsata bunye be-Afrika.
tgt: E baya Thekenoloji ya Ditlhaeletsano le Tshedimosetso (ICT) kwa setlhoeng sa Lenaneo la Tlhabololo la 2063 la dinaga tsa Aforika.

src: Kutfunyelwa kwembutfo wetekuvikela wavelonkhe waseningizimu Afrika (i-SANDF) uyosebenta kulenye indzawo Ikhabhinethi iyasemukela sincumo saMengameli Jacob Zuma sekwelulwa kwesikhatsi lesitawutsatfwa yi-SANDF eDemocratic Republic of Congo (e-DRC).
tgt: Aforika Borwa e tla unngwelwa mo maemong ka bobedi a ikonomi le a sepolotiki ka go nna le seabe mo go Smart Africa Alliance.

src: Loku kungumtamo wekufaka ligalelo kutekuthula nekutinta kulelivekati lase-Afrika ikakhulu sigodzi ngekuhambisana netibopho tetfu tekubukana nemave angaphandle nenchubomgomo yetfu yekuphatsa emave angaphandle yekufaka ligalelo ku-Afrika nemhlaba loncono.2 Samba lesi-1 371 semalunga e-SANDF sitfunyelwe e-DRC kuyokwesekela Imitamo Yenhlangano Yamhlabuhlangene Yekuletsa Kutinta.
tgt: Ka go baya diintaseteri tsa Aforika Borwa mo maemong a a tla di unngwelang mmogo le kitso ya bokgoni mo lenaneong la tlhabololo la Smart Africa Alliance, Aforika Borwa e tla nna le seabe mo kgolong ya dikgwebo tsa legae mo kgaolong.

src: Sikhatsi sekusebenta kwawo selulilwe sesuswa kumhla lu-01 Mabasa 2017 sayiswa kumhla tinge-31 Indlovulenkhulu 20.3 Kutfumela umbutfo wetfu wetekuvikela kulelivekati kwesekela lokuchubekako kwetinchubo tesigodzi nelivekati tekuphendvula nekukusombula tinhlekele, kukhutsata nekuvikela, kucinisa kuhlangana kwesigodzi, kukhulisa ngemandla kuhwebelana emkhatsini wemave ase-Afrika kanye nekuhola intfutfuko lesimememe e-Afrika.
tgt: Kabinete e letleletse gore go phasaladiwe Pholisi ya Naga ya Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo e e ka ga Lebolelamading (HIV), Malwetse a a Fetelanang ka Thobalano (di-STD) le Lehuba (TB).Pholisi ya ngwaga wa 1999 e tobane le tlhokomelo ya lefatshe lotlhe mmogo le dintlha tsa melemo ya tlhago ka ga thibelaketegelo, mme ga e lebelele thata sebopego, mekgwa le maitsholo a a bakang HIV.

src: Imiklomelo Yekuhlonishwa yaVelonkhe.1 Ikhabhinethi ihalalisela bonkhe labatfole Imiklomelo Yekuhlonishwa yaVelonkhe yanga-2017.
tgt: Pholisi eno e tshitshinya gore go nne le phetogo ka fao HIV e tsewang ka teng ka fao go dirisiwang maokelo a setšhaba go samagana le HIV, mmogo le go akarediwa ga TB jaaka e nngwe ya dintlha tsa botlhokwa go samaganwa natso kwa dikolong, gareng ga mafelo a mangwe.

src: Emnyakeni wa-OR Tambo basikhombise emandla ekusebentela kuba neNingizimu Afrika lencono kanye nesive lesincono.
tgt: Seno se atologile go akaretsa le barutwana, barutabana mmogo le badiredipuso, kwa dikolong tsa puso le tseo e seng tsa puso.

src: LoMbiko ukhombisa kutsi sisesekhashane kakhulu nekuzuza tisebenti letimelela ngeliciniso sive setfu.
tgt: Diphetogo tse di leng mo Melaotlhomong eno e mebedi di senka go tlamela ka Setheo sa Leruri sa Melawanataolo.

src: Ikhabhinethi yahlangana ngaLesitsatfu, mhla tinge-24 Inkhwekhweti 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.
tgt: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, la bo 24 Motsheganong 2017, kwa Tuynhuys, Motsekapa.

src: Ikhabinethi iyakhatsateka mayelana nelizinga lelikhulako letehlakalo tekuhlukunyetwa nebudlova lobentiwa kubomake eveni lakitsi.
tgt: Kabinete e tlhobaediwa ke ditiragalo tse di tswelelang tsa tiriso e e botlhaswa le tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le basadi mo setšhabeng sa rona.

src: Tehlakalo letisandza kwenteka letifaka ekhatsi budlova betitsandzani tetente bomake labanengi labanemandla futsi labanesibindzi bakhulumele mayelana nekulwela kwephulwa kwemalungelo abo.
tgt: Ditiragalo tsa sešweng tse di amang tirisodikgoka ka bakapelo di bakile gore basadi ba digatlhamelamasisi e bile ba le sebete ba bue kgatlhanong le go gatakwa ga ditshwanelo tsa bona.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyakubona kutsi silive sisachubeka nekuba live lelibuswa ngulabadvuna futsi loku-ke kubita kutsi kwentiwe lokunyenti kute kutsi kuliwe nekubulawa kwabomake nekushushunjiswa kwebantfu.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela gore jaaka naga re tswelela go nna le setšhaba se se laolwang ke banna mme ka jalo e ikuela gore go dirwe go le gontsi go lwantsha tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le basadi le kgwebisano ka batho.

src: Ikhabhinethi imema yonkhe imikhakha yemmango kutsi ibambisane kuliwe letehlakalo letinyenti tekuhlukunyetwa kwabomake, kuliwe nalo lonkhe luhlobo lwebudlova lolwentiwa kubomake nebantfwana, kuphindze futsi kusetjentiswane nemaphoyisa netebulungiswa kute kutsi letigilamkhuba tiboshwe.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go makala otlhe a setšhaba go dirisana mmogo go fenya bothata jo, go ganetsa mofuta ofe fela wa tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le basadi le bana le go dirisana le sepodisi le tsamaiso ya bosiamisi go dira gore badiri ba ditiro tse di maswe tse ba lebagane le molao.

src: Mengameli Jacob Zuma sewumemetele kutsi kuvinjwe kuhlukunyetwa kwabomake nebantfwana lokuchubekako.
tgt: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o ikuetse gore tiriso e e botlhaswa kgatlhanong le basadi le bana e khutle.

src: Ikhabhinethi seyiyalele Iklasta yeKuvikelwa Kwetenhlalo, Nekutfutfukiswa Kwemmango Nebantfu kutsi isungule luhlelo lwekusebenta lolutawusetjentiswa lelive ekulweni kuhlukunyetwa kwabomake nebantfwana.
tgt: Kabinete e laetse Setlhopha sa Tshireletso ya Loago, Tlhabololo ya Setšhaba le Baagi go tsenya tirisong lenaane la tiro le le tla thusang naga go thibela tiriso e e botlhaswa ya basadi le bana.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyayemukela imiphumela yeLuklayo Lwebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika nelweTemphilo lwanga-2016 lolwentiwe Lihhovisi Lelubalobalo laseNingizimu Afrika, lolukala simo setemphilo sebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, kanye netinhlelo tetemphilo letinotsile naletingutonatona.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela dipoelo tsa Dipatlisiso tsa Dipalopalo le Boitekanelo tsa Aforika Borwa tsa 2016 ka Lefapha la Mananepalo la Aforika Borwa (stats SA), tse di lekanyetsang kemo ya boitekanelo ya maAforika Borwa, le phitlhelelego le boleng jwa manaane a boitekanelo.

src: Loluklayo emkhatsini waletinye tintfo lubika kwehla kwelizinga lekushona kwebantfwana labancane nga-20% kanye nekwehla nga-11% kwelinani labomake nabobabe lababhema ligwayi.
tgt: Gareng ga tse dingwe, dipatlisiso tse di supa kwelotlase ya dintsho tsa masea ka 20% le kwelotlase ya 11% ya basadi le banna ba ba gogang motsoko.

src: Lemiphumela ikhombisa kutsi tinchubomgomo tekungenelela letahlelwa nguhulumende kaMengameli Zuma tinemiphumela lemihle.
tgt: Dipoelo tse di supa gore ditsereganyo tsa pholisi tse di neng tsa tsenngwa tirisong ke boeteledipele jwa ga Moporesitente Zuma di ungwa maungo a mantle.

src: Ikhabhinethi, nanoma kunjalo, iyakhatsateka ngebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labasachubeka nekuya emacasini nebalingani labanyenti ngalokungakavikeleki.
tgt: Le fa go le jalo, Kabinete e tlhobaediwa ke palo ya maAforika Borwa a a santseng a tswelela go robalana le balekane ba bantsi ntle le tshireletso.

src: Bomake labange-32% nemadvodza lange-42% bakhombise kutsi abakate sebahlolwe kutsi banaso yini Sandvulelangculazi (i-HIV) noma cha nanoma nje hulumende enta imitamo yekucaphelisa nekukhutsata bantfu kutsi bahlole simo sabo se-HIV.
tgt: Basadi ba le 32% le banna ba le 42% ba supile fa ba ise ba ke ba dirwe diteko tsa HIV le fa tota puso e leka go dira matsholotsiboso a go dirwa diteko tsa HIV.

src: Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi babe sibopho setemphilo nekuphila kahle kwabo, baye emacasini ngalokuphephile futsi bahle njalo batihlola i-HIV nato tonkhe letinye tifo letitsatselwanako naletingatsatselwana.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go rwala maikarabelo a boitekanelo le matshelo a bona, go robalana ba dirisa tshireletso le go nna ba dirwa diteko tsa HIV le malwetse a mangwe a a tshelanwang le a a sa tshelanweng gangwe le gape.

src: Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe batali kutsi nebanakekeli bebantfwana kutsi bacinisekise kutsi bantfwana babo bagonyelwa tifo tebuntfwana.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go batsadi le batlhokomedi go netefatsa gore bana ba soutisiwa kgatlhanong le malwetse a bana.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyachubeka nekutinikela ekucinisekiseni kutsi bantfwana bayagonywa kute kutsi bangangenwa tifo letitsatselwanako letiyingoti letingababulala.
tgt: Kabinete e tswelela ka maikemisetso a go netefatsa gore bana ba a soutisiwa go thibela malwetse a a tshelanwang e bile a le kotsi mo matshelong a bona.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyabacinisekisa batali nebanakekeli bebantfwana utsi imitsi labayinikwa Litiko Letemphilo iphephile.
tgt: Kabinete e netefaletsa batsadi le batlhokomedi gore diritibatsi tse di rebolwang ke Lefapha la Boitekanelo di babalesegile.

src: Ikhabhinethi isemukele sigaba sekucala sekwentiwa kancono kwepaki yeMboni yaseVulindlela Heights eMthatha eMphumalanga Kapa.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela kgato ya ntlha ya Madirelo a Vulindlela Heights a a tsosolositsweng kwa Mthatha kwa Kapa Botlhaba.

src: Loku kuyincenye yeLuhlelo lwalelive lweKwenta Kancono Emapaki Etimboni.
tgt: Se ke karolo ya Lenaane la Tsosoloso ya Diphaka tsa Madirelo.

src: Iyincalisakuvela yesibili eMphumalanga Kapa kantsi futsi iyipaki yesitfupha leyentiwa kancono kulo lonkhe lelive.
tgt: Ke ya bobedi ya mofuta wa yona kwa Kapa Botlhaba e bile e le nngwe ya diphaka tse thataro tse di ntšhwafadiwang go ralala naga.

src: Hulumende wenta kancono emapaki etimboni kute kutsi kufukuleke kudaleka kwematfuba emisebenti nekucinisekisa kukhula kwemnotfo lokuzuzisa wonkhe umuntfu.
tgt: Puso e ntšhwafatsa diphaka tsa madirelo go etleetsa go tlholwa ga ditiro le go netefatsa kgolo ya ikonomi e e akaretsang.

src: Kususwa kwemisebenti yetemnotfo etindzaweni tasemadolobheni nako kuyincenye yemitamo yahulumende yekugucula simo setemnotfo.
tgt: Go fudusiwa ga ditiragalo tsa ikonomi go tswa kwa mafelong a ditoropo ke karolo ya puso ya maiteko a tlhabololo ya ikonomi.

src: Lwatiso lolumayelana nekutsi ungawasebentisa kanjani lamatfuba lakhona kumapaki etfu etimboni, kutfola lusito lwahulumende netinhlelo tetibonelelo tahulumende kanye nematfuba elutjalomali emikhakheni leminengi leyehlukene lutfolakala ku: WEBTOKEN noma kuSikhungo Sekusita Ebantfu seLitiko Letekuhwebelana Netimboni (i-dti) ku: 0861 843 384.
tgt: Tshedimosetso ka ga go nna le seabe mo ditšhonong tse di leng teng kwa diphakeng tsa madirelo, go fitlhelela tshegetso ya puso le mananeo a thuso, le ditšhono tsa dipeeletso mo makaleng a a farologaneng e ka bonwa mo go WEBTOKEN kgotsa ka Tikwatikwe ya Thuso ya Badirisi ya Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Madirelo (the dti) mo go 0861 843 384.

src: Ikhabhinethi isemukele ngekushaceka sincumo se-General Motors South Africa (i-GMSA) (Pty) Ltd sekuyekela kukhicita nekutsengisa timoto teluhlobo lwe-Chevrolet kulelive.
tgt: Kabinete e swabisitswe ke tshwetso ya General Motors South Africa (GMSA) (Pty) Ltd ya go fedisa tlhagiso le thekiso ya dirori tsa Chevrolet mo nageng e. Se se na le ditlamorago tse di sa itumediseng mo go ba ba tla latlhegelwang ke ditiro le mo ikonoming ya rona.

src: Loku kunemphumela lomubi kakhulu kulabo labatawulahlekelwa yimisebenti yabo kanye nasemnotfweni welive lakitsi.
tgt: Puso e tswelela ka maikemisetso a yona a go tshegetsa lekala la dirori mo nageng e, le le leng botlhokwa mo ikonoming le go tlhola WEBTOKEN dti ba tswelela go dirisana le bannaleseabe botlhe go fokotsa ditlamorago tsa se.

src: Hulumende uyachubeka nekwesekela umkhakha walelive lokhicita timoto, lobaluleke kakhulu kutemnotfo nasekudaleni ematfuba emisebenti.
tgt: Go oketsa tlhagiso, go tlholwa ga ditiro le kgolo ya thomelontle, re sa tswa go thankgolola kgato ya borobongwe ya Leanotiro la Pholisi ya Madirelo (IPAP) go re supetsa tsela.

src: I-dti iyachubeka nekusebentisana nalabatsintsekako kute kutsi kuncishiwe lelifutse.
tgt: Kabinete e tlhaloganya gore Isuzu, e e ntseng e le mo semphatong le GMSA dingwaga di le dintsi mo Aforika Borwa, e tla dira ditiro tse di neng di dirwa ke GMSKabinete e lemogile go etegela ga maemo a komelelo kwa Kapa Bophirima le Kapa Botlhaba.

src: Ikhabhinethi imema yonkhe imimango kutsi yesekele imikhawulo yekusetjentiswa kwemanti lengeniswe tifundza.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go baagi go tshegetsa dikganelo tsa metsi tse di tlhomilweng ke diporofense tse.

src: Licembu lelifaka ekhatsi tisebenti teLitiko Letemanti Nekuhanjiswa Kwendle, Likomidi Lekulawula Tinhlekelele Lavelonkhe lisebentisana netifundza kanye nahulumende wendzawo, belimatasatasa licinisekisa kutsi tisombululo tethemu yesikhashana nalesemkhatsini tiyasheshiswa kute kutsi kucinisekiswe kutfolakala kwemanti esifundza ethemini lendze.
tgt: Setlhopha se se nang le batlhankedi go tswa kwa Lefapheng la Metsi le Kgeleloleswe, Komiti ya Bosetšhaba ya Taolo ya Matlhotlhapelo ka tirisano le diporofense le pusoselegae, e ntse e semeletse go netefatsa gore ditharabololo tsa pakakhutshwane go ya go tsa pakagare di a itlhaganedisiwa go netefatsa tshireletso ya tlamelo ka metsi mo diporofenseng tseno mo pakateleleng.

src: Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kufaka ekhatsi ebantfu emakhaya, emabhizinisi, umkhakha wetimbiwa, temandla netekulima kutsi basebentisane futsi basebentise emanti ngekuwonga kakhulu.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go akaretsa mo magaeng, dikgwebo, lekala la meepo, maatla le temothuo go dirisana mmogo go dirisa metsi ka tshomarelo.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyemukele idokhumenti lekhuluma ngeNdlelalisu Yekulwa Nenkhohlakalo, lekutawumiselwa kuyo Indlelalisu Yavelonkhe Yekulwa Nenkhonhlakalo.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go rebolwa ga tokomane ya dipuisano ya Togamaano Kgatlhanong le Bonweenwee, e e tla nnang mosupatsela mo Togamaanong ya Bosetšhaba Kgatlhanong le Bonweenwee.

src: Ikhabhinethi imema bantfu kutsi bafake ligalelo ngekutfumela mibono yabo kwiwebhusayithi yeLitiko Letekuhlela, Kucaphela Nekulinganisa: www.
tgt: Kabinete e laletsa baagi go neela ditshwaelo tse di kwadilweng ka go dirisa webosaete ya Lefapha la Tiromaano,Tekolo le Tshekatsheko ya Tiro: www.

src: zaKulwa nenkhohlakalo kuyachubeka nekuba yintfo yahulumende lenkhulu lebekwa embili.
tgt: Ntwa kgatlhanong le bonweenwee ke nngwe ya dintlhakgolo mo pusong.

src: Inkhohlakalo nekungatsembeki kwahulumende nemkhakha wangasese kunemiphumela lemibi kabi ekutfutfukeni kwelive letfu.
tgt: Bonweenwee le maitsholo a a maswe mo makaleng a poraefete le a puso di na le ditlamorago tse di maswe mo tlhabololong ya naga ya rona.

src: Ikhabhinethi ivakalise kukhatsateka mayelana nekuhlaselwa kumoshwe luhlelo lwabongcondvomshini lwemave emhlaba, lokusandza kwenteka lokubikwe njengekuhlaselwa lokukhulu kakhulu kwenchubo yabondvomshini yemhlaba lokungakate sekube khona.
tgt: Kabinete e supile fa e tshwenyegile thata ka tlhaselo ya diwebosaete go ralala lefatshe, e e runtseng go sa le gale mme e kaiwa e le yona e kgolo fa e sale.

src: Ikhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bacaphele nabachumana ngekwe-elekhthronikhi nanoma babhanga.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa go ntsha matlho dinameng ka gale fa ba dirisa ditsela tsa ileketeroniki go tlhaeletsana kgotsa go dira diphetisetso tse dingwe.

src: Kunconywa kutsi kusetjentiswe ema-software lalwa nemavayirasi lahambisana nesikhatsi lahlala njalo agadzile futsi ashayenyela tinhlelo te-inthanethi.
tgt: Tiriso ya dithibela-tsenelelo tsa sešweng tsa dikhomphiutha tse di lekolang tikologo ya dikhomphiutha gangwe le gape le tsona di botlhokwa.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyakhatsateka mayelana netehlakalo letisandza kwenteka e-Eskom.
tgt: Kabinete gape e tlhobaediwa ke ditiragalo tsa sešweng kwa Eskom.

src: Kuyayitfokotisa Ikhabhinethi kutsi loludzaba lolumayelana nekucashwa kabusha kweMnu Brian Molefe njengeSikhulu Lesiphetse (i-CEO) e-Eskom selusenkantolo nasePhalamende, futsi iyayihlonipha lenchubo.
tgt: Kabinete e lemoga gore ntlha ya go thapiwa gape ga ga Rre Brian Molefe jaaka Motlhankedikhuduthamagamogolo (CEO) kwa Eskom e kwa kgotlatshekelo le kwa Palamenteng, ka jalo e tla ikobela ditiragalo tseo.

src: Mengameli, nanoma kunjalo, sewusungule Likomidi Letindvuna (i-IMC) lelifaka ekhatsi Indvuna Yetemabhizinisi Ahulumende, yeTemandla, yeTetimali neyeTebulungiswa Nekucondziswa Kwesimilo.
tgt: Le fa go le jalo, Moporesitente o tlhomile Komiti ya Ditona (IMC) e e nang le Tona ya Dikgwebo tsa Puso, ya Maatla, ya Matlotlo le Bosiamisi le ya Ditirelo tsa Kgopololo.

src: Le-IMC icelwe kutsi igcogce emaciniso kute kutsi akhombe Ikhabhinethi indlela mayelana nekutsi kungabukwana kanjani netindzaba letinjena esikhatsini lesitako.
tgt: IMC e kopilwe go kokoanya dintlha gore di kgone go kaela Kabinete gore e ka samagana jang le merero e mo isagong.

src: Itawuhlangiswa yiNdvuna yeTebulungiswa Nekucondziswa Kwesimilo, Michael Masutha.
tgt: Moeteledipele ke Tona ya Bosiamisi le Ditirelo tsa Kgopololo, Michael Masutha.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweMculu Lobuyeketiwe Wemkhakhubanti Wekuhlomisa Labamnyama Ngemakhono Etemnotfo yemboni yaseNingizimu Afrika yeTetimayini Netimbiwa nga-2017.Indvuna yeTimbiwa Mosebenzi Zwane utawetfula inkhulumo uma lomculu sewufakwe kugazethi.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Tumelano e e Tlhabolotsweng ya Matlafatso e e Anameng ya Bantsho mo Ikonoming ya intaseteri ya Meepo le Diminerale ya Aforika Borwa ka 2017.Tona ya Meepo Mosebenzi Zwane o tla tlamela ka pegelo fa tumelano e e sena go phasaladiwa.

src: Ikhabhinethi iluvumile Luhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwemagagasi Emsakato Wemoya lweLitiko Letakhiwonchanti Tetekuchumanisa Netinsita Teliposi.
tgt: Kabinete e mametleletse Leano la Bosetšhaba la Marang a Radio ka Lefapha la Mafaratlhatlha a Ditlhaeletsano le Ditirelo tsa Poso.

src: Lokwabiwa kwemtsamo wemagagasi emsakato wemoya yiKhomfa Yemave Emahlaba yeTekuchumana ngeMsakato weMoya kunelifutse lelihle ekukhuleni kwemnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Go abiwa ga marang ke Khonferense ya Lefatshe ya Radiocommunication go na le seabe sa botlhokwa mo kgolong ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Luhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwemagagasi Emsakato Wemoya lwanga-2017 lungumtfombo lomkhulu wemtsamo wemagagasi emsakato wemoya lowabelwa tinsita letehlukene tekuchumana ngemsakato wemoya.
tgt: Leano la Bosetšhaba la Marang a Radio ke motswedi o o tletseng wa kabo ya marang a ditirelo tse di farologaneng tsa tlhaeletsano ka radio.

src: Luhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwemagagasi Emsakato Wemoya lwanga-2017 lolubuyeketiwe lucinisekisa kutsi iNingizimu Afrika iyahambisana neMitsetfo Yemave Emhlaba Yemsakato Wemoya leyemukelwa nga-2015 kukhomfa Yemhlaba Yebunye beTekuchumana ngeMsakato weMoya.
tgt: Leano la Bosetšhaba la Marang a Radio le le tlhabolotsweng la 2017 le netefatsa gore Aforika Borwa o nyalana le Melawana ya Boditšhaba ya Radio e e amogetsweng kwa khonferenseng ya Kopano ya Mafaratlhatlha a Ditlhaeletsano ya Boditšhaba (ITU) ka 2015.

src: Ikhabhinethi iluvumile Luhlelolisu Lwetekuphepha Emachibini.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Togamaano ya Pabalesego ya Ditselana tsa Metsi.

src: Loluhlelolisu, ngekusebentisa Umtimba Wetekuphepha Elwandle waseNingizimu Afrika, lubeka emazinga lubuye futsi luphucule tinchubo tekuniketa timvume nekuhlelela kuniketwa emalayisense etikebhe letisebenta emachibini.
tgt: Togamaano e, ka Bothati ba Pabalesego ya Mawatle a Aforika Borwa, e tlhoma maemo le go tsweletsa mekgwatsamaiso ya go letla le go rebolela dikepe dilaesense tsa go dira mo metsing a e seng a kwa mawatleng.

src: Loku kutawucinisekisa kuphepha kwetikebhe letincane emachibini aseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Se se tla netefatsa pabalesego ya diketswana tse mo metsing a a seng kwa mawatleng mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Ikhabhinethi iluvumile Luhlelolisu Lwekutfutsa Imikhicito Ngetitfutsi Temgwaco.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Togamaano ya Dithoto mo Tseleng.

src: Loluhlelo luhlose kwakha luhlakamsebenti loluhlanganisile lwekulawula nekusebenta, lolutawenta kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ikwati kuzuza emazinga emhlaba lahamba embili ekusebenta kwetitfutsi temikhicito temgwaco.
tgt: Togamaano e e ikaelela go tlhola letlhomeso la taolo e e momaganeng e bile e dira sentle, e e tla netefatsang gore Aforika Borwa o fitlhelela maemo a a gaisang a boditšhaba a ditiro tsa tsamaiso ya dithoto ka tsela.

src: Tincomo kuloluhlelolisu titawenta kancono kusebenta kahle, tikhutsata kuphepha emgwacweni, kwenta kancono kuvikelwa kwesakhiwonchati, kunciphisa lifutse kutemvelo, kanye nekusungula luhlakamsebenti lwemncintiswano lolawulwa ngekwelizinga lelifanele lapho khona umkhakha wemikhicito lehanjiswa ngetitfutsi temgwaco ungachubeka ufeze tidzingo temnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Dikatlenegiso mo letlhomesong le di tla netefatsa nonofo ya tiragatso, thotloetso ya pabalesego mo tseleng, fokotsa seabe mo tikologong, le go tlhola letlhomeso le le momaganeng la kgaisano e e laolwang ka boleng e mo go yona lekala la tsamaiso ya dithoto ka tsela e tla tswelelang go direla ditlhokego tsa maAforika Borwa tsa ikonomi.

src: Ikhabhinethi iwavumile emadizayini eNkampani Leyakha Luhlavumali yaseNingizimu Afrika anga-2017 na-2018 etimendlela tekugubha umkhosi wekukhumbula netinhlavumali letitawesetjentiswa ngebantfu.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse ditebego tse dišwa tsa madi a segopotso le a a tla dirisiwang ka 2017 le 2018.Ka tirisano le Kabinete, motseletsele o mošwa o, o ne wa tlhongwa go supa setso, kgololesego le temokerasi ka fa tlase ga setlhogo: “Go keteka Aforika Borwa”.

src: Ngekubambisana neKhabhinethi, kwakhiwe luchungechunge lolusha lolumelela emasiko, inkhululeko kanye nentsandvo yelinyenti ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kugubha umkhosi weNingizimu Afrika”.
tgt: Ngwagakgolo wa botsalo jwa mogaka wa Kgaratlho, Oliver Reginald Tambo o ne wa tlhophiwa jaaka setlhogo sa ntlha go supiwa.

src: Iminyaka elikhulu yekutalwa kwelishanhlitiyo leMzabalazo Oliver Reginald Tambo ikhetfwe njengentfo yekucala.
tgt: Go tlhagisiwa ga ledi la tshipi le lešwa la R50 (1oz, selefera e e tsabakelang), ledi la tshipi la R500 (1oz, gauta ya 24-carat) le ledi la tshipi la R50 (metale wa motheo) go keteka ngwaga wa bo100 wa letlha la matsalo la ga OR Tambo.

src: Kungeniswa kweluhlavumali lolusha i-R50 (i-1oz, sterling-silver), luhlabumali lwe-R500 (i-1oz, 24-carat gold) neluhlavumali i-R50 (base metal alloy) lwekugubha umkhosi weminyaka le-100 welusuku lwekutalwa kwa-OR Tambo.
tgt: Ditebego tsa motseletsele wa madi a tshipi a a latelang a 2017 le 2018 di tlhagisitswe:a. Motseletsele wa madi a tshipi wa 2017: Keteko ya Ngwagakgolo wa Oliver Reginald Tambob.

tgt: Ledi le le phasaladiwang la 2017: ledi la R5 le le supang Letshwao la Tlotlo la Ditsala tsa ga OR Tamboc.

tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go tshegetsa Beke ya Tshireletso ya Bana go tloga ka la bo 28 Motsheganong go fitlha ka la bo 4 Seetebosigo ka fa tlase ga setlhogo: “Tlaang rotlhe re sireletse bana go isa Aforika Borwa kwa pele”.

src: Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi besekele Liviki Lekuvikelwa Kwebantfwana kusukela mhla tinge-28 Inkhwekhweti kuya kumhla ti-4 Inhlaba ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Sonkhe asivikele bantfwana kute kutsi sichubele iNingizimu Afrika embili”.
tgt: Tshireletso ya bana ke tiro le maikarabelo a maAforika Borwa otlhe batsadi, batlhokomedi, motho ka nosi le setšhaba.

src: Kuvikela bantfwana betfu kungumsebenti nesibopho sabo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika batali, banakekeli bebantfwana, bantfu kanye nemmango.
tgt: Jaaka setšhaba re na le maikarabelo a go dira go le gontsi go netefatsa gore ba ba bokoa go gaisa mo setšhabeng sa rona ga ba sotlakiwe.

src: Singummango sinemsebenti wekutsi sente lokunyenti kucinisekisa kutsi bantfu belive lakitsi labasengotini yekuhlaseleka kalula abahlukunyetwa.
tgt: Go mo thateng ya rona go thibela tswelelo ya go itlhokomolosa, tirisobotlhaswa, tirisodikgoka le tsholo e e makgwakwa ya bana.

src: Kusetandleni tetfu kutsi sivimbe kunganakwa, kuhlukunyetwa, kwentiwa budlova kanye nekucashatwa kwebantfwana.
tgt: Kabinete e rotloetsa makala otlhe a baagi go dira mmogo go tlhola setšhaba se se babalesegileng e bile se itekanetse gore bana ba rona ba tshele sentle.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikhutsata yonkhe imikhakha yemmango kutsi isebentisane kute kutsi kube nemimango letse kuphepha kakhulu nalenemphilo kute kutsi bantfwana betfu bakhule futsi baphile ngendlela lefanele.
tgt: Mo ketekong ya ngwagakgolo wa ga OR Tambo, Aforika Borwa e tla bo e keteka Ngwaga wa Bašwa ka Seetebosigo 2017 ka fa tlase ga setlhogo: “Ngwaga wa ga OR Tambo: Go Tsweletsa Seabe sa Bašwa mo Ikonoming.”Mo kgweding e puso e tla nna le matsholo a a farologaneng a bašwa go akaretsa dipontsho, ditherisano mafelo a dikgwebo a bašwa go bontsha ditšhono tse bašwa ba ka nnnang natso le go ba rotloetsa go tsepama mo meonong ya thuto le boeteledipele ya ga OR Tambo.

src: Ekugubheni umkhosi wemnyaka elikhulu wekutalwa kwa-OR Tambo, iNingizimu Afrika itawugubha Inyanga yeLusha ngeNhlaba 2017 ngaphasi kwalengcikitsi: “Umnyaka wa-OR Tambo: Kutfutfukisa Kuhlanganyela Kwelusha Kutemnotfo.”Kuyo lenyanga hulumende utawubamba tingcoco letinyenti letifaka ekhatsi imikhangiso yelusha, tingcoco netikhungo tetemabhizinisi telusha tekukhangisa ematfuba lakhona ebantfu labasha, aphindze futsi abafake inshisekelo yekutsi bajulise emagugu ekufundza newebuholi a-OR Tambo.
tgt: Kabinete e rotloetsa bašwa botlhe go fitlhelela mananeo a a farologaneng a tshegetso le thuto a puso a a tlhagisang go tokafatsa ditšhono tsa bona le go tsweletsa seabe sa bona mo ikonoming.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikhutsata bonkhe bantfu labasha kutsi bafinyelele kwesekelwa lokunyenti lokwehlukahlukene netinhlelo tetemfundvo hulumende latente kutsi tibe khona kute kutsi kwentiwe kancono loko labalindzele kuphumelela kuko kanye nekutfutfukisa kuhlanganyela kwabo kutemnotfo.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go bathapi go nna le seabe mo lenaneong la e ya le mosetsayana tirong ka la bo 25 le la bo 26 Motsheganong.

src: Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe bacashi kutsi bafake ligalelo kulomkhosi lotako lobitwa ngekutsi i-Take a girl child to work mhla tinge-25 Inkhwekhweti namhla tinge-26 Inkhwekhweti.
tgt: Maitlhomo ke go supetsa basetsana ba Mephato ya 10 go fitlha go ya 12 mefuta e e farologaneng ya ditiro tse ba ka ithutelang tsone.

src: Mengameli Zuma ngaLesine, 25 Inkhwekhweti 2017, utawungenisa kugujwa kwemkhosi wavelonkhe weLilanga le-Afrika wanga-2017 eSefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse ePitoli.
tgt: Moporesitente Zuma ka Labone, la bo 25 Motsheganong 2017 o tla nna moamogelabaeng wa keteko ya bosetšhaba ya Letsatsi la Aforika la 2017 kwa Ntlong ya Baeng ba Moporesitente ya Sefako Makgatho kwa Pretoria.

src: Loku kukupheleliswa kwemisebenti netinhlelo tekugubha umkhosi weNyanga ye-Afrika ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Umnyaka wa-OR Tambo: Kwakha i-Afrika Lencono neMhlaba Loncono”.
tgt: Se e tla bo e le tsweletso ya ditiragalo le mananeo a a ntseng a le teng go keteka Kgwedi ya Aforika ka fa tlase ga setlhogo: “Ngwaga wa OR Tambo: Go Aga Aforika o o Botoka le Lefatshe le le Botoka”.

src: Kugujwa njalo ngemnyaka kwemkhosi wekukhumbula Lilanga le-Afrika kugubha umkhosi wekusungulwa kweNhlangano yeBunye be-Afrika (i-OAU) nga-1963.Lapho siphetsa Inyanga ye-Afrika, Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi babambisane nebantfu bakitsi base-Afrika labahlala eNingizimu Afrika nakuletinye tindzawo talelivekati lase-Afrika kucinisekisa kundlondlobala kwesigodzi setfu kanye ne-Afrika yonkhe.
tgt: Keteko ya ngwaga le ngwaga ya Letsatsi la Aforika le ka ga go tlhangwa ga Mokgatlo wa Tshwaraganelo ya Aforika (OAU) ka 1963.Jaaka re konosetsa Kgwedi ya Aforika, Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go dirisana le balekane ba bangwe ba Aforika ba ba nnang mo Aforika le mafelo a mangwe mo kontinenteng e go netefatsa tswelopele ya kgaolo ya rona le Aforika WEBTOKEN maikarabelo gape a botlhe ba ba nnang mo nageng ya rona, maAforika Borwa le baditšhaba go ikobela melao ya naga.

src: Kusemahlombe abo bonkhe bantfu labahlala ngekhatsi kweminyele yetfu, bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nebetive ngekufanana kutsi bagcina imitsetfo yalelive.
tgt: Mmogo re tshwanetse go lwantsha kgwebo ka batho, go thopiwa le tiriso e e botlhaswa ya basadi le bana.

src: Imilayeto yekuhalalisela.
tgt: Melaetsa ya dikakgolo.

src: Ikhabhinethi ihalalisela licembu letekwelashwa leNnyuvesi yaseStellenbosch nesibhedlela i-Tygerberg Academic Hospital lelifaka ekhatsi Solwati Andre van der Merwe, Dkt.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola setlhopha sa dingaka sa Yunibesithi ya Stellenbosch le Bookelo jwa Tygerberg Academic se se nang le Moporofesara Andre van der Merwe, Ngaka Alexander Zuhlke, Moporofesara Rafique Moosa, Ngaka Amir Zarrabi le Ngaka Zamira WEBTOKEN ne go sale gale ba dira karo ya go jalelela serwe sa bonna ya bobedi e leng se se dirang gore e nne tikwatikwe ya ntlha ya boitekanelo mo lefatsheng go ka dira karo e ka katlego lekgetlho la bobedi.

src: Basandza kwenta luhlindvo lwesibili loluyimphumelelo lwekufakwa kwesitfo salabadvuna sangasese sangembili, lokwente lesikhungo setekwelashwa kutsi sibe sekucala ngca emhlabeni lesente loluhlindvo kabili futsi lwaba yimphumelelo.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse Phaka ya iSimangaliso Wetland ka go amogela Sekgele sa Manontlhotlho mo Boruning kwa Dikabong tsa Botswerere mo Lekaleng la Puso tsa Setheo sa Diakhaontente sa Aforika Borwa (SAICA) go sale gale mo kgweding e. Kabo e ke ya go tlotla Phaka e ka go amogela boruni jo bo senang dilabe dingwaga di le tlhano ka tatelano.

src: Lokuphumelela kwaloluhlindvo lebelwentiwa licembu letfu lekuhlindza kubufakazi belikhono nebucwepheshe lobusezingeni leliphakeme kakhulu lobukhona emkhakheni wetemphilo wahulumende eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: iSimangaliso e ne ya goelediwa jaaka Lefelo la Ngwaoboswa la Lefatshe la ntlha mo Aforika Borwa ka Sedimonthole 1999.

src: Ikhabhinethi ihalalisela iSimangaliso Wetland Park ngekuklonyeliswa Umklomelo Weluhlolomabhuku Lwekusebenta Ngalokusezingeni Leliphakeme Emkhosini Wemiklomelo Yekusebenta Ngalokusezingeni Leliphakeme weSouth African Institute of Chartered Accountants (i-SAICA) ekucaleni kwalenyanga.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola lenaane la Go Dira ka Molelo ka go amogela sefikantswe go tswa go Puso ya Alberta kwa Canada jaaka segopotso sa thuso e e tlametsweng ke lenaane le mo go laoleng melelo ya naga mo Porofenseng ya bona ka 2016.

src: Lomklomelo bewuwekubongela iSimangaliso Wetland Park ngekutfola imiphumela yeluhlolomabhuku lemihle iminyaka lesihlanu lelandzelanako.
tgt: Go Dira ka Molelo ke Lenaane le le Atolositsweng la Ditiro tsa Setšhaba (EPWP) le maikaelelo a lona e leng go neela bašwa ba banna le basadi ditšhono tsa ditiro.

src: IKhabhinethi yahlangana ngaLesitsatfu, mhla ti-7 Inhlaba 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.
tgt: Kabinete e ne e tshwere kopano ya yona ka la bo, 7 Seetebosigo 2017, kwa Tuynhuys, Motsekapa.

src: TINDZABA LETIMCOKA EVENI.1 Ikhabhinethi iyaphindza igcizelela simemo saMengameli Jacob Zuma sekumema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bahlangane balwe nebudlova nekuhlukunyetwa kwabomake nebantfwana, iyaphindze futsi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi batsatse tinyatselo letiphutfumako tekucedza loluhlupho emimangweni yetfu.
tgt: Kabinete e boeleditse boikuelo jwa ga Moporesitente Jacob Zuma jwa gore maAforika Borwa a tshwaragane kgatlhanong le tirisodikgoka le go bogisiwa ga basadi le bana, le go ikuela mo go maAforika Borwa otlhe go tsaya dikgato ka ponyo ya leitlho tsa go fedisa setlwaedi seno mo metseng ya rona.

src: Loku kulandzela kuvakasha kwaMengameli e-Elsies River eKapa ayokwesekela Imbizo Yekulwa neBugebengu.
tgt: Seno se latela leeto la ga Moporesitente kwa Elsies River, kwa Motsekapa, mo go tshegetseng letsholo la Imbizo la Ntwa Kgatlhanong le Bosenyi.

src: Lokuvakasha kuphindze kwagcamisa kuhlaseleka kalula kwabomake nebantfwana emmangweni.
tgt: Leeto leno gape le nopotse go nna mo tlalelong ga basadi le bana mo metseng ya rona.

src: Mengameli uphindze wabuyela wayobuka lendzawo wayobuka letinsayeya letinyenti tebugebengu nekubulawa ikakhulu kwebantfwana nekutsi tiphatsimandla tekucinisekisa kulandzelwa kwemtsetfo tingatenta kancono kanjani tinsita tato kulommango.2 Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kukhishwa kweLuhlayo Lwemakhaya Lolwetayelekile lwanga-2016, loluchubekako nekukhombisa inchubekelembili ekufezekisweni kwetinhlelo tahulumende kwenta kancono timphilo tebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulu imimango lebeyincishwe ematfuba phambilini.
tgt: Moporesitente o ne a swetsa ka gore o tla boela kwa lefelong leno go tlhotlhomisa dikgwetlho tse dintsi tsa bosenyi le dipolao, bogolosegolo mo baneng le gore boramolao ba tla tokafatsa jang ditirelo tseo ba di abelang baagi ba foo.
