src: Ikhabinethi iyasemukela lesimemetelo seNhlangano Yemhlaba yeRugby lencome kutsi iNingizimu Afrika kube ngiyo lebamba umdlalo wendzebe Yemhlaba YeRugby we-2023.
tgt: Jaaka karolo ya go rotloetsa tiriso ya di-ICT ya go tlhoma ikonomi e e akaretsang botlhe, Kabinete e amogetse Molaotlhomo wa Setheo sa Naga sa Bokgoni jwa tsa Ileketeroniki wa iKamvao wa 2017 (Molaotlhomo wa iNeSI) gore o phasaladiwe mo Kaseteng ya Puso gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo ka one.

src: Ikhabinethi ibonga umsebenti weNdvuna Yetemidlalo Nekukhibika, Mnu Thulas Nxesi, Lisekela Mengameli, Cyril Ramaphosa kanye Nelitsimba leSouth African Rugby Union.
tgt: Molaotlhomo wa iNeSI o letlelela gore go tlhomiwe iNeSI jaaka setheo sa puso ka melao ya sona, go samagana le tlhaelo ya bokgoni jwa tsa ileketeroniki e e kgoreletsang dipeeletso, tlhabololo ya ikonomi ya loago mmogo le tlhabololo ya bokgoni mo nageng.

src: Ikhabinethi ihalalisela bonkhe labadlalako nalabo labawinile kuMcimbi Wemnyaka Welihlandla Le-15 Wekuklomelisa Kucamba Nekusungula Kumkhakha Wahulumende.
tgt: Seno se tla tlhoma mafelotlhagiso a didirisiwa tsa ICT mo porofenseng e nngwe le e nngwe, a a tla thusanang le iNeSI go tlhoma le go betla manaane le didirisiwa tsa katiso tse di maleba, go rotloetsa le go samagana le dipatlisiso tsa boitlhamedi, mmogo le go tlamela ka bokgoni jwa dipatlisiso mo baithuting ba dithuto tsa morago ga go konosetsa dithuto tsa ntlha tse dikgolwane.

src: Lemiklomelo yentelwa letindlela letinemphumelelo naletikahle tekwetfula tinsita letitfolakale ngekusebentisa tindlela tekucabanga, emasu kanye nemathulusi lafanele.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore go phasaladiwe mo Kaseteng ya Puso Molaotlhomo wa Diphetolo tsa Ditireloposo gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo ka one.

src: Ikhabinethi ihalalisela iSuperSport United FC ngekufika kumdlalo wemancamu we-CAF Confederation Cup emva kwekuhlula licembu laseTunisia iClub Africa nga-3-1 na-4-2 seyihlanganiswe yonkhe imiphumela.
tgt: Seno se tla fetola Diphetolo tsa Molao wa Ditireloposo wa bo 124 wa 1998.Molaotlhomo ono o letlelela gore lekala la poso lotlhe le ka rutlomololwa mme la rulaganngwa sešwa gore go nne le seabe mo phitlhelelong ya botlhe mo ditirelong tsa eleketeroniki tsa boithamedi fa mo letlhakoreng le lengwe le tswelela go tlamela ka ditireloposo tse di tlwaelegileng tse di boleng e bile di babalesegile.

src: Lelicembu lelatiwa ngekutsi Matsatsantsa litawudlala ne-TP Mazembe kumancamu emcudzelwano wesibili ngebukhulu kulelivekati lenyanga letako.
tgt: Seno se a thusa mo go nneng le boleng le seriti ka go fitlhelela tshedimosetso le ditireloposo tse di duelesegang, e leng se se samaganeng le tsa tlhabololo ya loago le go tokafatsa boleng jwa botshelo jwa motho ka nosi le jwa baagi.

src: Kubekwa EtikhundleniBonkhe labacokiwe kufanele bahlolwe ticu tabo kanye nekutsi bavumelekile kwenta lomsebenti.
tgt: Ditiragalo tse di TlangKabinete gape e amogetse tse dingwe tsa ditiragalo tse di tlang tse di leng mo Khalentarenng.

src: Bacondzisi beBhodi Yenhlangano yaseNingizimu Afrika Yemshwalensi Wemphahla Letfunyelwa Kulamanye Emave SOC Limited:a. Mk Lerato Herriette Mothae kanyeb.
tgt: Moporesitente Zuma o tla etela Sepetlele sa Baithuti sa Steve Biko kwa Tshwane ka la Botlhano, ka la bo 3 Ngwanaitseele Steve Biko go tlhokomela ka fao kabotirelo ya boitekanelo e diragadiwang ka yona, jaaka e le karolo ya Lenaale la Ditlhatlhobo tsa Moporesitente la Siyahlola.

src: IKhabhinethi beyihlangene ngaLesitsatfu, mhla ti-15 Lweti 2017 eTuynhuys, eKapa.
tgt: Kabinete e ne e tshwere kopano ya yona ka Laboraro, la bo 15 Ngwanaitseele 2017, kwa Tuynhuys, Motsekapa.

src: IKhabhinethi iyalwemukela lutjalotimali lwetigidzigidzi leti-R3 lweNkampani Yetimoto yakaFord lelufake kuSikhungomkhicito saseSilverton, ePitoli eGauteng.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse peeletso ya R3 bilione e e dirilweng ke Setlamo sa Ford Motor mo Polanteng ya kwa Silverton, Pretoria, Gauteng.

src: Lolutjalotimali lutakwenta kutsi kudaleke imisebenti ngco kuleSikhungomkhicito nakulamanye mabhizinisi lasebentisana naso ngenca yekwandza kwemkhicito lolindzelekile weluhlobo lwetimoto te-Ford Ranger.
tgt: Peeletso eno e tla tlhola ditiro tse di maleba le tse di seng maleba go lebilwe tlhagiso e e tla oketsegang ya sejanaga sa yona sa mobetlo wa Ford Ranger.

src: Lutjalotimali lolufute lolu lucinisekisa umsebenti lesichubeka njalo ngekuwenta njengahulumende ekukhuliseni umnotfo kanye nekulungisa tinsayeya tekuswelakala kwemsebenti.
tgt: Dipeeletso tsa mothale o di bontsha tiro eo re tsweletseng go samagana nayo jaaka puso mo go godiseng ikonomi le go samagana le dikgwetlho tsa botlhokatiro.

src: Ngekusebentisa sikimu sesibonelelo sahulumende setigidzigidzi leti-R.8 eLuhlelweni Lwekukhicitwa Nekutfutfukiswa Kwetimoto, kwadaleka lutjalotinmali lolutimele lwetigidzigidzi letinge-Loku kufaka ekhatsi simemetelo lesentiwe bakaToyota kutsi batakwakha tinhlobo tabo letinsha te-Toyota Hilux ne-Fortuner njengencenye yelutjalotimali lwetigidzigidzi leti-Kanye nekutsi futsi, nebaka-BMW bahlela kwakha sitolo setincenye temitimba yetimoto lesisezingeni lesibita tigidzigidzi leti-IBeijing Automobile International Corporation ihlela kufaka lutjalotimali lwetigidzigidzi leti-R11 kusikhungomkhicito lesakha timoto lapha eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Ka sekema sa puso mo Lenaaneng la Tlhagiso le Tlhabololo ya Dijanaga sa bokanaka R.8 bilione,go buletswe dipeeletso tsa ditlamo tsa poraefete tsa bokanaka R.5 bilione.

src: Sikhatsi Semtselo sanga-2017.
tgt: Tseno di akaretsa ditsiboso tse di dirilweng ke Toyota tsa maikaelelo a yona a go tlhagisa dijanaga tsa yona tsa mebetlo ya Toyota Hilux le Fortuner.

src: IKhabhinethi itsandza kuvakalisa kubonga kwayo kubo bonkhe labakhokha umtselo lasebavele sebawangenisile emafomu abo emtselo emnyakamtselo wanga-2016/17.
tgt: Kabinete e leboga baduelalekgetho botlhe bao ba setseng ba dirile dipusetso tsa lekgetho tsa ngwaga wa lekgetho wa 2016/17.

src: Imalingena letfolakala emtselweni icinisekisa kutsi hulumende akhone kuletsa tinsitakalo letidzingeka kakhulu kanye nekunika tibonelelo tetenhlalo tigidzi tebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labaswelako.
tgt: Madikokoanyo ao a kokoangwang go tswa mo lekgethong la megolo a kgontsha puso go nna le bokgoni jwa go tlamela ka ditirelo tse di tlhokagalang thata mmogo le go tshegetsa maAforika Borwa a a dikobo dikhutshwane.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuta labakhokha umtselo kutsi lusuku lolungumncamulajucu lwekungenisa emafomu emtselo nguLesihlanu tinge-24 Lweti 2017 futsi bayakhutsatwa kutsi bangenise emafomu abo emtselo.
tgt: Kabinete e gopotsa baduelalekgetho gore letlha la bofelo la go dira dipusetso tsa lekgetho ke Labotlhano la bo 24 Ngwanaitseele 2017 mme e ba rotloetsa go di tlisa go sa le gale.

src: Ikhomfa Yavelonkhe Yekutfutfukisa Temnotfo Wendzawo (i-LED).
tgt: Kamogelo ya Khonferense ya Naga ya Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi ya Selegae (LED).

src: IKhabhinethi iyayijabulela imiphumela yeKhomfa Yavelonkhe ye-LED lesandza kubanjwa.
tgt: Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke dipoelo tsa Khonferense ya Bosetšhaba ya LED e e neng e tshwerwe mo malobeng.

src: Beyibanjwe ngaphasi kwebuholi kweNdvuna yeLitiko Letekubusa Ngekubambisana Netendzabuko, Umnu Des van Rooyen kanye neNdvuna Yetekutfutfukisa Emabhizinisi Lamancane, Mk Lindiwe Zulu.
tgt: E ne e tshwerwe go latela boeteledipele jwa Tona ya Lefapha la Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Setso (COGTA), Rre Des van Rooyen mmogo le Tona ya Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Dikgwebopotlana, Mme Lindiwe Zulu.

src: Yadala litfuba lekusungula luhlelo lolusha LaseNingizimu Afrika Lwekutfutfukisa Temnotfo Wendzawo ngekuholwa nguloko lekumele kwentiwe kucala kweLisu Lavelonkhe Lentfutfuko (i-NDP).
tgt: E abelane ka tšhono ya go tlhagisa mogopolo o montšhwa wa LED ya Aforika Borwa o o supetswang tsela ke ditlapele tsa Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP).

src: Imiphumela yayo yafaka ekhatsi kwetfulwa kwekucala Kwemkhandlu waseNingizimu Afrika Wekutfutfukisa Temnotfo (i-EDCSA), lohlose kwenta lomkhakha wetentfutfuko yemnotfo kutsi uhanjiswe ngebungcweti.
tgt: Dipoelo tsa yona di akaretsa le go thankgololwa ga Lekgotla la Aforika Borwa le le Mabapi le Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi (EDCSA), leo maitlhomo a lona e leng go dira lekala la tlhabololo ya ikonomi gore e nne la seporofešenale.

src: Njengemtimba wetingcweti, i- EDCSA itawulawula futsi yeluse kutiphatsa ngebungcweti kwetisebenti letinengi letitimbandzakanya emitameni leyahlukene yentfutfuko.
tgt: Jaaka mokgatlho wa seporofešenale, EDCSA e tla laola le go lekola maitshwaro a seporofešenale a badiredi ba le bantsi bao ba tsayang karolo mo matsholong a a farologaneng a a ka ga tlhabololo.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze futsi yakubona kwetfulwa lokuyinchophamlandvo kweLiviki Letemhlaba Wonkhe Letemabhizinisi (i-GEW) e-22 On Sloane, sikhungo lesisha, mhla ti-10 Lweti 2017, lapho Indvuna Zulu beyemukele khona sihlabani lesatiwako, u-Sir Richard Branson.
tgt: Kabinete gape e etse tlhoko thankgololo ya hisetori ya Beke ya Lefatshe ya Baitshimololedikgwebo (GEW) kwa 22 e e kwa Sloane, eo e leng khamphase e ntšhwa ya boitshimololedi, ka la bo 10 Ngwanaitseele 2017, mo Tona Zulu a neng a amogetse moitseanape wa lefatshe wa boitshimololedikgwebo, Rre Richard Branson.

src: Isita ngekunita ngco tinsitakalo tekusekela bosomabhizinisi base-Afrika yonkhana kanye nekutsi bakhone kutsi bafinyelele kubaluleki, ebatjalitimali kanye nekusekelwa tinhlangano temabhizinisi temave emhlaba.
tgt: Khamphase eno ke yone ya ntlha go bulwa ke GEE tlamela ka ditirelo tsa tshegetso tse di molemo mo go baitshimololedikgwebo go ralala le Aforika mmogo le phitlhelelo ya lethathama la batlhatlheledi ba boditšhabatšhaba, babeeletsi mmogo le mekgatlho ya tshegetso ya boitshimololedikgwebo.

src: Ngesikhatsi seliviki le-GEW, bantfu labalinganiselwa etigidzini leti-10 labatimbandzakanye emicimbini, imisebenti nemicudzelwano lenge-35 000 emaveni langetulu kwe-165 emhlabeni wonkhe.
tgt: Mo nakong ya GEW, batsayakarolo ba ka nna 10 milione ba tsaya karolo mo meketeng, ditiragalong le dikgaisanong di ka nna 35 000 mo dinageng di feta 165 go ralala le lefatshe.

src: Umbiko weKhomishini yaHeher.
tgt: Pegelo ya Khomišene ya Heher.

src: IKhabhinethi ikubonile kukhishwa ngeMsombuluko, mhla ti-13 Lweti 2017 kweMbiko weKhomishini Lephenya Ngekufaneleka kwekwenta kutsi Imfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha kutsi ibe Mahhala eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Kabinete e nopotse go rebolwa ka Mosupologo, la bo 13 Ngwanaitseele 2017 ga Pegelo ya Khomišene e e mabapi le Dipatlisiso tse di mabapi le Kgonagalo ya go Dira gore Thuto le Katiso tse Dikgolwane di se duelelwe mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bawufundze lombiko kanye nemitselela yawo kulelive ngesikhatsi hulumende asatibuka letincomo.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo go maAforika Borwa otlhe go buisa pegelo eno mmogo le ditlamorago tsa yona mo nageng fa puso yona e santse e tsweletse go sekasekana le ditshtshinyo tsa yona.

src: Mengameli utawukhipha simemetelo lesimacondzana nalombiko khona nje madvute ngemuva kwekutsi Likomidi Lelihlanganisa Tindvuna Lekusita Ngetimali Imfundvo Lephakeme Nelikomidi LeMengameli Lesikhwama Setimali Tahulumende.
tgt: Moporesitente o tla neelana ka tsiboso mabapi le pegelo eno mo tsamaong ya nako go latela gore e sekasekiwe ke Komiti ya Ditona tsa ka fa Nageng ya Tlamelo ka Matlole a Thuto e Kgolwane mmogo le Komiti ya tsa Matlole ya Moporesitente.

src: Hulumende utimisele kusombulula tihibe tekungakhoni kufinyelela kutfola imfundvo lephakeme, nekutsi futsi uphokopholele ekutseni atfole sisombululo lesisimeme sekusita ngetimali imfundvo lephakeme.
tgt: Puso e tsweletse ka maikemisetso a yona a go rarabolola marara a a kgoreletsang phitlhelelo ya thuto e kgolwane, mme e ikaeletse go ka fitlhelela tharabololo e e tla nnelang ruri mabapi le tlamelo ka matlole a thuto e kgolwane.

src: Emazinga emanti emadamu lakhona eveni kwanyalo ayakhatsata ngobe kunekuhamuka lokukhulu kwemanti kunemvula lenako.
tgt: Maemo a metsi a ga jaanong kwa matamong a a tlhobaetsa ka ntlha ya fa go sena pula mme metsi a a mowafala.

src: Ngenca yesizatfu sekutsi iNingizimu Afrika ayikatfoli imvula leyanele kute kugcwale emadamu etfu kute kwenele emazinga emanti kusho kutsi lelive letfu lisengakaphumi esomisweni.
tgt: Ka ntlha ya fa Aforika Borwa e ntse e sa nelwe ke pula go le kalo go ka oketsa metsi a a leng mo metsweding ya rona ya metsi go raya gore naga e santse e le mo maemong a kakafalo.

src: Tangoma telitulu tibiketela kutsi lelive litawutfola imvula lenkhulu kusukela ekucaleni kwaBhimbidvwane 2018.
tgt: Ponelopele ya maemo a bosa e tlhalosa gore naga e tla nelwa ke dipula tse dintsi mo tshimologong ya Ferikgong 2018.

src: IKhabhinethi itsandza kucinisekisa sive kutsi hulumende wavelonkhe, wesifundza newasekhaya bayabambisana ekusebentisaneni ngekuhlanganyela kucinisekisa kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ayiphelelwa ngemanti.
tgt: Kabinete e batla go netefaletsa baagi gore puso ya naga, ya porofense le ya selegae e dirisana mmogo go netefatsa gore Aforika Borwa ga e kgale metsi.

src: IKhabhinethi igcugcutela wonkhe umuntfu kutsi adlale indzima yakhe ekongeni emanti kanye nekuwasebentisa ngekuhlakanipha nangekuwonga.
tgt: Kabinete e rotloetsa batho botlhe go nna le karolo mo go somareleng le mo go a diriseng ka go se a senye metsi.

src: IZimbabwe.
tgt: Zimbabwe.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwesekela kungenelela kwaMengameli Jacob Zuma, ngekwesikhundla sakhe sekuba nguSihlalo weNhlangano Yekutfutfukisa Emave ase-Afrika LengaseNingizimu (i-SADC) mayelana nesimo saseZimbabwe.
tgt: Kabinete e tshegetsa kgato ya tsereganyo e e tserweng ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma, mo maemong a gagwe jaaka Monnasetulo wa Dinaga tsa Mokgatlho wa Tlhabololo ya Borwa jwa Aforika (SADC) mo go tsibogeleng seemo sa kwa Zimbabwe.

src: Utfumele Litsimba Lelikhesetekile, Indvuna Yetekuvikela Netigayigayi Temphi, Mk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula kanye neNdvuna Yekuvikeleka Kwembuso, u-Adv Bongani Bongo.
tgt: O rometse Baromiwa ba Sesole ba ba Itlhophileng, Tona ya Sesole sa Tshireletso ya Naga le Bagale ba Sesole, Mme Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula mmogo le Tona ya Pabalesego ya Puso ya Naga, Moatefokate Bongani Bongo.

src: Batawuhlangana neMengameli Robert Mugabe kanye neMbutfo Wetekuvikela waseZimbabwe.
tgt: Ba tla kopana le Moporesitente Robert Mugabe mmogo le Sesole sa Tshireletso ya Naga ya Zimbabwe.

src: Emva kwaloko batawubese batjela Mengameli wase-Angola João Lourenço longuSihlalo weLuphiko Lwe-SADC Lwetepolitiki, Kuvikela Nekuphepha.
tgt: Ka jalo, ba tla tsibosa Moporesitente wa Angola João Lourenço mo maemong a gagwe jaaka Monnasetulo wa SADC mo Lekaleng la Sepolotiki, Sesole le Pabalesego.

src: Lihhovisi laMengameli litawubese-ke liyasho mayelana nekuchubeka kwetintfo mayelana naloludzaba.
tgt: Kantoro ya Moporesitente e tla abelana ka tshedimosetso e nngwe mo ntlheng eno fa nako e ntse e tsamaya.

src: I-Square Kilometre Array (i-SKA).
tgt: Arei ya Sekwere kilometara (SKA).

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela loko losekuzuziwe kutemnotfo nentfutfuko yetenhlalo lokutfolwe kulolutjalotimali kutentfutfuko yenhlalo kulesifundza se-SKA yaseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela diphitlhelelo tsa ikonomi le loago tse di tswang mo peeletsong e go tsepamisiwtsweng mogopolo mo go yona mo tlhabololong ya loago mo kgaolong ya SKA ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Imimango leyakhelene endzaweni lesedvute ne-SKA iyachubeka ngekutsi izuze ngekutfola imfundvo lencono kanye nemiklamo yekucecesha, lutjalotimali kumabhizinisi lamancane kanye nematfuba etemisebenti landzisiwe.
tgt: Metse e e gaufi le lefelo la SKA e tswelela go unngwelwa go tswa mo diporojekeng tsa thuto le katiso, peeletso mo dikgwebopotlaneng le koketsego ya ditšhono tsa ditiro.

src: Litiko Letesayensi Netheknoloji, leliholwa yiNdvuna Yetesayensi Netheknoloji, Mk Naledi Pandor, litawubaneluhlelo lwekutimbandzakanya kwemmango kute babungate imphumelelo bakanye nemimango leyakhelene neCarnavon, eNyakatfo Kapa kusukela mhla ti-16 kuya mhla ti-19 Lweti 2017.Tincumo teKhabhinethi.
tgt: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji, ka fa tlase ga boeteledipele jwa Tona ya lona, Mme Naledi Pandor, le tla tshwara lenaane la go tsaya karolo ga setšhaba go keteka diphitlhelelo le baagi ba tikologo ya Carnarvon, Kapa Bokone go simolola ka la bo 16 go fitlha ka la bo 19 Ngwanaitseele 2017.Ditshwetso tsa Kabinete.

src: Imibiko yenchubekelembili yekusebenta kwekota yesibili yanga-2017/1.
tgt: Pegelo ya kgweditharo ya bobedi ya tiragatso ya tiro 2017/1.

src: IKhabhinethi yachazelwa mayelana nemibiko yenchubekelembili yekusebenta kwekota yesibili yanga-2017/18 (Kholwane kuya enyangeni yeNyoni 2017) yawo onkhe osihlanu emacembu.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotswe ka dipegelo tsa kgweditharo ya bobedi ya tiragatso ya tiro tsa 2017/18 (Phukwi go fitlha go Lwetse 2017) tsa makala otlhe a le matlhano.

src: Loku kwakha incenye lebanti yeLuhlelo Lwekwenta lwekucaphela nekulinganisa lweKhabhinethi lolutsatselwe kuLuhlaka Lwendlelalisu Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini (i-MTSF) 2014 kuta ku-2019.
tgt: Seno ke karolo ya Lenaanetiro le legolo la Kabinete le le ka ga tekolo le tshekatsheko go tswa mo Letlhomeso la Togamaano ya Pakagare (MTSF) la 2014 go fitlha go 2019.

src: Litiko Letekuhlela, Kucaphela Nekulinganisa kanye nemakomidi Emacembu eTindvuna atawubamba umhlangano nebetindzaba kute achaze ngenchubekelembili yalemibiko.
tgt: Lefapha la Tiromaano,Tekolo le Tshekatsheko ya Tiro mmogo le Komiti ya Ditona tsa Makala ba tla tshwara ditsiboso tsa bobegakgang go ka tlharolola kgatelopele e e dirilweng go ya ka dipegelo tseno.

src: Luphiko Lwahulumende Lwetekuchumana Nelwatiso (i-GCIS) lutawuchumanisa lomhlangano nebetindzaba bese lushicilela loko lokutawukwentiwa ku: WEBTOKEN kungasikudzala.
tgt: Mo tsamaong ya nako GCIS e tla rulaganya ditsiboso tseno tsa bobegakgang le go phasalatsa lenaneothulaganyo la tsone mo go WEBTOKEDitsibosopeonakong ka ga letsholo la go tsenya diaterese le go neelana ka diaterese.

src: Lwatiso ngekuchubeka kwetintfo lokumayelana nemtamo wekutfola emakheli nekufaka emakheli.
tgt: Kabinete e tsopoletswe ka ga pegelo ya kgatelopele mo go tsenyeng tirisong Katlholo ya Kgotlatshekelo ya Molaotheo ya go tsenya diaterese mo lenaaneng la batlhophi.

src: IKhabhinethi yatjelwa ngalamafishane mayelana nembiko wenchubekelembili ngekucala kwekusebenta kweSehlulelo Senkantolo Yemtsetfosisekelo sekufaka emakheli eluhlwini lwebavoti.
tgt: Kabinete e leboga kobamelo ka botlalo ya pegelo ya kgatelopele ya dikgwedi di le thataro e e rometsweng kwa Kgotlatshekelo ya Molaotheo.

src: IKhabhinethi yakushayela tandla kuhambisana ngalokuphelele kwemibiko yetinyanga letisitfupha yenchubekelembili leyangeniswa eNkantolo Yemtsetfosisekelo.
tgt: Go fitlha ga jaanong khomišene ya Ditlhopho e e Ikemetseng (IEC), ka go dirisana mmogo le ditheo tse dingwe tsa puso, e fitlheletse katlego e e kanaka 75% mo go bokeletseng diaterese tsa batho bao ba batlang go ka tsenela ditlhopho.

src: Kute kube ngunyalo Ikhomishini Yelukhetfo Letimele (i-IEC), ngekusebentisana nalamanye ema-ejensi embuso, seyiphumelele kugcogca ngemphumelelo 75% emakheli ebavoti.
tgt: Kabinete gape e ne ya nopolelwa ka ga lenaane le le rulagantsweng ke ba Ditireloposo tsa Aforika Borwa (SAPO) go ka thusa bao ba senang diaterese mo metseng ya bona.

src: IKhabhinethi futsi yatjelwa ngalamafishane mayelana neluhlelo lolusungulwe baka-SAPO ekusiteni labo labete emakheli alapho bahlala khona.
tgt: Kabinete e itumeletse kgatelopele e e setseng e dirilwe go fitlha ga jaana mmogo le tirisanommogo magareng ga SAPO, IEC le ditheo tse dingwe tsa puso mo tirong eno ya porojekeng ya diaterese.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindza futsi icela labo labangakalweti lwabasesikhatsi lwatiso lwemakheli abo kutsi bakwente loko ngesikhatsi seliviki lekubhalisela kuvota lelitako ngenyanga yeNdlovulenkhulu 2018.Imicimbi Letako.
tgt: Kabinete gape e ikuela mo go bao ba iseng ba tsenyedinakong diaterese tsa bona gore ba dire jalo mo bekeng e e latelang ya ikwadisetso ditlhopho ka Mopitlwe 2018.Ditiragalo tse di Tlang.

src: Iseshini yesine yeKhomishini Yemave Lamabili yeNingizimu Afrika neBotswana (i-BNC).
tgt: Kopano ya bone ya Khomišene ya Dinagapedi (BNC) ya Aforika Borwa-Botswana.

src: Mengameli Zuma utawube avakashe ngekwemsebenti ekutimbandzakanyeni kanye nekuba ngusihlalo ngekuhlanganyela kuSeshini Yesine yeNingizimu Afrika neBotswana yeKhomishini Yemave Lamabili letawubanjelwa eGaborone, eBotswana ngaLesihlanu, mhla ti-17 Lweti 2017.
tgt: Moporesitente Zuma o tla tsaya leeto la tirelo go tsaya karolo le go nna monnasetulommogo mo Kopanong ya Bone ya BNC ya Aforika Borwa-Botswana e e tla tshwarelwang kwa Gaborone, Botswana ka Labotlhano, 17 Ngwanaitseele 2017.

src: INingizimu Afrika neleBotswana bahlangana ngemnyaka ezingeni Letinhloko Tembuso ngaphasi kweluhlakamsebenti lwe-BNC kute abukete kusebentisana emkhatsini walamave lamabili kanye nekucocisana ngetindzaba letiwatsintsa ngalokufanana lamave omabili.
tgt: Naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya Botswana di kopana ngwaga o mongwe le o mongwe mo maemong a go nna Ditlhogo tsa Dinaga mo letlhomesong la BNC go leba sešwa botsalano jwa bonagapedi mmogo le go buisanela merero e e amang dinaga ka bobedi.

src: Lamave lamabili anebudlelwane lobuhle ngenca yekuhlangana kwemasiko kanye nekwakhelana.
tgt: Dinaga ka bobedi di na le botsalano jo bo tseneletseng jo bo tlhodilweng ke kamano ya ditso tsa tsone le go nna baagisani ba ba gaufi.

src: Ayasebentisana etintfweni letinyenti lokufaka ekhatsi, tekutfutsa, kuhwebelana kanye nelutjalotimali, temphilo, temvelo, njll.
tgt: Di dirisana mo mererong e le mentsi e e akaretsang dipalangwa, kgwebisano le dipeeletso, boitekanelo, merero ya tikologo mmogo le merero e mengwe gape e mentsintsi.

src: INingizimu Afrika ingulelinye lemave lamcoka lahwebelana neleBotswana, lapho sikhandza khona tinkampani letinyenti taseNingizimu Afrika tisebenta kulela live.
tgt: Aforika Borwa ke mogwebisani yo mongwe wa bagwebisani ba bagolo ba Botswana, ka ditlamo di le mmalwa tsa yone tse ga jaanong di direlang kwa nageng eo.

src: Kuvakasha ngekweMbuso kwaMengameli wase-Angola.
tgt: Leeto la Semmuso la Moporesitente wa Puso ya Angola.

src: Mengameli Zuma utakwemukela Umhlonishwa, Mengameli waseRiphabhliki yase-Angola, João Lourenço, kuvakasha ngekweMbuso lokuyinchophamlandvo kusukela mhla tinge-23 Lweti 2017.
tgt: Moporesitente Zuma o tla amogela Motlotlegi, Moporesitente wa Rephaboliki ya Angola, João Lourenço, mo Leeto la Semmuso le le tla dirang hisetori mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa go simolola ka la bo 23 Ngwanaitseele 2017.

src: Loku kutawuba kuvakasha kwakhe kwekucala kulelive letfu emva kwekubekwa kwakhe kutsi abe nguMengameli.
tgt: Leno e tla nna Leeto la gagwe la Semmuso la ntlha mo nageng ya rona fa e sale a ikanisediwa go rwala puso mo magetleng a gagwe.

src: Lamave lamabili anebudlelwane lobacala kudzala ngesikhatsi sekuzabalazela inkhululeko ngesikhatsi live lase-Angola likhoselisa liphindze futsi lisekela tishikashiki temzabalazo lebetisetinkanjini letahlukahlukene kulela live.
tgt: Dinaga ka bobedi di na le botsalano jwa bogolotala le jwa tirisanommogo fa e sale mo nakong ya fa go ne go kgaratlhelwa kgololesego fa Angola e ne e amogetse le go tshegetsa balwelakgololesego ba Aforika Borwa ba ba neng ba le kwa dikampeng tse di farologaneng kwa nageng eo.

src: Kuhwebelana nekubambisana kutemnotfo emkhatsini walamave lamabili kukhule kakhulu, ngendlela yekutsi live laseNingizimu Afrika lilive leliphuma embili kunawo onkhe lelihwebelana ne-Angola kulelivekati.
tgt: Kgwebisano le tirisanommogo mo ikonoming magareng ga dinaga ka bobedi e oketsegile go utlwagala, mo ebileng Aforika Borwa e leng mogwebisani yo a di gogang kwa pele wa Angola mo kontinenteng.

src: Tinkampani letinyenti taseNingizimu Afrika tichuba emabhizinisi ato e-Angola emikhakheni leyahlukahlukene lokufaka ekhatsi tekwakha, tetimayini, tetindlu, tekutsengisa, kudla nalokunatfwako, emahhotela nekukhibika, temabhange kanye netinsitakalo tekwelapha.
tgt: Ditlamo di le dintsi tsa Aforika Borwa di dira dikgwebo kwa Angola mo makaleng a a farologaneng a a akaretsang setlamo sa dikago, sa meepo, sa dintlo, sa direkisiwa, sa dijo le dino, sa dihotele le botlhabakgobe, sa ditirelo tsa dibaka le tsa WEBTOKEN leetong la gagwe, Moporesitente Lourenço gape o tla ema ka lefoko phuthego ka Labotlhano, 24 Ngwanaitseele 2017 kwa OR Tambo Building mo Pretoria.

src: Tinsuku leti-16 Tekwecwayisa.
tgt: Matsatsi a le 16 a Bolweladitshwanelo.

src: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labatsatse sincumo sekulwa nekuhlukunyetwa kwabomake nebantfwana.
tgt: Kabinete e ikamanya le maAforika Borwa a a tsayang dikgato kgatlhanong le pogiso ya basadi le bana.

src: Lomkhankaso Wetinsuku leti-16 Tekulwa Nebudlova Lobentiwa kuBomake Nebantfwana utakwenteka kusukela emkhatsini wamhla tinge-25 Lweti namhla ti-10 Ingongoni 2017.
tgt: Letsholo la Matsatsi a le 16 a Bolweladitshwanelo Kgatlhanong le Tiririsodikgoka mo Basading le mo Baneng le tla simolola ka la bo 25 Ngwanaitseele go fitlha ka la bo 10 Sedimonthole 2017.

src: Lona ngumnyaka we-19 lomkhankhaso wentiwa lapha eNingizimu Afrika futsi utawuchubeka ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Nami Ngikhona: Sisonkhe Sichubela Embili iNingizimu Afrika Lete Budlova.”.
tgt: Ono ke ngwaga wa bo 19 wa letsholo leno mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa mme go tla tswelelwa ka lona ka moono yo o reng: “Mpale: Mmogo re Tsweletsa Pele Aforika Borwa yo o Senang Tirisodikgoka”.

src: Mengameli Zuma utakwetfula umkhankhaso weTinsuku Leti-16 Tekwecwayisa eMphumalanga Kapa ngeMgcibelo, mhla tinge-25 Lweti 2017.
tgt: Moporesitente Zuma o tla thankgolola letsholo la Matsatsi a le 16 a Bolweladitshwanelo mo Kapa Botlhaba ka Lamatlhatso, la bo 25 Ngwanaitseele 2017.

src: Utawube ugcile kuTinkhulumiswano Tavelonkhe letichubekako, letigcugcutela bantfu kutsi bakhulume ngalenkinga yebudlova bebulili.
tgt: Le tla tsepamisa mogopolo mo tsweletsong e e sa kgaotseng ya Dipusano tsa Bosetšhaba, e e rotloetsang batho go buisana ka leuba la tirisodikgoka e e totileng batho ba bong jo bo rileng (GBV).

src: Lomkhankhaso utakwendvulelwa Lusuku Lwemave Emhlaba Lwemadvodza ngeLisontfo, mhla ti-19 Lweti 2017, lapho kucelwa khona onkhe emadvodza kutsi adlale indzima yawo ekwakheni sive lesiphephile nesibumbene.
tgt: Seno se tla latelwa ke Letsatsi la Boditšhabatšhaba la Banna ka Latshipi, la bo 19 Ngwanaitseele 2017, leo le ikuelang mo banneng go tshameka karolo ya bona mo go ageng setšhaba se se bolokesegileng e bile se tshwaragane go ka nna seoposengwe.

src: Litiko Letebulungiswa Nekutfutfukiswa kweMtsetfosisekelo litawube lenta umkhankhaso wesibili wemsakato wemmango ngaphasi kweluhlelo lolutsi Let’s Talk Justice, loluletsa tinsikatalo tahulumende kubantfu ngekutsi banike balaleli litfuba lekucocisana nebaphatsi mayelana netindzaba letisematseni.
tgt: Lefapha la Bosiamisi le Tlhabololo ya Molaotheo le tla tsaya letsholo la bobedi la diyalemowa tsa baagi ka setlhogo sa yona sa Tla re Bueng ka Bosiamisi, leo le tlisang ditirelo tsa puso kwa baaging ka go neela bareetsi tšhono ya go buisana badiredipuso ka dintlha tse di kwa setlhoeng.

src: Kwetfulwa kweNkantolo Yemacala eTemacansi ngesikhatsi salomkhankhaso kutawucinisekisa kutsi kuba nekufinyelela lokuncono eluhlelweni lwetebulungiswa.
tgt: Go thankgolowla ga Kgotlatshekelo ya Dikgetse tsa Tlolomolao ya Thobalano mo nakong ya letsholo leno go tla netefatsa gape gore go nna bonolo go fitlhelela thulaganyo ya bosiamisi.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakholwa kutsi ngekusebenta ngekuhlanganyela singakucedza lokuhlukunyetwa lokuchubekako.
tgt: Kabinete e na le tshepo e e tletseng gore ka go dirisana mmogo re ka fedisa dipogisego.

src: Ngemitamo yetfu yekuhlanganyela singakhona kutsi sente lokutsi kute sivikele kuhlukunyetwa kodvwa sibe sicinisekisa kutsi bomake nebantfwana baphila eveni lelivikelekile.
tgt: Ka go dirisana mmogo re ka tsaya dikgato go thibela dipogisego fa mo letlhakoreng le lengwe re netefatsa gore re nna le setšhaba se se babalesegileng mo basading le mo baneng.

src: Bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhutsatwa kutsi bahlome emaribhoni lamhlophe njengeluphawu lwekutibophelela ekucedzeni lenkinga esiveni sakitsi.
tgt: Go ikuelwa mo baagi botlhe mo Aforika Borwa go apara lente le le tshweu go bontsha boikuelo jwa maikemisetso a go fedisa leuba leno mo setšhabeng sa rona.

src: Kwenta emalungiselelo eLusuku Lwemhlaba lweNgculazi (i-AIDS).
tgt: Itukisetso ya Letsatsi la Lefatshe ka ga AIDKabinete e ipiletsa mo go botlhe mo setšhabeng go tsaya karolo mo Labotlhanong wa Lente le le Khibidu go goteletsa kwa pele Letsatsi la Lefatshe ka ga AIDS ka la bo 1 Sedimonthole go fitlha kwa bokhutlhong jwa kgwedi eo.

src: IKhabhinethi icela wonkhe umuntfu kutsi atimbandzakanye kumalungesilelo landvulela Lesihlanu weTibhoni Lebovu (i-Redi Ribbon Friday) ngembikwkeutsi kucale Lusuku Lwemhlaba Lwe-AIDS mhla ti-01 Ingongoni kudzimate kube sekupheleni kwaleyo nyanga.
tgt: Go apara lente le le khibidu ke sesupo sa tshwaraganelo le maikemisetso a go lwantsha HIV le AIDLetsatsi la Lefatshe ka ga AIDS ke tšhono ya baagi botlhe go tshwaragana mo go lwantsheng HIV, ba bontshe tshegetso ya bao ba tshelang ka HIV le go gopola bao ba hulereng ka ntlha ya yona.

src: Kufaka iribhoni lebovu kuluphawu lwekuhlanganyela kanye nekutinikela ekulweni neSandvulelangculazi (i-HIV) ne-AIDLusuku Lwemhlaba Lwe-AIDS litfuba lapho yonkhe imimango ibumbana khona ekulweni ne-HIV, kukhombisa kwesekela labo bantfu labaphila neligciwane le-HIV kanye nekukhumbula labo labangasekho.
tgt: Mokete wa monongwaga o tla tshwarwa ka moono: “Ke Tshwanelo ya Me go Itse Seemo sa Me, Go Thibela Ketegelo ke Maikarabelo a Me”, o o golaganeng le moono wa lefatshe ka bophara o o reng: “Ke Tshwanelo ya Me go Iponela Ditirelo tsa Boitekanelo”.

src: Umcimbi walonyaka utawubanjwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Lilungelo Lami Kwati Simo Sami, Kuvikela Sibopho Sami”, lechumana nengcikitsi yemhlaba wonkhe letsi: “Lilungelo Kutemphilo.”.
tgt: Tsenngotirisong eno e e bonatla ya Leano la Togamaano ya Bosetšhaba (NSP) ka HIV, Lehuba le Malwetse a Phetelano ka Thobalano la 2017 - 2022 la Aforika Borwa, leo le leng botlhokwa mo kgatelong pele ya Aforika Borwa mo go fitlheleleng tlhokomelo ya boitekanelo ya batho botlhe jaaka go tlhalositswe mo go NDP, eo e rotloetsang gore go nne le baagi ba ba tshelang ka boitekanelo, ba ba nang le matla e bile ba lekalekana.

src: Liviki Lavelonkhe Lekugcila Kutimbizo.
tgt: Beke ya Mtsholo a Naga a Imbizo.

src: IKhabhinethi icela imimango kutsi ihlanganyele ekutimbandzakanyeni kuLeliviki Lavelonkhe Lembizo Lesikhombisa lelitako, lokulindzeleke kutsi licale mhla tinge-27 Lweti kute kube mhla ti-03 Ingongoni 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging go tsaya karolo mo Bekeng ya bo 7 ya Mtsholo a Naga a Imbizo a a tlang, a a solofelwang go simolola ka la bo 27 Ngwanaitseele go fitlha ka la bo 3 Sedimonthole 2017.

src: Ngaphasi kwebuholi be-GCIS, lenkhundla igcugcutela kucocisana emkhatsini wemalunga eSigungu nemimango.
tgt: Ka boeteledipele jwa GCIS, serala seno se rotloetsa dikgolagano tsa dipuisano magareng ga ditokololo tsa khuduthamaga le baagi.

src: Lomcimbi wenteka ngaphasi kwemongo wendzaba yeminyaka lelikhulu yekutalwa kwa-Oliver Reginald Tambo, lowagcugcutela kutsi kube nekulingana ngekwebulili.
tgt: E diragala ka nako ya mekete ya ngwagakgolo wa Oliver Reginald Tambo, yo a neng a lwela tekatekano ya batho ba bong jo bo sa tshwaneng.

src: Loko lokutawukwentiwa kuhloswe kutsi ngako kwesekwelwe umkhankhaso Wetinsuku Leti-16 Tekwecwayisa.
tgt: Ditiragalo tseno maitlhomo a tsona ke go tshegetsa Letsholo la Matsatsi a le 16 a Bolweladitshwanelo.

src: Imicimbi letawubakhona itawufakwa kukhalenda yavelonkhe kuphindze futsi kwabelanwe ngayo kuwebhusayithi yahulumende ku: WEBTOKEN.
tgt: Matsatsi ano a tla tsenngwa mo khalentareng ya naga le go abelanwa mo webesaeteng ya puso (WEBTOKEN).Melaotlhomo.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kwesatiso ngekulandzela sigaba se-74(5) seMtsetfosisekelo waseRiphabhliki yaseNingizimu Afrika wa-1996.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga tsiboso go ya ka karolo ya bo 74(5) ya Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996.

src: Inhloso yaloko kucala inchubo yavelonkhe neyetifundza yekubonisana ngenhloso yekwenta kutsi kube netingucuko eminyeleni yetifundza macondzana naMasipala Wendzawo waseMatatiele eMphumalanga Kapa kanye nasetindzweni letitsite taseBa Ga Mothibi eNyakatfo Nshonalanga.
tgt: Maitlhomo ke go simolola thulaganyo mo maemong a bosetšhaba le a porofense go senka maikutlo gore go diriwe diphetogo mo melelwaneng ya porofense tebang le Masepala wa Selegae wa Matatiele kwa Kapa Botlhaba mmogo le kwa mafelong a mangwe a Ba Ga Mothibi kwa Bokone Bophirima.

src: Lenhloso yekufinyelela kusincumo ngemincele yetifundza sivela emimmangweni yaletindzawo lekukhulunywa ngato letinesifiso sekutsi tifakwe ngaphansi kwetifundza letingubomakhelwane.
tgt: Maikemisetso a go lebelelwa sešwa melelwane ya porofense a tlhagelela ka ntlha ya fa baagi ba dikarolo tsa dinaga tse di umakilweng ba batla go wela kwa diporofenseng tsa baagisani.

src: Imilayeto.
tgt: Melaetsa.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalisela live laseFrance njengelive lelikhetfwe kutsi lisingatse Imidlalo Yendzebe Yemhlaba Yelibhola Lembhoco yanga-2023 futsi ibonga litsimba lahulumende, lebeliholwa Lisekelamengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, Indvuna Yetemidlalo Nekukhibika Thulas Nxesi kanye neNyonyana yaseNingizimu Afrika Yelibhola Lembhoco (i-SARU), ngemsebenti leyawenta ekukhangiseni live laseNingizimu Afrika kulomkhankhaso wekufaka sicelo sekutsi lisingatse lomcimbi.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse Fora go bo e le naga e e atlenegisitsweng go ka tshwarela kwa go yona Sejana sa Lefatshe tsa Rakabi sa 2023 mme e leboga boemedi jwa puso, jo bo neng bo eteletswe pele ke Motlatsamoporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa, Tona ya Metshameko le Boitapoloso Thulas Nxesi mmogo le Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika Borwa wa Rakabi, ka tiro e e dirilweng mo go tsholetseng maiteko a Aforika Borwa a go ka tshwarela meletlo eo kwano.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Indvuna Pandor, loklonyeliswe ngeMkomelo Wathishela Lophuma Embili.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse Tona Pandor, yo a abetsweng Kabo ya Morutabaithuti yo o Diphatsa.

src: Lomklomelo Indvuna Pandor uwunikwe yiShansela yaseNyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-Unisa), Mengameli waphambilini Thabo Mbeki.
tgt: Kabo eno e neetswe Tona Pandor, ke Molaodi wa Yunibesiti ya Aforika Borwa, Moporesitente wa mo malobeng rre Thabo Mbeki.

src: LoMkomelo Wathishela Lophuma Embili, munye wemikhakha yawo lemine, kwatisa ligalelo lanome ngabe ngumuphi thishela lophuma embili lophume embili ekufundziseni, ekufundzeni, ekutfutfukiseni emakhono kanye/nome lucwaningo emkhakheni wakhe webungcweti.
tgt: Kabo ya Morutabaithuti yo o Diphatsa, e leng e nngwe ya dikabo di le nne, e leboga seabe sa barutabaithuti ba ba diphatsa ba ba dirileng bontle mo thutong le mo go godiseng thuto, go ithuta, tlhabololo ya bokgoni le/dipatlisiso mo dikarolong tse ba di itseng jaaka ba ikitse.

src: IKhabhinethi idvumisa umsebenti lowentiwe i-South African Astronomical Observatory, lokuyincenye ye-Wide Angle Search for Planets lokuyinhlangano lefuna emaplanethi labatfole kutsi kunemaplanethi lamasha lamatsatfu.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse tiro e e dirilweng ke Lefelopatlisiso la Boithutelalefaufau la Aforika Borwa, e leng karolo ya Diphuruphutso tsa Dipatlisiso ka Bophara tsa batsomi ba molokoloko wa Dipholanete bao ba boneng dipholanete tse dingwe tse dintšhwa di le tharo.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela labo labatimbandzakanye futsi baphumelela kuklonyeliswa ngemklomelo we-Govan Mbeki Awards wanga-2017, wekuhlonipha labo labasebenta emkhakheni wetekwakha labaphume embili ekwakheni tindlu.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse batsayakarolo le bafenyi ba Dikabo tsa 2017 tsa Govan Mbeki, tseo di bontshang tlotlo mo go bao ba leng mo lekaleng la kago leo le dirileng bontle mo go ageng dintlo.

src: Ikhabhinethi ihlangene yabamba umhlangano wayo wekugcina wanga-2017 e-Union Buildings ePitoli.
tgt: Kapinete e tshwere kopano ya yona ya bofelo ya ngwaga wa 2017 kwa Union Buildings mo Pretoria.

src: Tincumo TeKhabhinethi.
tgt: Ditshwetso tsa Kabinete.

src: Ikhabhinethi ivumile kutsi Lisukuhlela Lemkhakha Wavelonkhe Wetekuvakasha (i-NTSS) lwanga-2016-2026 luphunyeleliswe.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse Togamaano ya Bosetšhaba ya Lekala la Bojanala (NTSS) 2016-2026 gore e ka tsenngwatirisong.

src: Le-NTSS isime kutinsika letine letibalulekile, lekunguleti, kumaketha, kwenta kutsi tivakashi tifinyelele kalula, kwenta kancono loko tivakashi letihlangabetana nako, kulawula indzawo lekuyiwa kuyo kanye netinzuzo letimkhakhubanti.
tgt: NTSS e tlhalosiwa ka dipilara tsa togamaano di le tlhano e leng ya phasalatso, tolamiso ya go nolofatsa phitlhelelo ya bojanala, go oketsa boitumelo jwa bajanala, taolo ya lefelo le go iwang kwa go lona mmogo le go anamisa dipoelo tse kgolo.

src: Umculu lophelela uyatfolakala kuwebhusayithi yeLitiko Letekuvakasha: WEBTOKEIkhabhinethi iluvumile luhlakamsebenti lwekusungula Inkampani Yavelonkhe Ye-intanethi Lesheshisako.
tgt: Tokomane e e feletseng e teng mo webesaeteng ya Lefapha la Bojanala ya: www.

src: Loku kutawuchuba kutsi kucala kusetjentiswa tintfo letihlangane ngendlela lechumene bese kwakheka shampeni we-intanethi yavelonkhe lesheshisako.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse letlhomeso la go tlhoma Setlamo sa Naga sa Neteweke ya Porotebente.

src: Ikhabhinethi iwuvumile Umbiko Wekucala Wemnyaka Wenchubekelembili Wekuphumelelisa Umtsetfo Lodzingidvwako weMalungelo Ebantfu Labaphila Nekukhubateka (i-WPRPD).
tgt: Se tla tlhamiwa ka go kopanya Sentech le Broadband Infraco.

src: Lombiko ukhuluma ngesikhatsi lesisuka mhla lu-1 Bhimbidvwane kuya kumhla tinge-31 Ingongoni 2016.Lombiko uhlola ngalokusezingeni leliphakeme kutsi ematiko ahulumende asahambe kangakanani nekujulisa imigomo yenchubomgomo ye-WPRPD ekuhleleni kwawo lokufanele, kubhajetha, kwetfulwa kwetinsita kanye netinchubo tekubika.
tgt: Seno se tla laola go tsenngwatirisong ga mananeo ano a a tshegetsaneng ka tsela e e rulagantsweng le go tlhoma mofenyi wa naga wa porotebente.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweLuhlakamsebenti Lwenchubomgomo Yelisukuhlela Yalabakhubatekile Yemfundvo Lephakeme neKucecesha kute kutsi sive siphawule ngayo.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse Pegelo ya Ntlha ya Dikgatelopele ya Ngwaga le Ngwaga e e ka ga go tsenngwatirisong Lokwalotemoso lwa Lefapha la Puso ka ga Ditshwanelo tsa Batho ba ba Nang le Bogolofadi (WPRPD).

src: Ikhabhinethi yatiswa ngemiphumela yeKubuyeketwa kweLuhlelo lweKuhlela Kabusha Kwemkhakha Wematekisi lolwentiwa ngeLweti 2015 kwate kwaba yiNyoni 2016.
tgt: Pegelo eno e akaretsa paka e e simolotseng ka la bo 1 Ferikgong go fitlha ka la bo 31 Sedimonthole 2016.Pegelo eno e tlhagisa tekolo ya maemo a a kwa godimo mo ebileng mafapha a puso a setseng a simolotse go tsenyeletsa ditaelo tsa pholisi eno ya WPRPD mo maanong a bona, mo ditekanyetsokabong le mo dithulaganyong tsa le tsa kaboditirelo le tsa go dira dpegelo.

src: Loluhlelo luyincenye lweLuhlelolisu Lwahulumende Lwetitfutsi, lokuhloswe ngalo kutsi eNingiziu Afrika kube netekutfutsa letihlangane letiphephile naletisebenta ngemphumelelo.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse phasalatso ya Pholisi ya Letlhomeso la Togamaano ya Bogolofadi go samagana le Thulaganyo ya Thuto le Katiso ya Morago ga go Konosetsa Dithuto tsa Sekolo (PSET) gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kutsi kufanele kutsi kube nalokunye kubonisana nekusebenta lokufanele kutsi kwentiwe ngematiko lafanele ngembi kwekutsi Litiko Letekutfutsa Lavelonkhe licale kusebentisa loluhlelo lolubuyeketiwe.
tgt: Kabinete e nopoletswe ka dipoelo tsa Tshekatsheko ya Lenaane la Tlhabololo ya Dithekesi le le diragaditsweng go simolola ka Ngwanaitseele 2015 go fitlha ka Lwetse 2016.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kukhululelwa esiveni kwelushicilelo lwe-8 lweTinkhomba Tekutfutfukisa (2016).
tgt: Lenaane leno ke karolo ya togamaano e kgolo ya Togamaano ya Dipalangwa tsa Baagi, eo maitlhomo a yona e leng go tlhagisa thulaganyo ya dipalangwa e e dirang sentle e bile e babalesegile e e kopanetsweng mo Aforika Borwa.

src: LoMbiko weTinkhomba teKutfutfukisa ugcile ekutfutfukeni kweNingizimu Afrika kusukela kwacala intsandvo yelinyenti futsi ulandzelela kuphunyeleliswa kweLisu Lavelonkhe Lekutfutfukisa (i-NDP): Umbononchanti-20.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse gore go diriwe dipuisano le tiro e e tseneletseng le mafapha a a maleba pele Lefapha la Naga la Dipalangwa le ka samagana le kgato e e ntšhwafaditsweng.

src: Ikhabhinethi itivumile tindlela tekucinisa kulawulwa kwekujeziswa kwetisebenti tahulumende mayelana netisebenti letichuba emabhizinisi nemitimba yembuso.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse go phasaladiwa mo baaging ga kgatiso ya bo robedi ya Ditshupetso tsa Kgatelopele (tsa 2016).

src: Tenta kutsi Imitsetfomgomo Yetisebenti Tahulumende yanga-2016 isebente, levimbela tisebenti tahulumende kutsi tichube emabhizinisi neMbuso.
tgt: Pegelo ya Ditshupetso tsa Kgatelopele e tsepamisitse mogopolo mo tlhabololong ya Aforika Borwa fa e sale go nna le temokerasi mme e ela tlhoko go tsenngwatirisong ga Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP): Ponelopele ya Kabinete e atlenegisitse dikgato tse di tla matlafatsang taolo ya dikgato tsa kgalemo ya badiredipuso mabapi le badiredipuso ba ba gwebisanang le ditheo tsa puso.

src: Kusukela ngeNdlovulenkhulu, Temafa Wavelonkhe, tesekelwa Litiko Letemisebenti Yahulumende Nekuphatsa (i-DPSA), litawulandzelela konkhe kubhaliswa lokusha kuDathabhesi Yavelonkhe Yebatfulitinsita ku-inthanethi ngekuhlola Inchubo ye-Persal.
tgt: E tswa mo Melawaneng ya Ditirelo tsa Puso ya 2016, e e thibelang badiredipuso go gwebisana le Puso.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile Kulawulwa Kwendlela Lensha Yekuhlola neNchubo Yekutfutfukisa Tinhloko Tematiko, lokukhombisa ngalokunembako kuchumana lokusemkhatsini wemsebenti wemuntfu nekusebenta kwenhlangano.
tgt: Go simolola ka la bo 1 Mopitlwe, Lefapha la Matlotlo a Naga, le tshegeditswe ke Lefapha la Bodiredipuso le Tsamaiso (DPSA), ba tla lekola boikwadiso jotlhe jo bo diragadiwang mo Sefalanakgobokgobotshedimosong sa Baabiditirelo (CSD) gore baikwadisi bao ga ba tlhagelele gape mo thulaganyong ya Persal.

src: Itawucala kusebenta kusukela mhla lu-1 Mabasa Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa nekuphunyeleliswa kweLuhlakamsebenti Lwesikimu Sekwehlaya Baphotfuli Bemanyuvesi Batewusebentela Hulumende.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse gore Thulaganyo e Ntšhwa ya Tlhabololo ya Bolaodi jwa Tiragatsotiro ya Ditlhogo tsa Lefapha, e e bontshang ka tolamo kgolagano magareng ga tiragatsotiro ya batho le ya mokgatlho o ba o direlang.

src: Loku kwenta incenye yeluhlelo lwekutfutfukisa ngekhatsi kuTemisebenti Yahulumende kute kucashwe lusha kuTemisebenti Yahulumende.
tgt: E tla simolola go tsenngwatirisong ka la bo 1 Moranang Kabinete e atlenegisitse go tsenngwatirisong ga Letlhomeso la Sekema sa go Thapiwa ga Dialogane mo Ditirelong tsa Puso.

src: Loluhlakamsebenti lufaka ekhatsi kubeka eceleni emaphesenti etikhala letivulekile telitiko ngalinye kutsi tihlwayelwe labaphotfule emanyuvesi bemisebenti yemakhono layindlala.
tgt: Seno ke karolo ya lenaane la tlhabololo mo Ditirelong tsa Puso go ka ngokela dialogane tse di nang le bokgoni go ka direla puso.

src: Indvuna yeLitiko Letemisebenti Yahulumende Nekuphatsa naye utawenta luhlakamsebenti lwakhe luhambisane neLuhlelo Lwetemisebenti Yekutfutfukisa Lusha.
tgt: Letlhomeso leno le akaretsa go nopola phesente e e rileng ya diphatlhatiro tsa lefapha le lengwe le le lengwe gore e tswalelwe ke dialogane mo ditirong tseo go nang le tlhaelo ya batho ba ba dirang mefuta eo ya tiro.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kwaleTatiso kuGazethi yaHulumende letiphatsele neKuhlelwa Kabusha Kwetindzawo Letingaphasi Kwetinkantolo, lokuhlose kukhulisa emandla ekufinyelela bulungiswa betigodzi tasemaphandleni lebetikadze tinganakwa noma tingatfoli tinsita ngalokufanele.
tgt: Tona ya DPSA o tla lepalepanya gape letlhomeso leno le Lenaane la Tirelo ya go Thapiwa ga Bašwa.

src: Lokuhlelwa kabusha kutawentiwa etigodzini tabomantji eFreyistata naseNyakatfo Kapa, kanye nekususwa kwaletinye Tigodzi taMantji letitsite kuLuphiko lwaseGauteng lweNkantolo Lephakeme bese tibekwa ngaphasi kwemandla eNkantolo Lephakame yaseNyakatfo Nshonalanga.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse gore go phasaladiwe Dikitsiso tse di latelang mo Kaseteng ya Puso tse di amanang le Dikamano tsa Melao ya Dikgotlatshekelo, tseo maitlhomo a tsone e leng go tokafatsa phitlhelesego ya bosiamisi mo go bao mo malobeng ba neng ba kgapetswe kwa thoko le mo metseng e e kwa metseselegaeng eo e sa direlweng ka botlalo.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyivumile Imitsetfosimiso Yekungenelela ngekwemibandzela yeMtsetfo Wekuvikela Lutjalomali, wanga-2015 (Umtsetfo-22 wanga-2015).
tgt: Go tla potlakisiwa dikgaolo tsa magiseterata kwa Foreistata le kwa Kapa Bokone, le go ntshiwa ga Dikgaolo tse dingwe tsa Magiseterata mo Kgaolong ya Gauteng go tswa ka fa diphukeng tsa Kgotlatshekelokgolo go di tsenya ka fa tlase ga diphuka tsa bosiamisi jwa Kgaolo ya Kgotlatshekelokgolo ya Bokone Bophirima.

src: Lemitsefosimiso ibonelela umtjalimali lonenkinga mayelana nesinyatselo lesitsetfwe nguhulumende lesitsintsa kabi lutjalomali, kutsi acele Litiko Letekuhwebelana Netetimboni (i-dti) kutsi lingenelele ngendlela lefanele yekulamula.
tgt: Melawana eno e thusa mobeeletsi yo a nang le ngongora ka kgato e e tserweng ke puso mme e ama peeletso, go kopa Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Intaseteri (dti) go ka tsereganya ka mekgwa eo maitlhomo e leng go tsereganya.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kutsi kubitwe kuphindze futsi kungeniswe letinkhomfa letilandzelako:Inkhomfa Yekubonisana yanga-2018 Yeluhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwetisebenti Letitfutfukisa Ummango ingeniswe yi-DPSInkhomfa ye-23 Yemave Emhlaba Yemnyaka Yebashushisi, letawungeniswa nguMkandlu Wetebushushisi Wavelonkhe eDurban ngeMphala nga-2018.Iforamu Yemhlaba Yesayensi eNingizimu Afrika nga-2021.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore go ka tsenelwa le go tshwarwa dikhonferense tse di latelang:Khonferense ya 2018 ya Dipatlisiso ka ga Lenaane la Naga la Tlhabololo ya Baagi le Badiri ka DPSA.

src: Litiko Letesayensi Netheknoloji litawukhulumisana neLikomidi Lelichuba Iforamu Yemhlaba Yesayensi mayelana nekungenisa leforamu.
tgt: Khonferense e e Tshwarwang Ngwaga le Ngwaga ya bo 23 ya Mokgatlho wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Basekisi, e e tla tshwarwang ke Bothati jwa Bosekisi jwa Bosetšhaba (NPA) kwa Durban mo pakeng ya Lwetse 2018.Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Saense mo Aforika Borwa ka 2021.

src: Inkhulumiswano Yelizinga Leliphakeme Yenhlangano Yebunye Be-Afrika (i-AU) yanga-2017, leyangeniswa yi-DPSA kusukela mhla ti-6 kuya kumhla ti-8 Ingongoni 2017.
tgt: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji le tla buisana le Bolaodi jwa Komiti ya Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Saense go buisanela kgonagalo ya gore e ka tshwarelwa fano gae.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kutsi nga-2018 kukhishwe tinhlavumali letitikhumbuto naletigcogcwako kanye naletitawusatjalaliswa.
tgt: Puisanelo ya Maemo a a kwa Godimo ya 2017 ya Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika (AU), e e tshwerweng ke DPSA go simolola gompieno ka la bo 6 go fitlha ka la bo 8 Sedimonthole 2017.

src: Letinhlavumali, nekumenyetelwa kwato, kutawushicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende: 2018 2oz, 22-carat gold KrugerrandLuhlavumali lwe-Natura lwanga-2018 loluyi-24-carat gold (Kuvela kwema-dinosaur – Archosauria)Luhlavumali lwa-R1 lwanga-2018 loluyi-24-carat gold (Tilwanyana taseNingizimu Afrika letihuma ngesisu – lufundvu lolonemlomo lofana newahhokwe (i-parrot beaked padloper))Luhlavumali lolujikeletako lwa-R5 lwanga-2018 lolwentiwe ngetinhlobo letimbili temethali (Iminyakalikhulu yaNelson Mandela)Luhlavumali lweSicalaba lwanga-2018 lolwentiwe nge-24-carat gold ne-sterling-silver (Imphilo yaMatiwase – Nelson Mandela)Luhlavumali lwe-R2 Crown naTiki loyi-2 ½ lwanga-2018 lolwentiwe nge-sterling-silver (Tintfo Letisungulwa eNingizimu Afrika – Ithomografi Leyentiwe ngaNgcondvomshini (i-Computed Tomography)) kanyeLuhlavumali lwanga-2018 le-sterling-silver lolufakwe umbala laphelela (Tinyoni neTimbali teSichiwi Sekulondvolota Imvelo saseWaterberg).Tindzaba Talelive Letimcoka.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go betliwa ga madi a tshipi a go bontsha tlotlo a a ka bokelediwang le a a tla dirisediwang go reka gore a rebolwe ka 2018.Mebetlo ya madi ano a tshipi, le seo a se buang, di tla gatisiwa mo Kaseteng ya Puso:Madi a 2018 a di onse di le 2, ka dikharate di le 22 tsa gauta a ranta ya KrugerMadi a 2018 a lethathama la madi a tshipi a Natura ka dikharate di le 24 tsa gauta (Go Tsoga ga dikgolomodumo – Archosauria)Madi a 2018 a lethathama la madi a tshipi a R1 ka dikharate di le 24 tsa gauta (Digagabi tsa naga ya Aforika Borwa – khudu)Madi a 2018 a a bopilweng ka motswako wa ditshipi di le pedi a R5 a a tla dirisediwang go reka (Ngwagakgolo wa Nelson Mandela)Madi a 2018 a lethathama la madi a tshipi a Protea a dikharate di le 24 tsa gauta le selefera o o opafaditsweng a (Botshelo jwa Mogaka – Nelson Mandela)Madi a 2018 a lethathama la madi a tshipi a R2 wa Korone le 2 ½ waTiki a selefera o o opafaditswenga (Ditlhagisiwa tsa Boitlhamedi tsa Aforika Borwa tsa Didirisiwa tsa khomphiuthara tsa go dirisa maphotho a pono go bona foo go sa bonagaleng) mmogo leMadi a 2018 a lethathama la madi a tshipi a a kgabisitsweng a selefera o o opafaditsweng(Polokelo ya tsa Tlhago ya Dinonyane le Malomo a Waterberg).

src: Imiphumela Yemkhicito Wonkhe WeliveIkhabhinethi iyatfokota ngekukhula kwemnotfo walapha eNingizimu Afrika lokhule nge-2% wemnyaka ekoteni yesitsatfu yanga-2017, usuka ku-2.8% lebewubuyeketwa kuya etulu ngekota yesibili.
tgt: Dipoelo tsa Seelosotlhe sa Ditlhagisiwa tsa Naga mo Ngwageng (GDP)Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke kgolo ya ikonomi ya Aforika Borwa e e godileng ka 2% mo ngwageng mo kotareng ya boraro mo ngwageng wa 2017, go tswa mo palong e e fetotsweng e e neng e le kwa godimo ya 2.8% mo kotareng ya bobedi.

src: Lokwenta kahle kakhulu lokunemandla kwabangelwa kukhula lobekuchubeka emkhakheni wetekulima, lofake ligalelo la-0.9% ekukhuleni sekukonkhe ngemuva kwa-44.2% wekukhula ngekota, ngekota.
tgt: Tiragatsotiro e e thata go feta e e neng e solofetswe eno e ne e ikaegile bogolosegolo ka kgolo e e neng e ntse e tsweletse go gola mo lekaleng la temothuo, leo le tlametseng ka seabe sa karolo ya diphesente ya go fitlha mo kgolokakaretsong ya mo morago ga 44.2% mo kotareng e nngwe le e nngwe.

src: Kwenta kahle kakhulu kutekulima, lokubone emakota lamatsatfu lalandzelanako ekukhula lokunemandla, kwabangelwa kukhicitwa ngelizinga leliphakeme kwetilimo tasemasimini (njengemmbila) etindzweni letitfola imvula ehlobo kanye nemikhicito yetijalo tasengadzeni.
tgt: Tiragatsotiro e e matlafetseng eno mo temothuong, e e tlhagisitseng dikotara di le tharo tse di latelaneng tsa kgolo, e dirilwe ke kotulo e e kwa godimo ya dijalo (tse di jaaka mmidi) mo mafelong a a tshologelwang ke dipula mo selemong le mo ditlhagisweng tse di somarelwang.

src: Timbiwa nekukhicita nako kufake ligalelo kulokhula lokubhaliwe, lapho khona tetimbiwa nekumbiwa kwenkwali kukhule nga-6.6% lokufake i-0.5% ekukhuleni.
tgt: Makala a meepo le a tlhagisodikuno le one a latlhetse tlhwarelegonnyane mo kgolong e e nopotsweng, ka meepo le lenkwari di oketsegile ka 6.6% le go nna le seabe sa karolo ya diphesente ya mo kgolong.

src: Umkhakha wetagezi nguwo lowehle kakhulu, nge-5.5%.
tgt: Lekala la motlakase ke lone le le nnileng bodipa go gaisa, ka go wela tlase ka 5.5%.

src: Kukhula kwalokusetjentiswa emindenini kwe-2.6% kwabangelwa kakhulu kusebentisa imali kumikhicto lecinile, lokwenta i-1.6% kusuka ekukhuleni nga-2.6%.
tgt: Kgolo ya dijo tsa kwa malapeng ya 2.6% ke ka ntlha ya go reka ditlhagisiwa tse di sa senyegeng, tseo di nnileng le seabe sa karolo ya diphesente ya mo kgolong ya 2.6%.

src: Kukhula lokunemandla kunaloku lebekulindzelekile kanye nekubuyeketa kuya etulu kumiphumela yekukhula yekota yesibili kusho kutsi kukhula kungafinyelela ku-0.9% nga-2017.Loku kungetulu kuna-0.7% lobekalindzelwe ngesikhatsi seSitatimende Senchubomgomo Yelwabiwomali Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini (i-MTBPS).
tgt: Kgolo e e matla go fete e e neng e solofetswe le koketsego mo kotareng ya bobedi dipoelo tsa kgolo di ra gore kgolo e ka fitlhelela 0.9% ka 2017.Seno ke go feta 0.7% e e neng e solofetswe fa go ne go diriwa Puo ya Pholisi ya Tekanyetsokabo ya Kgweditharo (MTBPS).

src: Hulumende ufanele kutsi acinisekise kutsi lamandla ekukhula agcinwa anjalo ngekutsi kuchutjekwe kuphunyeleliswe letindlela leti-14 letifaka emandla ekutetsembeni lokwakhela ekwenteni kancono kutetsemba kwebatsengi kantsi futsi kungabuyisa kutetsemba kwebhizinisi.
tgt: Puso e tshwanetse go netefatsa gore lebelo leno la kgolo le a somarelwa ka go tswelela go tsenya tirisong dikgato di le 14 tse di tlhotlheletsang boitshepelo tse di agelelang mo boitshepelong jwa moreki le go dira gore dikgwebo le tsone di nne le boitshepelo.

src: I-InvestSA One-Stop ShopIkhabhinethi iyakwemukela kwetfulwa kwesikhungo lesinako konkhe, i-InvestSA One-Stop Shop KwaZulu-Natal nguMengameli Jacob Zuma njengencenye yemitamo yekwenta kancono kuchuntjwa kwemabhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Lefelo la ditirelontsi la InvestSAKabinete e amogetse go thankgololwa ga Lefelo la Ditirelontsi la InvestSA la kwa KwaZulu-Natal ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma jaaka karolo ya maitlhomo a go tokafatsa bonolo jwa go dira kgwebo mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Lena yi-One-Stop-Shop yesitsatfu leyetfulwe kulelive.
tgt: Leno ke Lefelo la Ditirelontsi la boraro le le thankgolotsweng mo nageng.

src: Ihlose kwakha simondzawo lesivumako ngekutsi yente kutsi ibe yinye indzawo yekutsintsana yebatjalimali kutsi batfole kuyo tonkhe tinsita tekuphutfumisa imiklamo nekunciphisa bulukhuni lobuvetwa nguhulumende nawusungula ibhizinisi.
tgt: Maitlhomo a lona ke go dira tikologo e e lokologileng ka go tlhoma setlhongwa se se ka totiwang mabapi le babeeletsi gore ba iponele ditirelo tsotlhe, go latedisa diporojeke le go fokotsa dikgoreletso tsa puso tse di leng teng fa o itshimololela kgwebo.

src: Budlelwane neNingizimu Afrika ne-AngolaIkhabhinethi iyatemukela tivumelwane letisayinwe ngesikhatsi seKuvakasha kweNhloko yeMbuso eNingizimu Afrika lokwentiwe nguMengameli wase-Angola João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço.
tgt: Botsalano jwa Aforika Borwa le AngolaKabinete e amogetse tumelano e e saenilweng mo leetong la semmuso mo Aforika Borwa la Moporesitente wa Angola João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço.

src: Kusayinwe letivumelwane letilandzelako: Imemorandamu yeKuvisisana (i-MoU) yekusungulwa kweKhomishini yaBomengameli Lababili, i-MoU yetekubambisana Emkhakheni Wetemvelo, Kuphunyeleliswa kweTinchubomgomo tekususa ema-visa, Sivumelwane seLubambiswano lweTemaphoyisa kanye neSivumelwane lesimayelana neKusitana eTindzabeni Temtselo Wetekuhwebelana.
tgt: Ditumelano tse di latelang di saenetswe: Mmemorantamo wa Ditumelano (MoU) o o ka ga go tlhama Khomišene ya Diporesitente tsa Dinagapedi, MoU o o ka ga Tirisano mo Mererong ya Tikologo, Ditshupetsotsela tsa Tsenngotirisong mabapi le go tlhokomologa Visa, Thulaganyo ya Tirisano ya Sepodisi mmogo le Tumelano ka ga go Utlwanela go Thusana mo go tsa Botsamaisi mo Mererong ya tsa Lekgetho.

src: Ingcungcutsela yeSihlanu yeNhlangano yeMave ase-Afrika (i-AU) neyeNhlangano yeMave wase-Yurophu (i-EU)Ikhabhinethi iyayemukela imiphumela yeNgcungcutsela yeSihlanu ye-AU ne-ELengcungcutsela yaveta litfuba lekutsi iNingizimu Afrika yente kancono budlelwane bayo betemnotfo lobalulekile nebalamanye emave ngekukhulumisana ngetintfo letinyenti letehlukene kulengcungcutsela nakumikhosi yangekhatsi lefanana neForamu yeTemabhizinisi neNgcungcutsela yeLusha, ngekugcila kumnotfo lokhulako lofaka konkhe ekhatsi, kucashwa kwelusha netemabhizinisi.
tgt: Samiti ya Botlhano ya Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Yuropa (EU) le Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika (AU)kabinete e amogetse dipoelo tsa Samiti ya Botlhano ya EU le ASamiti eno e neelane ka tšhono ya gore Aforika Borwa e gagamatse botsalano jwa yona jwa togamaano mo ikonoming le mo botipolomateng ka dipuisanelo tse di farologaneng mo samiting le mo meketeng e e jaaka Formao ya Bogwebi le Samiti ya Bašwa ka tsepamisomogopolo e e ikaegileng ka kgodiso ya ikonomi, go thapiwa ga bašwa mmogo le mo boitlhamedikgwebong.

src: Luhwebo lwetigcila tebantfu base-Afrika labatitfutsela kulamanye emaveIkhabhinethi nayo njengamave emhlaba iyayigceka imibiko yekutsengiswa endalini kwebantfu base-Afrika labatitfutsela eLibya njengetigcila.
tgt: Go gweba ka bana ba mmala wa sebilo jaaka makgobaKabinete e ikamanya le baagi ba boditšhabatšhaba mo go kgalemeng ka mafoko a a bogale ditiro tse di begilweng tse go tweng bana ba mmala wa sebilo ba ba fudugelang kwa dinageng tse dingwe ba tshwarwa jaaka makgoba fa ba goroga kwa nageng ya Libya.

src: Letento tebulwane tiphambene nemigomo ye-AU, kanye netimiso letifanele tase-Afrika netemave emhlaba, kufaka ekhatsi Lucwebhu lwase-Afrika lweMalungelo eBuntfu neBantfu.
tgt: Ditiro tsa mothale oo tse di senang botho di nyatsa ditumelano tsa AU le maano a mangwe a a mabapi a Aforika le a boditšhabatšhaba, go akaretsa Lekwalotshwanelo la Aforika le le ka ga Ditshwanelo tsa Botho le batho.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyasemukela simemetelo setiphatsimandla sekutsi kutawuvulwa sikhungo sekusita bakhoseli labandlula eTripoli labadzinga kuvikelwa ngemave emhlaba.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse tsiboso ya bothati ya gore ba tla tlhoma lefelo la go tsena le gotswa kwa Tripoli go ka thusa bafodugedi le batshamedi ba dinaga tse dingwe ba ba tlhokang go ka sirelediwa mo maemong a boditšhabatšhaba.

src: Kubhedvuka kwe-ListeriosisIkhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu kutsi bacaphele – njengekutsi nje bageze tandla tabo ngembi kwekutsi balungise kudla kanye nekugwema kudla lokungakaphekwa – kutsi kuliwe nekubhebhetseka kwale-Listeriosis, lapho luphenyo lusachubeka nekutfola lapho leligciwane lisuka khona.
tgt: Go nama ga bolwetse jwa ListeriosisKabinete e ikuela mo bathong botlhe go tsaya dikgato tse di babalesegileng ka fao go tlhokagalang – tse di jaaka go tlhapa diatla pele ba ka baakanya dijo mme ba se je dijo tse di tala kgotsa tse di sa apeiwang – go ka fokotsa go anama ga bolwetse jwa Listeriosis, fa dipatlisiso di ntse di tsweletse go ka leka go bona gore motswedi wa twatsi eno o tswa o le mo kokwanatlhokong efe.

src: Lokugula kubangwa ligciwane lelitfolakala emhlabatsini, ematini, etitjalweni nakumikhicito yelubisi lengakahlantwa ngalokuphelele, futsi kungakuvetela timphawu letifanana netemkhuhlane letihamba nemsheko.
tgt: Bolwetse jono bo tsa mo kokwanatlhokong e e fitlhelwang mo mmung, mo metsing, mo dijalong le mo ditlhagisiweng tsa mašwi tse di sa apeiwang, mme e ka dira seka mokgotlhwane mo o ka iphitlhelang o tsholola.

src: Ingelashwa ngemphumelelo ngesibulalamagciwane (i-antibiotic), uma sitfolakele kusesenesikhatsi.
tgt: Yona e ka alafiwa ka melemo ya di antibiotic, fa e ka lemogiwa go sa le gale.

src: Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bachubeke nekusebentisa emanti ngekuwonga ngoba somiso sisachubeka kulelive.
tgt: Kabinete e santse e ikuela mo baaging go sonaga metsi ka ntlha ya fa naga e tswelela go nna mo lešekereng.

src: Nanoma nje litulu lisandza kuna, emazinga emanti emadamini kuvelonkhe ayachubeka nekwehla.
tgt: Go sa kgathalesege dipula tse dintseng di tsweletse go tsorotla mo gautshwane, maemo a letamo naga ka bophara a tswelela go wela tlase.

src: Loku kubangelwa ngemazinga ekushisha lasetulu kanye nekutsi sisengakatitfoli timvula letina tichubeke njalo.
tgt: Seno ke ka ntlha ya mogote o o tsweletseng mmogo le gore ga re ise re itemogele go tsorotla ga dipula go go latelaneng go sa kgaotse.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyakhutsateka ngenchubekelembili yetingcongco nabomasipala labacwile etikweletini tekutsi kutfolakale sisombululo saletikweti tamasipala.
tgt: Kabinete e rotloetsegile tota ka dipuisano tse di nang le ditharabololo magareng ga dimasepala tse di tseneng ka tlhogo mo dikolotong gore go bonwe tharabololo ya go ka ntsha dimasepala tseno mo dikolotong tseo.

src: Imitsetfosivivinyo.
tgt: Melaotlhomo.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kwetfulwa ePhalamende kwaleMitsetfosivivinyo lelandzelako:.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse go tlisiwa kwa Palamenteng ga Melaotlhomo e e latelang:.

src: Umtsetfosivivinyo weKuchibela Tibonelelo Tenhlalo wanga-2017.LoMtsetfosivivinyo uniketa tinzuzo letincono macondzana nesibonelelomali sebantfwana labatintsandzane nebantfwana labaphuyile, kufaka ekhatsi labo labahlala emakhaya laholwa bantfwana.
tgt: Molaotlhomo wa Diphetogo tsa Thuso ya Loago wa 2017.Molaotlhomo ono o rebola dipoelo tse di tokafaditsweng tebang le madithuso a tlhokomelo ya bana ba dikhutsana le ba ba leng mo tlalelong, go akaretsa bao e leng bona ba ba tlhokometseng malapa a bobona.

src: Umtsetfosivivinyo Walabatsengisa Tindlu Nemhlaba-2017LoMtsetfosivivinyo ucitsa lomtsetfo lokhona kwamanje Umtsetfo Wetindzaba Te-ejensi Yekutsengiswa Kwetindlu, wanga-1976 (Umtsetfo-112 wanga-1976).
tgt: Molaotlhomo wa Badiredi ba Dithoto wa 2017.Molaotlhomo ono o tsena mo legatong la Molao wa Merero ya Dithoto tsa Dieijente, 1976 (Molao wa bo 112 wa 1976).

src: Wakha mitsetfo yekwenta ncono umsebenti wetemnotfo ngekhatsi kumboni yekutsengiswa kwetindlu ube futsi ubukana nesidzingo sekucinisekisa kugucuka kwetintfo kulomkhakha.
tgt: O tlhola tikologo e e kgontshang e e nang le melawana go ka rotloetsa ditiro tsa ikonomi ka intaseteri ya dithoto tsa dintlo fa mo letlhakoreng le lengwe e samagana le tlhokego ya go netefatsa fa go nna le phetolothefosano mo lekaleng leno.

src: Umtsetfosisivivinyo Wekuchibela Luhlakamsebenti Lwavelonkhe Lweticu Tetemfundvo wanga-2016LoMtsetfosivivinyo ucinisa lomtsetfo lokhona kwamanje Umtsetfo Wavelonkhe Weluhlakamsebenti Lweticu Tetemfundvo, wanga-2008 (Umtsetfo-167 wanga-2008).
tgt: Molaotlhomo wa Diphetogo tsa Letlhomeso la Makwalothuto a Bosetšhaba (NQF) wa 2016.Molaotlhomo ono o matlafatsa Molao o o leng teng ga jaanong wa NQF, 2008 (Molao wa bo 67 wa 2008).

src: Ungenisa timiso tekubukana netindzaba tekumelela kabi kanye nekuhlisibeta imiphumela yekwenta kabi yebantfu labangetfuli kahle ticu tabo tetemfundvo noma tinhlangano letikhipha ticu tetemfundvo letingasebenti.
tgt: O tsenya tirisong dikgato tsa go samagana le merero ya go tlhoka tolamo mme e tlhagisa ditlamorago tse di tla lebanang mang le mang yo a ka tlamelang ka makwaloithuto a a sa lolamang kana ditheo tse di rebolang makwalothuto a a sa lolamang.

src: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wemacala Emave Emhlaba wanga-2017LoMtsetfosivivinyo ubeka luhlakamsebenti lwekushaya umtsetfo lolwentiwe kancono lolutawubukana nemacala ebugebengu lentiwe ngekhatsi kwaleli laseNingizimu Afrika nangale kweminyele yetfu.
tgt: Molaotlhomo wa Bosenyi jwa Boditšhabatšhaba wa 2017.Molaotlhomo ono o tlhagisitse letlhomeso la molao le le tokafaditsweng go samagana le bosenyi jwa boditšhabatšhaba jo bo dirilweng mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa le kwa ntle ga melelwane ya naga.

src: Uphindze futsi unikete kuvikeleka lokwentiwe kancono kanye nebulungiswa bemacala ebugebengu emave emhlaba.
tgt: Gape o tlhagisa tshireletsego le bosiamisi jo bo tokafaditsweng tebang le batswasetlhabelo ba bosenyi jwa boditšhabatšhaba.

src: Imibiko.
tgt: Melaetsa.

src: Mengameli Uhuru Kenyatta ngekubekwa esihlalweni sekuba nguMengameli weRiphabhuliki yaseKenya kanye nemgamu wakhe wesibili wekuba nguMengameli.
tgt: Moporesitente Uhuru Kenyatta ka boikaniso jwa gagwe jaaka Moporesitente wa Rephaboliki ya Kenya le go nna lekgetlho la bobedi mo setulong sa gagwe mo pusong.

src: Ikhabhinethi ilindzele kwakha budlelwane lobucinile lobutawuba semkhatsini futsi butfokotelwe ngulamave lababili.
tgt: Puso e ikaeletse go dira botsalano jo bo gagametseng jo bo tla itumedisang dinaga tsa rona ka bobedi.

src: Mengameli Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa ekubekweni kwakhe esihlalweni sekuba nguMengameli waseRiphabhuliki yaseZimbabwe.
tgt: Moporesitente Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa ka boikaniso jwa gagwe jaaka Moporesitente wa Rephaboliki ya Zimbabwe.

src: Ikhabhinethi ilindzele budlelwane lobuchubekako lobunemandla bekusebentisana naHulumende waseZimbabwe.
tgt: Kabinete e ikaeletse go tswelela go gagamatsa tirisano mmogo le puso ya Zimbabwe.

src: Utawukhunjulwa ngekusebenta ngekutikhandla angatinaki futsi asebentela bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika.

tgt: Go keteka tlotlo ya ngwagakgolo ya ga Nelson MandelaKabinete e ikamanya le maAforika Borwa mo go ketekeng tlotlo ya ngwagakgolo wa bone wa ga Nelson Mandela fa e sale a tlhokafala ka la bo 5 Sedimonthole 2013.

src: Kukhunjulwa kweMnyakalikhulu waNelson MandelaIkhabinethi nayo njengebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ikhumbula umkhosi wesine wekusishiya emhlabeni kwaNelson Mandela mhla ti-5 Ingongoni 2013.
tgt: Ka 2018 naga e tla keteka tlotlo ya ngwagakgolo ya botshelo jwa ga Mandela mme maAforika Borwa otlhe a rotloediwa go ikamanya le mekete eno ya ngwaga otlhe go bontsha tlotlo go yo mongwe wa basimane ba ba golo ba Aforika.

src: Nga-2018 lelive litawube lihlanganisa umnyakalikhulu wemphilo yaMandela futsi bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bakhutsatwa kutsi bahlanganyele kulomgubho wemnyaka wonkhe lapho sihlonipha lenye indvodzana yeludvumo yase-Afrika.
tgt: Kabinete e leboga maAforika Borwa otlhe ka go tsaya karolo mo meketeng ya tlotlo e e farologaneng ya ga OR Tambo e e neng e tshwerwe go ralala le naga mme e solofela go tla nna fela jalo ka re tla bo re gopola mogaka wa rona yo gape e leng Moporesitente wa Aforika Borwa wa ntlha yo a tlhophilweng ka mokgwa wa temokerasi, Madiba.

src: Ikhabhinethi ibonga bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ngekuhlanganyela kwabo kumikhosi leminyenti leyehlukene kulo lonkhe lelive yekukhumbula OR Tambo futsi ilindzele kutsi lizinga lekuhlanganyela lelifanana naleli lapho sikhumbula sikhonkhwane setfu kanye naMengameli waseNingizimu Afrika wekucala lowakhetfwa ngentsandvo yelinyenti, Mengameli, Madiba.
tgt: Paka ya khunologoKabinete e lakaletsa maAforika Borwa otlhe khunologo e e segofetseng e bile e rena kagiso.

src: Sikhatsi Semaholidi aKhisimusiIkhabhinethi ifisela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika sikhatsi semaholidi aKhisimusi lesiyintfokoto.
tgt: Re ikuela mo go bao ba tla bong ba tsaya maeto go netefatsa gore dijanaga tsa bona di baakanyeditswe maeto a matelele ao.

src: Simema labo labatawube bahamba kutsi bacinisekise kutsi timoto tabo tifanele kuba semgwacweni.
tgt: Badirisi botlhe ba mebila, bakganni ba dijanaga le batsamayakadinao ba tshwanetse go obamela melao ya tsela.

src: Indvuna yeTekutfutsa, Mnu Joe Maswanganyi, wetfule umkhakhaso we-Arrive Alive (Fika Uphila) eBela-Bela, eLimpopo mhla ti-5 Ingongoni.
tgt: Tona ya Lefapha la Dipalangwa, Rre Joe Maswanganyi, o thankgolotse letsholo la Arrive Alive kwa Bela-Bela, Limpopo ka la bo 5 Sedimonthole.

src: I-SAPS iphumelelisa umkhankhaso wavelonkhe wesikhatsi semaholidi aKhisimusi lesiphephile futsi wonkhe muntfu unesibopho sekwesekela i-SAPS ngekugcina umtsetfo nekutsiphatsa ngendlela lefanele.
tgt: Tirelo ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) e tsenya tirisong letsholo la yona naga ka bophara la paka ya khunologo e e babalesegileng mme botlhe ba na le maikarabelo a go tshegetsa SAPS ka go tlotla molao le go nna le maikarabelo.

src: Litiko Letasekhaya litawumemetela tinhlelo tesikhatsi semaholidi aKhisimusi sanga-2017/18 seminyele yaseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae le tla rebola maano a paka ya khunologo a 2017/18 mabapi le tikologo ya melelwane ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Loku kwentelwa kutsi kulawulwa kwekuphuma nekungena kwebantfu nemphahla eNingizimu Afrika kwenteke kahle futsi ngelizinga lelincono ngalesikhatsi sekuba matasatasa kakhulu.
tgt: Seno se mabapi le tsamaiso e e lolameng ya go kgabaganya ga batho le dithoto go tswa le go tsena mo Aforika Borwa mo pakeng ya fa go tla bo go iwa kwa godimo le kwa WEBTOKEN ikuela gape le mo batsading go se tlhokomologe bana ba bona ka e le maikarabelo a rona go tlhokomela bana ba rona.

src: Siphindze futsi sicela batali nebalondvoloti bebantfwana kutsi bangashisyi bantfwana bangakagadvwa njengoba sinesibopho sekunakekela bantfwana betfu.
tgt: Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke ditlhatlhobo tsa Materiki tse di tsweletseng ntle le dikgoreletso tse dintsi mme e lakaletsa barutwana ba 2017 masego ka ba tla bo ba letetse dipholo tsa bona tsa bofelo.
