tgt: Moporesitente o ne a tshwara kopano le Moporesitente ka ene wa naga ya Ukrain, Volodymyr Zelensky, mo ba tšhotlhileng kgang ya gore Letsholo la Barongwa ba Kontinente ya Aforika go Buisanela Kagiso le Dinaga tse di leng mo Ntweng le tsamaya kae mo go tleng ka ditharabololo mmogo le go buisanela le dintlha tse dingwe.

src: Mengameli Ramaphosa uphindze futsi wahlangana: NeMengameli Recep Tayyip Erdoğan waseTürkiye, mayelana nekucinisa budlelwane emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika neTurkey, kanye nekucocisana ngalamafishane mayelana naletingenelelo tekuthula ngalokushayisana emkhatsini weleRashiya nelase-Ukraine.
tgt: Moporesitente Recep Tayyip Erdoğan wa naga ya Türkiye, mabapi le go gagamatsa tirisanommogo magareng ga naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya Turkey, mmogo le go tsopolelana ka merero ya letsholo la go buisanela kagiso magareng ga naga ya Russia le ya Ukraine.

src: Mengameli Bola Tinubu waseRiphabhliki yaseNigeria, macondzana nekucinisa budlelwane emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika neleNigeria.
tgt: Moporesitente Bola Tinubu wa naga ya Federal Republic of Nigeria, mabapi le go gagamatsa tirisanommogo magareng ga naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya Nigeria.

src: Uphindze futsi watfola lwatiso lakamuva lolumayelana neMmango Wetemnotfo loholwa ngeMave aseNshonalanga ye-Afrika mayelana nekuketulwa kwembuso waseNiger kanye nemitamo nje jikelele yekubuyisa esimeni umtsetfo wentsandvo yelinyenti eSahel.
tgt: o ne gape a tsopolelwa tshedimosetso e e ka ga seo se setseng se dirilwe mo letsholong la Mererong ya Ikonomi le le eteletsweng kwa pele ke Dinaga tsa Bophirima jwa Aforika, mo go rarabololeng matsapa a menolopuso e e dirilweng kwa nageng ya Niger mmogo le dikgato tsotlhe tse go samaganweng natso mo go busetseng molao we temokerasi kwa karolong ya Sahel.

src: Mengameli Emmerson Mnangagwa waseRiphabhliki yaseZimbabwe, mayelana nemitamo yahulumende waseZimbabwe yekuhlanganisa kwakhiwa kabusha kwalelive ngemuva kwelukhetfo lokwavumelanwa ngalo lolusandza kuba khona.
tgt: Moporesitente Emmerson Mnangagwa wa naga ya Rephaboliki ya Zimbabwe, mabapi le maiteko a Zimbabwe mo go direng gore maemo kwa nageng a boele sekeng go latela gore naga eno mo malobeng e tshware ditlhopho tse di neng di sena merusu.

src: Mengameli Ramaphosa uphindze futsi watibandzakanya kumhlangano weTekuhweba emkhatsini weMelika (i-US) neNingizimu Afrika neMhlangano Wetebhizinisi Nelutjalomali, lofake ekhatsi baholi betemabhizinisi baseMelika nebaseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Moporesitente Ramaphosa o ne gape a tsaya karolo le mo kopanong ya magareng ga naga ya Aforika Borwa le Amerika mabapi le Kgwebisano le Dipeeletso, mo go neng go le baeteledipele ba dikgwebo ba dinaga ka bobedi.

src: Njengaloku kunetinkampani taseMelika letingetulu kwe-600 letisebentela lapha eNingizimu Afrika, lokucocisana bekumcoka kulokuchubeka kwekucinisa budlelwane emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika neMelika.
tgt: Jaaka ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa go na le dikgwebo di feta di le 6 000 tsa Amerika, go ne go le botlhokwa gore dipuisano tseno di tshwarwe gore tirisanommogo ya dinaga tseno e kgone go tswelela go gagamala.

src: Ngalesikhatsi, kwentiwe simemetelo lesisemtsetfweni lesitsi Inkhundla ye-20 Yekuhlanganyela Kutemnotfo Nekuhweba emkhatsini weMelika ne-Afrika Lengentasi kweSahara, (Inkhundla ye-AGOA) itawubanjelwa eJozi kusukela mhla ti-2 kuya mhla ti-4 kuLweti 2023.
tgt: Mo pakeng eno go ne ga ntshiwa tsiboso e e tlhamaletseng ya gore Kopano ya Kgato ya go Oketsa Ditšhono tsa go Godisa Ikonomi ya Aforika (AGOA) ya bo 20 e e ka ga Amerika le Dinaga tsa Borwa e tla tshwarelwa kwa Johannesburg go tloga ka la bo 2 go fitlha ka la bo 4 Ngwanaitseele 2023.

src: Lenkhundla itawufaka ekhatsi ‘Umbukiso Walokwentiwe e-Afrika’ lokutawubukiswa tinchubo tekukhicita kwesigodzi kulelivekati.
tgt: Mo foramong eno go tla tlhagisiwa gape le 'Dipontsho tsa Dilo tse di Dirilweng ka fa Kontinenteng ya Aforika' mme tsona di tla bontsha ka fao kgaolo ya kontinente e nang le dilo tse di botlhokwa mo ikonoming.

src: Mengameli Ramaphosa uphindze futsi waba ngufakazi wesimemetelo sekusebenta ngekuhlanganyela emkhatsini we-Novo Nordisk ne-Aspen.
tgt: Moporesitente Ramaphos gape o ne a le teng ga go diriwa kitsiso ya gore setlamo sa Novo Nordisk le sa Aspen di tla dirisana mmogo.

src: Lokusebenta ngekuhlanganyela kutawuholela ekukhicitweni kwelikhambi lekwelapha ushukela i-insulin etikhungweni te-Aspen letiseGqeberha, eMphumalanga Kapa.
tgt: Tirisanommogo eno e tla dira gore melemo ya go lwantshana le bolwetse jwa tshukiri e diriwe kwa femeng ya Aspen e e leng kwa Gqeberha, kwa porofesneng ya Kapa Botlhaba.

src: Lokusebenta ngekuhlanganyela kuhloswe ngako kuphakela tilinganisomutsi telikhambi lekwelapha ushukela letingetulu kwetigidzi leti-16 nga-2024.
tgt: Tirisanommogo eno e tla dira gore go tlhagisiwe melemo ya go lwantshana le bolwetse jwa tshukiri e feta dimilione di le 16 mo ngwageng wa 2024, mme palo eno e tla tlhatlosiwa gape mo ngwageng wa 2026.

src: Loku kutawukwenyusa kakhulu kufinyelela ekwelashweni nge-insulin hhayi kuphela lapha eNingizimu Afrika, kodvwa kulo lonkhe lelivekati.
tgt: Seno se tla oketsa tota palo ya melemo eno gore e kgone go lekana balwetse ba ba e tlhokang e seng fela ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa mme gape le go ralala le kontinente ka bophara.

src: Temandla.
tgt: Motlakase.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikwemukele kunikwa kweticelo temvume tekuhweba nekutfumela emaveni langephandle/nekutsenga kulamanye emave langephandle nguMlawuli Wavelonkhe Wetemandla waseNingizimu Afrika Inkampani Yavelonkhe Yekwendlulisa yaseNingizimu Afrika, ngekuvula indlela yekutsenga emandla ngale kulesigodzi.
tgt: Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke dikgato tsa Setheo sa Naga ya Aforika Borwa sa Taolo ya Merero ya Motlakase tsa go neela Setlamo sa Naga ya Aforika Borwa sa go Reka Motlakase tetla ya go reka le go rekisa motlakase, mme seno se bulela setlamo seno dikgoro tsa go ka reka motlakase go tswa kwa dinageng tsotlhe tsa kgaolo.

src: Kubuyela kwekusebenta kweYunithi ye-4 yaseSikhungweni Sekuphehla Ugezi saseKusile emva kwekugcinwa esimeni sekusebenta lobekuhleliwe kubuyise ema-megawatts lange-800 kugridi yetfu.
tgt: Go busediwa tirong ga Yuniti ya Bone ya Seteišene sa Motlakase sa Kusile, e e neng e baakanngwa, go busetsa tirong motlakase o o kana ka dimekawate di le 800 mo diyuniting tsa tlamelo ya motlakase.

src: Lenkhomba yalosekwentiwe imcoka ekwenteni ncono emandla ekuphehla kugridi yavelonkhe kanye nekulungisa kwenteka njalo kwekucishwa kwagezi ngenhloso yekuwonga.
tgt: Kgato eno e botlhokwa thata mo go tokafatseng maemo a tlhagisong ya motlakase mo diyuniting tsa ka fa nageng tsa tlamelo ya motlakase mmogo le mo go samaganeng le ditiragalo tsa motlakase o o tshabetseng ruri.

src: Ikhabhinethi yaphindze futsi yatjelwa ngalamafisha mayelana nenchubekelembili yekubuyiswa kwekusebenta kweMayunithi 1, 2 na-3 aseSikhungweni Sekuphehla Ugezi saseKusile ngembikwesikhatsi lebesihleliwe.
tgt: Kabinete e tsopoletswe gape le ka dikgato tse di setseng di dirilwe mo go busetseng tirong pele ga nako yuniti ya bo 1, 2 le ya bo 3 tsa Seteišene sa Motlakase sa Kusile.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikwemukele kuhlolwa kwelizinga lelisimeme lekusebenta kwe-Eskom lokwentiwe yi-Moody’s Investors Service, lokuyintfo letakwenta ncono kwetsembeka kwalesikhungo sagezi kanye nekutsi sikhone kuhlela ngaphambilini ekufezekiseni kugcina esimeni sekusebenta lokuhleliwe kwemayunithi aso ekuphehla gezi.
tgt: Kabinete e itumeletse gape le maemo a Eskom e a reboletsweng ke Setlamo sa Ditirelo tsa Dipeeletso sa Moody, mme ona a tla thusa go tlhatswa leina la setlamo seno mo mererong ya go adimiwa madi mmogo le go se kgontsha gore se kgone go ipaakanya sentle mo nakong e e tlang pele se ka diragatsa dikgato tsa go baakanya le go tsosolosa mafaratlhatlha a sona.

src: Kubakhona kwemanti.
tgt: Go se Felelwe ke Metsi.

src: Ikhabhinethi yatjelwa ngalamafisha mayelana nemitamo yekulungisa tinsayeya tekweswelakala kwemanti lokunemtselela etindzaweni letinyenti kulelive.
tgt: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka dikgato tse di tserweng go leka go rarabolola dikgwetlho tsa metsi tse di amang mafelo a le mantsinyana ka fa nageng.

src: Indvuna Yetemanti Nekuhanjiswa Kwekungcola, Mnu Senzo Mchunu kanye nabosodolobha balamanye emadolobhakati eGauteng batawuniketa lwati lolwakamuva lolumayelana netingenelelo tekusimamisa kuphakelwa kwemanti kulesifundza.
tgt: Tona ya Lefapha la Metsi le Kgeleloleswe, Rre Senzo Mchunu mmogo le Dimeyara tsa tse dingwe tsa diteropo tse dikgolo kwa Gauteng ba tla ema baagi ka lefoko go ba itsise gore ke eng se se diriwang go samagana le tlamelo ya metsi a a tshabetseng ruri mo porofenseng eno.

src: Ikhabhinethi ifisa kukhumbuta wonkhe umuntfu kutsi live laseNingizimu Afrika live leleswela emanti.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo go botlhe go gakologelwa gore naga ya Aforika Borwa ke e nngwe ya dinaga tse di senang metsi go le kalo.

src: Bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nawonkhe wonkhe kulelive kufanele kutsi onge emanti futsi awasebentise ngekuwonga.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa mmogo le botlhe ba ba leng ka fa nageng ba tshwanetse go somarela metsi le go se a dirise botlhaswa.

src: Tindzaba tekuhweba.
tgt: Merero ya Kgwebisano.

src: Ikhomishini Yetive Letimbili iNingizimu Afrika neLesotho (i-BNC) kanye neMhlangano Weklasta Yetindvuna.
tgt: Kopano ya Dintlo tsa Barongwa ba Dinaga (BNC) mmogo le Setlhopha sa Ditona tsa Naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya Lesotho.

src: Umhlangano weKhomishini Yetive Letimbili iNingizimu Afrika neLesotho kanye neMhlangano weKlasta Yetindvuna lebewubanjwe kusukela mhla tinge-25 kuya mhla tinge-28 Inyoni 2023 ugcile ekubambisaneni kutemnotfo, tindzaba letiphatselene nekuwela umnyele, kanye nekuhamba ngekukhululeka kwebantfu, timphahla kanye netinsita emkhatsini walamave lamabili.
tgt: Kopano ya Dintlo tsa Barongwa ba Dinaga (BNC) mmogo le Setlhopha sa Ditona tsa Naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya Lesotho e tshwerwe go tloga ka la bo 25 go fitlha ka la bo 28 Lwetse 2023 e tsepamisitse mogopolo mo go dirisaneng mmogo mo mererong ya ikonomi, ya go kgabaganya melelwane, mmogo le mo go letleleleng baagi le dithoto go kgabaganya melelwane ya dinaga ka bobedi ntle le tshitiso epe.

src: Mengameli Ramaphosa naNdvunankhulu Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane batawube babosihlalo ngekubambisana kuSeshini Yekuvula kwe-BNC emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika neLesotho ngaLesine, mhla tinge-28 Inyoni 2023.
tgt: Moporesitente Ramaphosa mmogo le Tonakgolo ya naga ya Lesotho e bong Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane e tla nna badulasetilo mo kopanong e e ka ga Dintlo tsa Barongwa ba Dinaga tsa Aforika Borwa le Lesotho ka Labone wa la bo 28 Lwetse 2023.

src: Le-BNC itawufaka ekhatsi budlelwane betebuncusa, tekuvikela nekuvikeleka, temanti, tekutfutsa, tagezi netekuhwebelana.
tgt: Mo kopanong eno go tla tšhotlhiwa merero e e ka ga tirisanommogo magareng ga dinaga, ditirelo tsa sesole le tsa pabalesego, metsi, dipalangwa, motlakase le kgwebisano.

src: Luphenyo Lwetenkhundla Yemakethe Lesemkhatsini Ye-inthanethi.. Ikhabhinethi iwutfolile umbiko lovela kuKhomishini Yetekuchudzelana mayelana nolokutfolile kanye netento tekulungisa letimayelana neLuphenyo Lwetenkhundla Yemakethe Lesemkhatsini Ye-inthanethi.
tgt: Dipatlisiso tse di ka ga go Tsenya Letsogo mo Diraleng tsa go Rekisa mo Inthaneteng.

src: Ikhabhinethi iwuncomile umsebenti wekhomishini ngekulungisa kukhatsateka kwekwenganyelwa sikhondlakhondla sinye kwetinkhundla letisemkhatsini tedijithali, lokufaka ekhatsi tebhizinisi nge-elekthronikhi, ema-ejensi ekuhamba laku-inthanethi, kuletfwa kwekudla, titolo tema-app, batfulitinsita labahleleke ngemikhakha kanye netinjini tekutfungatsa lwatiso ku-inthanethi.
tgt: Kabinete e rometswe pegelo go tswa kwa go Khomišene e e Okameng Merero ya Dikgaisano tsa Dikgwebo e e ka ga tseo e di ribolotseng mmogo le ditharabololo tsa tsona mo Dipatlisisong tse di ka ga go Tsenya Letsogo mo Diraleng tsa go Rekisa mo Inthaneteng.

src: Ikhabhinethi inike sicondziso Tindvuna tematiko ahulumende lafanele kutsi tichubeke ticubungule letincomo tekutfutfukisa, tibuke imitselela yetinchubomgomo kanye nekwenta tingucuku letinsha letidzingekako tetinchubomgomo letitawukwenta kutsi kube nekutibandzakanya lokuvakalako kwebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemabhizinisi lamancane, lasemkhatsini kanye nemabhizinisi lacashe bantfu labambalwa kubhizinisi ye-inthanethi lekhulako.
tgt: Kabinete e rolela hutshe tiro e e dirilweng ke khomišene eno mo go samaganeng le matsapa a go paralela dikgwebo tsotlhe ga dikgwebo tse dingwe mo diraleng tseno, go akatsetsa le dirala tse di supetsang bareki koo ba ka rekang gone, dirala tse di rekisang ditlhagisiwa, dirala tsa inthanete tse di rekisang mareu ka go rulaganyetsa bao ba tsayang maeto dithulaganyo tsa dinamelwa tse ba tla di dirisang, dirala tse di tlisetsang bareki dijo ba le kwa ba leng gone, dirala tse di rekisang diepe, dirala tse di rekisang ditirelo tse di itlhophileng mmogo le dirala tsa go batla dilo mo inthaneteng.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikunakile lokubhedvuka lokukhona kwemkhuhlane weligciwane lelibanga kugula kakhulu (i-HPAI) i-H5 ne-H7 embonini yetinkhukhu lapha eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Kabinete e laetse Ditona tse di maleba go sala morago ditshitshinyo tse di dirilweng gore maemo a tle a nolofale, go atlhaatlha seo pholisi e ka se dirang mmogo le go tsaya dikgato tse di maleba go baakanya pholisi gore e tle e kgontshe gore maAforika Borwa a a nang le dikgwebopotlana, tse dikgolwane le tse dikgolo a tle a nne le seabe se se utlwagalang mo dikgwebong tse di golang tsa inthanete.

src: Inshonalanga Kapa neKwaZulu-Natal babe nekubhedvuka kwe-HPAI H5 kwatsi i-HPAI H7 yona yabikwa kutsi ibhedvuke eGauteng, eLimpopo, eMpumalanga naseNyakatfo Nshonalanga.
tgt: Kabinete e tsibositswe ka Malwetse a a Tshelanang a Mokgotlhwane wa Dikgogo (HPAI) H5 le H7 a a aparetseng leruo la dikgogo ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Tinyatselo tekulawula kubhebhetseka kwalokubhedvuka setime ngemumo nebalimi bayagcugcutelwa kutsi bahloniphe tinyatselo tekuvikeleka letincunyiwe.
tgt: Porofense ya Kapa Bophirima mmogo le ya KwaZulu-Natal di wetswe ke bolwetse jwa HPAI H5 fa HPAI H7 yona e begilwe kwa diporofenseng tsa Gauteng, Limpopo, Mpumalanga le Bokone Bophirima.

src: Lokubhedvuka kubeka kubakhona kwekudla ebungotini kanye netinyatselo tekuhweba ngendlela yekutsenga kulamanye emave langesheya kulawula kubakhona kwemacandza latalako, emacandza latayelekile kubatsengi kanye nenyama yenkhukhu tingafezekiswa.
tgt: Go setse go tsentswe dikgato tirisong go ka samagana le go thibela go anama ga malwetse ano mme barui ba rotloediwa gore ba obamele dikgato tsa go thibela malwetse ano.

src: Litiko Letekulima, Kulungiswa Kabusha Kwemhlaba Nekutfutfukiswa Kwetindzawo Tasemaphandleni, Umtimba waseNingzimu Afrika Lolawula Imikhicito Yetemphilo kanye nemboni bahlola ticelo tekubhalisa imitsi yekugoma lengabakhona, kanye netinyatselo tekuhambisana letiphatselene nekuphepha, kusebenta ngemphumelelo kanye nelizingasimo kubekwe kumcoka kakhulu nawubhalisa imitsi yekugoma lenjalo.
tgt: Bolwetse jono bo dira gore go nne le tlhaelo ya dijo le dikgwebo di retelelwa ke go rekisetsa dinaga tse dingwe mae a go thuthusa ditsuane, mae a go jewa le dinama tsa kgogo go tswa ka fa nageng.

src: Kulwa nebugebengu ngendlela lehlanganisiwe Ikhabhinethi ilwemukele lwatiso lakamuva lolumayelana nekulwa nebugebengu, loluphindze futsi lwaniketwa sive yiNdvuna Yetemaphoyisa, Jenene Bheki Cele, kanye Nekusebenta Ngekuhlanyanyela Kwavelonkhe NeLuhlaka Lwetebunhloli.
tgt: Lefapha la Temothuo, Pusetsomafatshe le Tlhabololo ya Metsemagae, Setheo sa Taolo ya Melemo ya Boitekanelo ya Aforika Borwa mmogo le intaseteri eno ba samagane le dithulaganyo tsa go dira kopo ya go kwadisa meento e e ka dirisiwang mo bolwetseng jono, mme merero ya go obamela melao ya pabalesego, kalafo le boleng ke tsona dikarolo tse di botlhokwa mo go kwadiseng meento eno.

src: Kusebenta kwetinhlangotsi letinengi mayelana nekumba timayini ngalokungekho emtsetfweni nekungena eNyakatfo Kapa kuholele ekuboshweni kwebantfu labange-867, linyenti labo libuya eLesotho, eZimbabwe, eMzambiki nalabanye baseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Go Tshwaraganela go Lwantshana le Bosenyi Kabinete e neseditse pula tshedimosetso ya go e baya mo dinakong e e ka ga dikgato tsa go lwantshana le bosenyi, e Tona ya Mapodisi, Bheki Cele, a neelaneng ka yona mo setšhabeng mmogo le Setlhopha sa Maphata a a Farologaneng a Naga a go Lwantshana le Bosenyi.

src: Ikhabhinethi ivakalise luvo lwema-ejensi lacinisekisa kugcinwa kwemsetfo kutsi bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labafihla tigebengu letitibandzakanya ekugubheni timayini ngalokungekho emtsetfweni batawubukana nesandla semtsetfo ngalokuphelele.
tgt: Letsholo la go lwantshana le bosenyi le le tshwaraganetsweng ke ditheo tse di farologaneng tsa molao kwa porofenseng ya Kapa Bokone le le samaganeng le bogodu jwa dirašwa tsa meepo le kgonne go ka tshwara batho ba le 867, mme bontsi jwa bona bo tswa kwa nageng ya Lesotho, Zimbabwe, Mozambique mmogo le ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Simo selitulu lesibi salelive sigcizelela umtselela wetingucuko tesimomvama selitulu etimphilweni tetfu kanye nesidzingo sesinyatselo lesisimeme sekucedza ikhabhoni emnotfweni wetfu kodvwa sibe silandzela intfutfuko lesimeme.
tgt: Kabinete e boeletsa mafoko a ditheo tsa molao gore maAforika Borwa a a fitlhang ditlhokotsebe tse di amegang mo bogodung jwa dirašwa tsa meepo ba tla di gama ba sa di tlhapela.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyatiswa kabanti mayelana nemonakalo lobangwe tiphepho letimatima netikhukhula eMphumalanga Kapa, eNshonalanga Kapa naseGauteng, lokunetinkhomba letitsi kungenteka tisabalalele nakuletinye tifundza.
tgt: Maemo a a bogale a dipula ka fa nageng a bontsha gore re mo dinakong tsa phetogo ya maemo a loapi mmogo le gore go tlhokagala gore go tsewe dikgato tsa go fedisa kgotlhelo ya loapi mo ditirong tsa ikonomi ntle le go kgaotsa tlhabololo e e tsepameng.

src: Ikhabhinethi icela imimango kutsi ihlale icaphelele kakhulu tecwayiso tesimo selitulu lesibi, lokungenteka kutsi siletse lomunye umonakalo eveni lonkhe.
tgt: Kabinete e beewa mo dinakong ka dipula le merwalela e e gogotseng mafelo kwa porofenseng ya Kapa Botlhaba, Kapa Bophirima le Gauteng, mme go na le kgonagalo ya gore ditshenyegelo tseno di tla aparela le diporofense tse dingwe.

src: Hulumene uyachubeka nekwesekela tinsita letiphutfumako kanye netikhungo tekulawula tinhlekelele kwenta imisebenti yekuhlenga kanye nekunika kwesekela kwebuntfu.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging go ntsha matlho dinameng fa go na le melaetsa e e ka ga dipula tse di bogale, tse di ka senyetsang pele ka fa nageng.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikunakile kwetsiwa kabusha kwemgwaco i-William Nicol Drive eSandton nga-Winnie Mandela Avenue njengesinyatselo lesimcoka sekubhala kabusha umlandvo waseNingizimu Afrika kute kukhonjiswe ligalelo lalabo labalwele inkhululeko yetfu.
tgt: Winnie Mandela Avenue Kabinete e neseditse pula kgato ya go fetola leina la mmila wa William Nicol Drive kwa teropong ya Sandton go o neela leina la Winnie Mandela Avenue jaaka e tsaya seno e le kgato e kgolo mo hisetoring ya naga ya Aforika Borwa ka go dira gore bao ba nnileng le seabe se se botlhokwa mo kgaratlhelong ya kgololesego maina a bona a tlhagelele ka magetla.

src: Lomcimbi wenteke ngesikhatsi sinye lebekungabe lusuku lwekugubha lusuku lwakhe lwekutalwa lwa-Winnie Madikizela-Mandela leminyaka lenge-87 mhla tinge-26 Inyoni 2023.Tincumo TekhabhinethiLisubuciko laseNingizimu Afrika Lolubuyeketiwe Lwetenyama Yenyamatane.
tgt: Moletlo ono o diragetse ka nako e le esi le nako eo e ka bong go ketekiwa letsatsi la matsalo la ga Winnie Madikizela-Mandela mo a ka bong a ne a keteka dingwaga di le 87 ka la bo 26 Lwetse 2023 fa a ne a ka bo a tshela.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikwemukele kufezekiswa kweLisubuciko laseNingizimu Afrika Lolubuyeketiwe Lwetenyama Yetinyamatane, lokuhloswe ngalo kwenta imboni yenyama yetinyamatane kutsi ibe semtsetfweni futsi iguculwe.
tgt: Ditshwetso tsa Kabinete Leano le le Kwalolotsweng Sešwa la Naga ya Aforika Borwa la Nama ya Diphologolo tsa Naga Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa gore go tsenngwe tirisong Leano le le Kwalolotsweng Sešwa la Naga ya Aforika Borwa la Nama ya Diphologolo tsa Naga, mme maitlhomo a lona ke go dira gore intaseteri ya nama ya diphologolo tsa naga e tsenngwe tirisong semmuso mmogo le go fetola intaseteri eno.

src: Lelisubuciko lihlose kucinisa umkhakha wetenyama yenyamatane njengemetfuli wekubakhona kwekudla kanye nemkhakha wekukhula kutemnotfo longasita kudala imisebenti.
tgt: Maitlhomo a leano leno ke go gagamatsa intaseteri ya nama ya diphologolo tsa naga gore le yona e nne le seabe mo go direng gore go se nne le tlhaelo ya dijo mmogo le mo go godiseng ikonomi gore le yona e tlhole ditiro.

src: INingizimu Afrika ibekwe yaba yekucala lapha kulelivekati lase-Afrika ngekukhicita inyama yetinyamatane.
tgt: Aforika Borwa ke yona e e di gogang kwa pele ka fa kontinenteng ya Aforika fa go tla mo nameng ya diphologolo tsa naga.

src: Lelisubuciko lihlose kucinisekisa kudaleka kwemisebenti lesimeme leti-202 666 kumkhakha wetenyama yenyamatane nga-2030.
tgt: Leano leno le ikaeletse go tlhola ditiro di ka nna 202 666 tse di tla nnelang ruri mo lephateng la intaseteri ya nama ya diphologolo tsa naga mo ngwageng wa 2030.

src: Lelisubuciko litawushicilelwa kuwebhusayithi yeLitiko Letemahlatsi, Tekudoba Nemvelo ku: www.
tgt: Leano leno le tla phasaladiwa mo webesaeteng ya Lefapheng la Merero ya Dikgwa, Botshwaro jwa Ditlhapi le ya Tikologo mo go: WEBTOKELeanokonokono la Kgwebo ya Bojanala Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go bapisa Leano la go Tsosolosa Lekala la Bojanala le Leanokonokono la Kgwebo ya Bojanala.

src: Lisu Lelikhulu Lemkhakha Wetekuvakasha.
tgt: Le thusa gape le gore naga e itharabologelwe ka botlalo mo lephateng la bojanala.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kwentiwa kwekutsi Lisu Lekuvusetela Kabusha Lemkhakha Wetekuvakasha lihambisane neLisu Lelikhulu Letekuvakasha lelisha.
tgt: Fela jaaka maitlhomo a Leano la go Tsosolosa Lekala la Bojanala le ne le logetswe go thusa go tsosolosa lekala leno, go somarela ditiro le ditsela tse batho ba iphedisang ka tsona, Leanokonokono leno le logetswe go tsweletsa pele tiro ya leano leno ka go dira gore go nne le ditšhono tse dintšhwa mo lekaleng leno.

src: Incenye lebalulekile yaLelisu Lelikhulu kunciphisa imitselela lemibi yelubhubhane lwe-COVID-19 kulomkhakha wetekuvakasha.
tgt: Leano leno le tshitshinya dikgato di le supa go thusa go busetsa lekala la bojanala mo maemong a le neng le le mo go ona mo motsing yoo botshelo bo neng bo itobetsa, mme le dira gore lekala leno le nne botlhokwa mo go tlholeng ditiro le mo go itshimololeleng dikgwebo.

src: Lelisu liphakamisa emasubuciko ekungelela lasikhombisa kucinisekisa kutsi umkhakha wetekuvakasha ubuyela etinsukwini tawo ngesikhatsi usaseyimphumelelo, nekutsi ube sizindza sekudala imisebenti nemabhizinisi.
tgt: Intaseteri ya bojanala e na le seabe se se botlhokwa thata mo ikonoming, mme pele ga leroborobo la COVID-19 e ne e eme nokeng ditiro di le 725 000.

src: Umtsefosivivinyo Wenhlangano Yetekusakata Ngemoya yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SABC) wanga-2023.
tgt: Molaotlhomo wa Lekgotlakgaso la Aforika Borwa (SABC) wa Ngwaga wa 2023.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosisekelo we-SABC wanga-2023.
tgt: Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go isa kwa Palamenteng Molaotlhomo wa SABC wa 2023.

src: Nasewuphasiswe waba ngumtsetfo, loMtsetfosivivinyo utawuholela ekutseni kucitfwe loMtsetfo Wetekusakata Ngemoya lokhona, wanga-1999 (Umtsetfo Nombolo 4 wanga-1999).
tgt: Fa molaotlhomo ono o sena go fetisiwa go ka nna molao wa semmuso, o tla tsena mo legatong la molao wa ga jaana o o bidiwang Molao wa Kgaso wa ngwaga wa 1999 (Molao wa bo 4 wa 1999).

src: Letichibelo titawucinisa kusebenta ngelikhono kwalomsakato wesive.
tgt: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa di tla dira gore ditiro tsa setheo sa kgaso di nne tse di manontlhotlho.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uphindze uchubeke uphakamise kutsi kube netingucuko kumodeli ye-SABC yekusita ngetimali kanye naseluhlelweni lwekunika timvume te-TV.
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono o dira gape le ditshitshinyo mo mererong e e ka ga tlamelo ya SABC ka matlole mmogo le mo go ya dithulaganyo tsa dilaensense tsa thelebišene.

src: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wesikhashana Wekuchibela Tetinsita Temanti.
tgt: Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo yo o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Ditirelo tsa Metsi Kabinete e amogetse gore go phasaladiwe Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo yo o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Ditirelo tsa Metsi gore baagi ba ntshe se se mo mafatlheng a bona ka ga ona.

src: Ikhabhinethi yakwemukela kushicilelwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Tetinsita Temanti kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.
tgt: Maitlhomomagolo a Molaotlhomo ono ke go gagamatsa dikgato tsa go nna le maikarabelo ga batlamedi ba ditirelo tsa metsi mmogo le go dira gore mo lephateng leno go se nne mahunelo.

src: Tinhloso letimcoka taloMtsetfosivivinyo tekucinisa kutilandza kubatfulitinsita temanti kanye nekwetfula kutsi kungafihli lutfo.
tgt: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa mo Molaong wa Ditirelo tsa Metsi wa ngwaga wa 1997 (Molao wa bo 108 wa 1997) di tla dira bonnete jwa gore batlamedi ba ditirelo tsa metsi ba abelane ka metsi a maemo a ona a leng boleng jo bo kwa godimo jaaka seno e tla nna karolo ya ditlhokwa tse di beewang mo tumelanong ya go ba neela dilaesense.

src: Tichibelo letentiwe kuMtsetfo Wetetinsita Temanti, wanga-1997 (Umtsetfo Nombolo 108 wanga-1997) titawucinisekisa kutsi batfulitinsita temanti baletsa emanti lasezingeni lelisetulu njengencenye yetinchabekelwane tekunikwa imvume.
tgt: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa tseno di tla thusa gape le go tswalela makoa a a nopotsweng mo lekaleng la ditirelo tsa metsi.

src: Letichibelo titawuphindza futsi tilungise butsakatsaka losebubonakele kumkhakha wetinsita temanti.
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono o tlhoma maemo a batlamedi ba ditirelo tsa metsi ba tshwanetsweng go itepatepanya nao, mme tiro ya go netefatsa gore go itepatepanngwa nao e rwele ke magetla a Setheo sa Ditirelo tsa Metsi.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo ubeka tilinganisozinga telinanincane tekusebenta kwebatfulitinsita betinsita temanti, lekufanele kutsi ticinisekiswe tiphatsimandla Tetinsita Temanti kutsi tiyagcinwa.
tgt: Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Metsi a Naga Kabinete e amogetse gore go phasaladiwe Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Metsi a Naga gore baagi ba ntshe se se mo mafatlheng a bona ka ga ona.

src: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wesikhashana Wavelonkhe Wekuchibela Temanti.
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono o kwalola sešwa Molao wa Metsi a Naga wa ngwaga wa 1998 (Molao wa bo 36 wa 1998).

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo wesikhashana Wavelonkhe Wekuchibela Temanti kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.
tgt: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa di tla thusa go tokafatsa melawanataolo ya metsi mmogo le go dira bonnete jwa gore metsi a naga a tlhokomelwa ka tshwanelo, a sirelediwa mmogo le go somarelwa.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibela Umtsetfo Wavelonkhe Wetemanti, wanga-1998 (Umtsetfo Nombolo 36 wanga-1998).
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono o dira ditshitshinyo tsa gore go fedisiwe go tlhoka tekatekano go go tlhodilweng ke ditiragalo tsa mo nakong e e fetileng tse di ka ga kabelo ya metsi, mme o tshitshinya gore go nne le dikgato tse di matlhagatlhaga tsa go rarabolola ka bonako dikgogakgogano tse di nnang teng magareng ga ditheo tse di dirisanang mmogo.

src: Letichibelo titawutfutfukisa imitsetfosimiso futsi titawucinisekisa kutsi imitfombolusito yemanti yalelive ilawulwa kahle, iyavikelwa futsi iyalondvolotwa.
tgt: Go Thapiwa Pele batho botlhe ba thapiwa go tla tlhatlhobiwa makwalo a bona a dithuto le ditlankana dingwe tse di tlhokagalang.

src: Mnu Kuberndran Moodley njengeMlawuli Jikelele: Kwakha Imphahla Nebunjiniyela ku-Government Printing Works.
tgt: Rre Kuberndran Moodley o thapilwe go nna Motsamaisimogolo: mo Lekaleng la Tlhagisodikuno le Boenjenere mo Setheong sa Puso sa Bogatisi.

src: Mnu Sihle Ngubane njengeMlawuli Jikelele: Lulawulo Lwetemisebenti ku-Government Printing WEBTOKEMmolaeng Mooki njengeMlawuli Jikelele: Temisebenti ku-Government Printing Works.
tgt: Rre Sihle Ngubane o thapilwe go nna Motsamaisimogolo: mo Lekaleng la Tsamaiso ya Tiro mo Setheong sa Puso sa Bogatisi.

src: Kucashwa kwebacondzisi labangekho esigungwini lesiphetse seBhodi ye-South African Special Risk Insurance Association.
tgt: Mme Mmolaeng Mooki o thapilwe go nna Motsamaisimogolo: mo Lekaleng la Ditirelo tsa Taolo ya Tsamaiso ya Setheo mo Setheong sa Puso sa Bogatisi.

src: Kucashwa kwebacondzisi labangekho kusigungu lesiphetse eBhodini Ye-Development Bank of Southern Africa.
tgt: Go thapiwa ga Bakaedi bao e Seng ba Khuduthamaga ba Boto ya Mokgatlho wa Ditlamo tsa Diinšorense tsa Matshosetsi a a Itlhophileng tsa Aforika Borwa.

src: Inyanga Yetekutfutsa kulonyaka itawukhunjulwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Siyakha – Sakha sakhiwonchanti lesincono kute sikhulise iNingizimu Afrika.”.
tgt: Kgwedi ya Dipalangwa Monongwaga Kgwedi ya go Keteka Dipalangwa e tla ketekiwa ka molaetsamogolo yo o reng: “Re a Aga - Re aga mafaratlhatlha a a botoka thata gore Aforika Borwa e kgone go gola”.

src: Inyanga Yetekutfutsa yanga-2023 itawugcila kulutjalomali lolukhulu kusakhiwonchanti setekutfutsa, kanye nekucela kutsi kube khona lokwentiwako kuvikela sakhiwonchanti setekutfutsa kutsi singebiwa futsi singahhwatjulwa.
tgt: Kgwedi ya Dipalangwa ya ngwaga wa 2023 e tla tsepamisa mogopolo mo dipeeletsong tse dikgolo mo lephateng la mafaratlhatlha a dipalangwa, mmogo le mo go direng boikuelo jwa gore mafaratlhatlha a dipalangwa a tlhokomelwe gore a se utswiwe le go phutlhamisiwa.

src: INingizimu Afrika itawuhlanganyela nemhlaba wonkhe ekugubheni Lusuku Lwabothishela Lwemhlaba ngaLesine, mhla ti-5 Imphahla 2023, ngaphasi lwengcikitsi letsi: “Bothishela lesibadzingako bemfundvo lesiyifunako: Sibopho semhlaba wonkhe sekubuyisela emuva kweswelakala kabothishela.” Lolusuku kucondvwe ngalo kucaphelisa, kuvisisa nekudvumisa ligalelo lelimcoka labothishela labalifakako kutemfundvo kanye nentfutfuko emhlabeni wonkhe.
tgt: Letsatsi la go Keteka Tiro ya Barutabana Naga ya Aforika Borwa e tla keteka mmogo le lefatshe ka bophara Letsatsi la go Keteka Tiro ya Barutabana ka Labone wa la bo 05 Diphalane 2023 ka molaetsamogolo yo o reng: “Barutabana ba re ba tlhokang go tlisa thuto e re e batlang: dikgato tse di botlhokwa tsa lefatshe ka bophara tsa go dira gore barutabana ba se tlhaele”.Maitlhomo a letsatsi leno ke go lemosa setšhaba, go dira gore se tlhaloganye le go lemoga botlhokwa jo barutabana ba nang le bona mo thutong le mo go tliseng tlhabologo lefatshe ka bophara.

src: Lolusuku lumenyetelwe ngekuhlanganyela Inhlangano Yemave Emhlaba Yetebasebenti neNhlangano Yetemfundvo, Yetesayensi Nemasiko yaMhlabuhlangene ngenhloso yekugubha umsebenti lomcoka lowentiwa bothishela betfu.
tgt: Letsatsi leno le utlawnetswe mmogo ke Mokgatlho wa Lefatshe wa Badiri mmogo le Mokgatlho wa Dinagakopano o o ka ga Merero ya Thuto, Saense le Ditso go keteka tiro e e botlhokwa e barutabana ba rona ba e dirang.

src: ImilayetoKuhalaliselaIkhabhinethi ihalalisela iphindze futsi ifisele tilokotfo letinhle ku:Jenene Bheki Cele, Indvuna Yetemaphoyisa, loklonyeliswe nge-Great Wall Commemorative Medal yaseRiphabhliki yaseShayina ngeligalelo lelifakwe Luphiko Lwetemaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika ngekucinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo ngalokubanti emkhatsini walamave WEBTOKEAngie Motshekga, Indvuna Yetemfundvo Lesisekelo, ngekukhetfwa nguMabhalane Jikelele waMhlabuhlangene Mnu Antonio Guterres, kutsi atewusebenta kuPhaneli Yemhlaba Wonkhe Lesezingeni Lelisetulu kute atemeluleka ngekutsi emave kufanele kutsi atigucule njani tinhlelo tawo tetemfundvo.
tgt: Melaetsa ya go AkgolaKabinete e romela melaetsa ya yona ya go akgola le go eletsa masego kwa go: Rre Bheki Cele, Tona ya Mapodisi, yo a abetsweng Metale wa Tlotlo wa Great Wall go tswa kwa nageng ya China mabapi le go nneng le seabe ga gagwe mo Tirelong ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) mo go dirisaneng le ditheong ka bontsi tsa molao tse di dirisanang le dinaga ka bobedi.

src: Kukhetfwa kweNdvuna Motshekga kutsi angene kulephaneli lesezingeni leliphakeme kukhombisa lizinga lakhe lebungcweti emkhakheni wetemfundvo futsi kuyinkhomba yekwetsemba indlela yetemfundvo yelive laseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Mme Angie Motshekga, Tona ya Thuto ya Motheo, jaaka a tlhophilwe ke Mokwaledikakaretso wa UN Rre Antonio Guterres, gore a nne yo mongwe wa baeletsi ba gagwe ba bagolo mo Setlhopheng sa Merero e e kwa Godimo mo Lefatsheng ba ba mo eletsang ka fao dinaga di ka fetolang ka gone dithulaganyo tsa tsona tsa thuto.

src: Lephaneli ifaka ekhatsi labamelele Inhlangano Yemave Emhlaba Yebasebenti, neNhlangano Yetemfundvo, Yetesayensi Nemasiko yaMhlabuhlangene Yabothishela Yemsebenti Lotsite, Tinyonyana Temhlaba Wonkhe Tabothishela kanye neTindvuna letintsatfu temfundvo.
tgt: Go tlhophiwa ga Tona Motshekga mo Setlhopheng sa Merero e e kwa Godimo mo Lefatsheng go supa kitso e e tseneletseng e a nang le yona mo thutong e bile seno ke sesopu sa go bontsha tshepo mo dikgatong tsa thuto tse Aforika Borwa e di WEBTOKEN setlhopheng seno go na le baemedi go tswa kwa Mokgatlhong wa Lefatshe wa Badiri, Setlhopha sa Barutabana sa Mokgatlho wa Dinagakopano o o ka ga Merero ya Thuto, Saense le Ditso, Mokgatlho wa Lefatshe wa Badiri mmogo le Ditona di le tharo tsa Thuto.

src: Lephaneli bosihlalo bayo labebabosihlalo bobabili bekuBomengameli baphambilini.
tgt: Setlhopha seno se tla etelelwa pele ke Baporesitente ba mo malobeng ba le babedi.

src: KuTitjudiyo Temafilimu taseKapa, balingisi bendzawo kanye nemaciko laceceshiwe, ngemisebenti yabo kuluchungechunge lwe-Netflix, leluthi-One Piece leluphume embili emhlabeni wonkhe letisakatwa etinkhundleni te-inthanethi.
tgt: Disetudio tsa kwa Motse Kapa tsa Metshameko ya Difilimi, batshameko ba ka fa nageng mmogo le bao ba diragatsang ditiro tse di masisi mo legatong la batshameki, jaaka ba dirile bontle mo Metshamekong ya ditshwatsho tsa Netflix, mo setshwantsho sa One Piece, se tlhatlogetseng kwa maemong a ntlha a a kwa godimo a setshwantsho se se bogelwang ga jaana ke batho ba bantsi mo diraleng tse di gasang ditshwantsho tse di bogelwang.

src: A. Tindzaba Letibalulekile Talelive Tihlabani Tendzebe Yemhlaba Yelibhola Lembhoco Yanga-2023 IKhabhinethi ihalalisele Emabhokobhoko ngekuphumelela kutsatsa Indzebe Yemhlaba Yelibhola Lembhoco yanga-2023 leyenta kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ibe ngilo lodvwa live lelitsetse Lendzebe Yemhlaba Yelibhola Lembhoco emahlandla lamane nekutsi litsatse lendzebe tikhatsi letimbili ngekulandzelana.
tgt: Merero ya ga Jaanong Bagale ba Sejana sa Lefatshe sa Metshameko ya Rakabi ya Ngwaga wa 2023 Kabinete e akgotse setlhopha sa di-Springbok jaaka se fentse Sejana sa Lefatshe sa Metshameko ya Rakabi ya Ngwaga wa 2023 mme phenyo eno e dirile gore Aforika Borwa e nne yona naga e le esi mo lefatsheng go ka fenya makgetlo a le mane Sejana sa Lefatshe sa Metshameko ya Rakabi mme e bile gape setlhopha seno se fentse sejana seno ka tlhomagano makgetlo a le mabedi.

src: Emlandvweni welibhola lembhoco, lelicembu leMabhokobhoko ngilona libhice tinhlanga letehlukene kunawo onkhe emacembu ngekwebuhlanga bebantfu labakhona eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Fa e sale go nna le rakabi mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa setlhopha seno sa di-Springbok ke sona sa ntlha se se emetsweng ke batshameki ba merafe e e farologaneng ya naga ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Kuhlanganiswa kwalelicembu lelibhice kangaka akuzange kumane kwenteke nje, kepha kwaba yimitamo leyentiwa ngulabaphetse kanye netisebenti leticecesha lelicembu leMabhokobhoko yekutsi bakhetse licembu lelifaka bantfu labehlukene.
tgt: Gore setlhopha seno se rulaganngwe ka mokgwa o se leng ka ona ga se ka ntlha ya lesego, ke ka ntlha ya ditshweetso tse di totobetseng tse balaodi le bakatisi ba di tsereng ba butse matlho mo ba neng ba batla gore di-Springbok di emelwe ke setlhopha sa merafe e e farologaneng.

src: Leso sincumo semceceshi Rassie Erasmus nelicembu lakhe lesabonisa kuba nesibindzi siyachubeka kubonisa takhamuti taseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemhlaba wonkhe kwekutsi wonkhe umuntfu lonelikhono, uma anikwa litfuba nekusekelwa, angaba mkhulu - lokusiciniseko sekutsi Sinemandla Lamakhulu Uma Sihlangene.
tgt: Tshweetso e e nonofileng e e tserweng ke mokatisi wa mo malobeng Rassie Erasmus mmogo le setlhopha se se neng se mo eme nokeng e tswelela go iponagatsa mo go maAforika Borwa le mo lefatsheng ka bophara gore motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe yo a nang le bokgoni, fa a ka neelwa tšhono le go enngwa nokeng, a ka kgona go ntsha ga tshwene – mme seno ke bontlha bongwe jo bo totobatsang boammaruri jwa gore Re le Ngatananngwe ga go se se ka re Tsenang fa Gare.

src: Lokumcoka kakhulu, kucina nekutimisela kweMabhokobhoko enkhundleni yemdlalo kucuketse liciniso leliyingcikitsi yebuve baseNingizimu Afrika, loko lokwenta lelive lelihle kangaka liphakame limelane nebumatima kuze baphumelele bancobe.
tgt: Se se botlhokwa go gaisa ke ka fao batshameki ba di-Springbok ba neng ba kakatletse ka teng mo lebaleng fa ba ne ba tshameka e leng sesupo sa go nna moAforika Borwa tota, e leng sona se se dirang gore naga eno ya baganka e atlege le go finyelela le fa e tobane le dikgwetlho tsa dinta di fuduga.

src: Labanye bebadlali balelicembu leMabhokobhoko kubite kutsi bamelane netitsa lebetisendleleni yabo yekuphumelela.
tgt: Ba bangwe ba batshameki ba ba dirileng bontle mo setlhopheng seno sa di-Springbok ba ne ba itshokela dikgwetlho mo matshelong a bona gore ba kgone go atlega.

src: IKhabhinethi iphumisele kuhalalisa kwayo kuSiyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, longukapteni weMabhokobhoko Lotsetse Indzebe Yemhlaba kabili ngekuhola licembu lelibe kulelizinga lelibitwa nge-Greatest Of All Time (GOAT), lekungako lemigubho kumele ichubeke.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse Siyamtanda “Siya” Kolisi, mokapotene wa setlhopha sa di-Springbok sa go fenya gabedi ka tatelano Sejana sa Lefatshe jaaka a eteletse kwa pele setlhopha seno gore se kgone go fenya maemo a a iseng a tle a bonwe mme ka ntlha ya seno re tshwanetse go se kgaotse go keteka tiro e ntle eno.

src: Umhlangano we-AGOA IKhabhinethi isemukele sincumo sebaphatsi beMerikha kanye nemhlangano ngekuba nenhloso yekwelula sikhatsi se-AGOA, lokuyintfo leletsa sicinisekiso kubahlanyeli betimali kulawo mave lavumelekile ku-AGOIKhabhinethi beyiphindze yakwemukela kutsi leli lisingatse uMhlangano we-AGOA wanga-2023 eJozi kusukela mhlaka-2 kuya ku-4 kuLweti wanga-2023, lobenetihambi letivela emaveni langu-32 ase-Afrika letifaka ekhatsi bohulumende, bosomabhizinisi, umphakatsi wonkana kanye nekwekucala nalabamele tisebenti kanye nalabamele hulumende waseMerikha.
tgt: Kopano ya AGOA Kabinete e neseditse pula mafoko a puso ya Amerika mmogo le a palamente ya yona a go totobatsa gore ba ikemiseditse go oketsa nako ya go nna mo tirisong ga Molao wa Kgato ya go Oketsa Ditšhono tsa go Godisa Ikonomi ya Aforika (AGOA), mme seno se tla digela matswalo a bao ba batlang go ka beeletsa mo dinageng tse di nang le matshwanedi a go unngwelwa ke AGOKabinete e neseditse pula gape le go neelwa tetla ya go tshwara Kopano ya AGOA ya 2023 kwa Johannesburg go tloga ka la bo 2 go fitlha ka la bo 4 Ngwanaitseele 2023 mme e tla tsenelwa ke bannaleseabe go tswa kwa dinageng di le 32 tsa Aforika mo maphateng a puso, kgwebo, mme lekgetlho la ntlha fa e sale go tla bo go na le mekgatlho ya baagi le mekgatlho ya badiri mmogo le batlhankedi ba puso ya naga ya Amerika.

src: IKhabhinethi beyikadze ikuphakamisa kwekutsi i-AGOA iniketa litfuba lekutsi iMerikha icinise budlelwane bayo ne-Afrika kutemnotfo nekutsi ngaloko kumele ikuchubekise sikhatsi leseluliwe, nekutsi iciniswe kuze ibe nemiphumela futsi igcame.
tgt: Kabinete ga e a bolo go ema ka lefoko le le reng AGOA e naya Amerika tšhono ya go ka ema ka dintsetsenkwano go thusa ikonomi ya Aforika mme ka jalo go matshwanedi gore e okelediwe nako gore e nne mo tirisong sebaka se se utlwagalang, mme e atlaatlhiwe gore e kgone go nna le seabe se se utlwagalang mmogo le go ngokela.

src: Umhlangano WeTindvuna te-BRICS kuTekuvakasha IKhabhinethi ikwemukele kuphetfwa kweMhlangano We-2023 BRICS WeTindvuna KuTekuvakasha lobe yimphumelelo, lobewubanjelwe e-Cape Town, lapho emave layincenye yalenhlangano atibophelele ekubambisaneni lokujulile kanye nekutfutfukisa kuvakashelana kwe-BRICS, kusungula imizila letawutfutfukisa kuvakashelana kancono nekuchumana kwemave layincenye yalenhlangano.
tgt: Kopano ya Ditona tsa Bojanala mo Dinageng tsa BRICS Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go garela ka katlego Kopano ya Ngwaga wa 2023 ya Ditona tsa Bojanala mo Dinageng tsa BRICS e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Motsekapa, mme kopano eno e lopile dinaga tse e leng leloko go oketsa tirisanommogo ya tsona ka go rotloetsa go jelana nala ga batho ba dinaga tsa BRICS, go aga mebila gore go etelana le go golagana ga dinaga tse e leng leloko e nne selo se se botlhofo.

src: Loku kutawucinisa umkhakha wetekuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika losewuvele ubonisa timphawu tekuvuseteleka.
tgt: Seno se tla gagamatsa lephata la bojanala la naga ya Aforika Borwa jaaka le setse le ntse le itharabologelwa.

src: Etinyangeni letingu-8 tekucala kulomnyaka wa-2023, lelive libe netivakashi letingu-5.5 wetigidzi letifikile, loku yinkhulo lengu-63.4% uma kucatsaniswa nesikhatsi lesifanako emnyakeni wa-2022.
tgt: Mo dikgweding di le robedi tsa ntlha tsa ngwaga wa 2023, re bone ka fa nageng go goroga bajanala ba le dimilione di le tlhano le halofo mme palo eno e lekana le koketsego ya bokana ka diphesente di le 63.4% go tloga mo go tsa yona paka eno mo ngwageng wa 2022.

src: Kubhalisela Kuvota I-IEC seyimemetele imphelasontfo yekucala mhlaka-18 na 19 kuLweti 2023 kutsi ibe yekubhalisela Kuvota Elukhetfweni Lwavelonkhe lwa-2024.
tgt: Go Ikwadisetsa go Tlhopha Khomišene e e Ikemetseng ya Ditlhopho (IEC) e tsibositse gore ka la bo 18 le la bo 19 Ngwanaitseele 2023 e tla bo e le matsatsi a bokhutlho jwa beke jwa ntlha a go ikwadisetsa go tlhopha mo Ditlhophong tsa ngwaga wa 2024.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhutsata bonkhe labavunyelwe kuvota kutsi babhalisele kuvota Elukhetfweni Lwavelonkhe lwa-2024 etindzaweni tekuvota lesitedvute.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo bathong botlhe ba ba nang le matshwanedi a go tlhopha go ikwadisetsa go tlhopha mo Ditlhophong tsa ngwaga wa 2024 ka go leba kwa mafelong a ditlhopho a mo metseng ya bona.

src: Kubhalisa nge-intanethi kwebavoti kwavulwa kusukela ngeNdlovana 2023 futsi takhamuti tiyakhutsatwa kutsi tisebentise letinsita kuze babhalise noma balungise imininingwane yabo.
tgt: Serala sa go ikwadisetsa ditlhopho ka inthanete ga se a bolo go bula ka Tlhakole 2023 mme baagi go ikuelwa mo go bona go sola mosola serala seno ka go ikwadisa mo go sona kgotsa ka go tsenya dintlha tsa bona mo dinakong.

src: Takhamuti taseNingizimu Afrika letifake ticelo tema-ID tiyakhutsatwa nato kutsi tivakashele emaHhovisi Elitiko Letasekhaya kuyowalandza.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a a dirileng dikopo tsa makwaloitshupo go ikuelwa mo go bona go leba kwa dikantorong tsa Merero ya Selegae go di lata.

src: Kunema-ID langemakhadi langetulu kweti-500 000 lasolo angakalandvwa emaHhovisi Elitiko Letasekhaya eveni lonkhe.
tgt: Go santse go na le makwaloitshupo a feta a le 500 000 a a santseng a tlhoka beng ba ona go tla go a tsaya kwa dikantorong ya Merero ya Selegae go ralala le naga ka bophara.

src: Gezi Indvuna leseHhovisi LaMengameli lephetse lindzaba taGezi ikhulume kabanti nesive ngesimo sagezi eveni.
tgt: Motlakase Tona mo Kantorong ya Moporesitente e e rweleng maikarabelo mo kantorong ya Tona ya Merero ya Motlakase o buile go tlala molomo ka maemo a motlakase ka fa nageng.

src: IKhabhinethi iyidvumisile imitamo yaHulumende Wesifundza se-Gauteng losebenta ne-Eskom kulungisa gezi etindzaweni letise-Gauteng lebetihlushwa kuhamba kwagezi ngenca yekubiwa noma kubhidlita ema-transformer.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse Puso ya Porofense ya Gauteng jaaka e dirisana le setlamo sa Eskom gore ba busetse motlakase kwa mafelong a a kgaoletsweng motlakase a kwa Gauteng ka ntlha ya go utswiwa kgotsa go senyega ga diteransefomara tsa motlakase.

src: Ebusuku bayitolo, kukhanyiswe ema-transformer agezi lasitfupha eKagiso, lese-West Rand emva kwekutsi takhamuti takhona tihleli ngaphandle kwagezi iminyaka lengetulu kwalemitsatfu.
tgt: Maabane bosigo go letswe go tshumilwe diteransefomara tsa motlakase tse dintšhwa di le thataro kwa Kagiso, mo kgaolong ya West Rand morago ga gore baagi ba foo ba fetse dingwaga di le tharo ba se na motlakase.

src: IKhabhinethi imema lemiphakatsi kutsi ivikele letakhiwo ekubiweni, kumoshwa kanye nemonakalo lokubangwa kokhela gezi ngalokungekho emtsetfweni.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging bano go tlhokomela mafaratlhatlha ano a a botlhokwa gore a se utswiwe ke magodu, ba se a senye bona ka bo bona ka ntlha ya fa ba batla go itsenyetsa motlakase go se mo molaong.

src: Kudla lokunebutsi IKhabhinethi ikhatsatekile ngakuvama kwekutsi bantfwana badle kudla lokunebutsi ngoba badla kudla losekudlulelwe sikhatsi, nalokonakele lokutsengiswa etipaza nasetitaladini.
tgt: Dijo tse di nang le botlhole Kabinete e tshwenyegile thata ka dintsho tse di ganang go fela tsa bana ba ba nnye ba ba fetsang ke dijo tse di feletsweng ke nako le tse di kgotlhelegileng tse ba di rekang kwa mabentleleng a di-spaza le mo bathong ba ba rekisang mo mebileng.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakhutsateka ngemitamo yebemtsetfo kucinisa tekuphepha nekulandzelwa kwemigomo yekudla.
tgt: Kabinete e tiisitswe maatla ke dikgato tse ditheo tsa molao di di tsereng mo go direng gore go obamelwe melao e e buang ka tlhokomelo ya dijo.

src: Umhlangano Wekucecesha Kutfutsela Kulamanye Emave Nebaholi Bemadolobha kanye Nebendzabuko IKhabhinethi yatjelwa kafishane ngalomhlangano wekucecesha lowabanjwa Litiko Letasekhaya nalowahanjelwa yi-DSBD, i-COGTA, Litiko Letekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu kanye nebaholi bendzabuko, nebaholi bemadolobha labaphuma kubomasipala bemadolobha kanye netigodzi, lebewubuka tindlela tekuncandvwa kwemiphumela yekungena eveni ngalokungekho emtsetfweni, lokufaka ekhatsi kusebenta kwetipaza.
tgt: Kopano ya go Tlhatlhelela Dimeyara le Magosi ka Phudugelo ya Baditšhaba Kabinete e tsibositswe ka Kopano ya go Tlhatlhelela Dimeyara le Magosi ka Phudugelo ya Baditšhaba e e neng e tshwerwe ke Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae mo Lefapha la Thuso ya Dikgwebopotlana (DSBD), la Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Setso (CoGTA), le la Bonno jwa Batho ba nnileng le seabe mmogo le magosi le dimeyara tsa diteropokgolo le tsa dikgaolo ba atlhaatlhileng kgang ya gore ba ka fokotsa jang ditiragalo tsa batho ba ba tlang ka fa nageng go se mo molaong, mmogo le ona mabenkele a di-spaza.

src: Imiphumela lesembili ifaka ekhatsi kucalwa kweluchungechunge lwetichibelo temitsetfo yekubukana netingcinamba letiphatselene nekutsi bomasipala kanye netiphatsimandla tendzabuko bacinise tichibelo temitsetfo yemabhizinisi.
tgt: Dintlha tse di botlhokwa tse di tswileng foo ke go tsenya tirisong matsholo a sekaseka mabenkele go bona gore a obamela melao ya dimasepala le ya magosi.

src: Kutawuba khona kuhlolwa kwemabhizinisi, ikakhulu tipaza ngulabaphuma ematiko etekusebenta, temphilo, kusungulwa kwemabhizinisi lamancane kanye nemacembu ebahloli beLitiko Letasekhaya, khona kutawucinisa kulandzelwa kwemigomo ngekusebentisa imitsetfo lefanele.
tgt: Go tla simololwa ka gangwe matsholo a go phuruphutsa dikgwebo, segolobogolo dikgwebo tsa di-spaza mme tiro eno e tla diriwa ke ba lefapha la merero ya ditiro, la boitekanelo, la thuso ya dikgwebopotlana mmogo le la merero ya selegae leo le tla bong le emetswe ke batlhankedi ba go phuruphutsa ditokomane tsa go tsena ka fa nageng, mme seno se tla dira bonnete jwa gore go ikobelwa melao ya naga e e leng teng.

src: Kutawentiwa luphenyo lwetipaza etindzaweni tasemakhaya kanye nasemalokishini, lokuhambisana netindlela tekutsi tibhaliswe lokutawentiwa baholi bendzabuko kanye nabomasipala.
tgt: Go tla tsewa dikgato tsa go sekaseka mabentlele a di-spaza a a butsweng kwa metseselegaeng le kwa makeišeneng, mme go tla nna le ditsela tse di tsenngwang tirisong tsa go kwadisa dikgwebo tseno mo dikantorong tsa magosi kgotsa tsa dimasepala.

src: Kuphindze kube khona nemitamo yekusekela tiphatsimandla tendzabuko kwekutsi bagcine luhlu lalabaphuma kulamanye emave emiphakatsini yabo.
tgt: Go na gape le dikgato tsa go ema nokeng ditshwetso tsa gore magosi a nne le rekoto ya gore batho ba ba nnang foo ba tswa kwa dinageng tsa kwa ntle ke bo mang.

src: Imitsetfo yekubhaliswa kwemabhizinisi nayo iyaguculwa kuze kusekelwe bonkhe labo labafuna kutsengisa kulomkhakha wekutisebentela.
tgt: Go samaganwe le go kwalola sešwa molao wa go rebola dilaesense tsa dikgwebo gore o kgone go ema nokeng batho botlhe ba ba batlang go simolola dikgwebo tse di sa kwadisiwang.

src: Kulwa Nebugebengu Lokuhlangahlangene IKhabhinethi iyayincoma i-SAPS ngekuncandza ngemandla kwalabo lababambisana ngekutsengiswa kwetidzakamiva lokulandzela kutfolakala kwe-cocaine lengabita emarandi latigidzi letingu-80 leyatsatfwa mhlaka-20 kuMphala 2023 endzaweni yekugcina imphahla e-Dube Trade Port ngekhatsi kweSikhumulo Setindiza I-King Shaka.
tgt: Letsholo le le Tshwaraganetsweng la go Lwantshana le Bosenyi Kabinete e akgotse Tirelo ya Mapodisi a Aforika Borwa (SAPS) ka tsela eo e phuagantseng ditiragalo tsa digongwana tsa bogodu tsa go gweba ka diritibatse ka ntlha ya go utolola le go thopa diritibatsi tse di ka balelwang go R80 milione ka la bo 20 Diphalane 2023 kwa lefelong la go tlhokomela dithoto la Dube Trade Port kwa Boemelafofaneng jwa Difofane tsa Boditšhabatšhaba jwa King Shaka.

src: Emalangeni lamabili landvulela kutsatfwa kwaletidzakamiva, kwatsatfwa lenye i-cocaine lengabita emarandi latigidzi letinge-70 kukhonteyina eSikhumulweni Semikhumbi eThekwini.
tgt: Matsatsi a le mabedi pele ga letsatsi leno go ne go letswe go tshwerwe diritibatsi tse dingwe gape tsa khokheini tse di ka balelwang go R70 milione mo lefelong la go tlhokomela dithoto la Durban Harbour.

src: IKhabhinethi ishaya tandla ngemsebenti we-SAPS wekuphatamisa nekuhliphitwa kwetinhlelo tebugebengu emkhatsini wemave lokumisa kabi kakhulu imiphakatsi yetfu kanye nesive.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse SAPS ka tiro e ba e dirileng mo go latlhiseng motlhala bosenyi jo bo tsamaisanang le magodu a dinaga tsa boditšhaba jaaka seno se wisetsa baagi ba rona le naga ya rona ka digegi.

src: Umkhankaso lobitwa nge-Operation Safer Festive Season wetekuphepha ngesikhatsi semaholide sewuvele uveta titselo ngoba emaphoyisa sekabophe basolwa labangu-140, lebafaka ekhatsi longungcondvongcondvo wekumbiwa kwetimayini ngalokungekho emtsetfweni, nangekutsatsa tibhamu letingenawo emalayisensi.
tgt: Letsholo la Tshireletsego mo Pakeng ya Matsatsi a Dikeresemose le setse le re tswela mosola mo re boneng mapodisi a golega babelaelwa ba feta ba le 140, go tsenyeletsa le mmelaelwa yo a latofadiwang ka gore ke ene komang ka nna wa ditiragalo tsa bogodu jwa dirašwa, mmogo le go thopa ditlhobolo tse di seng mo molaong.

src: .IKhabhinethi ikwemukele Kuhambela kwaMongameli welive kuMasipala wase-Emfuleni lwekuyohlola kuchubeka kwemsebenti, lobekulandzelela emva kwetingcoco letabakhona nemphakatsi ngesikhatsi sekuchutjwa kweLuhlelo Lekutfutfukisa Tigodzi (i-DDM) nga-2022.
tgt: Leeto la Moporesitente la go Lekola Maemo Kabinete e neseditse pula Leeto la Moporesitente la go Lekola Maemo kwa Masepaleng wa Emfuleni, mme mo leetong leno Moporesitente o ne a ikgata motlhala morago ga gore a tsee leeto la ntlha la Leano la Tiragatso ya Kabo ya Ditirelo le le Ikaegileng ka Ditikologo mo ngwageng wa 2022.

src: Kuvakashela e-Emfuleni nga-2022 kwaveta tingcinamba tekugcinwa kwesakhiwonchanti ngumasipala.
tgt: Mo leetong la ngwaga wa 2022 kwa Emfuleni go nopotswe dikgwetlho tse di tsamaisanang le masepala jaaka o sa tlhokomele mafaratlhatlha.

src: .Ngekungenelela kweLitiko Letemanti Netekuhlanta, kwaba nenchubekela embili leyabonakala ekubukeni tingcinamba letiphatselene netakhiwonchanti temanti kanye nekuhlanta letabangela kungasebenti kwe-Vaal Water Waste.
tgt: Ka ntlha ya go thusiwa ke Lefapha la Metsi le Kgeleloleswe, jaanong go na le ponelopele ya gore go lebilwe kae mo go rarabololeng matsapa a metsi le kgeleloleswe a a dirileng gore Bodutelo jwa go Tlhatswa Metsi a a Leswe jwa Vaal bo phutlhame.

src: Kunemisebenti leseyentiwe kutfutfukisa kwabiwa kwemanti, kusebenta kahle kwetakhiwonchanti temanti langcolile kanye nekucedvwa kwenkinga yemangcoliso lagijima etitaladini nasemabaleni etakhamuti.
tgt: Go setse go simolotswe ka tiro ya go baakanya tlamelo ya metsi, go dira gore bodutelo jwa go tlhatswa metsi a a letswe bo dire ka tshwanelo le go fedisa matsapa a kgelelolese gore re se nne le mantle a a gasaganeng mo mebileng le mo malapeng a batho.

src: Inchubekela embili leyabonakala ngesikhatsi salokuvakasha ifaka ekhatsi kuphuculwa kwemaphayiphi kanye netiteshi tekufutsa emanti lamaningi, kulungiswa nekuchitjelwa kwemigwaco, kanye nekutfutfukiswa kwekukhanyisa nekuphepha ngekutsi kufakwe emalambu etitaladini.
tgt: Seo go bonagetseng e kete go na le kgatelopele mo teng ke dipeipi tse dikgolo tsa metsi mmogo le diteišene tsa dipompo tsa metsi, go tsosoloswa le go tshelwa ga dikontiri, mmogo le matsholo a magolo a go tsenya mabone mo mebileng gore go nne le lesedi le gore go nne le pabalesego.

src: INkhombandlela Yenchubo Yetekutfutfwa Kwemphahla eNingizimu Afrika Litiko Letekutfutsa selicale tinkhulumo letimayelana neNkhombandlela Yenchubo Yetekutfutfwa Kwemphahla eNingizimu Afrika, lokuyincenye yetaba tekubhekana netingcinamba letibukene nemkhakha wetekutfutsa nekuhanjiswa kwemphahla kanye nekuciniswa kwemitamo yekuvusetela umnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Leano la Tsamaiso ya Dithoto la Ditlamo tsa Naga ya Aforika Borwa Lefapha la Dipalangwa le setse le boloditse letsholo la go batla maikutlo a Ditlamo tsa Naga ya Aforika Borwa tsa Tsamaiso ya Dithoto, jaaka seno e le karolo ya dikgato tse di tsewang go rarabolola dikgwetlho tse di tobaneng le lephata la tsamaiso ya dithoto mmogo le go matlafatsa maiteko a go busetsa sekeng maemo a ikonomi ya Aforika Borwa sekeng.

src: Kutfutfukiswa Nekugcinwa Kwetakhiwonchanti IKhabhinethi iyemukele inchubekela embili leyentiwa kutfutfukiswa kanye nekugcinwa kwetakhiwonchanti ngekutsi kuphetfwe kwakhiwa kwemabhuloho langu-36 etindzaweni tasemaphandleni ngephasi kwemkhankaso i-Welisizwe Rural Bridges, kanye nekwakhiwa lokusachubeka kwemiklamo lengu-20 yetekuhlaliswa kwebantfu, imigwaco, kanye nemanti.
tgt: Kago le Tlhokomelo ya Mafaratlhatlha Kabinete e neseditse pula kgatelopele e e diriwang mabapi le go agiwa le go tlhokomelwa ga mafaratlhatlha mo go setseng go konoseditswe diporojeke tsa go agiwa ga maborogo a le 36 kwa metseselegaeng ka letsholo la Mborogo a Metseselegae la Welisizwe, mmogo le matsholo a go samaganweng nao a diporojeke di le 20 tsa go aga dintlo, ditsela le mafaratlhatlha a metsi.

src: Kubuyiselwa Kwemizila Yekuya Kulamanye Emave Kwe-South African Airways (i-SAA) IKhabhinethi ikwemukele kubuyiselwa kwemizila yekundizela kulamanye emave kwe-SAA ngekutsi kuphindze kucalwe tindiza emkhatsini welivekati kuya e-São Paulo, e-Brazil, lokukhombise kubuya kwemizila lemidze lesuka e-Cape Town kanye naseJozi.
tgt: Go Bulwa Sešwa ga Mebila ya go Leba kwa Dinageng tsa Boditšhabatšhaba ka Difofane tsa Naga ya Aforika Borwa Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go bulwa Sešwa ga Mebila ya SAA go Leba kwa Dinageng tsa Boditšhabatšhaba mmogo le go busediwa tirong gape ga difofane tsa yona tsa mebila ya ka fa kontinenteng go leba kwa São Paulo, Brazil, mme seno se tshwaile gape le go busediwa tirong ga ditirelo tsa maeto a matelele a go tloga kwa Motse Kapa go leba kwa Johannesburg.

src: Lokubuyela kuletindlela tekundizela kulamanye emave kutawufaka sandla ekuphakamiseni kukhula kwekuhambela kwalamanye emave kuleli, kanye nekukhula kwemkhakha wetekuvakasha kulandzela umonakalo lowadalwa yi-COVID-19.
tgt: Go busediwa tirong ga maeto a go leba kwa dinageng tsa boditšhabatšhaba ga SAA go tla nna le seabe mo go godiseng kgolo mo maetong a boditšhabatšhaba a go leba ka fa nageng, mmogo le go godisa lephata la bojanala go latela gore le phuaganngwe ke leroborobo la COVID-19.

src: INingizimu Afrika isungula idroni lenkhulu kunawo wonkhe e-Afrika IKhabhinethi ihalalisele inkampani yaka-Milkor yeTekuvikela kanye netekundiza, ngekuphumelela kusungula I-Milkor 380, lekuyindizamshini lengashayelwa ngumuntfu, leyente kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ibalwe kanye nalamanye emave lachubeka ngemandla kutebuchwepheshe bemadroni.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e Thankgolola Terouno e Kgolo go Gaisa tsa Dinaga tse Dingwe tsa Aforika Kabinete e akgotse Sesole sa yona mmogo le setlamo sa go aga difofane sa Milkor jaaka ba atlegile mo go thankgololeng sefofane se se okomelang maemo se le kwa godimo (UAV) se se bediwang Milkor 380, mme seno se raya gore naga ya Aforika Borwa ke e nngwe ya dinaga tse di ntshang ga tshwene fa go tla mo go thekenolojing ya difofane tsa diterouno.

src: Le-Milkor 380 yidroni lenkhulu kunawo onkhe lekakhiwe e-Afrika futsi itawusetjentiswa kuhlasela ngumkhakha wetekuvikela, kulawula imincele, nemitamo yekonga imvelo lefaka ekhatsi kuncandza kutingela ngalokungekho emtsetfweni.
tgt: Milkor 380 ke terouno e kgolo e e iseng e tle e agiwe ka fa kontinenteng ya Aforika mme e tla dirisiwa ke sesole mo dintweng, mo go diseng melelwane, mo go tlhokomeleng tlhago mmogo le mo go lwantshaneng le polao ya diphologolo tsa naga.

src: Luhlolo Lwetikolwa Lwekuphetsa Umyaka kanye NaMethrikhi IKhabhinethi ikwemukele kucala kahle kweluhlolo Lwesitifiketi Selibanga Lelisetulu (iMethrikhi) lwanga-2023, lolucale mhlaka-30 kuMphala 2023.
tgt: Ditlhatlhobo tsa Bokhutlho jwa Ngwaga mmogo le tsa Mameteriki Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke ditlhatlhobo tse di simolotseng sentle tsa Ngwaga wa 2023 tsa go Kwala Lekwalo la Naga la Dithuto tse Dikgolwane, mme tsona di simolotse ka la bo 30 Diphalane 2023.

src: Batali kanye nebagcini bayakhutsatwa kwekutsi bachubeke kusekela bafundzi ngalesikhatsi lesimcoka kangaka.
tgt: Batsadi le bagodisi ba bana ba rotloediwa go tswelela go ema barutwana nokeng mo pakeng e e botlhokwa eno.

src: Tincumo teKhabhinethi Simo SasePalestine IKhabhinethi ijabhile ngekutsi hulumende we-Israyeli ale kuhlonipha umtsetfo wemave nekuchubeka kucekela phasi tincumo teNhlangano Yamhlabuhlangene tekumisa kulwa ngaphandle kwekujeziswa.
tgt: Ditshwetso tsa Kabinete Seemo sa kwa Palestina Kabinete e swabile nko go feta molomo ke maitsholo a puso ya Iseraele a go gana go ikobela melao ya lefatshe jaaka e tswelela go bontsha lenyatso le le feletseng mo ditshweetsong tse di tserweng ke Dinagakopano tsa go fedisa ntwa e e runtseng koo.

src: Imizila yekuletsa lusito kubantfu basePalestine solo ivaliwe, intfo lenemiphumela lemibi kubantfwana, basikati kanye netakhamuti letingenacala.
tgt: Ditirelo tsa go thusa baagi ba Palestina ba ba leng mo tlalelong di santse di tswaleletswe ke puso ya Iseraele, mme seno ga se jese diwelang mo baneng, basading le mo baaging ba ba senang molato.

src: Lokugadla ngetindiza kwahulumende we-Israyeli lokucotfula bantfu basePalestine, kuyachubeka kantsi nesibalo salabafile lokufaka ekhatsi basikati nebantfwana siyenyuka.
tgt: Polao ya Mapalestina e kete ke ditshenekegi ba bolawa ka difofane ke puso ya Iseraele e santse e tswelela mo dipalo tsa batho ba ba bolawang di tlhatlogang e bile di tsenyeletsang basadi le bana.

src: Kulamalanga lamabili ledlulile, umhlaba bewumile ubuka ungakhoni kwenta lutfo ngekugadla emoyeni lokunemandla eGaza naseWest Bank lokubhubhise tikolwa, takhiwo temphilo, ema-ambulensi kanye netakhiwo teluntfu kanye nemigwaco lekutsiwa iphephile kuya eNingizimu neGaza.
tgt: Mo matsatsing a le mabedi fela a a fetileng lefatshe le ne le itshwere ditlhogo le lebeletse difofane di tlhasela metse ya kwa Gaza le kwa West Bank mo go phampholotsweng dikolo, maokelo, dijanaga tsa balwetse le mafaratlhatlha a baagi mmogo le ditsela e leng dilo tse di neng di tshwanetse go bo di sa kgomiwe e bile di babalesegile ka ntlha ya fa e le dilo tse di sa tshwanelang go tlhaselwa kwa kgaolong ya Borwa jwa Gaza.

src: Ngenca yaloku, iKhabhinethi itsetse sincumo sekubita bonkhe labaseTel Aviv labamele lelive kuze bacocisane.
tgt: Ka ntlha ya tiragalo eno, Kabinete e tsere tshweetso ya go laela diambasatara tsotlhe tsa naga ya Aforika Borwa go phuthaphutha sengwe le sengwe sa puso eno kwa Tel Aviv go boela gae gore ba tle go itlhalosa sentle gore matsapa di a tsaya kae.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze yakubona kuchubeka kwetinkhulumo letinetinshanshu talolincusa le-Israyeli kuleli, Mnz.
tgt: Kabinete e nopotse gape le dipuo tse di swabisang nko tse di tswang mo molomong wa moabasatara wa naga ya Iseraele tse di ka ga naga ya Aforika Borwa, e bong Rre Eliav Belotsercovsky, yo a buang kgattlhanong le Aforika Borwa, le boeteledipele jwa Aforika Borwa fa a bua a le mo maemong a gagwe a puso le fa a bua a sa emela maemo a gagwe a puso yo a ganetsang gore se se diriwang ke puso ya Iseraele mo baaging ba Palestina ga se tshwane le seo Puso ya Jeremane e kileng ya se dira baagi ba Majuta.

src: Eliav Belotsercovsky, lebekatibhekise kutakhamuti teNingizimu Afrika, nakubaholi beNingizimu Afrika labakuhulumende kanye nangaphandle kwakhe, lokufaka ekhatsi imibutfo yeluntfu lekhuluma lokuphambene nalokubhujiswa kwebantfu basePalestine lokwentiwa nguhulumende we-Israyeli.
tgt: Dipuopuo tsa ga Moabasatara Belotsercovsky ga di tsamaisane ka gope le tseo di tswang mo melomong ya diambasatara di le pedi tsa mo nakong e e fetileng tsa Iseraele tse di neng di emetse naga ya tsona ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa (mme bona ke Illan Baruch mmogo le Ngaka Alon Liel) mme bona ba ne ba totobetse ka le le reng seo puso ya bona e se dirang mo go Mapalestina ga se farologane ka gope le seo puso ya tlhaolele e neng e se dira.

src: Letinkhulumo teLincusa Belotsercovisky letinekucekela phasi ticatsaniswa nalokwaphawulwa ngulabake baba ngemancusa e-Israyeli kuleli (Illan Baruch naDkt.
tgt: Dipuopuo tsa moambasatara yono tse di emang kgatlhanong le bao ba ntshang maikutlo a bona ka seo se sa itumediseng seo se diriwang ke baeteledipele ba naga eo se dira gore go se tlhole go nna le pelotelele ya go itshokela moambasatara Belotsercovsky.

src: Alon Liel) lebebangayekeli kuchaza tento tahulumende wabo kubantfu basePalestine batifananisa neMbuso Welibandlululo.
tgt: Mme ka ntlha ya seno, Kabinete e laetse Lefapha la Dikamano le Tirisano le Dinaga tsa Boditšhaba go begela moamasatara yono semmuso ka fao puso ya Aforika Borwa e swabisiwang ke dipuopuo tsa gagwe mme e dire jalo ka go latela dikgato tsa semmuso tsa setipolomate.

src: Letinkhulumo leticekela phasi letibhekiswe kulabo labaphumisela kuphambana kwabo nalokubulala lokunelunya kanye nebaholi balelive kwenta sikhundla saBelotsercovsky sichubeke kungameleki.
tgt: Puo ya Pholisi ya Tekanyetsokabo ya Kgweditharo (MTBPS) Kabinete e neseditse pula MTBPS ya ngwaga wa 2023, e e neng e baya mo pepeneneng maemo a ikonomi a re leng mo go ona mme e bontshitse le ka fao puso e kakatletseng ka gone mo mererong ya matlole a naga le fa go ntse go le boima mo go direng letseno.

src: Ngenca yaloko iKhabhinethi seyikhiphe umyalo wekutsi Litiko Lebudlelwane Kanye Nekuhlanganyela Nemave ledlulise kungaphatseki kahle kwahulumende weNingizimu Afrika ngalesento salelincusa lisebentisa tindlela tebuhlobo nalamanye emave.
tgt: Ditshwetso tse di tserweng mo go MTBPS di tla tokafatsa matlole a rona, tsa godisa ikonomi mmogo le go re thusa gore re diragatse ditsholofetso tsa rona mo go tlhokomeleng baagi ba ba tlhokang ditlogo ka fa nageng.

src: Inkhulumo Yenchubo Yemaphakelotimali Esikhatsi Esisemkhatsini IKhabhinethi isemukele Sitatimende Senchubo Yemaphaketimali Esikhatsi Esisemkhatsini (i-MTBPS), lesibeke elubala kuhlolwa kwesimo semnotfo saletinsuku yaphindze yabonisa kubambelela kwahulumende mayelana netimali talelive esikhatsini lapho kungena kwayo kunetihibe.
tgt: Leano la Itharabologelo le Kagosešwa ya Ikonomi le thusitse dikarolo di le dintsi mo ikonoming ya rona.

src: Tincumo leticuketfwe ngule-MTBPS tiyaluphakamisa luhlelo lwetimali temnyaka kukhutsatwa kwekukhula kwemnotfo kube kulinganisa nekutibophelela kwetfu eluntfwini lokusekela labo labasengcupheni esiveni sakitsi.
tgt: Go Agiwa ga Diterene tse di Tsamayang ka Lebelo Kabinete e neseditse pula Leano la go Tsamaisa Tiro ya Go Agiwa ga Diterene tse di Tsamayang ka Lebelo mme Tona ya Matlole mmogo le ya Dipalangwa ba tla atlhaatlha kgang ya gore go tla tlhokagala matlole a le kanakang.

src: 3.Kwakhiwa Kwemzila Wetitimela Letinelitubane Lelikhulu IKhabhinethi seyiphasise Luhlelo Loluluhlaka Lwekwakhiwa Kwemzila Wetitimela Letinelitubane Lelikhulu kantsi imitselela yekucaliswa kwaloluhlelo kutawudzingidvwa Tindvuna Tetekutfutsa kanye Netetimali.
tgt: Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go simolola ka diporo tsa go tloga kwa Johannesburg go leba kwa Durban gore go diriwe dipatlisiso tse di tseneletseng tsa gore go ka tlhokagala eng, mmogo le tsa go tloga kwa Johannesburg go leba kwa Polokwane le go fetela kwa Musina, mmogo le tsa Johannesburg go leba kwa Mbombela.

src: IKhabhinethi seyiphasise kubekwa embili kwemzila losemkhatsini weJozi kanye naseThekwini kwekutsi kube neluphandvo loluyibukisisako lendzaba, kulapho imizila emkhatsini weJozi nePolokwane naseMusina, kanye nalesemkhatsini neJozi neMbombela yona itawufakwa emakethe.
tgt: Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Masupatsela se se Buang ka go Bona Ditshwanelo tsa go Nna Moagi, Mofaladi le Tlhokomelo ya Batho ba ba Tshabetseng ka fa Nageng Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go phasalatsa Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Masupatsela se se Buang ka go Bona Ditshwanelo tsa go Nna Moagi, Mofaladi le Tlhokomelo ya Batho ba ba Tshabetseng ka fa Nageng gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo ka ga sona.

src: Umhlahlandlela WeLiphepha Lelimhlophe Lelimayelana Nekuvikelwa Kwebuve, Kungena Eveni kanye Nekukhosela IKhabhinethi seyiphasise kushicilelwa kweLiphepha Lelimhlophe Lelimayelana Nekuvikelwa Kwebuve, Kungena Eveni kanye Nekukhosela kuze sive sibeke imibono yaso.
tgt: Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe seno maitlhomo a sona ke go tla ka ditsela tse dintšhwa tsa go neela baagi ba dinaga tsa kwa ntle ditshwanelo tsa go nna baagi ba naga eno, mmogo le tsa go tlhokomela bafaladi le batho ba ba tshabetseng ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa, mme seno ga se ree gore go tla itlhokomoloswa melao ya pabalesego ya naga mmogo le go tswelela go ikobela ditumelano tsa dinaga tsa boditšhabatšhaba mmogo le melao e e tshwanetsweng go latelwa e e ka ga baagi ba ba tshabelang kwa dinageng tse dingwe eo naga ya Aforika Borwa e leng karolo ya dinaga tse di di saenetseng.

src: Lomhlahlandlela Wenchubo uhlose kubeka luhlaka lweticondziso tekuniketwa kwebuve nemvume yekuhlala kuleli kulabaphuma kulamanye emave, kanye nekuvikelwa kwalabakhosele kuleli laseNingizimu Afrika ngekubalekela timphi nekufuna kufihla inhloko ngenca yemphatfo yemave abo, ibe ingakhohlwa ngulokufunwa yiRiphabhliki mayelana netekuphepha kwelive ibuye ilandzele tivumelwano nenchubo yemave lecondzene netekuhamba emkhatsini wemave iNingizimu Afrika letibophelele kuko.
tgt: Pegelo ya Borataro ya Dikgatelopele tsa Ngwaga le Ngwaga ka ga go Tsenywa Tirisong Sekwalwa sa Masupatsela se se Buang ka Ditshwanelo tse Batho ba ba Nang le bogolofadi ba Nang le Tsona Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go gatisa mo Lekwalong la Semmuso le le Gatisang Melao ya Puso Pegelo ya Borataro ya Dikgatelopele tsa Ngwaga le Ngwaga ka ga go Tsenywa Tirisong Sekwalwa sa Masupatsela se se Buang ka Ditshwanelo tse Batho ba ba Nang le bogolofadi ba Nang le Tsona Go phasaladiwa ga pegelo ya dikgatelopele eno go tla diragadiwa ka nako e le nngwe le ya go ketekiwa ga Kgwedi ya Bosetšhaba ya Temososetšhaba ka ga Ditshwanelo tsa Batho ba ba nang le Bogolofadi e e simololang ka la bo 03 Ngwanaitseele le go garela ka la bo 03 Sedimonthole.

src: Umbiko Wesitfupha Wemnyaka Wenchubekela Embili Lomayelana Nekusetjentiswa KweLiphepha Lelimhlophe Lemalungelo Ebantfu Labakhubatekile IKhabhinethi seyiphasise kutsi Umbiko Wesitfupha Wemnyaka Wenchubekela Embili ngekusetjentiswa kweLiphepha Lelimhlophe Ngemalungelo Ebantfu Labakhubatekile ushicilelwe kugazethi yahulumende.
tgt: Pegelo eno ya dikgatelopele e bua gape le ka dipalo tse di tlhomilweng tse di tshwanetsweng go fitlhelelwa tsa diphatlhatiro tse di tshwanetseng go tlhodiwa gore di tloge mo go 2% mme di beewe mo go 3% mo bathong ba ba nang le bogolofadi mo ngwageng wa matlole wa 2024/2025, mme go lebeletswe gore di fetlhelele bonnye jwa 7% mo ngwageng wa 2030.

src: Lokushicilelwa kwalombiko wenchubekela embili kutawucondzana nekugujwa kweNyanga Yekwatisa Ngemalungelo Alabakhubatekile lokucala mhlaka ti-3 kuLweti kuya kumhla ti-3 iNgongoni.
tgt: Melaotlhomo Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo yo o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Letlole la Tirisano le Dinaga tsa Boditšhabatšhaba go Tsosolosa Aforika (ARF) Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go isa kwa Palamentent Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo yo o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa ARMaitlhomo a Molaotlhomo ono ke go kwalola sešwa Molao wa ARF wa ngwaga wa 2000 (Molao wa bo 51 wa 2000) mmogo le go dira gore go tlhomiwe Setheo sa Aforika Borwa sa Badirisanimmogo go Tlisa Tlhabologo, mme sona se tla ema nokeng dikgato tsa naga ya Aforika Borwa tsa go go tlisa tlhabologo le go tlisa tirisanommogo magareng ga dinaga tse di dirisanang le Aforika Borwa ka go tlotlomatsa temokerasi, tsamaiso e e lolameng ya ditheo tsa puso, go thibela le go rarabolola dintwa, go thusana le ikonomi le baagi mmogo le go bopa setšhaba se e leng seoposengwe.

src: Kubekwa Etikhundleni Kutawucinisekiswa ticu tetemfundvo nekuhlola kufaneleka kwabo bonkhe lababekwe etikhundleni.
tgt: Pele batho botlhe ba thapiwa go tla tlhatlhobiwa makwalo a bona a dithuto le ditlankana dingwe tse di tlhokagalang.

src: Kubekwa kwa-MnuEbrahim Rasool esikhundleni sekuba nguSihlalo we-Development Bank of Southern Africa.
tgt: Go thapiwa ga Rre Ebrahim Rasool go nna Monnasetulo wa Bankatlhabololo ya Dinaga tsa Borwa jwa Aforika.

src: Kubekwa kwa-MkMargaret Mosibudi kuba lilunga le-National Nuclear Regulator Board.
tgt: Go thapiwa ga Mme Margaret Mosibudi Phiri go nna tokololo ya Setheo sa Taolo ya Motlakase wa Naga.

src: Imicimbi Letako Ingcoco Yekumelana Nenkhohlakalo Ingcoco yekumelana nenkhohlakalo itawubanjwa mhlaka ti-8 namhla ti-9 kuLweti 2023 eHhotela i-Birchwood Ekurhuleni kutogcugcutela umphakatsi ekulweni nenkhohlakalo ngekuhambisana neNdlelalisu Yekumelana Nenkhohlakalo Eveni.
tgt: Ditiragalo tse di Tlang Dipuisano ka ga go Lwantshana le Bonweenwee Dipuisano ka ga go Lwantshana le Bonweenwee di tla tshwarwa ka la bo 08 le la bo 09 Ngwanaitseele 2023 kwa Birchwood Hotel kwa Ekurhuleni mo go tla ngokelwang setšhaba gore se ipope ngatana se eme kgatlhanong le bonweenwee go ya ka Leano la Naga la go Ema Kgatlhanong le Bonweenwee (NACS 2020-2030).

src: Ngenyanga yeLweti 2020, iKhabhinethi yaphasisa iNdlelalisu Yekumelana Nenkhohlakalo Eveni (i-NACS 2020-2030).
tgt: Kabinete mo ka Ngwanaitseele 2020 e ne ya nesetsa pula NACS 2020-2030.

src: Lena kuyindlela yelive lehlose kusungula umphakatsi longenankhohlakalo iphindze ikhutsate sive kutsi singayibeketeleli inkhohlakalo futsi sigcine umtsetfo lobekiwe.
tgt: Leno ke leano la naga le maitlhomo a lona e leng go dira gore ka fa nageng go se tlhole go nna le bonweenwee e bile le rotloetsa baagi gore ba se tlhole ba itshokela bonweenwee mme ba ikobele melao.

src: Umnkankaso Wemalanga Langu-16 Wekumelana Nekuhlukubetwa Kwebasikati kanye Nebantfwana wange-2023 Lomnyaka lesikuwo wekukhumbula minyaka lenge-25 yekuhlanganyela kweNingizimu Afrika kuloMkankaso Wemalanga langu-16 Wekumelana Nekuhlukubetwa Kwebasikati Nebantfwana lotawugujwa ngephasi kwesicubulo lesitsi: “Kukhutsatwa Kwetento Tekucedza Budlova Lobucondziswe Kubulili Lobutsite Nekubulawa Kwebasikati (i-GBVF): Asishiyi Muntfu Ngaphandle”.
tgt: Letsholo la Ngwaga wa 2023 la Matsatsing a le 16 la go Ema Kgatlhanong le Tirisodikgoka mo Basading le mo Baneng Monongwaga ke Mokete wa bo 25 wa go keteka tseokarolo ya naga ya Aforika Borwa mo Letsholong la Matsatsing a le 16 la go Ema Kgatlhanong le Tirisodikgoka mo Basading le mo Baneng mme lona le tla ka ketekiwa ka molaetsamogolo yo o reng: “Go Oketsa Lebelo la go Tsaya Dikgato tsa go Fedisa Tirisodikgoka le Polao ya Basadi le Bana: Ga go Ope yo go Itlhokomoloswang Ene”.

src: Lomkhankaso wemhlaba utawucala kusukela mhlaka ti-25 kuLweti, ngeLilanga Lemave Lekucedza Kuhlukubetwa Kwebasikati kuze kube ngumhla ti-10 kuNgongoni, lekuLilanga Lemave Lemalungelo Eluntfu.
tgt: Letsholo leno le tla simolola ka la bo 25 Ngwanaitseele, fa go tla bo go ketekiwa Letsatsi la Boditšhabatšhaba le Phediso ya Tirisodikgoka mo Basading mme le tla garelwa ka la bo 10 Sedimonthole, fa go tla bo go ketekiwa Letsatsi la Boditšhabatšhaba la Ditshwanelo tsa Batho.

src: Lomkhankaso uhlose kucedza kuhlukubetwa kwebasikati kodvwa kube kuphakanyiswa emalungelo eluntfu.
tgt: Maitlhomo a letsholo leno ke go lwantshana le tirisodikgoka mo basading fa ka fa letlhakoreng le lengwe le tsholetsa ditshwanelo tse batho ba nang le tsona.

src: Umhlangano Weli-14 Wengcoco Yenchubomgomo INingizimu Afrika itawubambisana neLicembu Lemave laboThishela le-UNESCO (i-TTF) kusingatsa uMhlangano Weli-14 Wengcoco Yenchubomgomo ngenyanga yaBhimbidvwane 2024, lotawubanjwa ngephasi kwesihloko lesitsi “Kubukana nekungabikho kwabothishela ngalokwenele nekwenta lomsebenti wekufundzisa ube ngulokhangisako”.
tgt: Kopano ya bo 14 ya go Buisana ka Pholisi Naga ya Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Kopano ya bo 14 ya go Buisana ka Pholisi mmogo le Setlhopha sa Tiro sa Baromiwa ba Merero ya Barutabana Lefatshe ka Bophara (TTF) ba Mokgatlho wa Dinagakopano mo Mererong ya Thuto, Saense le Setso (UNESCO) ka Ferikgong 2024 ka molaetsamogolo yo o reng, “Go samagana le kgwetlho ya go tlhaela ga barutabana mmogo le go dira gore tiro eno e nne e e ngokelang”.

src: Lomhlangano utawubutsanisa tisebenti tahulumende, bothishela kanye netingcweti temfundvo kutodzingidza ndzaba letiphatselene nesimo sekusebenta kwabothishela, tindzaba tekukhutimela kwabothishela ekusebenteni kwabo kanye nekutiphendvulela nekwenta umsebenti wekufundzisa ukhangeke.
tgt: Foramo eno e tla tsenelwa ke batlhankedi ba puso, Mekgatlho e e sa Direng Letseno (di-NGO), barutabana mmogo le baitseanape mo mererong ya thuto mme ba tla bo ba tshwaraganetse kgetse ya tsie e e ka ga maemo mo ditirong tsa bona, go ikemela ka bobona jaaka barutabana mmogo le go rweswa maikarabelo mmogo le ka ga seo se ka diriwang go dira gore batho ba nne le lerato la go fisegela go ka nna barutabana.

src: Licembu lema-Proteas ngekutibekela indzawo ekucudzelaneni lokwendvulela umdlalo wekugcina wekhilikithi weNdzebe Yemhlaba ye-ICC 2023 eNdiya.
tgt: Setlhopha sa di-Protea jaaka se kgonne go phunyeletsa kwa makgaolakgannyeng kwa Metshamekong ya Sejana sa Lefatshe ya Kerikete e e tshamekelwang kwa nageng ya India.

src: Nobe kube khona kubuyiselwa emuva emdlalweni wabo neNdiya itolo, live lakitsi lime lisimile ngekusekela lelicembu futsi liyetsemba kwekutsi licembu litawuchubeka kwakha nekusenta sitichenye.
tgt: Le fa se reteletswe ke go ka fopha setlhopha sa India maabane, setšhaba sa rona se tswelela go ba ema nokeng e bile se na le tshepo e e tletseng ya gore ba tla tswelela go dira bontle mo metshamekong ya bona le go re dira motlotlo.

src: Sihlabani semjako we-Moto GP, Brad Binder, losenyalo ente umlandvo wema ephodiyamu yalabahamba embili wamela iNingizimu Afrika kulandzela kuphumelela kwakhe waba kulabatsatfu labasembili emjahweni i-Grand prix eThailand.
tgt: Moganka wa Metshameko ya Mabelo a Dijanaga ya Moto GP e bong Brad Binder yo ga jaanong e leng moganka wa maemo a a kwa godimo ka go se sute mo maemong a gagwe yo a emetseng naga ya Aforika Borwa morago ga gore a dire bontle kwa metshamekong ya Thailand Grand Prix.

src: Umdlali waseNingizimu Afrika walabakha ticubu temtimba nalohamba ngencola yalabakhubatekile, Macethandile Kulati ngekuvikela sicoco sakhe Emdlalweni wanga-2023 Wenhlangano Yemave Yabombetsa Labakha Ticubu Temtimba eSlovania.
tgt: Rra dikgoka wa moAforika Borwa wa ntlha wa metshameko ya batho ba ba tsamayang ka ditiloteti, e bong Macethandile Kulati, jaaka a santse a tshwere maemo a gagwe mo metshamekong ya ngwaga wa 2023 ya Dikgaisano tsa Boditšhabatšhaba tsa Batshameki ba Lefatshe ka Bophara ba Metshameko ya go Kuka Ditshipi le go Ikwetlisa e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Slovenia.

src: Ngasetibalweni tetimali, i-South African Chartered Accountants lebambe lichaza lelisetulu eluphandvweni lwabochwepheshe emhlabeni jikelele lolwentiwe yi-Edelman.
tgt: Batlhankedi ba Ditiro tsa Chartered Accountants jaaka ba fitlheletse maemo a a kwa godimo mo dipatlisisong tsa botshepegi mo tirong eno lefatshe ka bophara tsa Edelman.

src: Dkt Calude Mashego ngekutsatsa sicoco sekubekwa abe yiNkhosatana yeMhlaba eNingizimu Afrika, losatawumela live laseNingizimu Afrika emcudzelwaneni wesicoco semhlaba seNkhosatana Yemhlaba lotawubanjelwa e-New Delhi, eNdiya ngeNgongoni lonyaka.
tgt: Ngaka Claude Mashego jaaka a fentse dikgaisano tsa Aforika Borwa tsa Bommabontle ba Lefatshe mme o tla emela naga ya Aforika Borwa kwa dikgaisanong tsa Bommabontle ba Lefatshe tse di tla tshwarelwang kwa New Delhi, kwa India ka Sedimonthole monongwaga.

src: UMmeli Kholeka Gcaleka kulandzela kubekwa kwakhe kutsi abe nguMvikeli Weluntfu lomusha lokutawuba sikhatsi lesiminyaka lesikhombisa letako kusukela mhlaka lu-1 kuLweti 2023.
tgt: Moatefokate Kholeka Gcaleka jaaka a thapilwe go nna motlhankedi yo montšhwa yo a tla okamang maemo a Mosireletsi wa Setšhaba sebaka sa dingwaga di le supa go simolola ka la bo 01 Ngwanaitseele 2023.

src: Kuvusetelwa Nekukhula Kwemnotfo Luklayo Lwekota Lwetemisebenti (i-QLFS) Ikhabhinethi iyayemukela imiphumela ye-QLFS yekota yesitsatfu, yanga-2023 njengaloku ikhishwe Lubalobalo lwaseNingizimu Afrika lekhombe tibalo tekucasha letibe ngetulu kwemazinga ekucasha ngembi kwe-COVID-19.
tgt: Merero ya ga Jaanong Tsosoloso le Kgolo ya Ikonomi Dipatlisiso tsa Kgweditharo tsa Dipalopalo tsa Badiri (QLFS) Kabinete e amogetse Pegelo ya kotara ya boraro ya ngwaga wa 2023 ya QLFS e e gololotsweng ke ba Setheo sa Dipatlisiso tsa Dipalopalo sa Aforika Borwa (StatsSA) e e bontshang gore dipalopalo tsa batho ba ba nang le ditiro di setse jaanong di tlhatlogile go feta le tseo di neng di le teng mo matsatsing a pele ga COVID-19.

src: Ikhabhinethi ijabulile kutsi tonkhe tifundza ngaphandle nje kwasinye tifake ligalelo kulelinani le-399 000 lekwenyuka kwebantfu labacashiwe labenta samba sesisonkhe sebantfu labatigidzi le-16.7 labacashiwe ngekota yesitsatfu, nakucatsaniswa kusigidzi le-16.3 sebantfu ngekota yesibili nga-2023.
tgt: Kabinete e itumedisiwa ke gore diporofense tsotlhe, ntle le e le esi fela, di dirile gore palo ya batho ba ba nang le ditiro e oketsege ka bokanaka 399 000 mo jaanong batho botlhe ba ba nang le ditiro ba leng kanaka dimilione di le 16,7 mo kotareng ya boraro, fa di bapisiwa le dimilione di le 16,3 mo kotareng ya bobedi mo ngwageng wa 2023.

src: Leligalelo lelikhulu lekengeteka kwemisebenti kaKwaZulu-Natal (kwenyuke nga-152 000), eLimpopo (kwenyuke nge-70 000), eNyakatfo Nshonalanga (kwenyuke nge-61 000) kwatsi iMpumalanga, yakhombisa kancane kodvwa ngendlela lesimeme kufezekiswa kwenjongo yeLuhlelo Lekwakha Kabusha Nekuvusetelwa Kwemnotfo lekwakha ncono, ngemandla nangekufaka wonkhe wonkhe.
